scope: Listed entrances and published transport; stock, charges, quest stages and encounter supplies are separate.

abalone cliffs.name: Abalone Cliffs
abalone cliffs.summary: Abalone Cliffs are cliffs located in The Great Conch. The cliffs are inhabited by eagles, tiny scorpions, and snakes. Additionally, orange salamanders can be hunted here.
travel: Abalone Cliffs are cliffs located in The Great Conch.
caveats: Give Floopa the bandage during Troubled Tortugans. Charter ships/fairy ring CJQ avoid imposing the 45 Sailing mooring requirement on every route.

abandoned mine.name: Abandoned Mine
abandoned mine.summary: The Mort Ridge mines, are an old and deserted, hence more commonly known as the Abandoned Mine, multi-level mine complex under Morytania that once were the site of an extensive mining operation. They have since been abandoned and partially flooded by the River Salve. The mine features prominently in the Haunted Mine quest. The mine has six levels. It has many ore veins, which yield clay, tin, copper, iron, coal, mithril, and adamantite ore, and the crystal mine. In the quest, you cut a piece of crystal to make a salve amulet. After the quest, you can cut more crystal to make a new amulet if you lost your salve amulet. The mine also contains the entrance to Tarn's Lair which can be found through a passageway in the northern part of the mine's level 1. This is the location of The Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest, in which you can fight Tarn Razorlor and enchant a salve amulet. The lair also has terror dogs, which are sometimes assigned as Slayer tasks.
transportNotes: It can be accessed somewhat quickly and with low requirements by using fairy ring code Fairy ring BIP, crossing the River Salve via the shortcut (requiring 50 Agility), and running south. Also of mention is using the Morytania legs 3 teleport (or Drakan's medallion teleport to Slepe, then boat travel to Burgh de Rott) and running west to use the fence shortcut (requiring 25 Agility).
travel: The mine also contains the entrance to Tarn's Lair which can be found through a passageway in the northern part of the mine's level 1.

abyssal area.name: Abyssal Area
abyssal area.summary: The Abyssal Area can be accessed by using the code Fairy ring ALR in the fairy rings network (must have started Fairytale II - Cure a Queen). It is one of several areas in Abyssal Space, and as such is inhabited by the Abyss' denizens. Abyssal demons can also be found in this section of the Abyss; however, the demons here are rarely killed unless part of Konar quo Maten's Slayer assignment due to them being spread out and the other monsters being aggressive. Since the Abyssal Area is the whole plane itself, players assigned abyssal demons in the Abyss may alternatively kill the Abyssal Sire. Unlike the Abyss, it is not a multi-combat area. There is only one fairy ring in the south-east corner of the cavern, and the only other exit is via teleport. When entering you are neither skulled nor drained of prayer, as the fairy ring teleports players here, not the Mage of Zamorak. It may be safer to obtain essence pouches here as you will not need to cross the Wilderness first and risk your gear, nor will you have multiple monsters fighting you at once. A dwarf multicannon cannot be used in the Abyssal Area. The abyssal leeches, walkers, and guardians provide 75% less experience when fought. This experience reduction does not apply to the abyssal demons.
travel: The Abyssal Area can be accessed by using the code Fairy ring ALR in the fairy rings network (must have started Fairytale II - Cure a Queen).

Abyssal demons can also be found in this section of the Abyss; however, the demons here are rarely killed unless part of Konar quo Maten's Slayer assignment due to them being spread out and the other monsters being aggressive.

abyssal nexus.name: Abyssal Nexus
abyssal nexus.summary: The Abyssal Nexus is an area connected to the Runecrafting Abyss. Described as the lungs of an unfathomably large chthonian demon named Hostilius, it is inhabited by four Abyssal Sires, a higher order of abyssal demons, who were imprisoned within the Nexus during the God Wars along with The Overseer. The Nexus can be accessed via a one-way entrance in the southern part of the outer ring of the Abyss. Players entering the abyss in this manner will be skulled, unless wearing an abyssal bracelet, and will lose all their prayer points. Alternatively, players who have partially completed Fairytale II - Cure a Queen can safely reach the Nexus using the code Fairy ring DIP in the fairy ring network. The centre of the Nexus contains the Font of Consumption, behind The Overseer, where players can place the unsired and receive valuable items. Near the entrances to the individual chambers are eyes on the floor that can be inspected to check if there are any players fighting the Sire. In addition, there is an appendage north of the Overseer, marked by an icon , that teleports players to Lumbridge when pulled.
travel: The Nexus can be accessed via a one-way entrance in the southern part of the outer ring of the Abyss.
Near the entrances to the individual chambers are eyes on the floor that can be inspected to check if there are any players fighting the Sire.
abyssal nexus.confirmation: Confirm fairy ring DIP access, or the Enter the Abyss approach (Wilderness, skull and Prayer-drain risk).

agility pyramid.name: Agility Pyramid
agility pyramid.summary: The Agility Pyramid, also known as the Jaleustrophos Pyramid (meaning Tomb of the Agile in an old desert language), is an Agility training area located in the Kharidian Desert, between Sophanem and Nardah, available to players with level 30 Agility. On this course, players start at the bottom of a pyramid with the goal of reaching the top, where they are able to collect the pyramid top. Players have to successfully traverse each of the five layers of the pyramid, which are filled with obstacles that force the player back to the previous layer upon failure to pass them. Pyramid tops may be handed in to Simon Templeton in exchange for coins each and respawn only when the player has entered the doorway at the top of the pyramid. Level 75 Agility or higher ensures success on all of the obstacles, making it possible to complete a maximum of 26 laps per hour, which rewards a maximum of 44,700 experience per hour. In addition, players doing a hard Clue Scroll may be sent here as one of the steps requires climbing to the top of the pyramid to complete it.
transportNotes: There are several different methods for travelling to the Agility Pyramid. The best options, ordered from fast to slow, are:
Use the Jaleustrophos teleport of the pharaoh's sceptre.
Teleport to Nardah using a Nardah teleport, desert amulet 2, 3, or 4, and run south-west.
Camulet teleport and run south-east.
Have the player-owned house at Pollnivneach and cast Teleport to House (or use a scroll of redirection on a Teleport to House tablet). From here, either:
Take a magic carpet to Sophanem (requires starting Icthlarin's Little Helper), and run north-east to the pyramid.
Run south to the Agility Pyramid.
Take a magic carpet to Nardah and walk south-west from Nardah.
travel: The Agility Pyramid, also known as the Jaleustrophos Pyramid (meaning Tomb of the Agile in an old desert language), is an Agility training area located in the Kharidian Desert, between Sophanem and Nardah, available to players with level 30 Agility.
In addition, players doing a hard Clue Scroll may be sent here as one of the steps requires climbing to the top of the pyramid to complete it.

ah za rhoon.name: Ah Za Rhoon
ah za rhoon.summary: Ah Za Rhoon, which means Magnificence Floating on Water in an ancient language, was an ancient temple in Karamja that was built by Zadimus and destroyed by Rashiliyia. After being lost for many years, the temple became a legend, making many doubt its existence. This temple is visited during the Shilo Village quest.
transportNotes: To get to the temple from Tai Bwo Wannai, go east to the river, cross the log near the crashed glider, and go south along the river until you reach a mound of earth.

Use your spade on it to find a fissure. If you haven't done so already, use a lit light source on the fissure to light up the temple below. (Warning: don't use an expensive light source as you will lose it. Therefore, it is recommended to use a candle or torch). Next, add a rope to the fissure, securing it to the lip. Search the fissure again to climb down into the dungeon below (32 Agility required). After a short period of time the fissure will be covered in earth again - use your spade to uncover the fissure, and the rope and torch will still be in place.
travel: Ah Za Rhoon, which means Magnificence Floating on Water in an ancient language, was an ancient temple in Karamja that was built by Zadimus and destroyed by Rashiliyia.

al kharid.name: Al Kharid
al kharid.summary: Al Kharid is a large city in the north of the Kharidian Desert, and the only desert city open to non-members. Players in the city do not suffer from the desert effect. Al Kharid is popular among free-to-play players because it contains one of the closest banks to a range and to a furnace, two reasonably close fishing spots, and a tanner, Ellis. Also popular is the nearby mining site, which contains almost all ores up to and including adamant.
transportNotes: — Emir's Arena, just north-east of Al Kharid.
— near to the Fire Altar entrance, north of the city.
— Sorceress's Garden. Usable once every 20 minutes, and only after asking Osman/Selim if they need any help.
— Shantay Pass, just south of the city.
— Kalphite cave, near the Shantay Pass.
— inside the cow field, just beyond the western gate.
— Lumbridge Castle, decently west of the city.

From Lumbridge, players can use the toll gate which costs either 10 coins, or nothing if you have completed the Prince Ali Rescue quest. Alternatively, members can use the level 8 Agility shortcut to grapple to and from the Lumbridge Swamp.
travel: Al Kharid is a large city in the north of the Kharidian Desert, and the only desert city open to non-members.

al kharid mine.name: Al Kharid mine
al kharid mine.summary: The Al Kharid mine (also called Scorpion mine or Al Kharid Mining pit) is a Mining area located just north of the desert city of Al Kharid. The mine is advantageous because it is near a bank and a furnace and is located in a very low-risk location for its high-value infrequent rocks, such as gold, mithril, and adamantite. In addition, this mine is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for power-mining.
travel: The Al Kharid mine (also called Scorpion mine or Al Kharid Mining pit) is a Mining area located just north of the desert city of Al Kharid.
The mine is advantageous because it is near a bank and a furnace and is located in a very low-risk location for its high-value infrequent rocks, such as gold, mithril, and adamantite.

aldarin.name: Aldarin
aldarin.summary: Aldarin is a large island off the south-west coast of Varlamore. It is a lush and luxurious location, inhabited by wealthy citizens who live in villas, though its rocky south and west coasts are inhabited by dwarves and bandits. The island is most known for the famous Moonrise Brewery and Winery, the oldest producer of alcohol in Varlamore. It is also home to the main facility of the Alchemical Society, an organisation of herbalists who fuse techniques left behind by the Old Ones with traditional druidic practices to advance the study of Herblore.
transportNotes: There are several ways to reach Aldarin:
Using the western ship from Sunset Coast. Requires paying Antonia 20 coins.
Using the Quetzal Transport System.
Minigame Teleport to Mastering Mixology. Requires 60 Herblore (20 minute cooldown).
Casting Teleport to house if the player-owned house is in Aldarin; otherwise a Teleport to house tablet with a scroll of redirection (requiring 35 Construction), or the Construction cape.
Using Fairy Ring Fairy ring CKQ.
North Aldarin teleport via the Pendant of Ates (Requires completion of Death on the Isle and subsequent activation of the North Aldarin statue, see here for details).
travel: Aldarin is a large island off the south-west coast of Varlamore.
It is a lush and luxurious location, inhabited by wealthy citizens who live in villas, though its rocky south and west coasts are inhabited by dwarves and bandits.

alice's farm.name: Alice's farm
alice's farm.summary: Alice's farm is a farm located west of Port Phasmatys and east of Canifis. It's managed by Alice and her now-ethereal husband Malcolm. The farm is involved in the Animal Magnetism quest and also the locations of several undead chickens and undead cows. Alice's Farming Shop can be accessed by either talking or right-clicking Alice. West of the farm, one can find two allotments, a herb patch, and a flower patch. Alice's daughter, Lyra, attends the allotments for a payment. There's also a tool leprechaun and a compost bin.
transportNotes: Use the Ectophial to the Ectofuntus and run west
Fairy ring code Fairy ring ALQ and run north (be careful of level 61 Feral Vampyres)
Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport from the Arceuus spellbook and run east
Take a Charter ship to Port Phasmatys and run west
travel: Alice's farm is a farm located west of Port Phasmatys and east of Canifis.
Alice's Farming Shop can be accessed by either talking or right-clicking Alice.

ancient cavern.name: Ancient Cavern
ancient cavern.summary: The Ancient Cavern is an area reached from the whirlpool near Otto Godblessed's house. Players must dive into the whirlpool to enter the cavern, which contains many high-level monsters, including a high level metal dragon, the mithril dragon. The cavern can only be accessed after the player has completed the first part of Barbarian Firemaking, requiring level 35 Firemaking. After that, the player must ask Otto about making pyre ships, and then will be granted access to the dungeon in order to fulfil the objectives required to make them. If a player dives into the whirlpool before completing these tasks, they will be swept away, losing a small amount of their hitpoints, eventually washing up on the shore near Hadley's house. In order to leave the dungeon, the player must either teleport or use one of two aged logs near the body of water. The logs will bring the player to shore south-east of Baxtorian Falls. Dwarf multicannons cannot be used here. If attempted, players will receive the message:
transportNotes: The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost near Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut north-east of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)
Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:

A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is the quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost. Minigame Teleport to Barbarian Assault can also be used, requiring having gone through the tutorial for Barbarian Assault, and it can only be cast once every 20 minutes.
Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during Slayer tasks.

Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and then use the shortcut north of the Grand Tree to get to the Baxtorian Falls lake. Additionally, players who have completed Monkey Madness II may use the royal seed pod to teleport to the Grand Tree.
Players with level 99 Fishing can use the Fishing cape to teleport to Otto's Grotto and run to the whirlpool from there.
travel: The cavern can only be accessed after the player has completed the first part of Barbarian Firemaking, requiring level 35 Firemaking.
After that, the player must ask Otto about making pyre ships, and then will be granted access to the dungeon in order to fulfil the objectives required to make them.

ancient guthixian temple.name: Ancient Guthixian Temple
ancient guthixian temple.summary: The Ancient Guthixian Temple is an ancient temple devoted to Guthix that was primarily built to house the Stone of Jas. The druids who built the temple created a complex system that was meant to keep intruders out. Found at the bottom of the Chasm of Tears, it is accessed by attracting a light creature with a sapphire lantern to ride down into the chasm. The player must then run south and climb up two stone walls to reach the entrance. Alternatively, players can teleport to the temple with a Guthixian temple teleport. During the events of While Guthix Sleeps, the whereabouts of the Stone of Jas are discovered to be at the bottom of the Chasm of Tears. The player, pretending to be Surok Magis in order to get past Movario and Darve, opens a huge door within the temple to reach the Stone of Jas. The Stone was protected by the Balance Elemental, a Guardian created by Guthix, and remained there since the end of the God Wars until it was stolen by Lucien, a Mahjarrat who also possesses the Staff of Armadyl. Once descending into the chasm players cannot set up a dwarf multicannon anywhere within the temple. Attempting to do so yields the chatbox message: "A strange magical force won't let you set up a cannon here."
travel: Found at the bottom of the Chasm of Tears, it is accessed by attracting a light creature with a sapphire lantern to ride down into the chasm.
The player must then run south and climb up two stone walls to reach the entrance.

ancient pyramid.name: Ancient Pyramid
ancient pyramid.summary: The Ancient Pyramid, also known as the Jaldraocht Pyramid, meaning Tomb of Magic in an old desert language, is located south of the Bandit Camp in the Kharidian Desert. It is a key location in the quest Desert Treasure I, and upon its completion, can be used by players to switch their spellbook to Ancient Magicks or back, as well as create magic tablets for Ancient Magicks teleports via the nearby lectern. During the quest, players must use the main entrance of the pyramid to get in, which requires them to run past attacking creatures (see below) while dodging traps. The pyramid has four levels, each of which is larger in width than the last. Some players consider getting through to be of some difficulty, as the traps will send the player back to the entrance. After the completion of the quest, players may use the south entrance to return to the centre of the pyramid without frustration. After completion of the Desert Treasure I quest, players can buy the ancient staff from Eblis for 80,000 coins. If they happen to lose it, they can buy one from another player or kill mummies inside the pyramid for another. Various sarcophagi can be found within the pyramid, and can be looted, yielding small treasure such as gems, gold bars, and sapphire rings.
transportNotes: Various methods exist for reaching the Ancient Pyramid:
The fastest way to reach the pyramid is to use the Jaldraocht teleport of the Pharaoh's sceptre.

The second fastest way is by using a Camulet and teleporting to Enahkra's temple just north-west of the pyramid, following the completion of the hard Desert Diary. Without the hard Desert Diary completed the teleport will be inside the temple, and you will have to navigate out.

Teleport to the POH portal in Pollnivneach using a Pollnivneach teleport tablet (or Teleport to House for players who have their houses located in Pollnivneach) and run south, through Pollnivneach, around the cliffs then west to the pyramid. This is the third fastest way.
Use a Nardah teleport scroll and run west across the bridge to the pyramid.
Use the Fairy ring code Fairy ring BIQ (Kalphite Hive) and run south-west around cliffs, then south-east to the Pyramid.

From Al Kharid (you can teleport there using charged amulet of glory, ring of dueling or the Minigame Teleport for Giant's Foundry, or you can fly a Gnome glider) take the ferry via Ferryman Sathwood to the Ruins of Unkah. Enter the desert (you will need a Shantay pass to go into the desert; you can buy one from the guard there for 5 coins), then run north to the pyramid.
travel: The Ancient Pyramid, also known as the Jaldraocht Pyramid, meaning Tomb of Magic in an old desert language, is located south of the Bandit Camp in the Kharidian Desert.
During the quest, players must use the main entrance of the pyramid to get in, which requires them to run past attacking creatures (see below) while dodging traps.

ape atoll.name: Ape Atoll
ape atoll.summary: Ape Atoll is an island in the Ardent Ocean of Gielinor, home to a vibrant population of monkeys. The settlement of Marim, where the monkeys reside, is under the rule of King Awowogei. It is only accessible to players who have partially or fully completed the Monkey Madness I quest. Players who have not taken the form of a monkey using a greegree will find themselves the target of aggressive creatures throughout the island. Being spotted by the monkey locals or interacting with them may result in the player being knocked out and sent to the prison in Marim. However, upon completion of Monkey Madness II, a greegree becomes unnecessary for this purpose as all surface inhabitants become tolerant towards the player. Monkey zombies and skeletal apes remain aggressive to those without a greegree, however. The island is teeming with dangers including Ninja Monkey Archers and Ninja Monkey Guards, Gorilla Monkey Guards, poison-inducing jungle snakes and spiders, and environmental hazards such as a collapsing cave. As a result, Ape Atoll is widely regarded as one of the most hazardous regions in Old School RuneScape, particularly for those new to the challenges it presents.
transportNotes: Initial access to Ape Atoll requires the player to first travel via Lumdo on Crash Island during Monkey Madness I. To get there, speak to Daero on the 1 of the Grand Tree. From there, have Waydar fly you to Crash Island.
There are several alternative transportation methods available after completion of Monkey Madness I:

A Fairy ring (Fairy ring CLR) will take players to the Ape Atoll Agility Course. 48 Agility and a ninja monkey greegree are required to exit the course and travel to the city. One can exit the course by failing the rope obstacle in human form (however this still requires level 48 Agility to attempt the obstacle).

The level 64 Ape Atoll Teleport is available in the normal spellbook after Freeing King Awowogei during Recipe for Disaster. The spell takes the player to the safe upstairs section of the Temple of Marimbo in the north-east corner of Ape Atoll.
The level 90 Ape Atoll Teleport in the Arceuus spellbook, as well as the equivalent magic tablet, takes players to the Ape Atoll Dungeon on the southern part of the island.

The Gnome glider network can take players to the north-west of the island after completion of Monkey Madness II by choosing the Ookookolly Undri destination. The fastest way to access the glider network is by climbing to the top floor of the Grand Tree.
travel: Grand Tree: Daero, then Waydar
Crash Island: speak to Lumdo
Ape Atoll: follow the relevant temple or tunnel entrance
caveats: A greegree and quest travel steps may still be needed. Monkey Madness II removes surface hostility, not all dungeon dangers.

ape atoll dungeon.name: Ape Atoll Dungeon
ape atoll dungeon.summary: The Ape Atoll Dungeon (also known as Zooknock's Tunnel) can be found in the southern jungle of Ape Atoll. It is infested with extremely strong monsters and traps. It is advised to have 43 Prayer when exploring this dungeon, in order to protect against the melee attacks from the monsters inside. If you are doing Monkey Madness I, then it is strongly recommended that you bring plenty of stamina or energy potions, super antipoison potions and lots of food. Completion of Monkey Madness II does not make the mobs non-aggressive.
transportNotes: Access to the island Ape Atoll is obtained through the quest Monkey Madness I.

You can go to the dungeon on Ape Atoll by going to the 1 of the Grand Tree and speaking to Daero on the east side. He will then take you to a bunker where you can speak to Waydar who will take you to Crash Island, from which you can speak to Lumdo to visit Ape Atoll near the dungeon.

After completion of Monkey Madness I, there is a teleport spell in the Arceuus spellbook, requiring level 90 Magic to cast, as well as the equivalent magic tablet, which takes players to the tunnels of Ape Atoll Dungeon.
travel: Grand Tree: Daero, then Waydar
Crash Island: speak to Lumdo
Ape Atoll: follow the relevant temple or tunnel entrance
caveats: A greegree and quest travel steps may still be needed. Monkey Madness II removes surface hostility, not all dungeon dangers.

apsul hunting ground.name: Apsul Hunting Ground
apsul hunting ground.summary: Apsul Hunting Ground is a wooded area in Vampyrium, just south of Sangvesti, containing venators and bloodwood trees. There is a plateau atop which letvek can be hunted, with an Agility shortcut leading to the top.
travel: Apsul Hunting Ground is a wooded area in Vampyrium, just south of Sangvesti, containing venators and bloodwood trees.

arandar.name: Arandar
arandar.summary: Arandar is a mountain pass leading to Tirannwn that may be used by players upon completion of the Regicide quest. Players may use the pass to access the elven lands without having to travel through the Underground Pass again. Prior to completion, the huge gate is a one-way exit, leading to the forest south-west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. The pass was constructed by the elves after the God Wars as part of "The Break Out".
travel: Players may use the pass to access the elven lands without having to travel through the Underground Pass again.
Prior to completion, the huge gate is a one-way exit, leading to the forest south-west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

arceuus.name: Arceuus
arceuus.summary: Arceuus (pronounced ) is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend. Led by Lord Trobin Arceuus of the Arceuus House, the city is inhabited by Citizens of Arceuus, immortal beings who commit themselves to studying magic through the Dark Altar, a mysterious altar whose powers extend to life and death, expanding their Magic abilities and producing runes for the region. A majority of those who reside in Arceuus are former humans who, through the power of the Dark Altar, are able to achieve immortality by moving their soul from their mortal body into an incorporeal one. Their souls are freed from the mortal bodies in the crypt below the church, and take on the incorporeal form commonly seen among Arceuus residents. The art of runecrafting has been known by the Arceuus since at least 150 years before the wave of visitors from the mainland arrived. However, they were unable to create law runes, explaining the lack of teleportation spells, save for those used by Xeric. However, a book titled Transvergence Theory documents the differences between runecrafting in the mainland and runecrafting in Arceuus. While the mainland uses talismans to teleport individuals to another dimension, runecrafters in Arceuus use energy that emanates from the ground near the Dark Altar to change the essence. Arceuus is closest to the Northern Tundras of Great Kourend, and is the first line of defence against the Wintertodt, a mysterious entity that brings along with it extremely harsh cold.
transportNotes: There are several methods to quickly reach Arceuus:
Kourend Castle Teleport - Run north
Arceuus Home Teleport to Dark Altar
Lovakengj Minecart Network to Arceuus
Xeric's talisman - Xeric's Heart teleport and run north
Games necklace - Wintertodt teleport and run south
Transport by ship to Port Piscarilius via Veos at the dock south of the pub in Port Sarim or from Land's End by via Captain Magoro.

Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead - A Dark Disposition teleport (required completion of The Ascent of Arceuus. Optionally, The Fisher's Flute teleport (requires completion of The Queen of Thieves) to Port Piscarilius can be used, then run west.
travel: The art of runecrafting has been known by the Arceuus since at least 150 years before the wave of visitors from the mainland arrived.
Arceuus is closest to the Northern Tundras of Great Kourend, and is the first line of defence against the Wintertodt, a mysterious entity that brings along with it extremely harsh cold.

ardougne.name: Ardougne
ardougne.summary: Ardougne ( ) is the capital city of the Kingdom of Kandarin. It is divided into East Ardougne and West Ardougne. West Ardougne is closed off to the general public because of a mysterious "plague" affecting the inhabitants, but you can slowly gain complete access by completing the first few quests of the Plague City quest line.
transportNotes: Ardougne Teleport - requires level 51 Magic and completion of the Plague City quest.
West Ardougne Teleport - requires level 51 Magic and completion of the Biohazard quest.
Spirit tree (Battlefield of Khazard) south-west of the city below the south wall of West Ardougne.
Captain Barnaby's ship to and from Brimhaven, Rimmington, and East Ardougne.
Ardougne Monastery using an Ardougne cloak 1 or better.
The farming patch east of the Fishing Guild using an Ardougne cloak 2 or better.
travel: It is divided into East Ardougne and West Ardougne.

West Ardougne is closed off to the general public because of a mysterious "plague" affecting the inhabitants, but you can slowly gain complete access by completing the first few quests of the Plague City quest line.

ardougne sewers.name: Ardougne Sewers
ardougne sewers.summary: The Ardougne Sewers are an extensive dungeon system underneath East Ardougne and part of West Ardougne. Currently, players have access to three separate sections of the sewers, most of which are visited during various quests.
travel: The Ardougne Sewers are an extensive dungeon system underneath East Ardougne and part of West Ardougne.
Currently, players have access to three separate sections of the sewers, most of which are visited during various quests.
ardougne sewers.confirmation: Confirm the relevant sewer section: Clock Tower valve, Hazeel Cult route or Ratcatchers basement; they are not interchangeable.
caveats: Three disconnected sewer sections have different entrances and quest steps.

ardougne zoo.name: Ardougne Zoo
ardougne zoo.summary: The Ardougne Zoo, located in the southern part of East Ardougne, holds a variety of creatures gathered from across Gielinor. It is currently the only zoo in Old School RuneScape, and is involved in a handful of quests. The Ardougne Zoo is the only place outside of Ape Atoll where the player can use a monkey greegree.
transportNotes: Ardougne cloak teleport to the Ardougne Monastery and run north
Fairy ring code Fairy ring DJP to teleport near the Tower of Life and run north-west
Code Fairy ring BIS can be used to go directly inside the unicorn pen
Spirit tree to the Khazard Battlefield and run east
Ardougne teleport and run south-west from the city centre
Charter a ship to Ardougne (run south-west) or Port Khazard and run (north-west)
travel: The Ardougne Zoo, located in the southern part of East Ardougne, holds a variety of creatures gathered from across Gielinor.

asgarnian ice dungeon.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
asgarnian ice dungeon.summary: The Asgarnian Ice Dungeon is a moderately large dungeon in Asgarnia. It is found south of Port Sarim and north of Mudskipper Point, Fairy ring AIQ, under a trapdoor. Look for the red exclamation sign () on the minimap, which indicates a dungeon. This dungeon is particularly dangerous to low level players, as every single monster within it is aggressive. The dungeon is also crucial to the The Knight's Sword quest as this is the only location in Gielinor that contains blurite rocks, allowing players to mine blurite ore. Three Agility shortcuts can be found in the dungeon; one just east of the entrance ladder requiring 82 Agility, another in the chamber with muggers requiring 60 Agility, leading them to the ice chamber to the west, and a third right before the ice giants and warriors in the eastern area, requiring 72 Agility. All three are boostable. The western area of the dungeon leads to the Royal Titans encounter, and contains six ice giants and an iron longsword spawn. This area is a multicombat area. If fighting enemies in the dungeon, Prayer can be restored at the nearby Rimmington church.
transportNotes: When walking, go to Port Sarim and head south from the Port Sarim jail, past a grove of willow trees. Go up the small hill and you will arrive at the trapdoor.
For faster transportation, players can use:
(Fastest method) Giantsoul amulet teleport to Branda and Eldric.
Fairy ring code Fairy ring AIQ, which goes to Mudskipper Point.
Teleport to House, if the player has a player-owned house located in Rimmington.
Minigame Teleport to Port Sarim Rat Pits, after completing Rat Catchers.
An amulet of glory, which can teleport to Draynor Village, the village east of Port Sarim.
Minigame Teleport to Pest Control, then take the ship to Port Sarim.
travel: It is found south of Port Sarim and north of Mudskipper Point, Fairy ring AIQ, under a trapdoor.

Three Agility shortcuts can be found in the dungeon; one just east of the entrance ladder requiring 82 Agility, another in the chamber with muggers requiring 60 Agility, leading them to the ice chamber to the west, and a third right before the ice giants and warriors in the eastern area, requiring 72 Agility.

avium savannah.name: Avium Savannah
avium savannah.summary: The Avium Savannah is a large plain located within Varlamore, just south of Civitas illa Fortis. The Colossal Wyrm was known to inhabit the Savannah, whose remains can be found at the southern part of the savannah. Alongside the Hunter Guild, the savannah also contains the Locus Oasis, the Stonecutter Outpost, as well as a large diversity of hunter creatures. Aggressive jaguars can also be found east of the Sunset Coast.
transportNotes: The player must first travel to Civitas illa Fortis via Regulus Cento after completing Children of the Sun before other transportation methods become usable.
The fairy ring Fairy ring AJP is located in the centre of the savannah.

The Quetzal Transport System, unlocked during Twilight's Promise, has several landing zones in the savannah: one by the entrance to the Hunter Guild, one in Outer Fortis, and one by the Colossal Wyrm Remains. The latter two require a landing site to be built.

The Hunter cape or max cape teleports players inside the Hunter Guild. Speak to Guildmaster Apatura with either cape equipped or in your inventory and she will unlock the teleport, after a brief conversation.
A quetzal whistle takes players to the Hunter Guild's landing site. Quetzal whistles can be unlocked after completing 10 Hunters' Rumours.
Civitas illa Fortis Teleport can be used after Twilight's Promise, and is near a quetzal landing site.
travel: The Avium Savannah is a large plain located within Varlamore, just south of Civitas illa Fortis.
The Colossal Wyrm was known to inhabit the Savannah, whose remains can be found at the southern part of the savannah.

bandit camp (wilderness).name: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)
bandit camp (wilderness).summary: The Bandit Camp is an outlaw stronghold located within levels 17-24 Wilderness. It is most commonly visited to kill bandits for a Krystilia Slayer task, and to sell items to the general store. The southern entrance is guarded by level 22 and level 130 bandits, and the eastern entrance is guarded only by two giant rats, making it the much safer entrance.
transportNotes: Several methods of transport bring players to the camp, listed here from least to most walking involved:
— western ruins, just west of the camp.
— Ferox Enclave, south-east of the camp.
— Forgotten Cemetery, north-west of the camp.
— Wilderness hunter area, north-east of the camp.
— Revenant Caves, fairly north-west of the ruins.
travel: The Bandit Camp is an outlaw stronghold located within levels 17-24 Wilderness.
The southern entrance is guarded by level 22 and level 130 bandits, and the eastern entrance is guarded only by two giant rats, making it the much safer entrance.

bandit camp mine.name: Bandit Camp mine
bandit camp mine.summary: The Bandit Camp mine (or the Hobgoblin Mine) is a mining site found north-east of the Bandit Camp in the Wilderness from levels 32 to 35 and east of the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon. The mine is occupied by a large number of aggressive hobgoblins, from whom the mine gets its nickname.
travel: The Bandit Camp mine (or the Hobgoblin Mine) is a mining site found north-east of the Bandit Camp in the Wilderness from levels 32 to 35 and east of the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon.

barbarian outpost agility course.name: Barbarian Outpost Agility Course
barbarian outpost agility course.summary: The Barbarian Outpost Agility Course is an Agility training area located in the Barbarian Outpost, available to players with level 35 Agility. Access to this course requires completion of the Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl miniquest. The Agility course rewards 153.3 Agility experience and 41.3 Strength experience per completed lap. With an average time of 32 seconds per lap (49 ticks if using additional clicks for tick-perfect), it is possible to get upwards of 18,000 Agility experience per hour from this course. At lower Agility levels expect to get around 11,000–14,000 Agility experience per hour, depending on concentration levels. In addition to experience, players will also receive marks of grace on this course.
transportNotes: Teleport to the Barbarian Assault minigame using Minigame Teleport, requiring completing the tutorial of the minigame.
Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace.
Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost by casting the Barbarian Teleport spell. This spell is on the Lunar spellbook and requires level 75 Magic and completion of Lunar Diplomacy to cast.
Use the shortcut to the north-east of the Grand Tree in the Gnome Stronghold, which requires level 37 Agility.
Teleport to the Fishing Guild using a skills necklace and walk north.
travel: The Barbarian Outpost Agility Course is an Agility training area located in the Barbarian Outpost, available to players with level 35 Agility.
Access to this course requires completion of the Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl miniquest.

barrows.name: Barrows
barrows.summary: The Barrows is a series of six burial mounds east of Mort'ton in which the Barrows brothers were entombed after their deaths during the Third Age. 'Barrows' also commonly refers to the minigame-like dungeon-delving experience of looting the chest at the centre of the tunnels beneath the crypts, released on 9 May 2005. Players can attempt to rob valuable items from the Barrows brothers' crypts. However, due to an ancient spell, the brothers' wights continued to dwell in the barrows, protecting these treasures. Looting the Barrows is popular due to the potential of receiving valuable rewards, including the unique Barrows equipment, with increasingly valuable rewards for killing more monsters in the crypts, including the Barrows brothers themselves. In the miniquest His Faithful Servants players are tasked to slay all six Barrows brothers and then loot the chest for the strange icon. Completing the miniquest rewards 20,000 Prayer experience and the ability to use the minimap within the Barrows tunnels.
transportNotes: There are several different methods for travelling to the Barrows. The best options, ordered from fast to slow, are:
Casting Barrows Teleport in the Arceuus spellbook (requires level 83 Magic), or using a Barrows teleport tablet or house portal to teleport right next to the entrance.
Using the Mort'ton teleport scroll and then running east to Barrows.
Using the Morytania legs 3 or 4 to Burgh de Rott and running north through Mort'ton towards Barrows.

Using the Minigame Teleport to Shades of Mort'ton (requires completion of the Shades of Mort'ton quest). This method is free and takes up no inventory or equipment spaces, though there is a 20-minute cooldown between uses.

Casting Kharyrll Teleport in the Ancient spellbook (requires level 66 Magic and completion of Desert Treasure I), or using a Kharyrll teleport tablet or house portal to teleport to Canifis, then using the Myreque Hideout shortcut south of the pub and running south, crossing the rope bridge, continuing south and using the swamp boaty to travel to Mort'ton, then running east.
Using the fairy ring code Fairy ring BKR, running south-east and using the swamp boaty to travel to Mort'ton, then running east.
Using the fairy ring code Fairy ring BIP, hopping across the stepping stone shortcut (requires level 50 Agility), then going east and south, following the path through Mort'ton.
travel: The Barrows is a series of six burial mounds east of Mort'ton in which the Barrows brothers were entombed after their deaths during the Third Age.

battlefront.name: Battlefront
battlefront.summary: The Battlefront is a large battlefield just outside the western border of Great Kourend. It is where the majority of Shayzien soldiers fight the lizardmen to keep Kourend safe. Players can reach the Battlefront by casting Battlefront Teleport, or running south-east from the fairy ring (code Fairy ring CIR). The army here consists of soldiers, rangers and doyens led by General Vir, with Lovakengj Engineers helping to keep the siege weapons running. In addition, they have one on-field nurse, Nurse Emma Gentsy, next to Vir's quarters in the north side. An ancient grave is located by the fountain, as well as several yew trees. Unlike the Lizardman Canyon, the battlefield is single-combat.
travel: The Battlefront is a large battlefield just outside the western border of Great Kourend.
Players can reach the Battlefront by casting Battlefront Teleport, or running south-east from the fairy ring (code Fairy ring CIR).

black knights' base.name: Black Knights' Base
black knights' base.summary: The Black Knights' Base is a Kinshra base in the far south of Taverley Dungeon. The base has two main areas, and both are swarming with black knights. In the top right of the first area is a kitchen, with a sink and a range. In the far right area of the second compartment is the jail. To gain access to the jail cells, the jailer must be killed; his combat level is 47. Inside the south cell is Velrak the explorer, who can give the player a dusty key which gives access shortcuts in the dungeon. To access the base, the player must enter the ladder south of Taverley and run past numerous monsters including chaos dwarves and hill giants. Because of this, it is advised that lower levelled players take food. The base plays a part in the Wanted! quest, where the player must interrogate Lord Daquarius about the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar.
travel: The Black Knights' Base is a Kinshra base in the far south of Taverley Dungeon.
To gain access to the jail cells, the jailer must be killed; his combat level is 47.

black knights' fortress (location).name: Black Knights' Fortress (location)
black knights' fortress (location).summary: The Black Knights' Fortress is a castle of the Zamorakian military order of the Kinshra, commonly referred to as the black knights. It plays a central role in the eponymous Black Knights' Fortress quest, and is also visited during the King's Ransom and While Guthix Sleeps quests. The interior and surrounding areas contain level 20 fortress guards and level 33 black knights. Unlike the guards, the knights are aggressive and will automatically attack lower-levelled players. The black knights in the meeting room with the large table will always be aggressive to players entering the room and disturbing their meeting. An altar to Zamorak can be found on the 1.
transportNotes: The Black Knights' Fortress can be reached a number of ways:
Using the Arceuus spellbook spell Mind Altar Teleport and heading east.
Using the Ancient Magicks spell Lassar Teleport and heading north.
Using the standard spellbook spell Falador Teleport and heading north.
Using the Construction skillcape or Taverley teleport tablet to teleport to Taverley and heading east.
Using the combat bracelet teleport to the Edgeville Monastery and heading around Ice Mountain.
Using the games necklace to the Burthorpe Games Room and heading south-east.

Players attempting to enter the fortress normally will be stopped from doing so by one of the fortress guards. In order to infiltrate the fortress, the player must be wearing one of the following combinations of armour:
travel: An altar to Zamorak can be found on the 1.

bone yard.name: Bone Yard
bone yard.summary: The Bone Yard is located in level 32 Wilderness, and is populated by aggressive level 25 skeletons. It is notable for the large amounts of bones and big bones that can be found there. Due to the fast respawn rate of the bones there, the Bone Yard is an effective way for free-to-play players to train Prayer, by picking up and burying the bones and big bones as they spawn. To the south-east of the Bone Yard is the Bone Yard Hunter area, which contains black salamanders which can be caught with Hunter.
transportNotes: Games necklace to the Corporeal Beast, exit the lair and run north-east.
Carrallanger Teleport to the Graveyard of Shadows and run north-east.
Ring of dueling to Ferox Enclave and run north-east.
travel: The Bone Yard is located in level 32 Wilderness, and is populated by aggressive level 25 skeletons.
It is notable for the large amounts of bones and big bones that can be found there.

bone yard hunter area.name: Bone Yard Hunter area
bone yard hunter area.summary: The Bone Yard Hunter area is located slightly south-east of the Bone Yard in the Wilderness. Players with 67 Hunter can catch black salamanders here. Since this Hunter area is located in the Wilderness, an additional trap can be set in the area.
transportNotes: Burning amulet teleport to the Chaos Temple and run north-east from there.
Teleport to the level 19 Wilderness Obelisk.
Carrallanger Teleport (tablet) and run east from there.
Games necklace teleport to the Corporeal Beast lair and run east.
Enter the Wilderness from Varrock and run north-east.
travel: The Bone Yard Hunter area is located slightly south-east of the Bone Yard in the Wilderness.
Since this Hunter area is located in the Wilderness, an additional trap can be set in the area.

braindeath island.name: Braindeath Island
braindeath island.summary: Braindeath Island is the location for the Rum Deal quest and can only be accessed after starting Rum Deal. It is the only location of Fever spiders, which can be assigned as Slayer tasks. Players can talk to Pirate Pete at the dock outside and north of Port Phasmatys to get a lift to the island. The island isn't shown on the World Map surface, although its climate and culture suggest it is somewhere in the Eastern Ocean. Braindeath Island houses a brewery, which is the main producer of Braindeath 'rum'. The 'rum' is then shipped to other nearby islands, such as Mos Le'Harmless. However, a large number of zombie pirates of The Inebriated's crew have recently appeared, demanding the factory's 'rum'. Since then, the brewery has not produced any, and the pirates of Mos Le'Harmless have been forced to brew it themselves using local ingredients. They, too, have had some trouble brewing. If a player loses the holy wrench obtained during Rum Deal, they can talk to Davey to get another one. The player can obtain multiple wrenches by dropping them and talking to Davey again; however, their effects won't stack.
transportNotes: Players should go to the dock north-east of Port Phasmatys and the Ectofuntus and talk to Pirate Pete there. He will transport players to the island using his unique bottle teleport method.
The quickest way to get to the dock is to use the Ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus. The ectophial is obtained during the Ghosts Ahoy quest.
Another way to get to Pirate Pete is by chartering a ship to Port Phasmatys and running to the north through the energy barrier to Pirate Pete.
travel: North-east of Port Phasmatys
Speak to Pirate Pete
Enter the brewery basement

brimhaven.name: Brimhaven
brimhaven.summary: Brimhaven is a members-only pirate town located on north-western Karamja, led by the wealthy Scarface Pete. Although it is mainly inhabited by pirates, it is also the home of Sandy's Sand Corporation and contains outposts of two Varrockian crime gangs aiming to rob the pirate leader. The street from The Shrimp and Parrot restaurant to Davon's Amulet Store is called Palm Street.
transportNotes: Several transport options bring players into or close to Brimhaven, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
— Brimhaven house portal. Requires a POH in Brimhaven.
— Northern Brimhaven. Requires 83 Farming.
Fairy ring BJR — Fisher Realm, which can be exited by blowing the magic whistle, landing near the Brimhaven mine.
— TzHaar Fight Pits, in the dungeon east of Brimhaven. Usable once every 20 minutes.
teleports players to Musa Point, east of Brimhaven.
Additionally, many forms of non-teleport transport exist:

Players can sail to and from East Ardougne by paying Captain Barnaby 30 coins at his ship on the northern Brimhaven docks. Wearing Karamja gloves will lower the cost to 15 coins, and wearing a Ring of Charos(a) will allow the player to travel for free.
travel: Brimhaven is a members-only pirate town located on north-western Karamja, led by the wealthy Scarface Pete.

brimhaven dungeon.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
brimhaven dungeon.summary: The Brimhaven Dungeon is an underground cave located south-west of Brimhaven on the members' portion of the island of Karamja. To enter the dungeon, players must pay Saniboch, who is outside the entrance, 875 coins each time they wish to enter the dungeon. Alternatively, a one-off fee of 1,000,000 coins can be paid for permanent access. A player will also need an axe to cut the vines blocking the path (requiring level 10 Woodcutting). Vines can be cut by hand only when going towards the main exit to avoid trapping players. A blessed axe will not work. The closest bronze axe spawns in the Brimhaven bar, if needed. The stepping stones to the west of the vines in the dungeon require level 12 Agility to pass. If a player fails it (which is quite rare), they will get hit by a low amount of damage. To get further in the dungeon (Black Demons and beyond), you will need at least a Woodcutting level of 34. With 56 Agility, the stepping stones south of the vines can be used to get to the red dragons faster. The cost of entering the dungeon can often be easily recouped, from the drops of the many powerful monsters in the dungeon like demons, giants, and dragons. The dungeon is a popular destination for players seeking to fight greater demons, black demons, red dragons, or metal dragons. Another entrance to the dungeon can be found west of Tai Bwo Wannai. Guarded by Saniboch's sister Banisoch, a one-time fee of 5,000 trading sticks must be given to her before she will allow players to us
transportNotes: The dungeon can be reached by sailing from East Ardougne to Brimhaven, for a fee of 30 coins or for free when using the Ring of Charos. Another sea route can be taken from Port Sarim to Musa Point, again requiring 30 coins or the Ring of Charos for a free trip. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven. Alternatively, one can charter a ship to get to Brimhaven (the Port Sarim-Brimhaven charter ship ride costs 1,600 coins).
The nearest bank, although completion of the quest Shilo Village and 10 extra coins are required, is Shilo Village bank which can be reached by using Hajedy's cart. The Tzhaar City is also an option.
Teleportation is also practical:

Teleport to House if the player-owned house is in Brimhaven or if using a scroll of redirection. This is by far the quickest way to get to the dungeon, and best to get items lost on death back if the player dies.

Using a Tai bwo wannai teleport scroll and running west to the alternate entrance. This requires paying Banisoch a one-time fee of 5,000 trading sticks (GE: ), and takes players to the bronze dragon area.
Spirit tree if the player has a fully grown spirit tree behind the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run west then south.
Fairy ring code Fairy ring CKR and then north to the dungeon.
travel: The Brimhaven Dungeon is an underground cave located south-west of Brimhaven on the members' portion of the island of Karamja.
To enter the dungeon, players must pay Saniboch, who is outside the entrance, 875 coins each time they wish to enter the dungeon.
caveats: The ordinary entrance is open with its fee. Bring an axe and 10 Woodcutting for the vine routes; deeper stepping stones have their own Agility requirements.

brine rat cavern.name: Brine Rat Cavern
brine rat cavern.summary: The Brine Rat Cavern, also known as Sven's cave, is a dungeon accessible during and after Olaf's Quest. Players can enter the dungeon by digging with a spade south of the windswept tree, which is on a plateau east of Olaf Hradson and south-east of the Rellekka Hunter area. When the hole is dug, the player falls through it and is stunned for a few seconds, but no damage is taken. The south-western part of the cavern contains the exit back to the surface world. To exit, the player must roll back the rock to expose a cave leading to the outside. After exiting, the rock rolls back to block the cave, so the cavern cannot be entered by this route. The cavern actually consists of the main cavern, an outdoors area on the coast, a slippery walkway, another outdoors, coastal area, and a small shallow cavern south of the second coastal area. Neither of the coastal areas appear on the world map, so the entire complex is considered a single dungeon. The entire cavern is a single combat zone. Dwarf multicannons may be used here.
transportNotes: The Brine Rat Cavern is in the north-eastern region of the Fremennik Province, and requires a spade to access. This is a remote area and takes some time to walk to. There are some faster means to get here:
Fairy ring code Fairy ring DKS is very close to the cavern's entrance. Use of the fairy rings requires players to complete at least part of the Fairytale II - Cure a Queen quest.
The Eagle transport system flies to the Rellekka Hunter area, which is north of the dungeon's entrance. Players must have completed the Eagles' Peak quest to use an eagle to fly here.

The passage to Keldagrim is close to the cavern's entrance. Players must have at least started The Giant Dwarf quest to have access to Keldagrim. Keldagrim is important in that two transport systems go there:

The mine carts run to Keldagrim from three locations. One is the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain; access to the tunnel requires completion of the Fishing Contest quest. The second location is in the Dwarven Mine under Ice Mountain. The third is a hatch in the north-west part of Grand Exchange. All carts are free of charge.
A train system runs between Dorgesh-Kaan and Keldagrim. The train is free to use but requires the player to have completed Another Slice of H.A.M. quest.
The slayer ring teleport to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon is just south of the Brine Rat cavern.
The use of an enchanted lyre will teleport the player outside the gates of Rellekka, just south of the cavern entrance.
travel: The Brine Rat Cavern, also known as Sven's cave, is a dungeon accessible during and after Olaf's Quest.
Players can enter the dungeon by digging with a spade south of the windswept tree, which is on a plateau east of Olaf Hradson and south-east of the Rellekka Hunter area.

buccaneers' haven.name: Buccaneers' Haven
buccaneers' haven.summary: Buccaneers' Haven is an island west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony and east of Port Piscarilius. It requires 76 Sailing (not boostable) to moor on. A castle can be found on the eastern end of the island containing pirates. Once the rowboat is built, the player may travel to and from the island using a rowboat on the south coast of Pirates' Cove, provided they've previously been taken to Pirates' Cove during Lunar Diplomacy. The Buccaneers' Laboratory can be accessed through this island.
travel: Buccaneers' Haven is an island west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony and east of Port Piscarilius.
A castle can be found on the eastern end of the island containing pirates.

buccaneers' laboratory.name: Buccaneers' Laboratory
buccaneers' laboratory.summary: Buccaneers' Laboratory is located on Buccaneers' Haven, therefore requiring 76 Sailing to access. The entire laboratory is a multicombat area, and a dwarven multicannon can be used here. There are a total of: *8 mutated bloodvelds to the north-east *5 hellhounds in the centre *11 shadow spiders to the south-east *2 skeletons to the west The small key (Buccaneers' Haven) can be dug up by digging on the red ball in the second-most westward prison cell in the north-west of the laboratory.
travel: Buccaneers' Laboratory is located on Buccaneers' Haven, therefore requiring 76 Sailing to access.

There are a total of: *8 mutated bloodvelds to the north-east *5 hellhounds in the centre *11 shadow spiders to the south-east *2 skeletons to the west The small key (Buccaneers' Haven) can be dug up by digging on the red ball in the second-most westward prison cell in the north-west of the laboratory.

burgh de rott.name: Burgh de Rott
burgh de rott.summary: Burgh de Rott is a desolate town located in the south-western coast of Morytania, known for housing the human resistance to the oppressive vampyres. Players must have started In Aid of the Myreque in order to access the town.
transportNotes: Several teleports bring players into or close to Burgh de Rott, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
— entrance to the town. Requires hard Morytania diary.
— Mort'ton town centre, slightly north of Burgh de Rott.
— Barrows, north-east of the town.
— Ver Sinhaza, from which players can run to the Icyene Graveyard and take the boat to town.
— Shades of Mort'ton entrance north of the town. Usable once every 20 minutes.
Fairy ring BIP — the island east of the Mage Training Arena. Requires 50 Agility.
travel: Burgh de Rott is a desolate town located in the south-western coast of Morytania, known for housing the human resistance to the oppressive vampyres.
Players must have started In Aid of the Myreque in order to access the town.

cabin fever.name: Cabin Fever
cabin fever.summary: Cabin Fever is the second quest in the Pirate quest series. During the quest, you learn to become a pirate by aiding the shifty Bill Teach in running his ship. The quest ends with access to the pirate island of Mos Le'Harmless.
travel: The quest ends with access to the pirate island of Mos Le'Harmless.

cairn isle.name: Cairn Isle
cairn isle.summary: Cairn Isle is an island on the south-west of Karamja, south of Tai Bwo Wannai and west of Shilo Village. To access the island, players must scale a small promontory stood on the Karamjan coastline by climbing up a rockslide (requires 15 Agility), and then walk across the wooden bridge linking up the two islands. In case the player stumbles while climbing the rockslide, they will slide back down and take damage. If the player fails to keep their balance while crossing the bridge, they will fall off and be washed back to the shoreline of Karamja, again taking damage. The isle is involved in both Tai Bwo Wannai Trio and Shilo Village quests. One of Timfraku's sons, Tinsay, resides in Cairn Isle before the player convinces him back to the village in Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest. Rashiliyia's son Bervirius is also buried on the isle in the Tomb of Bervirius, accessible by climbing down the well stacked rocks on the isle. Exploring Cairn Isle is an easy task in the Karamja Achievement Diary.
travel: Cairn Isle is an island on the south-west of Karamja, south of Tai Bwo Wannai and west of Shilo Village.

To access the island, players must scale a small promontory stood on the Karamjan coastline by climbing up a rockslide (requires 15 Agility), and then walk across the wooden bridge linking up the two islands.

callisto's den.name: Callisto's Den
callisto's den.summary: Callisto's Den is the lair of Callisto. It is a multi-combat dungeon located in the Wilderness, just south of Demonic Ruins. Entering the boss lair requires completion of the medium Wilderness diary OR a Callisto boss Slayer task, and a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. This fee is shared across Callisto's Den, Hunter's End, the Skeletal Tomb, Vet'ion's Rest, the Silk Chasm, the Web Chasm and the Escape Caves. The fee does not need to be paid again, unless the player dies to another player without having left the Wilderness since their most recent visit to a boss lair or the Escape Caves. If this happens, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer, and needs to be paid again to re-enter the boss lairs. Players can decrease the fee by killing the six bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins. Like the Silk Chasm and Vet'ion's Rest, players exiting Callisto's Den will always arrive at one of three points within the Escape Caves at random. Note that any player who exits within 10 seconds of the previous player will arrive at the same point, meaning player killers can pursue their targets through the boss lair. Upon entering the lair, players will be unable to teleport for 3 ticks. This delay no longer occurs after completion of the hard Wilderness diary. In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills registered in the
travel: It is a multi-combat dungeon located in the Wilderness, just south of Demonic Ruins.
In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills registered in their name.
callisto's den.confirmation: Requires medium Wilderness diary OR a specific Callisto boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.
caveats: A generic bear, skeleton or spider assignment does not bypass the diary gate. PvP risk applies.

canifis.name: Canifis
canifis.summary: Canifis is a small town in Morytania inhabited by werewolves in human form. The town is only accessible to players who have completed the Priest in Peril quest. Canifis is the starting point for the Myreque storyline.
transportNotes: Several teleports bring players into or close to Canifis, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
— Hair of the Dog pub next to Canifis Bank.
— Slayer Tower entrance north of the town.
Fairy ring CKS — just west of Canifis.
— Fenkenstrain's Castle, north-east of the town.
— Ectofuntus, far east of the town.
travel: The town is only accessible to players who have completed the Priest in Peril quest.

castle drakan.name: Castle Drakan
castle drakan.summary: Castle Drakan is the seat of power of Morytania and the stronghold from which Lowerniel Drakan rules the region. Following the events of The Blood Moon Rises, it is claimed by Sugadinti Vitur. The castle was built as a replica of House Drakan's original castle on Vampyrium, which is explored during The Blood Moon Rises. The walls surrounding the castle are frequented by players who are directed there via master emote clues.
travel: Castle Drakan is the seat of power of Morytania and the stronghold from which Lowerniel Drakan rules the region.

catacombs of kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
catacombs of kourend.summary: The Catacombs of Kourend is a massive dungeon located beneath Great Kourend. The main entrance is found by investigating the statue of King Rada I in the courtyard of Kourend Castle. There are five other entrances to the catacombs - three scattered around the surface of Great Kourend and two further entrances connecting to other dungeons on Great Kourend (Forthos Dungeon and Giants' Den, respectively). However, these additional entrances will only appear once the player has climbed the respective vines from inside the Catacombs. The vines connecting to the surface are located in the dungeon map to the right, marked with a icon.
transportNotes: The fastest way to the main entrance is through Xeric's talisman with the "Xeric's Heart" function, which teleports the player outside the statue of King Rada I, the Kourend Castle Teleport spell, which requires completion of Client of Kourend, or using a Ring of returning having set your respawn point to Kourend Castle, which can only be done after completion of A Kingdom Divided.
Alternate forms of transport include:
Achievement diary cape to the Kourend & Kebos option, which puts the player next to Elise.
A portal in the portal chamber or portal nexus of a player-owned house attuned to Kourend Castle.
Using the Hosidius page(Lunch by the Lancalliums) in the Kharedst's memoirs; or using the Hosidius page in the Book of the Dead, after completion of A Kingdom Divided
Games necklace to Wintertodt, then Lovakengj Minecart Network to Kingstown
Rada's blessing to Kourend Woodland, then Lovakengj Minecart Network to Kingstown
travel: The Catacombs of Kourend is a massive dungeon located beneath Great Kourend.
The main entrance is found by investigating the statue of King Rada I in the courtyard of Kourend Castle.

cerberus' lair.name: Cerberus' Lair
cerberus' lair.summary: Cerberus' Lair is a dungeon that borders between the River of Souls and the rest of Gielinor. It is inhabited by Cerberus, a three-headed hellhound, who guards the River of Souls, preventing the living from entering, and the dead from escaping. The lair is also inhabited by the Key Master, who is tasked with preventing Cerberus from escaping the iron gates that hold it. The lair may be accessed via a cave entrance in the eastern wall of the hellhound area within the Taverley Dungeon. This leads to the Key Master, who guards three iron gates that lead to Cerberus. He will only allow players who are assigned hellhounds or Cerberus as a slayer task to fight it. Players can also teleport here directly with a Key master teleport, an uncommon drop from Cerberus.
travel: The lair may be accessed via a cave entrance in the eastern wall of the hellhound area within the Taverley Dungeon.

champions' guild.name: Champions' Guild
champions' guild.summary: The Champions' Guild is located south of Varrock and is accessible to players with at least 32 quest points. It has Scavvo's Rune Store and Valaine's Shop of Champions, and is also the starting point of the free-to-play quest, Dragon Slayer I.
transportNotes: The Portal of Champions on the 2 of the Myths' Guild can be used by members to teleport outside the front door of the Champions' Guild.
The combat bracelet can be used by members to teleport outside the front door of the Champions' Guild.
The Chronicle teleports directly east of the Champions' Guild.
The canoe transport system, requiring at least 12 Woodcutting, to the riverbank south-east of the Champions' Guild.
The closest Magic teleport spell is a Varrock Teleport or its tablet.

The Guildmaster welcomes players that enter the guild. He is the starting point of the hardest free-to-play quest, Dragon Slayer I. The main room has stairs to the 1, and a trapdoor that leads to the Champions' Challenge in the basement. The southern room has a range.

The 0 contains two rooms and a small outdoor area with chickens. Among the chickens there is a level 159 Evil Chicken which gives reduced experience and does not count towards the Recipe for Disaster: Sir Amik Varze subquest.

Scavvo walks around the south side of the room and runs Scavvo's Rune Store. He sells rune weapons and armour, green d'hide vambraces, green d'hide chaps, and coifs. Scavvo has one of the only shops, along with Oziach and Nurmof, that sells rune equipment in free-to-play.
travel: The Champions' Guild is located south of Varrock and is accessible to players with at least 32 quest points.

chaos druid tower.name: Chaos Druid Tower
chaos druid tower.summary: The Chaos Druid Tower is located to the north of Ardougne and is home to 4 chaos druids, located on the 0. The door is locked, requiring level 46 Thieving to open, and granting 37.5 experience when successful. Picking the lock does not require a lockpick. The tower also houses the entrance to a dungeon containing two chests requiring level 59 Thieving to open. Upon doing so the player receives two blood runes and 500 coins and is granted 250 experience. Once a player has successfully opened the chest and removed its contents they will be teleported, along with their loot, to a house in the north of East Ardougne. The chest respawns every 210 seconds or 3 and a half minutes. The dungeon itself is also inhabited by 5 giant bats and 7 ogres.
transportNotes: Teleport to Ardougne with the Achievement diary cape
Teleport to the Fishing Guild using a skills necklace or Fishing Guild Teleport (Level 85 Magic and Lunar Diplomacy) and run south-west.
Teleport to the Outpost using a necklace of passage and run east.
Teleport to the Ardougne farm patch using Ardougne cloak and run west.
Teleport to Ardougne using the Ardougne Teleport spell or tablet and run north-west to the Chaos Druid Tower, then go to its basement.
Teleport to West Ardougne using West Ardougne Teleport spell or tab and running east through the gate into East Ardougne and then north.
travel: The Chaos Druid Tower is located to the north of Ardougne and is home to 4 chaos druids, located on the 0.
The tower also houses the entrance to a dungeon containing two chests requiring level 59 Thieving to open.

chaos temple (wilderness).name: Chaos Temple (Wilderness)
chaos temple (wilderness).summary: The Chaos Temple is a temple of Zamorak located around level 11 Wilderness, north of Varrock. The entire building is near-completely surrounded by molten lava which frequently ejects flaming rocks that do minor damage to anyone nearby where they land. The area is also multi-combat, and contains many elder chaos druids who will teleblock any players who get too close. The pattern on the floor hints that the temple may once have been dedicated to Zaros, which is plausible given that many of his fortresses and outposts in the Second Age were in what is now the Wilderness, and were destroyed and/or aligned to different gods during and after the God Wars. Players will receive the following message the first time they enter the Chaos Temple each day:
transportNotes: Burning amulet teleport to the north entrance in level 15 Wilderness.
Ring of dueling teleport to Ferox Enclave, and run east.
Run north from Varrock or north-east from the Grand Exchange, crossing the wilderness ditch.
travel: The Chaos Temple is a temple of Zamorak located around level 11 Wilderness, north of Varrock.

charred dungeon.name: Charred Dungeon
charred dungeon.summary: The Charred Dungeon is a dungeon containing several Slayer monsters and other resources, including lava strykewyrms. It is accessible by climbing down the dark hole on Charred Island, which requires level 60 Sailing to dock at. Rope is required when entering the dungeon the first time. However, there is a rope item spawn on the island so one doesn't need to be brought to the island. If you teleport out of the dungeon, you will need to retrieve your boat via a Shipwright, use one of the boat teleportation spells, or be brought to the island by another player, as there is no other way to get to the island than with a player-owned ship. Two mining spots can be found in the dungeon; one to the south-west containing 10 coal, 3 adamantite and 2 runite rocks, and one to the south-central area containing 24 rubium rocks and 2 rubium deposits being mined by a dwarf named Kragin. Random events can not spawn inside the dungeon.
travel: It is accessible by climbing down the dark hole on Charred Island, which requires level 60 Sailing to dock at.

If you teleport out of the dungeon, you will need to retrieve your boat via a Shipwright, use one of the boat teleportation spells, or be brought to the island by another player, as there is no other way to get to the island than with a player-owned ship.

charred island.name: Charred Island
charred island.summary: Charred Island is located south of the Void Knights' Outpost and Pest Control Island, in the Unquiet Ocean. Docking here requires level 60 Sailing, unboosted. A dark hole in the north-west of the island leads to the Charred Dungeon, in which lava strykewyrms and rubium rocks can be found. A rope is required to be used on the hole to access the dungeon the first time, and one can be found on the southern part of the island near the bank chest space. The dungeon contains the old chest, which can be unlocked using the charred key to obtain Zamorakian paint.
transportNotes: The island can only be reached using Sailing. Mooring at the island requires level 60 Sailing.

The fastest way to get to the island without using Teleport to Boat is to sail south-west from the Red Rock (requires partial completion of The Red Reef quest to access). At Red Rock, player can either pay the Shipwright to recover their boat, or cast summon boat spell. Without access to Red Rock, Void Knights' Outpost is the closest port to sail from.
travel: Charred Island is located south of the Void Knights' Outpost and Pest Control Island, in the Unquiet Ocean.
A dark hole in the north-west of the island leads to the Charred Dungeon, in which lava strykewyrms and rubium rocks can be found.

chasm of fire.name: Chasm of Fire
chasm of fire.summary: The Chasm of Fire is a dungeon located in the north-west corner of Shayzien, housing a variety of demons led by Yama, the Master of Pacts. After completion of A Kingdom Divided, a group of five Shayzien soldiers (a lieutenant, sergeant, and three soldiers) will be found loitering around the entrance. Likewise, the player can access Yama's Domain by speaking to the Voice of Yama at the bottom level of the chasm. Players can use the lifts to travel between floors. Two shortcuts can be found in the dungeon; one at the entrance, requiring 83 Agility and another by the first lift, requiring 73 Agility. The first shortcut drops players off on the third floor by the Voice of Yama, while the second shortcut takes players to the greater demon area and leads to another two shortcuts leading to the lift to the third floor. These shortcuts are one-way only. A dwarf multicannon can be used in the chasm, although it is not a multi-combat area. There are several safespots for killing greater demons on the middle floor, by utilising the piles of rocks and the narrow pathways. Resurrection spells cannot be cast whilst within the Chasm of Fire (excluding Yama's arena) with the message "You can't resurrect a thrall here." appearing when attempting to do so.
transportNotes: There are several ways to reach the dungeon:
A chasm teleport scroll brings players inside the dungeon on the bottom floor (only if you've previously been to Great Kourend).
The Fairy ring code Fairy ring DJR will bring the players just south-east of the Chasm (only if you've previously been to Great Kourend).
Using Kharedst's memoirs to teleport to the Graveyard of Heroes via reminiscing "History and Hearsay". Requires completion of Tale of the Righteous.
Using Battlefront teleport brings players just north-west of the chasm.
Using a skills necklace to teleport to the Farming Guild, and then running south-east. A form of antipoison is recommended due to lizardmen on the way.
travel: The Chasm of Fire is a dungeon located in the north-west corner of Shayzien, housing a variety of demons led by Yama, the Master of Pacts.
After completion of A Kingdom Divided, a group of five Shayzien soldiers (a lieutenant, sergeant, and three soldiers) will be found loitering around the entrance.

clock tower (building).name: Clock Tower (building)
clock tower (building).summary: The Clock Tower is a tower south of Ardougne. There are 4 floors, the fourth one being the basement. During the quest of the same name, you have to find 4 cogs in different colours. The owner and monk of the Clock Tower is Brother Kojo, the giver of the Clock Tower quest. Kojo also gives the player a watch for use in Treasure Trails. The Clock Tower seems to be quite broken down, due to the large number of missing floorboards as well as several broken windows and a boarded-up door. The basement is also infested with a number of different monsters.
transportNotes: The quickest way to get to the Clock Tower is by using the Ardougne cloak's teleport to the Ardougne Monastery.

The next best way to get to the Clock Tower is to use the spirit tree teleportation system and go to 'Battlefield of Khazard', which lands you slightly north-west of the Clock Tower as can be seen in the above image.
travel: The Clock Tower is a tower south of Ardougne.

clock tower dungeon.name: Clock Tower dungeon
clock tower dungeon.summary: The Clock Tower dungeon is a major part of the Clock Tower quest. It is a huge, multi-zone dungeon complex underneath the south-western part of East Ardougne. It is where you find the four cogs that are needed in the Clock Tower quest. Players must start the quest before they can access most of the dungeon.
travel: It is a huge, multi-zone dungeon complex underneath the south-western part of East Ardougne.
Players must start the quest before they can access most of the dungeon.

coal trucks.name: Coal Trucks
coal trucks.summary: The Coal Trucks are located north of the Fishing Guild and west of McGrubor's Wood. At the coal truck mining area, there are 18 coal rocks and several carts. Coal can be deposited into the trucks and later retrieved from any truck along the mine track, allowing players to collect and bank their coal from the depot at Seers' Village. 120 coal can be stored in the carts if no Kandarin achievement diaries have been completed, though 140, 280, or 308 pieces of coal can be stored in the trucks if the easy, medium, or hard diary is completed (respectively). With the elite diary, the first 200 coal removed in a day are automatically transported to the player's bank. Though the diary reward says placed, you must first place then attempt to remove the coal from the coal truck to initiate transfer to your bank. An exploit currently exists in which a player can transport 27 additional coal if the trucks are filled up to one less than full, then an entire inventory of coal is placed in the cart. Once the carts are full of coal, the coal may then be removed from any of the carts. A log balance shortcut just east of the coal trucks can be used at level 20 Agility to cross over towards McGrubor's Wood. It should also be noted that there are aggressive Giant bats amongst the coal, so mining here may not be suitable for players with a low combat level.
travel: The Coal Trucks are located north of the Fishing Guild and west of McGrubor's Wood.
A log balance shortcut just east of the coal trucks can be used at level 20 Agility to cross over towards McGrubor's Wood.

colossal wyrm remains.name: Colossal Wyrm Remains
colossal wyrm remains.summary: The Colossal Wyrm Remains are the remains of a colossal wyrm that once inhabited the Avium Savannah. The wyrm was believed to have come from deep within the Hailstorm Mountains before settling in the Avium Savannah for unknown reasons around 200 years ago.
