Terrorising the savannah, warriors from across the kingdom banded together to defeat it, with the help of an adventurer from Hosidius during the War of the Five Houses. It remains today as a famous landmark in Varlamore, found at the southern end of the savannah; one of its fangs is also on display on the top floor of the Grand Museum. In recent years, the remains have fell victim to a termite infestation that is threatening the structure's integrity; thus, the museum has sent Worm Tongue and Construction Workers to lead the preservation effort. The scaffolding around the remains serve as an agility course in which players help Worm Tongue scoop up termites around the course for him to eat in exchange for rewards. Many items are scattered around the remains: * 8 Bones (2 requiring Telekinetic Grab) * 5 Big bones (1 requiring Telekinetic Grab) * 1 Bucket * 1 Hammer * 2 Plank * 1 Jug of water on the advanced side of the agility course * 1 Steel arrow on the advanced side of the agility course * 1 Rotten tomato on the advanced side of the agility course
travel: It remains today as a famous landmark in Varlamore, found at the southern end of the savannah; one of its fangs is also on display on the top floor of the Grand Museum.

combat training camp.name: Combat Training Camp
combat training camp.summary: The Combat Training Camp is a combat training facility which players may access upon completion of the Biohazard quest. The camp is located north of West Ardougne and just east of the Gnome Stronghold's entrance. It was established by King Lathas of East Ardougne to train his forces, and various guards can be seen within the camp.
transportNotes: Achievement diary cape to Two-pints, open the door and run north-west.
Necklace of passage to The Outpost and run east.
Spirit tree to the Tree Gnome Stronghold exit the stronghold to the south, and run east.
Ardougne Teleport to East Ardougne, run north, then run west, take the bridge south and run west past the Chaos Temple.
Canoe Station just north of the camp.
travel: The Combat Training Camp is a combat training facility which players may access upon completion of the Biohazard quest.
The camp is located north of West Ardougne and just east of the Gnome Stronghold's entrance.

corsair cove.name: Corsair Cove
corsair cove.summary: Corsair Cove is a small port town located on the southern shore of Feldip Hills. It is isolated from the rest of the area by large impassable cliffs. Unlike most of the western part of the world map, the cove is accessible to free-to-play players, after starting The Corsair Curse quest.
transportNotes: Players can be automatically ferried to the Cove by speaking to various NPCs. If The Corsair Curse is not started, players can speak with Captain Tock north of Port Sarim. Once started, players can speak to Captain Tock on the western end of Rimmington. Players can speak to Cabin Boy Colin in this same location after completing the quest. (To return to Rimmington, speak to Captain Tock during the quest, or Cabin Boy Colin post-quest aboard the ship at Corsair Cove.)
With The Corsair Curse completed, players with 40 Sailing can dock at the cove.
Other transport options which bring players into or close to Corsair Cove listed with their arrival destination, from closest to farthest:
— Corsair Cove mooring point once a player-owned boat with a greater teleport focus is docked there (with 40 Sailing and The Corsair Curse completed)
— Feldip Hills, south-west of the town.
— Myths' Guild, west of the town, from the basement.
or max cape — Feldip Hunter area, north of the town.

With 10 Agility, players can access Corsair Cove via the Feldip Hills by climbing the rocks south of the Feldip Hunter area. Players can also climb the rocks near the resource area with 30 Agility, after completion of Dragon Slayer I and having spoken to Haris.
travel: Corsair Cove is a small port town located on the southern shore of Feldip Hills.
Unlike most of the western part of the world map, the cove is accessible to free-to-play players, after starting The Corsair Curse quest.

corsair cove dungeon.name: Corsair Cove Dungeon
corsair cove dungeon.summary: The Corsair Cove Dungeon is a large cave system beneath the Corsair Cove at the southern part of Feldip Hills. It is mainly inhabited by ogresses, though the western caves are part of the Myths' Guild. The Dwarf multicannon can be used in the dungeon, though it is not multicombat.
transportNotes: Talk to Cabin Boy Colin on the western end of Rimmington after completion of The Corsair Curse, or Captain Tock during the quest. This is the only way to access the island in free-to-play worlds.
Spirit tree teleport to Feldip Hills and run east.
Mythical cape teleport to the Myths' Guild.
travel: The Corsair Cove Dungeon is a large cave system beneath the Corsair Cove at the southern part of Feldip Hills.
It is mainly inhabited by ogresses, though the western caves are part of the Myths' Guild.

crabclaw caves.name: Crabclaw Caves
crabclaw caves.summary: The Crabclaw Caves is a dungeon found south of the Woodcutting Guild in Great Kourend. Access to the caves requires partial completion of The Depths of Despair quest. If players attempt to enter the cave without starting the quest, they will not be able to enter. You are able to set up a dwarf multicannon inside the cave to kill a king sand crab for the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary. The dwarf multicannon will not target immune targets such as sand crabs or sand snakes, however. The caves contain an additional place to train on sand crabs, with three crabs next to each other in one spot, and another spot with four crabs next to each other. There are also two smaller caves with several king sand crabs. During The Depths of Despair, players must travel to the very end of the caves, and climbing down the tunnel entrance to find Artur Hosidius, who is searching for the Royal Accord of Twill, and finds a sand snake guarding the chest containing it. After the quest is complete, players can no longer access the bottom area, with the player stating "I don't really want to go down there again."
transportNotes: Skills necklace teleport to the Woodcutting Guild - run a short distance south to the cave entrance.
Spirit tree planted in a spirit tree patch south-east of the Forthos Ruin near Hosidius - run south-west to the cave entrance.
Lovakengj Minecart Network - run south-west to the cave entrance from the Hosidius West station of the minecart network.
travel: The Crabclaw Caves is a dungeon found south of the Woodcutting Guild in Great Kourend.
Access to the caves requires partial completion of The Depths of Despair quest.
caveats: The Sand Snake quest room closes after the quest; the cave entrance does not prove repeatable access to that encounter.

crabclaw isle.name: Crabclaw Isle
crabclaw isle.summary: Crabclaw Isle is a small island just south of the Hosidius coast. Players can reach the island by paying Sandicrahb 10,000 coins. Completing the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary will allow players to access it for half the price. Completing the medium Kourend & Kebos Diary will allow players to access the island for free. There are 40 sand crabs scattered throughout the isle, with several spots containing three/four crabs near one tile.
transportNotes: Casting the Minigame Teleport spell to Tithe Farm and run south.
Use a Hosidius teleport or exit a player-owned house in Hosidius and go south.
Use a planted spirit tree and run south-east.
travel: Crabclaw Isle is a small island just south of the Hosidius coast.
Completing the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary will allow players to access it for half the price.

crafting guild.name: Crafting Guild
crafting guild.summary: The Crafting Guild is located south-west of Falador and north of Rimmington. It provides top-notch workshops for accomplished crafters. A Crafting level of 40 is required to enter the guild as well as wearing one of the following: *A brown or golden apron *A Crafting cape *A Max cape or any of its variants These items are only required to enter through the door. Once inside, they are not required at all.
transportNotes: In addition to walking to the guild, players may use the following transportation methods:
A skills necklace, Crafting cape, or max cape can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
Players who have unlocked the Crafting Guild hot air balloon route after completing Enlightened Journey can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of one oak log.
Players who have their player-owned house located in Rimmington can walk a short distance north-west to the Crafting Guild. Players with a tool store 3 can pick up a brown apron on their way.
travel: South-west of Falador
Use the external cow pen beside the guild
caveats: The listed cows and calves are outside the guild. The interior's 40 Crafting/apron requirement does not gate these creatures.

crandor.name: Crandor
crandor.summary: Crandor is a small volcanic island north of Karamja. Players are unable to sail to Crandor themselves, but can buy the last remaining ship that can handle Crandor's reefs from Klarense. Players seek out this boat during Dragon Slayer I, when the Guildmaster tasks them with defeating the mighty dragon Elvarg.
transportNotes: Crandor is first accessed by boat during the Dragon Slayer I quest. Players must obtain all three map pieces and repair the boat; after this, Ned will bring them to the island. After the quest, Crandor can only be accessed via a secret door in the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.

To reach the Crandor surface, players must first enter the Karamja Volcano, either by exiting the TzHaar City, or by climbing down from Karamja. The wall can be found in the north-west corner of the area. After passing the wall, players can run north, to the rope they placed during Dragon Slayer I, and climb up the rope to reach the surface.
travel: Musa Point or Brimhaven
Karamja Volcano dungeon
Unlocked false wall, then the rope up to Crandor
caveats: First access uses the repaired quest ship. Subsequent access needs the false wall unlocked from the Crandor side.

crandor and karamja dungeon.name: Crandor and Karamja Dungeon
crandor and karamja dungeon.summary: The Karamja Dungeon is located underneath the Karamja Volcano, and the Crandor Dungeon is located underneath Crandor. Both dungeons are connected to each other. In order for a player to gain full access to the Crandor dungeon, they must have completed or be about to engage in the final fight in the quest Dragon Slayer I. No part of the dungeons are multicombat zones.
transportNotes: The Karamja entrance to the dungeon can be accessed by travelling to Musa Point or Brimhaven via ship, then walking west or east, respectively, to the Karamja Volcano. The eastern lip of the volcano has rocks that can be climbed down.
The dungeon can also be accessed by using the Minigame Teleport to TzHaar Fight Pit, travelling east through Mor Ul Rek, then exiting via the cave to the north.

The Crandor side of the dungeon must first be unlocked during Dragon Slayer I. After that, it can be accessed by passing the hidden door at the north end of the Karamja side of the dungeon. The door becomes usable after crash-landing on Crandor.
travel: The Karamja Dungeon is located underneath the Karamja Volcano, and the Crandor Dungeon is located underneath Crandor.
In order for a player to gain full access to the Crandor dungeon, they must have completed or be about to engage in the final fight in the quest Dragon Slayer I.

crash site cavern.name: Crash Site Cavern
crash site cavern.summary: The Crash Site Cavern is a cave located a very short distance north of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. It is visited during Monkey Madness II, where the final battle is fought. It remains accessible after completing the quest, after talking to Steve, where it is inhabited by tortured and demonic gorillas, which drop the components used to create the light and heavy ballista, as well as zenyte shards used to create zenyte jewellery. Outside the cavern are the remains of Glough's airship along with Assistant Le Smith's remains. A crate near the cavern entrance can be searched to obtain a monkey, which is worn in the cape slot. The monkey will return to this crate if lost in any way. Upon entering the cavern entrance, two messages will appear in the chat box stating and . The caverns consist of both single and multi-way combat zones, with the singles zone being just ahead of the archway near the two demonic gorillas in the single-way area. A path near the exit rope in the caves leads to a large area filled with demonic gorillas in single-way combat. Past this archway, the entire area is exclusively multi-way. Gorillas killed in the multi-way zones will broadcast their drop within the nearby vicinity.
transportNotes: The entrance to the Crash Site Cavern may be found north-west of the Grand Tree through the opening in the fence. Once through the fence run north-east to enter the cavern.
There are a few ways to get to the Grand Tree from which you can run to the cavern.
Use the royal seed pod's teleport option which takes you to the base of the Grand Tree. This is the fastest travel option.
Use a Spirit tree to the Gnome stronghold and run north and then north-west to the gap in the fence.
Use the Gnome glider to Ta Quir Priw which will take you to the top of the Grand Tree. Descend the tree and run north-west to the gap in the fence.
travel: The Crash Site Cavern is a cave located a very short distance north of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

It remains accessible after completing the quest, after talking to Steve, where it is inhabited by tortured and demonic gorillas, which drop the components used to create the light and heavy ballista, as well as zenyte shards used to create zenyte jewellery.

crumbling tower.name: Crumbling Tower
crumbling tower.summary: The Crumbling Tower is a tower located on a small island off the north-west coast of Isle of Souls, which can be reached by using the fairy ring code Fairy ring BJP and running westward. Several Forgotten Souls can be found on all three of the tower's floors. On the 1, a rope spawn can be found, and on the 2, a pestle and mortar spawns. In the basement, players can find Dark Chests, which can only be opened with a dark key. Some bones, leather gloves, and a bronze pickaxe spawn down here as well. A few spiders also inhabit the basement. A part of the basement wall, directly south of the table, can be inspected, giving a message in the chatbox stating Someone has crudely carved a message into the wall: 'The Soul Stone was here. Where is it now?
travel: The Crumbling Tower is a tower located on a small island off the north-west coast of Isle of Souls, which can be reached by using the fairy ring code Fairy ring BJP and running westward.
Several Forgotten Souls can be found on all three of the tower's floors.

crypt of tonali.name: Crypt of Tonali
crypt of tonali.summary: The Crypt of Tonali is one of seven holy sites of the Losanium religion, located in the Tlati Rainforest. Built by the Old Ones, the entrance to the crypt is a ziggurat with a large tree atop it, with a passageway in the tree allowing access to the underground caverns as well as the Ruins of Mokhaiotl. The entrance and the interior is guarded by Tonali Warriors and Archers. The crypt is the location where the Teok Xiki, or the Gathering, is performed to select a new Teokan upon the death of the previous one. As a holy site, the teoki of Ralos and Ranul - Xopanatl and Nenetl - are responsible for the crypt.
transportNotes: Mokhaiotl waystones can be used to teleport directly inside the Ruins of Mokhaiotl, which is deep beneath the crypt.
The Pendant of Ates can be used to teleport to Kastori just east of the cavern's entrances.
The Quetzal Transport System can be used to land at Tal Teklan or Kastori, both near the cavern's entrances.
travel: The Crypt of Tonali is one of seven holy sites of the Losanium religion, located in the Tlati Rainforest.
Built by the Old Ones, the entrance to the crypt is a ziggurat with a large tree atop it, with a passageway in the tree allowing access to the underground caverns as well as the Ruins of Mokhaiotl.

custodia mountains.name: Custodia Mountains
custodia mountains.summary: The Custodia Mountains are a mountain range that separates Varlamore and the Kebos Lowlands, which are accessible after completion of the Children of the Sun quest. They were first explored by refugees escaping from Xeric during the Age of Strife. Travel between Auburnvale and the Kebos Lowlands is possible by walking through the mountains once player has unlocked both Varlamore and Great Kourend. A closed gatehouse blocks the path to the Stranglewood.
travel: The Custodia Mountains are a mountain range that separates Varlamore and the Kebos Lowlands, which are accessible after completion of the Children of the Sun quest.
Travel between Auburnvale and the Kebos Lowlands is possible by walking through the mountains once player has unlocked both Varlamore and Great Kourend.

custodia pass.name: Custodia Pass
custodia pass.summary: Custodia Pass is a trail in the Custodia Mountains allowing travel between Auburnvale and the Kebos Lowlands. The pass is briefly visited during the Shadows of Custodia quest. The pass contains the entrances to the Stalker Den, a dungeon where custodian stalkers are found.
travel: Custodia Pass is a trail in the Custodia Mountains allowing travel between Auburnvale and the Kebos Lowlands.
The pass contains the entrances to the Stalker Den, a dungeon where custodian stalkers are found.

dark altar.name: Dark Altar
dark altar.summary: The Dark Altar is an artefact located north of Arceuus. Guarded by Tyss, the Dark Altar is one of the most significant artefacts to not only the Citizens of Arceuus, but in the history of Great Kourend as well. It plays a critical role in the freeing of trapped souls in Kourend, as well as enabling the crafting of runes through the runic altars it has created. This power enables the souls of Great Kourend's dead to be transported to the River of Souls, where they are brought to the afterlife. Players can use the Dark Altar to transform dense essence blocks into dark essence blocks, draining their prayer points in the process. These dark essence blocks can then be used with a chisel and crushed into dark essence fragments, which are used to craft blood and soul runes. Each dark essence block is equivalent to 4 fragments of essence. Creating dark essence blocks will reduce prayer points by 1 per block and 2.5 Runecraft experience is gained per block. Dark essence blocks can be created without any remaining prayer points. Although not visible in-game, texts of an ancient language are inscribed on the Dark Altar, which contains a recurring symbol that translates to sacrifice, although it may also be interpreted as death.
transportNotes: There are several methods to quickly reach the Dark Altar:
Arceuus Home Teleport takes you direct to the Dark Altar
Fairy rings - Fairy ring CIS and run north then east.
Arceuus Library Teleport and run north and east.
Games necklace - Wintertodt teleport and run south
travel: The Dark Altar is an artefact located north of Arceuus.

dark warriors' fortress.name: Dark Warriors' Fortress
dark warriors' fortress.summary: The Dark Warriors' Fortress is a castle in level 14 to 16 multi-combat Wilderness, north of Ice Mountain. It is populated with level 8 and 145 dark warriors in members worlds, but only level 8 dark warriors in non-members worlds. Caution should be used as these warriors can overwhelm lower level players who don't use Protect from Melee.
transportNotes: Burning amulet teleport to the Bandit Camp and run south-west to the entrance
Dareeyak Teleport and run south-east.
travel: The Dark Warriors' Fortress is a castle in level 14 to 16 multi-combat Wilderness, north of Ice Mountain.

darkmeyer.name: Darkmeyer
darkmeyer.summary: Darkmeyer is the capital city of Morytania located in the Sanguinesti region, north of Meiyerditch. It is inhabited by vampyres and ruled by Lowerniel Drakan, his sister Vanescula Drakan and brother Ranis Drakan. Darkmeyer and Meiyerditch appear to be twin cities, with Darkmeyer making up the northern half of the region and Meiyerditch the southern half. The vampyric inhabitants get most of their blood from blood tithes conducted in the rundown neighbouring concentration camp Meiyerditch. The city can be entered with partial completion of the quest Sins of the Father, but completion of the quest and wearing a set of vyre noble clothing is required to access most of its features. Once the player has progressed to a certain point in The Blood Moon Rises, the set is no longer needed.
transportNotes: After exiting the Meiyerditch mine, a crack in the wall just north of the Meiyerditch mine exit leads players to the lower tier of the city.
After completing Sins of the Father, Drakan's medallion can teleport players to the city's upper tier.

A shortcut (requiring 63 Agility) becomes available on the eastern wall of Darkmeyer, requiring two long ropes, that can be bought for 104,000 coins (52,000 coins each, at full stock) in the Darkmeyer General Store.

With 52 Agility, 66 Thieving, and completion of Sins of the Father, hallowed crystal shards, bought with hallowed marks from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop (five are given freely at the first visit), teleport the player to the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby in the north-east section of the city.
travel: Darkmeyer is the capital city of Morytania located in the Sanguinesti region, north of Meiyerditch.
Darkmeyer and Meiyerditch appear to be twin cities, with Darkmeyer making up the northern half of the region and Meiyerditch the southern half.

death altar.name: Death Altar
death altar.summary: The Death Altar is a runic altar upon which death runes are crafted from pure essence, providing 10 Runecraft experience per essence imbued. Level 65 Runecraft and completion of the quest Mourning's End Part II are required to craft death runes. Players may create a death tiara here by using either a death talisman or a tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 50 Runecraft experience. A catalytic tiara can also be created here by using a catalytic talisman and gold tiara, granting 42.5 Runecraft experience. Upon entering the Death Altar, the music track La Mort plays.
transportNotes: The entrance to the altar can be found on the bottom level of the Temple of Light. After completion of Mourning's End Part II, the altar can also be accessed through the Abyss.

To enter the mysterious ruins, players either have to use a death talisman on the ruins, or click "Enter" on the ruins while wearing a death tiara. Alternatively, a catalytic talisman or tiara can be used.
As the altar is one of the least-accessible in terms of distance from a bank, it's recommended to use the Abyss in order to craft a large amount of runes.
Additionally, the altar can be accessed via the Guardians of the Rift minigame. This can be a useful shortcut if wanting to access the altar quickly while avoiding the wilderness.
Entering the ruins by walking requires entering the Temple of Light with a crystal trinket and using the following directions.
Go up the stairs at the main entrance.
Go to the centre of the temple.
Climb down the next stairs twice.
travel: The Death Altar is a runic altar upon which death runes are crafted from pure essence, providing 10 Runecraft experience per essence imbued.

death plateau (location).name: Death Plateau (location)
death plateau (location).summary: The Death Plateau is a tall, flat land formation, surrounded by steep ascents, north-west of Burthorpe and directly north of the Warriors' Guild. This area is inhabited by various trolls, who have recently set up camp in the area. Though the plateau is not a multi-combat area, the path leading around the plateau is riddled with thrower trolls and is multi-combat. Extreme caution is advised here, and players should take advantage of protection prayers as certain monsters can hit very high here. A dwarf multicannon may be used here.
transportNotes: A few teleports bring the player to Burthorpe, close to the plateau:
or — to the Burthorpe Games Room and walking north-west along the path.
— to the Warriors' Guild (then along the same path).
Note that you will need climbing boots to pass the various rock obstacles on some paths.
travel: The Death Plateau is a tall, flat land formation, surrounded by steep ascents, north-west of Burthorpe and directly north of the Warriors' Guild.

deep wilderness dungeon.name: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
deep wilderness dungeon.summary: The Deep Wilderness Dungeon can be found in level 51 Wilderness. The entrance is via stairs in a broken house west of the Mage Arena. It is entirely single-way combat and covers level 49 to 56 Wilderness. The main attractions here are the wine of Zamorak spawn found at the end of the dungeon, which respawns every 3-7 ticks (and are obtained in noted form if players have completed the hard Wilderness Diary), as well as the fire giants which can be assigned as a Wilderness Slayer task by Krystilia, this being their only location in the Wilderness. A cannon can be used within the dungeon. Approximately 9-14 wine of Zamorak per minute (540-840 per hour) can be obtained here, accounting for respawn times and the telekinetic grab animation. Note that unlike other wine of Zamorak spawns, killing the monks of Zamorak here does not allow a player to pick up the wines without telekinetic grab. The respawn time of the Wine of Zamorak is lower on worlds with higher population, following this chart: {| class="wikitable" !World Population !Ticks/Wine |- |1-444 |11 |- |445-889 |10 |- |890-1334 |9 |- |1335-1779 |8 |- |1780-2000 |7 |} A crevice can be found near the staircase, requiring level 46 Agility and completion of the medium Wilderness Diary, that will take the player directly to the fire giant area. There is also a grimy guam leaf and an attack potion(1) that spawns in the dungeon. Players who are planning on killing fire giants that do not have access to the crevice shortcut are advi
transportNotes: There are several ways to reach the deep wilderness dungeon:

Casting Ice Plateau Teleport and running East, requiring level 89 Magic and costing 3 law, 3 astral and 8 water runes. The dungeon entrance is approximately 90 tiles from the teleport location. Note that the teleport location features aggressive level 57 ice warriors.

Using the wilderness lever from Edgeville or Ardougne and running West past the Mage Arena, approximately 150 tiles in total. This route requires a knife or a slash weapon to cut the web at the edge of the Deserted Keep.
Running from the level 44 wilderness obelisk - first North to the gate on the Western edge of the wilderness fence, and then East to the entrance, is approximately 175 tiles.

The fastest way to leave the wilderness from the deep wilderness dungeon is to run East to the Mage Arena bank, from which players can teleport as normal. This route requires a knife or a slash weapon to cut the web at the bank's entrance.
travel: The Deep Wilderness Dungeon can be found in level 51 Wilderness.
The entrance is via stairs in a broken house west of the Mage Arena.

deepfin mine.name: Deepfin Mine
deepfin mine.summary: Deepfin Mine is a dungeon containing several mineable rocks including lead rocks and nickel rocks. It is accessible by entering the cave on Deepfin Point, which requires level 67 Sailing to dock at (unboostable). The dungeon contains two unbuilt bank chest spaces as well as Durrik's Goods, a general store with a unique stock of items for sale. Each bank chest requires 1 magic stone, 2 cupronickel bars, 2 adamantite bars, and 4 ironwood planks to build. The two eastern parts of the mine are linked with an agility shortcut, requiring 84 Agility to use. There are also attackable aberrant spectres, ankou, and giant ants to the east. A dwarf multicannon can be used in this dungeon, but the areas are single-way combat.
travel: It is accessible by entering the cave on Deepfin Point, which requires level 67 Sailing to dock at (unboostable).
The two eastern parts of the mine are linked with an agility shortcut, requiring 84 Agility to use.

deepfin point.name: Deepfin Point
deepfin point.summary: Deepfin Point is an island west of the Isle of Souls, in the Shrouded Ocean. Docking here requires level 67 Sailing. A cave in the north-west of the island leads to the Deepfin Mine, where various rocks can be mined. The island contains a lockbox near the entrance of the mines, which gives lockbox directions (Deepfin Point) when investigated and the dragon cannon schematic when unlocked. The key for this chest is located on Buccaneers' Haven. A patch of nettles can be found south-west of the yew trees. Several cormorants fly over the water surrounding the island.
transportNotes: Teleport with the sailors' amulet (requires inspecting Sailors' Marker before using)
The teleport location is 8 tiles away (on average) from a bank chest, making it one of the quickest banks to access in the game
Sailing to the gangplank on the west of the dock
Charter ship (requires an initial visit via other method to unlock).
travel: Deepfin Point is an island west of the Isle of Souls, in the Shrouded Ocean.
A cave in the north-west of the island leads to the Deepfin Mine, where various rocks can be mined.

digsite dungeon.name: Digsite Dungeon
digsite dungeon.summary: The Digsite Dungeon is below the Digsite and can only be accessed during and after The Dig Site quest. It appears to have once been a temple of Zaros. Players rarely use the dungeon after the quest, because of the dungeon's distance from a bank, though it has several iron pickaxe and bucket spawns and five silver rocks.
transportNotes: The entrances to the dungeon are at the Digsite. Players can walk to the Digsite from Varrock. There are also two fast ways to get there:
The Digsite pendant teleports to the north of the Digsite. (Players must play the Varrock Museum miniquest to learn how to enchant ruby necklaces into Digsite pendants.)

The Gnome glider to Lemanto Andra crashes to the west of the Digsite. Since the glider crashes on arrival, it cannot be used to travel away from the Digsite. (Players can use this glider after completing The Grand Tree quest.)

There are two entrances, each of which goes to a separate part of the dungeon. The entrances are winches that the player must use. The player must use a rope on the west winch to enter the dungeon there, which will not be consumed. The player can use the north-east winch without a rope.
travel: The Digsite Dungeon is below the Digsite and can only be accessed during and after The Dig Site quest.

dorgesh-kaan south dungeon.name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
dorgesh-kaan south dungeon.summary: The Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon is a dungeon south of the underground city of Dorgesh-Kaan (notated by an Agility icon on the map). Entry to the dungeon requires completion of the Death to the Dorgeshuun quest. The dungeon is dark and requires the player to have a light source or face relentless damage from stinging insects. A tinderbox is recommended (to relight the light source, just in case) but is not necessary. An antipoison potion may also be helpful, as there are several poisonous creatures in the dungeon. You can use a dwarf multicannon in the dungeon, however it is not multicombat.
travel: The Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon is a dungeon south of the underground city of Dorgesh-Kaan (notated by an Agility icon on the map).
caveats: Bring a safe light source. The Lumbridge Swamp Cave connection has a separate 36 Agility step.

dorgesh-kaan mine.name: Dorgesh-Kaan mine
dorgesh-kaan mine.summary: The Dorgesh-Kaan Mine (also known as Dorgeshuun Mines or Cave Goblin Mines), is used by the Dorgeshuun tribe of Cave goblins. The mine contains 9 iron ore rocks and 12 silver ore rocks, and it requires The Lost Tribe quest to be started to use. It can be accessed via the tunnels from the Lumbridge Castle cellar by going through the tunnel entrance and talking to or following Kazgar in the tunnel. (A player could retrace the route followed during The Lost Tribe, but this is unnecessary and dangerous.) The mine has the entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun underground city. Although the mine requires a light source, it is possible to enter the mine from Dorgesh-Kaan without one. It is even possible to navigate in the mine after doing this by using the darkened image provided. However, players attempting to do this will find themselves swarmed by cave insects that will damage them slowly but regularly (constant 1s, and these hits cannot be blocked by any form of Defence, including Prayer) until they either light up a light source, leave the mine, or die.
travel: It can be accessed via the tunnels from the Lumbridge Castle cellar by going through the tunnel entrance and talking to or following Kazgar in the tunnel.
(A player could retrace the route followed during The Lost Tribe, but this is unnecessary and dangerous.) The mine has the entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun underground city.

dragon nest.name: Dragon Nest
dragon nest.summary: The Dragon Nest is a cave east of Tal Teklan in the Tlati Rainforest. Completion of Children of the Sun is required to access the Rainforest, but the Nest has no other requirements to access. It is visited as part of the Scrambled! quest, where the player must retrieve a dragon egg from the south-east corner of the cave. Upon attempting to take the egg, the player is attacked by and must defeat a red dragon. Dragon Nest contains 5 blue dragons and 5 red dragons, in addition to 2 baby blue dragons and 2 baby red dragons. Item spawns include 4 blue dragon scales, some burnt bones, and a number of coin spawns. A cannon can be set up in the cave.
travel: The Dragon Nest is a cave east of Tal Teklan in the Tlati Rainforest.
Completion of Children of the Sun is required to access the Rainforest, but the Nest has no other requirements to access.

draynor manor.name: Draynor Manor
draynor manor.summary: Draynor Manor is a large, haunted, mansion located north of Draynor Village owned by Count Draynor Drakan. The manor contains 4 floors and is a central location for 3 quests: Ernest the Chicken, Vampyre Slayer, and Animal Magnetism, and is visited briefly during Fairytale I - Growing Pains. It also holds a portal that grants access to the dimension where killerwatts reside. There is a Belladonna patch outside the manor, towards the west and within the fence. Upon entering the manor through the front doors, the doors will lock behind the player. There is an exit in the eastern-most room that can be used to leave the building. The yard around the mansion contains dead trees that can be chopped down, but also undead trees that can attack the player and deal 0 to 3 damage. In the south-eastern part of the yard, vines can spawn from the ground that deal 1 damage to the player.
transportNotes: A few teleports bring the player close to the manor:
— directly to the manor doors via the . Players can also use the magic tablet equivalent.
— to Draynor Village then walk north to the manor
— to the Champions' Guild then run west to the manor via the stepping stones (31 Agility).
travel: Draynor Manor is a large, haunted, mansion located north of Draynor Village owned by Count Draynor Drakan.
It also holds a portal that grants access to the dimension where killerwatts reside.

draynor sewers.name: Draynor Sewers
draynor sewers.summary: The Draynor Village Sewers is a dungeon found beneath Draynor Village that is mainly populated by undead monsters: skeletons and zombies. It has two entrances: one entrance is to the west of village, and the other is just west of the jail. The sewers aren't a commonly ventured place since they only contain low level enemies.
transportNotes: The dungeon is located underneath a trapdoor north-west of Draynor (or north of the marketplace), and through an entrance west of the jailhouse.
Amulet of glory teleport to Draynor Village
travel: The Draynor Village Sewers is a dungeon found beneath Draynor Village that is mainly populated by undead monsters: skeletons and zombies.
It has two entrances: one entrance is to the west of village, and the other is just west of the jail.

draynor village.name: Draynor Village
draynor village.summary: Draynor Village, often shortened to Draynor, is a small village located between Falador and Lumbridge. The village is featured in many quests, and is a popular training location due to its willow trees and master farmers.
transportNotes: Several teleports bring players into or close to Draynor Village, listed here with their teleport destination. From closest to farthest:
— directly to the village centre.
— just south of the village bank.
— the spirit tree patch in Port Sarim, west of the village.
can teleport players to the farm south of Falador, north-west of Draynor.
— Draynor Manor, just north of the village.
— Port Sarim Rat Pits, well west of the village. Usable once every 20 minutes.
— Wizards' Tower, found south-east of the village.
travel: Draynor Village, often shortened to Draynor, is a small village located between Falador and Lumbridge.

dwarven mine.name: Dwarven Mine
dwarven mine.summary: The Dwarven Mine is a large mine ran by dwarves located beneath Asgarnia. It contains a variety of ores and can be accessed from the entrance south of Ice Mountain or from the two entrances located in Falador. The Dwarven Mine also connects to both the Mining Guild and the Motherlode Mine, which are located at the southern end of the mine. At the southern end of the mine, there is a severe infestation of scorpions and King Scorpions that will trouble those with lower combat levels. You need a combat level of 65 in order to be left alone by the King Scorpions. North of the scorpions is an Agility shortcut (narrow crevice in the wall) requiring level 42 Agility. The Mining Guild can be found in the southern part of the mine, requiring 60 Mining to access. The entrance to the Motherlode Mine can be found in the south-eastern section of the Dwarven Mine marked by a dungeon icon (). To make use of the Motherlode Mine, players require a minimum of 30 Mining, with 57 Mining required to access the upper level.
transportNotes: South gate: Entrance to the Mining Guild, level 60 Mining required. Using a skills necklace to teleport directly to the Mining Guild is the quickest way to get here.
Alternatively, Lassar Teleport to the top of the Ice Mountain, then run south down to the main entrance.
Falador entrance: A building in the far north-east of Falador has stairs down to the south end of the mine. A Falador Teleport is a fast way to get here and to get to the next entrance.

Main entrance: In the foothills of the Ice Mountain, north of the Falador-to-Barbarian Village road. Using a combat bracelet to teleport to the Edgeville Monastery is a quick way to get to this entrance. Another option is to use the Skull sceptre/Skull sceptre (i) to teleport to Barbarian village and walk north-west towards Ice Mountain.

Mine cart: Members may use the Keldagrim mine cart system, to enter the mine in the north-west section. This two-way network allows players to travel between the Dwarven Mine and the bustling dwarven capital of Keldagrim. From the cart station in Keldagrim it is also possible to travel to White Wolf Mountain and the Grand Exchange, provided that the Fishing Contest quest has been completed. One fast way to get to the mine is to take the carts from the Grand Exchange to Keldagrim and then to Ice Mountain.
travel: The Dwarven Mine is a large mine ran by dwarves located beneath Asgarnia.
It contains a variety of ores and can be accessed from the entrance south of Ice Mountain or from the two entrances located in Falador.

ectofuntus.name: Ectofuntus
ectofuntus.summary: The Ectofuntus is a fountain located within a temple just north of Port Phasmatys that can be worshipped for Prayer experience. Worshipping the Ectofuntus involves using the bone grinder on the upper level of the temple to crush any kind of bones into bonemeal, then clicking the Ectofuntus on the ground floor with the bonemeal and a bucket of slime in your inventory to consume them. Worshipping the Ectofuntus provides four times the Prayer experience that would be gained from burying the bones. 5 Ecto-tokens may be claimed per worship by talking to any ghost disciple while wearing a ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2+. These are used as a currency in the nearby Port Phasmatys and to charge the bonecrusher. Training at the Ectofuntus is a slower method than using a gilded altar or the Chaos altar, but is a cheaper alternative that doesn't require access to a player-owned house or the Wilderness.
travel: The Ectofuntus is a fountain located within a temple just north of Port Phasmatys that can be worshipped for Prayer experience.
5 Ecto-tokens may be claimed per worship by talking to any ghost disciple while wearing a ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2+.

edgeville dungeon.name: Edgeville Dungeon
edgeville dungeon.summary: The Edgeville Dungeon is a dungeon in Edgeville. It contains a large variety of monsters spanning across a wide range of levels, as well as the Slayer master Vannaka. It can be accessed by a trapdoor south of the Edgeville bank, or a locked shed (requiring a Brass key to open) west of the Cooks' Guild. The southern half of the dungeon is free-to-play, and is a popular location for killing Hill Giants on free-to-play worlds. The northern half is members-only, and is in the Wilderness, so anyone who wishes to explore the deeper parts of this dungeon should watch out for PK'ers and only bring items that they are willing to lose. The Members' area is a popular location for killing Chaos druids. The Dwarf Multicannon can be used here.
transportNotes: There are three entrances to the dungeon:
One is found in Edgeville, in the ruined house south of the bank. It is a trapdoor by a coffin marked by a dungeon icon () on the minimap. ()
The other is found in a locked shed west of the Cooks' Guild near Varrock on the east side of the River Lum. To get in, the player must bring a brass key, which can be found in the dungeon. ()
An obstacle pipe Agility shortcut from the Varrock Sewers, near Bryophyta's lair. ()
Alternatively, the Paddewwa Teleport on the Ancient Magicks spellbook can be used to teleport directly into the dungeon.
travel: It can be accessed by a trapdoor south of the Edgeville bank, or a locked shed (requiring a Brass key to open) west of the Cooks' Guild.
The southern half of the dungeon is free-to-play, and is a popular location for killing Hill Giants on free-to-play worlds.

edgeville dungeon mine.name: Edgeville Dungeon mine
edgeville dungeon mine.summary: The Edgeville Dungeon mine is a mine near the centre of the Edgeville Dungeon. The mine itself is north of the hill giants and the ladder near the brass key. It is south of Vannaka and the Agility shortcut to Varrock Sewers. It is sometimes called the Skeleton Mine by some; similar to how several other mines guarded by skeletons are called the same, such as the Southern Wilderness mine. Due to being so far out of the way, the mine is almost never used by non-Free-to-play players. It is a compact mine with a variety of ores. The resident skeletons and the occasionally visiting hobgoblin may be dangerous for players with low combat levels.
transportNotes: The long way: From the dungeon entrance at Edgeville, through the dungeon.

The short way: In a small room north of the hill giants but south of the mine, there is the brass key spawn. This key can be used to enter and exit the Edgeville Dungeon via the ladder just north of the hill giants. This is by far the fastest walking route to and from the mine.

Nearest bank: Varrock west bank, with the brass key. However, if a player has Varrock armour 3, from completing their hard Varrock Diary, they can use the bank within the Cooks' Guild. This bank is closer than Varrock west bank.

Teleportation: Paddewwa Teleport, from the Ancient Magicks spellbook, teleports the user to the entrance of Edgeville Dungeon. However, this is not recommended for long-term mining due to the distance to the mine from the teleport.
travel: The mine itself is north of the hill giants and the ladder near the brass key.
It is south of Vannaka and the Agility shortcut to Varrock Sewers.

entrana.name: Entrana
entrana.summary: Entrana is a large island south-west of Taverley, occupied by Saradominist monks. When entering Entrana, adventurers are prohibited from bringing most weapons or armour with them.
transportNotes: Via a ship in Port Sarim by talking to the monks on the dock
through the Law Altar via the Abyss in the Wilderness
Docking there via the Sailing skill (requires 36 Sailing)
Teleport to Boat — Entrana mooring point once a player-owned boat with a greater teleport focus is docked there.

Before being able to sail or fly to Entrana, the monk or a balloon transport assistant will search the player to make sure that there are no prohibited items being brought to the island. At the law rift, the power of Saradomin is present and will prevent the player from bringing prohibited equipment.

If a player logs in on Entrana or exits the Law Altar with prohibited equipment, a monk will immediately appear next to the player on Entrana and knock them unconscious. The player will then reawaken in Port Sarim aboard the Entrana ferry, and exclaim .

Generally, players cannot take any armour with attack or defence bonuses to the island. Most non-equipable items that deal damage (such as runes and poison dynamite) are allowed. Some items which violate these rules can still be brought to the island, listed below.

Trying to Telekinetic Grab dropped items on the coast of Falador will result in a chat message saying . Additionally, players cannot smuggle weapons or armour to Entrana by opening Treasure Trails caskets there, as they cannot be received on the island; an alternate version of the drop table without prohibited items is rolled instead. This makes it useful for players seeking specific rewards such as god pages to open caskets on the island. However, beginner and master caskets may not be opened on the island; if attempted, a message displays saying Although monk's robes are allowed on the island, you are not able to receive the monk's robe top (g) or the monk's robe (g) from easy caskets here as they are considered a tier-specific clue unique on the easy clue loot table.
travel: Port Sarim monks' ship
Pass the equipment inspection
Entrana

entrana dungeon.name: Entrana Dungeon
entrana dungeon.summary: The Entrana Dungeon is found on the north-west corner of Entrana. Entering the dungeon drains your Prayer to almost zero, and there is no way to climb back up to Entrana from inside. It is visited during the Lost City and Recipe for Disaster quests. There are zombies, greater demons and during the Lost City quest, a Dramen Tree Spirit. However, armour and weapons can't be brought to the island, so the player must obtain their own via killing the zombies or demons.
travel: The Entrana Dungeon is found on the north-west corner of Entrana.
Entering the dungeon drains your Prayer to almost zero, and there is no way to climb back up to Entrana from inside.
caveats: Entrana forbids ordinary weapons and armour. The dungeon is one-way, drains Prayer and needs an exit teleport or the Wilderness exit.

etceteria.name: Etceteria
etceteria.summary: Etceteria is an island kingdom in the Northern Ocean, north-west off the coast of the Fremennik Province. It was formed as a colony by Fremenniks who split off from the Fremennik people of the mainland due to cultural differences a long time ago, but has since become independent. It lies directly east of the kingdom of Miscellania. The island kingdom is ruled by Queen Sigrid, who was at war with King Vargas of the Kingdom of Miscellania. The two kingdoms have been at war (despite neither side having an army) prior to the player intervening in their politics. After the events of Throne of Miscellania, peace was established between the two monarchs. Immediately after, tensions rose again primarily due to the meddling of Fremennik kids, which were found out about and resolved by the player during the events of Royal Trouble.
transportNotes: A spirit tree can be grown in the spirit tree patch on Etceteria, provided that the relevant quest and Farming level requirements have been met to grow and use it. This is the only direct transportation to Etceteria.

A boat found off of the second most western dock in northern Rellekka sails to and from the dock on Miscellania (requires the completion of the quest The Fremennik Trials). The player will need to travel north and then east across the bridge to reach Etceteria. Players with 55 Agility can hop across the rocks connecting the dock and southern Etceteria.
Docking at the island with level 65 Sailing and after the completion of Royal Trouble
There is a fairy ring (code Fairy ring CIP) to the north-west on Miscellania, which requires the completion of The Fremennik Trials in order to use.
A charged ring of wealth can be used to teleport to Miscellania, but only once Throne of Miscellania has been completed.
travel: Etceteria is an island kingdom in the Northern Ocean, north-west off the coast of the Fremennik Province.
It lies directly east of the kingdom of Miscellania.

evil chicken's lair.name: Evil Chicken's Lair
evil chicken's lair.summary: The Evil Chicken's Lair is located on Zanaris and is accessed by using a raw chicken on the Chicken Shrine. Undead raw chicken does not work. It is accessible during and after the Recipe for Disaster subquest Freeing Sir Amik Varze during which players must kill the Evil Chicken. To be able to access the Evil Chicken's Lair, the player must have spoken to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village after speaking to the Cook to learn Sir Amik Varze's recipe. The area can be exited via the portal, which takes you next to the chicken shrine.
travel: The Evil Chicken's Lair is located on Zanaris and is accessed by using a raw chicken on the Chicken Shrine.
It is accessible during and after the Recipe for Disaster subquest Freeing Sir Amik Varze during which players must kill the Evil Chicken.

falador.name: Falador
falador.summary: Falador is the capital city of the Kingdom of Asgarnia, currently ruled by King Vallance. It is home to the iconic White Knight's Castle, and is one of the largest and most major cities, only slightly smaller than Varrock. It plays a key role in the Gielinor ore trade because it houses the Mining Guild, the Motherlode Mine, and a portion of the large Dwarven mine underground.
transportNotes: North gate - road leading to Barbarian Village and Goblin Village
South gate - road leading to Port Sarim
Mine entrance next to Party Room (with access to dwarf cart system)
Agility shortcuts (members only):
Northern Wall Grapple (requires crossbow, grapple, 11 Agility, 37 Strength, and 19 Ranged)
Western Wall Climb (with 5 Agility)
Southern Wall Tunnel (with 26 Agility)

The guards near the north and south gates are popular targets for players hunting for clue scrolls, due to the completion of the medium Falador Diary awarding a 20% increased chance of receiving a clue scroll drop from guards in Falador.
travel: Falador is the capital city of the Kingdom of Asgarnia, currently ruled by King Vallance.

white knights' castle.name: White Knights' Castle
white knights' castle.summary: The White Knights' Castle is the centre of Falador and base of the White Knights, who are a major political force in Asgarnia and loyal to Saradomin. If the player has completed Recruitment Drive, they can talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien and make the castle their respawn point.
travel: The White Knights' Castle is the centre of Falador and base of the White Knights, who are a major political force in Asgarnia and loyal to Saradomin.

falador park.name: Falador Park
falador park.summary: The Falador Park is a large, fenced-in park found in Falador. Several gardeners maintain the plants and ponds located here. It is the entrance to the lair of the Giant Mole, and is a key location in the members' quest Wanted!, as well as the free-to-play quest Pirate's Treasure which requires the player to dig the ground at Falador Park. Multiple Treasure Trails clue scrolls will also lead the player to Falador Park in order to talk to Wyson the gardener or play music for Cecilia. Sir Tiffy Cashien can also be found in the park. He is involved in several quests.
travel: The Falador Park is a large, fenced-in park found in Falador.
Several gardeners maintain the plants and ponds located here.

farming guild.name: Farming Guild
farming guild.summary: The Farming Guild is a members-only guild located within the Kebos Lowlands just north of the Kebos Swamp. The guild is a large greenhouse separated into three tiers, with each tier requiring an increasing Farming level to enter (boosts may be used for all tiers). To enter the guild, a minimum Farming level of 45 is required. This will take you into the central area of the guild. The beginner section of the guild (the eastern wing) is also already accessible from level 45 onwards, but the intermediate and advanced tier requires level 65 and 85 Farming to enter respectively. The guild was founded by Jane, the guildmaster, along with other fellow Hosidius farmers after the Shayzien Army cleared out the lizardmen in the surrounding area. Despite the risks of the lizardmen just across River Molch, the discoveries made here, along with the heat coming from Mount Karuulm just north-east, allows the guild to grow flora that would never survive in Great Kourend's climate, such as the Hespori and the celastrus tree.
transportNotes: Using a skills necklace to teleport to the guild. Players with at least 45 Farming will be teleported inside the guild rather than outside.
Note: If teleporting inside the guild, players must leave and re-enter the guild to satisfy the requirements of the medium Kourend & Kebos Diary
Using the Farming cape to teleport to the guild.

Using the Lovakengj Minecart Network to the Farming Guild station, and run east. Using the Minigame Teleport to Tithe Farm puts you very close to a minecart. Minecarts cost 20 gp unless The Forsaken Tower has been completed.
Casting Battlefront Teleport or using the magic tablet equivalent, then run west to the guild.
Travelling to Mount Karuulm via fairy ring (code Fairy ring CIR), and running south-west.

Players with 85 Farming can plant a spirit tree in the advanced tier of the guild. If players with less than 85 have a fully grown spirit tree planted, they must boost their level to 85 in order to teleport via spirit tree.
Using Rada's blessing 3 or Rada's blessing 4, obtained from completing the hard and elite Kourend & Kebos Diary respectively, to teleport to Mount Karuulm and walk south-west to the guild.
travel: The Farming Guild is a members-only guild located within the Kebos Lowlands just north of the Kebos Swamp.
The beginner section of the guild (the eastern wing) is also already accessible from level 45 onwards, but the intermediate and advanced tier requires level 65 and 85 Farming to enter respectively.

feldip hills.name: Feldip Hills
feldip hills.summary: The Feldip Hills are a tropical and marshy area positioned to the south of Yanille and Kandarin generally. The region is dominated by a variety of ogre inhabitants, centred in their city of Gu'Tanoth. To the west of Gu'Tanoth is the ogre burial ground, Jiggig, filled with zogres and skogres. To the west of Jiggig is the Chompy Marsh and Smoke Devil Dungeon. Further to the south is the Feldip hunter area. After completing the quest Big Chompy Bird Hunting, the hunting area can be used to hunt chompy birds. There is a southernmost section accessible to free-to-play centred around the Corsair Cove. The Myths' Guild is found at the southwestern corner.
transportNotes: A number of transportation options exist for travelling through the Feldip Hills:
Bring a Rope and a teasing stick the first time entering through the Feldip Hills.
travel: The Feldip Hills are a tropical and marshy area positioned to the south of Yanille and Kandarin generally.
To the west of Gu'Tanoth is the ogre burial ground, Jiggig, filled with zogres and skogres.

ferox enclave.name: Ferox Enclave
ferox enclave.summary: Ferox Enclave is the restored remains of the Carrallanger fortress, once part of the Zarosian Empire before being abandoned and left to decay over the ages. It has since been transformed into a safe haven for travellers by Ferox, a former Zamorakian acolyte seeking knowledge to uncover the history of the Wilderness. The town is a safe area within the Wilderness, meaning players cannot kill other players while within the boundaries of the town. Due to the nature of the Tele Block spell, Ferox does not allow players who have had it cast on them to enter the town through the town's barriers until the spell has worn off, though players may still enter whilst in combat. Outside of the town by each entrance, there is a semi-safe-zone area immediately outside the barriers where (under normal circumstances) players cannot be attacked. While you are tele-blocked, you cannot attack anyone by default. However, anyone within your combat level range is able to attack you in this "safe" zone. You are able to retaliate against them if this happens. While tele-blocked, someone attacking you will not prevent them from re-entering Ferox Enclave, provided they are not tele-blocked themselves. Getting a skull via tele-blocking a player, followed by intentionally dying to get rid of it afterwards, will cause the tele-blocked player to gain a skull themselves if they attack you, as well as being able to attack you "without" retaliation. The town is home to Clan Wars and Last Man Standing, as well
transportNotes: The level 13 Wilderness obelisk is east of the Enclave. There are also a few safe methods of reaching Ferox Enclave that do not require players to traverse the Wilderness:
A ring of dueling will teleport directly here.
Minigame Teleport to the Bounty Hunter, Last Man Standing and Clan Wars minigames.
Exiting the Castle Wars area in a free-to-play world.
Using a waka canoe along the River Lum to row here (requires level 57 Woodcutting).
travel: It has since been transformed into a safe haven for travellers by Ferox, a former Zamorakian acolyte seeking knowledge to uncover the history of the Wilderness.
Outside of the town by each entrance, there is a semi-safe-zone area immediately outside the barriers where (under normal circumstances) players cannot be attacked.

fire altar.name: Fire Altar
fire altar.summary: The Fire Altar is a runic altar upon which fire runes are crafted from rune essence or pure essence, providing 7 Runecraft experience per essence imbued. Level 14 Runecraft is required to craft fire runes. Players may create a fire tiara here by using either a fire talisman or a tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 35 Runecraft experience. An elemental tiara can also be created here by using an elemental talisman and gold tiara, granting 40 Runecraft experience. Upon entering the Fire Altar, the music track Quest plays.
transportNotes: The entrance to the altar can be found north of Al Kharid, west of the Emir's Arena, the altar can also be accessed through the Abyss. The ring of the elements can be used to teleport to the altar.

To enter the mysterious ruins, players either have to use a fire talisman on the ruins, or click "Enter" on the ruins while wearing a fire tiara. Alternatively, an elemental talisman or tiara can be used.
travel: The Fire Altar is a runic altar upon which fire runes are crafted from rune essence or pure essence, providing 7 Runecraft experience per essence imbued.

fisher realm.name: Fisher Realm
fisher realm.summary: The Realm of the Fisher King is the name given to a small kingdom located on an inter-dimensional plane alongside that of Gielinor's. The area plays a key role in the Holy Grail quest, in which the player is tasked with returning the grail to The Knights of the Round Table following Sir Galahad's choice to pardon himself from the order so he could become a monk. Prior to completion of the quest, the area is ruled by The Fisher King; however, he is eventually succeeded by Sir Percival upon completion of the quest. It can be accessed during the quest by blowing the magic whistle underneath the Brimhaven watchtower, or may be revisited by the use of fairy ring code Fairy ring BJR.
transportNotes: The completion of Holy Grail up to the point that you are able to pick up the Holy grail is required to access the Fisher Realm.
Blowing a magic whistle under a tower near a horseshoe gold mining spot north-west of Brimhaven.
Fairy ring code Fairy ring BJR teleports on the northern side of the realm.
travel: The Realm of the Fisher King is the name given to a small kingdom located on an inter-dimensional plane alongside that of Gielinor's.
It can be accessed during the quest by blowing the magic whistle underneath the Brimhaven watchtower, or may be revisited by the use of fairy ring code Fairy ring BJR.

fishing guild.name: Fishing Guild
fishing guild.summary: The Fishing Guild is a members-only guild located in a fenced area north of East Ardougne; west of Hemenster, which was released on 17 June 2002. To enter, players must have a Fishing level of 68; temporary boosts can be used to boost one's level in order to enter the guild, making the lowest level to possibly enter 62 using a super fishing potion. Historically, aside from Catherby, the Fishing Guild has been one of the most popular places to fish because of the nearby bank. Outside of the guild is the Master Fisher. Players can talk to him to receive advice on training Fishing, or to purchase a Fishing cape for 99,000 coins. While inside the guild, players will receive an invisible +7 level boost to their Fishing. This boost will stack with any existing boosts the player already has, such as the visible +3 boost from using the dragon harpoon's special attack, though visible boosts are capped to level 99. However, the invisible boost will not allow a player to perform actions above their base level. The guild is an excellent option for players hunting big fish, since the big bass, big swordfish, and big shark are all obtainable from the fishing spots around the docks.
transportNotes: The fishing guild is located south-west of Seers' Village and north of Ardougne. There are several transportation options
Using a Skills necklace to teleport directly outside the front door.
Teleporting to Camelot and running west through Seers' Village and then south-west through Hemenster.
Teleporting to Ardougne and running north (requires Plague City).
Using the lunar spell Fishing Guild Teleport.
Using a Combat bracelet to teleport to the Ranging Guild and run west.
Kandarin headgear 3/4 teleport to Sherlock and running west.
Using the Ardougne cloak 2/3/4, teleport to the farming patch north of Ardougne and head west.
travel: The Fishing Guild is a members-only guild located in a fenced area north of East Ardougne; west of Hemenster, which was released on 17 June 2002.

To enter, players must have a Fishing level of 68; temporary boosts can be used to boost one's level in order to enter the guild, making the lowest level to possibly enter 62 using a super fishing potion.

forthos dungeon.name: Forthos Dungeon
forthos dungeon.summary: The Forthos Dungeon, also known as the Ruined Temple Dungeon and Hosidius Dungeon, is an ancient underground temple found beneath the Forthos Ruin in Hosidius. The underground temple is one dedicated to Ralos, the god of the sun, and Ranul, the god of the moon, and is believed to be the origin of the Losanium religion. Monsters here range from mid to high combat levels and can be accessed from the staircase in the Forthos Ruin itself or the smaller ruins just east. Additionally, players can access The Shallows within the Catacombs of Kourend via the strange passage once climbing down the stairs from the Forthos Ruin. However, this passage will only open once the player has climbed up the respective vine from inside the Catacombs. Dwarf multicannons cannot be placed inside the Forthos Dungeon. If players attempt to place one, the chatbox will state "A mysterious presence prevents your cannon being set up here."
transportNotes: The dungeon can be easily reached by various teleport methods:
Xeric's talisman - Teleporting to Xeric's Glade brings players just east of the eastern dungeon entrance.
Kharedst's memoirs/Book of the Dead - Using the "Lunch by the Lancalliums" teleport brings the player by the River Hos just north-east of the dungeon entrances.
Watson teleport - Brings the player to Watson's house, just west of the Forthos Ruin.
Spirit tree - Brings the player just south of the Ruin.
Lovakengj Minecart Network - The Hosidius West station of the minecart network brings the player just south of the Ruin.
Skills necklace - Teleport to the Woodcutting Guild and run north.
Hosidius player-owned house portal - Teleport to House spell or redirected house tab and run north west.
travel: The Forthos Dungeon, also known as the Ruined Temple Dungeon and Hosidius Dungeon, is an ancient underground temple found beneath the Forthos Ruin in Hosidius.
Monsters here range from mid to high combat levels and can be accessed from the staircase in the Forthos Ruin itself or the smaller ruins just east.

fortis cothon.name: Fortis Cothon
fortis cothon.summary: The Fortis Cothon is a large harbour on the north side of Civitas illa Fortis. Players who sail to Fortis via charter ship will arrive here. During the Twilight's Promise quest, the player must travel to the Fortis Cothon to speak with Nel, a Knight of Varlamore. If you have completed the quest Children of the Sun you can travel there by talking with Regulus Cento. He can be found outside Varrock's east gate. Players may dock their own boats here at level 38 Sailing.
travel: The Fortis Cothon is a large harbour on the north side of Civitas illa Fortis.
During the Twilight's Promise quest, the player must travel to the Fortis Cothon to speak with Nel, a Knight of Varlamore.

fossil island.name: Fossil Island
fossil island.summary: Fossil Island is a members-only area located north-east of Morytania and unveils a unique environment where players can train a variety of skills. It is an ancient, uncharted island currently being explored by the Varrock Museum. The island itself is surrounded by seven other smaller islands, though they are currently inaccessible save for Lithkren, the island north-west that players visit during the quest Dragon Slayer II. In order to reach the island, players must have completed the Bone Voyage quest. Fossil Island uses a form of currency called Numulite.
transportNotes: Initially, Fossil Island could only be reached via the barge from the Digsite, which is close to the Varrock Teleport.

The fastest way to travel to Fossil Island is to use a digsite pendant, which will teleport the player near the barge at the Digsite, where they can fast travel to the Museum Camp by speaking to the barge guard.

The pendant can be used on the southernmost strange machine inside the House on the Hill, north-east of the Museum Camp, to unlock the 'Fossil Island' (or house) teleport option. There is also a magic mushtree at the house that utilises the Mycelium Transportation System; this system of magic mushtrees allows transportation around Fossil Island, but in order to access them, they must be discovered by walking to their locations first and attempting to use them.
If a digsite pendant is not available, several other options to reach the Digsite are available.
The fastest way is to use a Digsite teleport scroll which teleports players south-west of the barge.

Alternatively, gnome glider transport to Lemanto Andra, the glider landing site south-west of the barge, can be suitable with easy access to a glider. Players can use a ring of dueling to teleport to the Emir's Arena to use the glider west of the gem trader in Al Kharid, the Cowbell amulet and run south east to the glider west of the gem trader in Al Kharid, or travel to the Gnome Stronghold via a royal seed pod after completion of Monkey Madness II to use the glider atop the Grand Tree.
travel: Fossil Island is a members-only area located north-east of Morytania and unveils a unique environment where players can train a variety of skills.
The island itself is surrounded by seven other smaller islands, though they are currently inaccessible save for Lithkren, the island north-west that players visit during the quest Dragon Slayer II.

fossil island volcano.name: Fossil Island Volcano
fossil island volcano.summary: The Fossil Island Volcano (marked Volcano on the world map) is a volcanic outcrop found on the eastern coast of Fossil Island. Periodically, there are volcanic eruptions shooting balls of lava out of the volcano. If one hits a player, it can inflict minor damage. The entrance to the Volcanic Mine can be found here. In addition, there are also many ash piles found throughout the volcano, which can be mined for soda ash and volcanic ash. Near the volcano, the Fossil Island mine and the Verdant Valley can be found.
travel: The Fossil Island Volcano (marked Volcano on the world map) is a volcanic outcrop found on the eastern coast of Fossil Island.
The entrance to the Volcanic Mine can be found here.

fred's farm.name: Fred's farm
fred's farm.summary: Fred's farm, also known as the Lumbridge farm, is a large farm in Lumbridge found north of the Lumbridge Castle. The farm is owned by Fred the Farmer, and is worked by Fred and several farmers.
travel: Fred's farm, also known as the Lumbridge farm, is a large farm in Lumbridge found north of the Lumbridge Castle.

fremennik isles.name: Fremennik Isles
fremennik isles.summary: The Fremennik Isles are a volcanic archipelago in the Northern Ocean consisting of six islands: Jatizso, Neitiznot, an uninhabited island containing the Central Fremennik Isles mine, an island containing the Ice Troll Caves, an island north of Neitiznot where honour guards fight ice trolls and an island north of Jatizso where guards also fight ice trolls. Although the islands of Miscellania and Etceteria are also inhabited by Fremennik, they are not part of the Fremennik Isles. They are the location where most of the The Fremennik Isles quest takes place. Points of interest include the towns of Neitiznot and Jatizso, Jatizso mine, the Central Fremennik Isles mine and the yak enclosure. The ice trolls north of Jatizso are commonly killed on slayer task due to their valuable drops and the island being multicombat. The East Fremennik Isles mine and the West Fremennik Isles mine are also located on the isles.
transportNotes: The Fremennik Isles are located north-west of Rellekka. There are several ways to get there:
After completion of the elite Fremennik Diary, use the "Neitiznot" or "Jatizso" option on an enchanted lyre.
Use the "Rellekka" option on an enchanted lyre to get to Rellekka, and then talk to Maria Gunnars or Mord Gunnars on the northernmost dock. There is no cost for this travel.
travel: The Fremennik Isles are a volcanic archipelago in the Northern Ocean consisting of six islands: Jatizso, Neitiznot, an uninhabited island containing the Central Fremennik Isles mine, an island containing the Ice Troll Caves, an island north of Neitiznot where honour guards fight ice trolls and an island north of Jatizso where guards also fight ice trolls.
The ice trolls north of Jatizso are commonly killed on slayer task due to their valuable drops and the island being multicombat.

fremennik slayer dungeon.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
fremennik slayer dungeon.summary: The Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, also known as the Rellekka Slayer Caves and the Fremennik Slayer Cave, is a cave system found south-east of Rellekka, featuring slayer monsters that can only be killed by players with the appropriate Slayer level. The monsters within require progressively higher levels as the player travels deeper into the caves. Players cannot set up a dwarf multicannon within the caves. Attempting to do so yields the chatbox message:
transportNotes: The entrance to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon is east of Rellekka and north-east of Sinclair Mansion (). There are several ways to reach the cave:
(Fastest method) Players may use the slayer ring to teleport next to the cave exit.
Players can get there via the fairy rings (code Fairy ring AJR). This is also a fast way to bank in Zanaris.
Players can set out from Rellekka and head south-east past the Golden Apple Tree.
The Rellekka home teleport, Enchanted lyre, or Fremennik sea boots can be used to quickly reach Rellekka, if the player meets the requirements to use them.
Players can travel south from the entrance to the underground city of Keldagrim.
The eagle transport system gets the player a bit to the north of the cave.

Players may teleport to Camelot and travel the road that leads north, taking a left at the first fork, which leads you towards Rellekka. There is a log balance shortcut south-west of the cave, requiring 48 Agility to pass.
travel: The Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, also known as the Rellekka Slayer Caves and the Fremennik Slayer Cave, is a cave system found south-east of Rellekka, featuring slayer monsters that can only be killed by players with the appropriate Slayer level.
The monsters within require progressively higher levels as the player travels deeper into the caves.

frozen waste plateau.name: Frozen Waste Plateau
frozen waste plateau.summary: The Frozen Waste Plateau, also known as Ice Plateau (or historically Ghorrock), is located in the north-west corner of the Wilderness. The area spans both free-to-play and members areas. It contains ice giants and ice warriors in the free-to-play area. In the member's area, ice spiders can also be found. There are also spawns of water runes and cosmic runes. Notably, three runite rocks can be found in the members' only area of the plateau.
transportNotes: The area can be quickly accessed using the Ghorrock Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook (south of the Wilderness fence) at Level 96 Magic, or the Ice Plateau Teleport from the Lunar spellbook (north of the wilderness fence) at Level 89 Magic. Portals to each of these locations can be built in a Portal chamber in a Player-owned house.
travel: The Frozen Waste Plateau, also known as Ice Plateau (or historically Ghorrock), is located in the north-west corner of the Wilderness.
In the member's area, ice spiders can also be found.

gertrude.name: Gertrude
gertrude.summary: Gertrude Fairweather is a woman living in a house just west of Varrock. She is the starting point for both the Gertrude's Cat and Ratcatchers quests. She has four sons: Wilough, Shilop, Philop, and Kanel. Her husband, Walter Fairweather, is a travelling merchant, and is not present ingame. Once your cat has become overgrown, she will sell you kittens for , but keep in mind you can only have one kitten at a time. When you have a normal cat in your inventory or in your bank, she won't give you a kitten. If you store your normal cats in your POH, she will sell you a new kitten. The colour of the kitten is random unless you have a Ring of Charos(a), then you will be able to charm Gertrude into letting you choose the colour of the kitten. Doing so the first time completes a medium Varrock Diary task. Once a player catches 100 rats with their cat, she'll award them with the cat training medal. Note that this must be done before their cat reaches overgrown stage, or they'll not get the reward.
travel: Gertrude Fairweather is a woman living in a house just west of Varrock.
Her husband, Walter Fairweather, is a travelling merchant, and is not present ingame.

giant pit.name: Giant Pit
giant pit.summary: The Giant Pit is a small enclosure found north-west of Shayzien. Occupied by 13 Hill Giants, the pit is guarded by three soldiers and their sergeant. A jetty can be found just west where players can board the boaty to Molch, Lake Molch, or the Battlefront. Just south-west of the pit is a cave entrance that leads to the Giants' Den, which is inhabited by more dangerous giants that have been corrupted by the power of the Dark Altar. Immediately south of the den is the Secluded Chapel. An easy way to travel to the Giant Pit is to use fairy ring Fairy ring DJR and run south; or travel to History and Hearsay via the Kharedst's memoirs or the Book of the Dead and run north then west.
travel: The Giant Pit is a small enclosure found north-west of Shayzien.
A jetty can be found just west where players can board the boaty to Molch, Lake Molch, or the Battlefront.

giants' den.name: Giants' Den
giants' den.summary: The Giants' Den is a dungeon located just south-west of the Giant Pit, within a cave housing a variety of giants. All of the giants can be killed with or without a Slayer task. Giants in the den have access to the Catacombs of Kourend drop table, including dark totem pieces and ancient shards. The Catacombs' effect of restoring prayer points when bones are buried also applies within the Giants' Den. Despite this, the Fire Giants in the Giants' Den do not count towards a slayer task required to be completed within the Catacombs of Kourend, assigned by Konar quo Maten. The vine ladder near the skeletons inside the Catacombs of Kourend must first be used to travel to the Giants' Den to unlock the strange passage. After it is unlocked, it can be used to travel both ways. A dwarf multicannon can be used in the den; however, it is only single-way combat. Random events do not spawn while you are inside the Giants' Den. If a random event has tried to spawn while a player is inside the den, it will spawn at the next 5-minute interval after leaving.
transportNotes: Lovakengj Minecart Network to Shayzien West brings you right next to the dungeon
Kourend Castle Teleport or Xeric's talisman teleport to Xeric's Heart, enter the catacombs of Kourend, run west to the skeletons and climb the vine ladder.
Fairy ring Fairy ring DJR and run south-west, by the coast. Just south of the dock, there is a cave.
Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead to 'History and Hearsay' Shayzien teleport, run south-west through the graveyard gate, then north-west.
travel: The Giants' Den is a dungeon located just south-west of the Giant Pit, within a cave housing a variety of giants.
Giants in the den have access to the Catacombs of Kourend drop table, including dark totem pieces and ancient shards.

giants' plateau.name: Giants' Plateau
giants' plateau.summary: The Giants' Plateau is an area found east of Al Kharid. Prior to the release of Ferox Enclave, the plateau was the location where players could participate in the Clan Wars and Last Man Standing minigames. Here, players can find Dr Ford, who has set up camp after hearing whispers from the nearby hole; a tinderbox and bronze pickaxe spawn on the large table nearby. Players can also find an anvil further south, with a bronze scimitar and wooden shield spawn on the large table next to it. Further south, players can find a small tribe of hill giants, who share the same drop table as their standard counterparts, but drop steel scimitars and iron med helms instead of steel longswords and iron full helms respectively.
