Here, players can start the Sleeping Giants quest and play the Giants' Foundry minigame within the nearby cave entrance. On the eastern end of the plateau, players can find the Citharede Abbey, a small abandoned Saradominist abbey, as well as a mine, with three iron rocks and four coal rocks.
transportNotes: Minigame Teleport to Giants' Foundry
Necklace of passage to teleport to Eagle's Eyrie, then climb rocks to the west (requires level 54 Agility)
Amulet of glory to teleport to Al Kharid, then run east through the gate.
Ring of dueling to teleport to the Emir's Arena, then run south-east.
travel: The Giants' Plateau is an area found east of Al Kharid.
Players can also find an anvil further south, with a bronze scimitar and wooden shield spawn on the large table next to it.

glarial's tomb.name: Glarial's Tomb
glarial's tomb.summary: Glarial's Tomb is a dungeon underneath the tombstone near the Baxtorian Falls and the Kingdom of Kandarin. To enter, the player needs Glarial's pebble, which is obtained during the Waterfall Quest, and must not have any weapons, armour or runes either equipped or in their inventory. Level 84 moss guardians roam here. The location is close to the Fishing Guild; use Glarial's pebble on her tombstone and you may enter. Players can get Glarial's amulet in the west chest. This location can be re-entered after the Waterfall Quest has been completed in order to obtain Glarial's amulet once again. Glarial's tomb is also involved with the Roving Elves quest. The player has to kill a moss guardian completely unarmed and unarmoured (food and potions are allowed) to obtain a consecration seed. The tomb has a roaming mysterious ghost outside of it named Valdez, who can only be seen when wearing the Ring of visibility. This ghost starts the Curse of the Empty Lord miniquest.
travel: Players can get Glarial's amulet in the west chest.
glarial's tomb.confirmation: Requires Glarial's pebble and an unarmed, unarmoured, rune-free entry method.
caveats: Waterfall Quest completion does not waive the pebble and equipment restrictions.

gloomthorn trail.name: Gloomthorn Trail
gloomthorn trail.summary: Gloomthorn Trail is a trail connecting the Tlati Rainforest and Nemus Retreat. The trail runs between a tributary of River Varla to the east and the sea surrounding Tempestus to the west. The landscape is mostly featureless except for a number of dead trees and an abandoned keep with a crate that is used for a medium clue step. At the north end of the trail, Achilka has a ferry service that can take the player to Tal Teklan and Kastori free of charge.
transportNotes: Using the Quetzal Transport System (must be built before it can be used) to Kastori and then running east to use Achilka's boat service.
Pendant of Ates teleport to Kastori and run south east to use Achilka's boat service.
Pendant of Ates teleport to Nemus Retreat and run south
If you don't have the Kastori Quetzal landing site or the Pendant of Ates: Use the Quetzal Transport System to Quetzacalli Gorge, follow the mountain guide to Auburn Valley, then run south.
travel: The trail runs between a tributary of River Varla to the east and the sea surrounding Tempestus to the west.
At the north end of the trail, Achilka has a ferry service that can take the player to Tal Teklan and Kastori free of charge.

gnome maze.name: Gnome Maze
gnome maze.summary: The gnome maze is a large hedge maze that makes up the exterior part of the Tree Gnome Village. The maze must be solved at least once in order to start the Tree Gnome Village quest. After the first completion, Elkoy will be available as an escort through the maze both to and from the village, although only if players have started the quest. The maze is also involved in other quests, such as Waterfall Quest (where the player enters the maze dungeon) and Regicide.
transportNotes: Spirit Tree teleport directly to the centre of the maze.
Fairy ring to (Fairy ring CIQ) and run west and then north.
Ardougne cloak teleport to Ardougne Monastery and run west.
Inside the city is a house portal, which can be reached with a House Teleport spell or tablet if your player-owned house is located in Yanille.
A yanille tablet (made from using a scroll of redirection on a house tablet) can be used to teleport to the Yanille house portal, even if your house is located elsewhere.
Minigame teleport to fishing trawler and run west.
Ardougne Teleport (tablet), run south.
travel: The maze must be solved at least once in order to start the Tree Gnome Village quest.

goblin cave.name: Goblin Cave
goblin cave.summary: The Goblin Cave, known to the goblins as the Plain of Mud, is a dungeon filled with goblins located east of the Fishing Guild and south of Hemenster. Some of its inhabitants are aggressive no matter what level you are. The cave contains the entrance to the Goblin Temple, built by goblin tribes for Bandos during the Fourth Age after the Battle of Plain of Mud.
transportNotes: The fastest methods to get to the Goblin Cave include:
Using a plain of mud sphere to teleport directly inside the cave (requires Land of the Goblins)
Using a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Fishing Guild and running east.
Using the Fishing cape to teleport directly to the guild, and running east.
Teleporting to Ardougne and running north (requires Plague City)
Using the Ardougne cloak 2/3/4, teleport to the farming patch north of Ardougne and head west.
travel: The Goblin Cave, known to the goblins as the Plain of Mud, is a dungeon filled with goblins located east of the Fishing Guild and south of Hemenster.
The cave contains the entrance to the Goblin Temple, built by goblin tribes for Bandos during the Fourth Age after the Battle of Plain of Mud.

god wars dungeon.name: God Wars Dungeon
god wars dungeon.summary: The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dungeon where armies of various gods fight, left over from the God Wars. It was originally released on 28 August 2007, 18 days after the 10 August 2007 archive of RuneScape that Old School is based on. Its quick return to the live game was enabled by the fact that most of its assets had already been made at the time of the archive and it thus took minimal development time to recreate. One of the first major content releases following the February 2013 server launch, it passed Old School Feature Poll #9 on 9 September 2013 with over 24,860 votes for the return, at an approval of 89%. It was then released on 17 October for Old School RuneScape servers. To get Slayer assignments related to the God Wars Dungeon, such as boss tasks, players must complete the Death Plateau quest.
transportNotes: God Wars Dungeon is located north of Trollheim. Accessing it requires partial completion of Troll Stronghold (defeating Dad) or full completion of the Easy Combat Achievements (in order to use the teleport on Ghommal's hilt 1) and either 60 Strength or 60 Agility. A rope is also required the first time. Without 61 Magic and the completion of Eadgar's Ruse (to be able to use the Trollheim Teleport), climbing boots are required each time. Strength potions may be used to boost past the boulder blocking the entrance, but cannot be used to reach the Bandos area. Before entering, items aligned to the gods should be equipped; otherwise, all the followers of those gods will be aggressive, which can quickly kill any player, as there are numerous monsters residing in the dungeon.

If you have completed Eadgar's Ruse and have level 61 Magic, you may use the Trollheim Teleport (or the equivalent teleport tablet) to land on top of the mountain east of the Troll Stronghold. From there, make your way down to the base of the mountain and go north. There are Agility shortcuts from level 41 to 47 along the mountain that can be used to shorten the walk. If Making Friends with My Arm has been completed, a stony basalt can also be used as it teleports you to the Troll Stronghold, but this is a slightly longer run.

Players can reach Trollheim without losing additional inventory slots for teleports. This requires using two scrolls of redirection on two house teletabs, creating two Trollheim teletabs. Once players use the first tablet, they can revert the second one back into a house teletab, thus negating the need to perform the drop trick.

If you cannot use the Trollheim Teleport, teleport to Burthorpe (with a games necklace, for example). This route requires climbing boots, rope, the start of Troll Stronghold and a stamina potion or some super energies will make the trip faster. From there, follow the blue route either up past the wounded soldier and past Death Plateau, making sure to Protect from Range, or go south-west at the fork to Tenzing's house. Make your way north and follow the route through to where Dad is: either you will have to fight him, or he won't be there, depending on how far along the Troll Stronghold quest you are. From there, enter the cave to the north and follow the map route up to the north.

After arriving from either method, go to the northern side of the mountain, where there are thrower trolls, so turning on Protect from Missiles is recommended when close to them. Go to the small alcove in the north, go past the boulder or crack in the wall, and run north to the entrance, which is the large hole in the ground. This area's chill effect drains your stats by 1 every few seconds, and will also drain all of your run and special energy. This effect can be completely negated by building the Fire of Unseasonal Warmth found south-west of the dungeon entrance, which requires completion of Making Friends with My Arm and 60 Construction. There are high-level ice wolves here, so using Protect from Melee is helpful. If it is your first time entering the dungeon, use a rope on the hole, a

Note: The Agility shortcuts (climb the rocky stoneholds) north-east of the entrance as well as to the east of Trollheim are one-way routes into level 22 and 31 Wilderness. Players cannot use the shortcut from the Wilderness to get to the GWD area.

West of the dungeon entrance, talk to the Dying knight and receive the Knight's notes. The knight asks you to bring the notes to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park. You can enter the dungeon without bringing the notes to Sir Tiffy. You don't even need the notes to enter—just speak to the knight before entering the first time. (If you bring the notes to Sir Tiffy, he will take them whether you have read them or not.)

After you grab the notes from the dying knight, he will succumb to his fatal wounds. If you fail to bring the notes to Sir Tiffy (by destroying them), you can obtain another set of notes from his corpse.
travel: The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dungeon where armies of various gods fight, left over from the God Wars.

gordon and mary's farm.name: Gordon and Mary's farm
gordon and mary's farm.summary: Gordon and Mary's farm is a large farm located in the Kebos Lowlands just north of the Kebos Swamp. The farm has small cabbage and onion fields, as well as pens with chickens and cows. A barrel of flour is also located on the second floor of this farm. The quest Getting Ahead takes place here, with players helping Gordon and Mary.
travel: Gordon and Mary's farm is a large farm located in the Kebos Lowlands just north of the Kebos Swamp.
A barrel of flour is also located on the second floor of this farm.

grand exchange.name: Grand Exchange
grand exchange.summary: The Grand Exchange, commonly referred to as the GE, is a trading system for players to purchase and sell tradeable items in Old School RuneScape. It was released on 26 February 2015 following a content poll where it passed by 76.3%, narrowly passing the 75% threshold. Members get eight Grand Exchange slots, each of which may be used to either buy or sell items; however, free players are limited to three. Additionally, free players may only purchase free-to-play items, and not members' items. In the event that a member lists a sell offer and then their membership expires prior to fulfillment, the trade remains active and the item will sell when the price rises. No restriction exists on selling items, regardless of memberships status. However, if a player has been logged out for several days, any unfulfilled offers will pause until they log back in. Traders do not need to advertise, meet each other, or even wait at the Grand Exchange for trades to finish, because coins and items from fully and partially finished trades can be collected at any bank. Additionally, players will receive a message in their chatbox when the status of a trade offer is updated. This trading system resembles a real-life electronic asset exchange and has since replaced the trading post and the older marketplaces in Varrock (west bank and east bank) and Falador (Falador Park). Ironmen that use the Grand Exchange are redirected to a unique interface that allows them to purchase bonds while disallowing them
transportNotes: The Grand Exchange is located north-west of Varrock and east of Edgeville, both of which are located just south of the Wilderness. There are many ways to get there, including the following:
Using the Varrock Teleport spell from the Standard spellbook, or a Varrock teleport tablet.
If you have completed the Varrock medium diary, a Grand Exchange teleport option will be automatically added to any Varrock Teleport method.
Using a POH Varrock teleport with either a portal in a Portal Chamber (requires 50 Construction and, 25 Magic), or a Portal Nexus (requires 72 Construction and, 25 Magic.)
Using a charge on a ring of wealth.

Using a charge on an amulet of glory, or fairy ring code Fairy ring DKR (requires access to the fairy rings from partial completion of Fairytale II - Cure a Queen), to get to Edgeville and then using the tunnel.
Using a skills necklace to teleport to the Cooks' Guild then running slightly north.
Walking (with or without use of the Varrock Teleport spell).
travel: This trading system resembles a real-life electronic asset exchange and has since replaced the trading post and the older marketplaces in Varrock (west bank and east bank) and Falador (Falador Park).

grand tree mine.name: Grand Tree Mine
grand tree mine.summary: The Grand Tree mine is an area in the northern part of the Grand Tree Tunnels and is only accessible after The Grand Tree quest. Players can enter the mine after the quest by pushing the roots that block access from the central area. No axe or other equipment is required to push the roots aside. Within the mine lie two slightly separated mining areas, one to the east and one to the west.
travel: The Grand Tree mine is an area in the northern part of the Grand Tree Tunnels and is only accessible after The Grand Tree quest.
Players can enter the mine after the quest by pushing the roots that block access from the central area.

graveyard of heroes.name: Graveyard of Heroes
graveyard of heroes.summary: The Graveyard of Heroes is located in the south-western part of Shayzien. The city's church is found here, and is filled with ceremonial pillars representing the soldiers who have perished in the line of duty. In the north-west corner, a gravestone with a rose engraved next to the lancalliums can be found. This gravestone belongs to Rose's mother, who died in childbirth. Those who have added History and Hearsay to Kharedst's memoirs (Tale of the Righteous completion required) may teleport here using the book. On occasion, gang meetings take place here while players tackle organised crime. A large monument can be found at the end of the passageway east of the church. Here, an old man can be seen reminiscing his days in the army. New Recruit Tony can be found walking around south-east of the Graveyard of Heroes. In the south-west corner, the entrance to the Shayzien Crypts, accessed during Dragon Slayer II, houses the tombs of Kourend's royalty from decades past, though it is now overrun by undead. At the bottom of the crypt is Camorra Shayzien's tomb, alongside an unknown tomb that has collapsed into the ground further below.
travel: The Graveyard of Heroes is located in the south-western part of Shayzien.
The city's church is found here, and is filled with ceremonial pillars representing the soldiers who have perished in the line of duty.

graveyard of shadows.name: Graveyard of Shadows
graveyard of shadows.summary: The Graveyard of Shadows, located at levels 18–21 in the Wilderness, occupies a section of what was once the Zarosian fortress of Carrallanger. This area is a large, seemingly forgotten graveyard filled with dead trees, wandering zombies, and derelict gravestones. Within the graveyard lies the Skeletal Tomb, the lair of Calvar'ion.
transportNotes: Carrallanger Teleport, part of Ancient Magicks, goes directly to the graveyard.
travel: The Graveyard of Shadows, located at levels 18–21 in the Wilderness, occupies a section of what was once the Zarosian fortress of Carrallanger.

great kourend.name: Great Kourend
great kourend.summary: Great Kourend is a kingdom found in the continent of Zeah, found far west of the mainland across the Western Ocean. It is one of the three regions that make up the continent, the other two being the Kebos Lowlands and the Kingdom of Varlamore. One of the largest kingdoms in Gielinor, it is larger than Misthalin and Asgarnia combined, and is similar in size to Kandarin. Despite being called a kingdom, Great Kourend is actually a republic, currently ruled by the Kourend Council, with the five houses of Great Kourend ruling over the kingdom's five cities: Arceuus, Hosidius, Port Piscarilius, Lovakengj, and Shayzien. Although the five Houses can rule over their city as they see fit, they must also enforce and obey the laws set out by the Kourend Council. However, after the events of A Kingdom Divided, Great Kourend is once again ruled by a monarchy. Great Kourend can be accessed via ship from Port Sarim, and the region must have been visited at least once before players may use most teleportation methods to get to it.
transportNotes: Players can travel to Great Kourend by speaking to Veos by his ship (or Cabin Boy Herbert after A Kingdom Divided) in Port Sarim, directly south of the Rusty Anchor Inn. Doing so will take players to either Port Piscarilius, the easternmost section of the city, or Land's End, the south-western docks near the Kourend Woodland. Players are able to choose to which point they want to be taken. Players can also charter ships to the aforementioned ports from any charter port.

Players may use the Kharedst's memoirs book (or Book of the Dead after A Kingdom Divided) to teleport here after completing the Client of Kourend quest. This book allows players to teleport to each of the five cities.

Players with level 25 Construction can have their player-owned house moved to Hosidius north of the Charcoal furnaces for 8,750 coins. Players may also make use of a Hosidius teleport tablet, made by combining a Teleport to house tablet and a Scroll of redirection if they do not wish to move their house. This still requires level 25 Construction.
Players can unlock the Kourend Castle Teleport spell after completion of Client of Kourend.
A fairy ring, code Fairy ring CIS, will take players north of the Arceuus Library.
The fairy ring Fairy ring DJR teleports players near the Chasm of Fire.
The fairy ring Fairy ring AKR teleports players south of the Vinery.
The fairy ring Fairy ring BLS teleports players south of Mount Quidamortem.
travel: Great Kourend is a kingdom found in the continent of Zeah, found far west of the mainland across the Western Ocean.
Great Kourend can be accessed via ship from Port Sarim, and the region must have been visited at least once before players may use most teleportation methods to get to it.

grimstone.name: Grimstone
grimstone.summary: Grimstone is an island north of Weiss. It is a long-forgotten frozen island beyond the Fremenniks' border, requiring 87 Sailing to moor on. As Grimstone is in icy seas, an eternal brazier is required to access it. The island surface contains several rocks of coal, nickel, adamantite, and runite, along with a wallasalki colony that resides on the southern half of the island. There is also a lockbox which contains the dragon keel schematic. Additionally, there is a cave leading to the Grimstone Dungeon, which is the main attraction of the island. The dungeon contains chilled jellies, frost dragons, as well as a furnace that can smelt cannonballs at twice the normal speed.
transportNotes: Teleport to fairy ring Fairy ring DLP inside the dungeon (requires that you have moored on the island at least once)
Sail with your ship and dock at the island (requires 87 Sailing)
Teleport to your boat (if it's situated at Grimstone, which requires completion of Pandemonium, 67 Magic, and a greater teleport focus on the boat)
travel: Grimstone is an island north of Weiss.
As Grimstone is in icy seas, an eternal brazier is required to access it.
caveats: An eternal brazier is needed for the icy-seas approach. Fairy ring DLP only becomes available after first mooring.

grimstone dungeon.name: Grimstone Dungeon
grimstone dungeon.summary: Grimstone Dungeon is a dungeon beneath Grimstone. It contains the Ancient Furnace, which can smelt cannonballs at double the usual speed; an ancient mould; and a fairy ring, code Fairy ring DLP. This fairy ring is only accessible once the player has moored on the island at least once. You can unnote any metal bar(s) here with Isles at a cost of 100 coins per note. Before doing so, however, you need to have sailed to Grimstone and then you must invite him to accompany you there on your boat. He can be found wandering outside the bank at Port Roberts. Alongside these features, the dungeon is the only location where frost dragons reside, located in the centre of the dungeon. To the west of this area is another cave with frost dragons, though these can only be killed on a slayer task. Attempting to attack these dragons outside of a slayer task will result in the message "You feel a strange coldness wash over you, filling you with fear. You decide it best not to attack these dragons without permission." They can be accessed either by climbing up the rock face from the north or south; the south climb requires 83 Agility, which can be boosted. Chilled jellies can also be found to the north and west of the fairy ring. Attempting to set up a Dwarf multicannon anywhere in the dungeon will result in the message It's far too cold for you to set up a cannon here.
travel: This fairy ring is only accessible once the player has moored on the island at least once.
Before doing so, however, you need to have sailed to Grimstone and then you must invite him to accompany you there on your boat.

gryphon caves.name: Gryphon Caves
gryphon caves.summary: The Gryphon Caves are two caves found on The Great Conch. Both dungeons contain a number of Gryphons, a Slayer monster requiring 51 Slayer to kill. A Dwarf multicannon can be used in both dungeons.
travel: The Gryphon Caves are two caves found on The Great Conch.
caveats: Give Floopa the bandage during Troubled Tortugans. Charter ships/fairy ring CJQ avoid imposing the 45 Sailing mooring requirement on every route.

gu'tanoth.name: Gu'Tanoth
gu'tanoth.summary: Gu'Tanoth is an ogre city far south of Ardougne and slightly south-west of Yanille. Players need to progress far enough into the Watchtower quest in order to enter. Some ogres here are aggressive to players.
travel: Gu'Tanoth is an ogre city far south of Ardougne and slightly south-west of Yanille.

h.a.m. hideout.name: H.A.M. Hideout
h.a.m. hideout.summary: The H.A.M. Hideout is the base of operations for the Humans Against Monsters organisation. It is located west of the Lumbridge general store. To enter it, the player will need to pick the lock on the trapdoor to get in. This can be done with the player's hand, but a lockpick will increase the player's chance of success.
transportNotes: The fastest way there is using a charged amulet of glory to teleport to Draynor Village and running east (~33 ticks)
Teleporting to Twiggy O'Korn with an Achievement diary cape and running east (~37 ticks)
Using Lumbridge Teleport and running west through the castle, exiting through the gate, and running north-west (~41 ticks)
travel: It is located west of the Lumbridge general store.
To enter it, the player will need to pick the lock on the trapdoor to get in.

handelmort mansion.name: Handelmort Mansion
handelmort mansion.summary: Handelmort Mansion is a mansion found in East Ardougne, just west of Ardougne market. It plays a large role in the Tribal Totem quest. Home to Lord Francis Kurt Handelmort, a wealthy East Ardougne noble, the mansion is richly decorated. It is also home to some artefacts that Lord Handelmort has taken. He has gone to great lengths to protect these artefacts with guard dogs, locked house, and a booby-trapped staircase.
travel: Handelmort Mansion is a mansion found in East Ardougne, just west of Ardougne market.
Home to Lord Francis Kurt Handelmort, a wealthy East Ardougne noble, the mansion is richly decorated.

haunted woods.name: Haunted Woods
haunted woods.summary: The Haunted Woods is a large swampy forest in Morytania. It is located east of Canifis and is home to leeches, swamp crabs and feral vampyres, all of which are aggressive. A certain kind of non-attackable spider can also be found in the Haunted Woods that will summon a level 72 feral vampyre if a player gets too close. There is a fairy ring (code Fairy ring ALQ) south of the Port Phasmatys farming patch. The Haunted Woods is the only place where hollow trees can be found, which can be cut for bark. It also contains a few yew trees to the far east, as well as a large number of non-interactable dead trees and some dangerous undead trees similar to those found around Draynor Manor. In the south-western corner is the entrance to the Werewolf Agility Course and Werewolf Skullball. The player is required to wear a Ring of Charos to gain access. During the Creature of Fenkenstrain quest, the player must dig at the grave of Ed Lestwit, which is located in the Haunted Woods. During Sins of the Father the player and the Myreque spy on Damien Leucurte after foiling his plan, this is also where they are first approached by Vanescula Drakan. During a hard clue scroll you may be asked to perform the panic emote, provoking a visit from a double agent in the 'heart of the haunted woods'. This can be found by the hollow tree, just east of the 'ALQ' fairy ring.
travel: It is located east of Canifis and is home to leeches, swamp crabs and feral vampyres, all of which are aggressive.
A certain kind of non-attackable spider can also be found in the Haunted Woods that will summon a level 72 feral vampyre if a player gets too close.

heroes' guild.name: Heroes' Guild
heroes' guild.summary: The Heroes' Guild is located just south of Burthorpe. The guild is only accessible to members who have completed the Heroes' Quest. Dragon maces and dragon battleaxes can be purchased here, and amulets of glory can be recharged at the fountain in the basement of the guild.
transportNotes: The Portal of Heroes on the 2 of the Myths' Guild can be used to teleport outside the front door of the Heroes' Guild.
The Teleport to House spell (if the player-owned house is in Taverley), or a redirected Taverley teleport tablet.
A games necklace or Minigame Teleport to the Burthorpe Games Room.
A combat bracelet can be used to teleport to the Warriors' Guild, north of the Heroes' Guild.
The 1 has a Prayer altar (dedicated to Saradomin). Helemos's shop, the "Happy Heroes' H'emporium", is here, which sells the dragon battleaxe for 200,000 coins and the dragon mace for 50,000 coins.
The 2 of the Heroes' Guild has a table with six chairs around it and a pair of empty chests.
travel: The Heroes' Guild is located just south of Burthorpe.
The guild is only accessible to members who have completed the Heroes' Quest.

hobgoblin peninsula.name: Hobgoblin Peninsula
hobgoblin peninsula.summary: The Hobgoblin Peninsula is an area west of the Crafting Guild. It is crawling with several level 28 hobgoblins. On members servers, it spawns 3 snape grass in the sand pit near the end of the island. Some players gather the snape grass for a small profit, but since the peninsula is far away from a bank, this is not done by many players. The quickest way to get there is via the skills necklace teleport to the Crafting Guild. Players can safely range or mage the hobgoblins from the cow area beside it. However, they are suggested to cast Telekinetic Grab to get back their arrows or to retrieve loot. There's also a strange pile of sand in it, with an odd "look" option. Its use as of now is simply a place to gather sand. Players are able to use a bucket with the pile of sand to get a 'bucket of sand', a material for glass-making. Since glass-making is part of the Crafting skill, and the peninsula is very close to the Crafting Guild, it is possible that Jagex put this here with that in mind (though the purpose of the 'look' option on it is still a mystery). When a bucket is used on the pile it becomes smaller, and when a second is used it goes away completely, respawning a few seconds later.
travel: The Hobgoblin Peninsula is an area west of the Crafting Guild.

hosidius.name: Hosidius
hosidius.summary: Hosidius is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend. Currently led by Lord Pandur Hosidius of the Hosidius House, their main export focus is on Farming/agriculture and Cooking, and are the primary supplier of food to the citizens of the Kingdom as well as the soldiers of the Shayzien Army. Most people in Hosidius worship Saradomin, though a few also worship Zamorak, although as with most other human settlements, they are looked down upon. Because of the high demand of food in Great Kourend, Hosidius requires a large amount of land to grow their crops in, and thus possesses the most land out of the five cities - this is because a famine struck the kingdom sometime during 5th BA to 1st BA (1,460 years ago). Five years after the famine began, Lord Ethrain Hosidius I met with the Lords of the other four Houses, coming to an agreement that half of each of the city's lands be granted to Hosidius in order to grow more crops to stop the famine, which was then approved by the ruling Council of Elders. Like Shayzien, Hosidius is one of the more recent cities founded in the history of Great Kourend - the founder is unknown, but it was created by refugees escaping the Dragonkin Conflicts.
transportNotes: Teleport to House or a redirected teleport to house tablet.
Xeric's talisman - Xeric's Glade Teleport, north-east of farming patch.
Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead - Lunch by the Lancalliums teleport (requires completion of The Depths of Despair).
Kourend Castle Teleport - Run east past Kingstown then south after the bridge.
Spirit tree planted in a spirit tree patch south-east of the Forthos Ruin.
Skills necklace - North-east of the Woodcutting Guild teleport.
Tithe Farm minigame teleport - Requires having entered the minigame at least once.

Travel south of the Rusty Anchor Inn (and north of the Monks of Entrana) in Port Sarim and find Veos on the dock. Then right-click "Port Piscarilius Veos" (don't right-click "Land's End Veos"), run west on the dock of Port Piscarilius, keep running west until you get to a pub, then turn left and run south from Port Piscarilius to Hosidius.
travel: Like Shayzien, Hosidius is one of the more recent cities founded in the history of Great Kourend - the founder is unknown, but it was created by refugees escaping the Dragonkin Conflicts.

hosidius mine.name: Hosidius mine
hosidius mine.summary: The Hosidius mine is located west of the Tithe farm and north of Crabclaw Isle. It is a medium-sized mine, containing a variety of low-level ores. There is a bronze pickaxe spawn located just north of the mine in the ruins of an abandoned building.
travel: The Hosidius mine is located west of the Tithe farm and north of Crabclaw Isle.
There is a bronze pickaxe spawn located just north of the mine in the ruins of an abandoned building.

hunter's end.name: Hunter's End
hunter's end.summary: Hunter's End is the lair of Artio. It is a singles-plus combat dungeon located in the Wilderness, north-west of Ferox Enclave. To enter the lair, players must have completed the hard Wilderness diary, OR they must have a Callisto boss Slayer task (a bear Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement). While the entrance to Hunter's End is found in level 20 Wilderness, the cave itself is in level 21 Wilderness, meaning items that can teleport players above level 20 Wilderness is recommended in the event of player killers arriving. Entering the boss lairs requires players to pay a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. Whenever a player dies to another player, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer. Players can decrease the fee by killing the three bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins. Upon entering the lair, if players have recently attacked Artio, they will be unable to teleport for 3 ticks unless they have completed the hard Wilderness diary. In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills registered in their name.
travel: It is a singles-plus combat dungeon located in the Wilderness, north-west of Ferox Enclave.

While the entrance to Hunter's End is found in level 20 Wilderness, the cave itself is in level 21 Wilderness, meaning items that can teleport players above level 20 Wilderness is recommended in the event of player killers arriving.
hunter's end.confirmation: Requires hard Wilderness diary OR a specific Callisto boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.
caveats: A generic bear, skeleton or spider assignment does not bypass the diary gate. PvP risk applies.

ice mountain.name: Ice Mountain
ice mountain.summary: Ice Mountain is located just north-west of Barbarian Village, and the main entrance to the Dwarven Mine is located on its lower southern slope. It dominates northern Asgarnia, and is Asgarnia's only remaining region in which it snows year-round.
transportNotes: Players can walk there fairly easily from Falador (go north and north-east) and from the region of Barbarian Village and Edgeville (go west). Other transport routes to the mountain include:
Lassar Teleport directly to the top of the mountain.
Mind Altar Teleport north-west of the mountain, and run south-east.
Use a combat bracelet to teleport to the Edgeville Monastery and go south and west.
Enter the Dwarven Mine from Falador (either directly or via the Mining Guild) and travel to the mine's exit on the mountain.
Use the Keldagrim mine cart system to go to the Dwarven Mine and then exit onto the mountain. Players can enter the cart system in Keldagrim or in the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain.
Use a skull sceptre to teleport to Barbarian Village and then walk west to the mountain.
Useful for Ironmen: Use the chronicle book, then using an axe cut a canoe behind the champions guild and travel to the Barbarian Village. From there Ice Mountain is a short run.
travel: Ice Mountain is located just north-west of Barbarian Village, and the main entrance to the Dwarven Mine is located on its lower southern slope.
It dominates northern Asgarnia, and is Asgarnia's only remaining region in which it snows year-round.

ice path.name: Ice Path
ice path.summary: The Ice Path is a path ascending up a mountain, in the Troll Country region of Gielinor. It has no purpose other than the part it plays during the ice diamond section of the Desert Treasure I quest and a location for a master cryptic clue on a master clue scroll. It is extremely dangerous, and players are advised not to enter unless prepared. The entrance to the path is barred with a gate and players may only pass if they have given the troll child a (chocolate) cake during the Desert Treasure I quest. After that, the player can freely go through the gate at any time. West of the Ice Gate is the entrance to Trollweiss Dungeon. Because of the extremely cold conditions, players cannot run after passing the Ice Gate (although this effect can be countered by using stamina potions). The area's chill effect also drains your Hitpoints periodically by 1-2 and other stats in the same fashion by one. However, this effect stops draining your Hitpoints once you have only 1 left. Towards the end of the path, after defeating Kamil, players must use spiked boots on the ice shelf to be able to walk at all; however, they may still slip and fall several times, taking damage.
travel: The entrance to the path is barred with a gate and players may only pass if they have given the troll child a (chocolate) cake during the Desert Treasure I quest.
West of the Ice Gate is the entrance to Trollweiss Dungeon.

ice queen's lair.name: Ice Queen's Lair
ice queen's lair.summary: The Ice Queen's Lair is a dungeon located under the White Wolf Mountain. The entrance is blocked by a rock slide requiring a pickaxe and level 50 Mining to remove. The rock slide can not be mined by another player. The lair plays a major role in Heroes' Quest, where players must kill the Ice Queen to obtain ice gloves. Player can get there quickly via the gnome glider. If a player loses their ice gloves, they may acquire a new pair by slaying the queen again, but because the dungeon is out of the way, it's recommended to get multiple pairs during the quest.
travel: The Ice Queen's Lair is a dungeon located under the White Wolf Mountain.
The entrance is blocked by a rock slide requiring a pickaxe and level 50 Mining to remove.

ice troll caves.name: Ice Troll Caves
ice troll caves.summary: The Ice Troll Caves can be found north of Jatizso and Neitiznot. To enter the caves, players need to have completed parts of The Fremennik Isles quest. Six Honour guards can be found fighting ice trolls in the northern most cave. During the quest, the Ice Troll King is also found in this cave. After the completion of The Fremennik Isles, the caves can only be accessed using the western entrance, and the Ice Troll King is no longer present. The cave is a dangerous area as it is multicombat and the trolls can hit high using both Melee and Ranged attacks; wearing a Neitiznot shield is advised as it lowers the max hit of the ranged trolls from 6 to 2. While en route to the cave, it's strongly advised to activate Protect from Melee since the melee trolls do more damage. You are unable to use the Dwarf multicannon within this cave, when attempting to set up the cannon it will state, "The air is too dank for you to set up a cannon here."
travel: The Ice Troll Caves can be found north of Jatizso and Neitiznot.
Six Honour guards can be found fighting ice trolls in the northern most cave.

iceberg.name: Iceberg
iceberg.summary: The iceberg is a plain iceberg in the sea. It is the location of the KGP Headquarters penguin base. It can only be accessed by those who have gone halfway through Cold War. Players can travel back to the iceberg after the quest is completed by talking to Larry on the dock north-east of Rellekka. If one is wearing a clockwork suit, it can be entered via the Avalanche (scenery) to the north-west of Larry's boat. This is required for the master clue cryptic step.
travel: It can only be accessed by those who have gone halfway through Cold War.
Players can travel back to the iceberg after the quest is completed by talking to Larry on the dock north-east of Rellekka.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.summary: The Inferno is a solo minigame that was added to Old School RuneScape on the 1 June 2017, along with an update to the city of Mor Ul Rek. The player must survive 69 increasingly challenging waves, ultimately killing the level 1400 TzKal-Zuk, to obtain the infernal cape. If defeated, the player must restart from the first wave. A successor to the TzHaar Fight Caves, the Inferno was dubbed the greatest solo PVM challenge to date upon release. In order to access the Inferno, players must give TzHaar-Ket-Keh a fire cape. This is a one-time fee, so after giving a fire cape to him, TzHaar-Ket-Keh will allow players to enter as much as they want. Restocking between waves is not possible and other players cannot enter, although the minigame can be paused by attempting to log out between waves. Purple sweets also cannot be used in the Inferno. If the player has previously defeated TzKal-Zuk, it may be chosen as a Slayer task when assigned TzHaar, which will affect all monsters inside the Inferno. The task will also be cancelled in the event the player is defeated, much like the Fight Caves.
travel: In order to access the Inferno, players must give TzHaar-Ket-Keh a fire cape.
inferno.confirmation: Requires showing a fire cape for Mor Ul Rek and sacrificing one to unlock the Inferno; use a full-wave method.
caveats: TzKal-Zuk is the final wave, not a repeatable ordinary room spawn.

iorwerth camp.name: Iorwerth Camp
iorwerth camp.summary: The Iorwerth Camp is a small camp outside Prifddinas, occupied by elf warriors under the command of Lord Iorwerth. The Regicide quest needs to be started to access it, as well as at least 45 Agility to pass obstacles along the way through the forest.
transportNotes: The Iorwerth Camp can be reached in several ways, all of which require partial (or full) completion of Regicide. Listed here in order from closest to furthest:
— Prifddinas, a short walk north of the village.
— Port Tyras, slightly south of the camp (costs ).
Fairy ring BJS — island west of the camp (requires 76 Agility to leave the island).
— Zul-Andra, south of the camp.
— Lletya, east of the poison waste.
From Port Tyras, the camp is reached from the following path: north, east, south, east, north, west, north.
travel: The Regicide quest needs to be started to access it, as well as at least 45 Agility to pass obstacles along the way through the forest.
caveats: Forest obstacles and traps remain. The Arandar gate is a separate completed-quest route.

iorwerth dungeon.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
iorwerth dungeon.summary: The Iorwerth Dungeon is a dungeon found in Prifddinas' Iorwerth district in the south-west part of the city, used by the Iorwerth Clan for training (). Players have access to the dungeon after the completion of Song of the Elves quest; Konar quo Maten will also begin to be able to assign them to slay monsters in the dungeon. The dungeon consists of numerous rooms which contain a variety of Slayer monsters, as well as some traitorous Iorwerth Warriors camping out. The monsters in the dungeon do not require players to be on a Slayer task to be killed. A dwarf multicannon can be used in the dungeon. However, the whole dungeon is single-way combat. Upon their deaths, monsters in the dungeon have a chance of dropping 3-5 crystal shards, while superior slayer monsters are guaranteed to drop 6-10. Morvran can be found by the dungeon's exit.
travel: The Iorwerth Dungeon is a dungeon found in Prifddinas' Iorwerth district in the south-west part of the city, used by the Iorwerth Clan for training ().
Players have access to the dungeon after the completion of Song of the Elves quest; Konar quo Maten will also begin to be able to assign them to slay monsters in the dungeon.

isafdar.name: Isafdar
isafdar.summary: Isafdar (Jagex pronunciation: ISS-aff-dar) is the elven forest. It is the largest part of the region Tirannwn, located on the very western edge of the mainland. Isafdar is located just west of Lletya, and south of Prifddinas. It is reachable by the Underground Pass to the east, by Arandar to the north-east, as well as Port Tyras to the south-west of the forest.
travel: It is the largest part of the region Tirannwn, located on the very western edge of the mainland.
Isafdar is located just west of Lletya, and south of Prifddinas.
caveats: Forest obstacles and traps remain. The Arandar gate is a separate completed-quest route.

isle of bones.name: Isle of Bones
isle of bones.summary: The Isle of Bones is an island located south-west of the Void Knights' Outpost. It requires 56 Sailing to moor on. This small island consists of several level 45 skeletons, dead trees, several Big bones spawns, several Bones spawns, and a small gulf where players can disembark at the mooring point. There are also several one-off activities: *A Meaty Aura Logist on for Sea charting. *A medallion fragment can be found by investigating the cauldron. *A small key can be dug up one tile south of the shell west of the mooring point.
travel: The Isle of Bones is an island located south-west of the Void Knights' Outpost.
*A medallion fragment can be found by investigating the cauldron.

isle of souls.name: Isle of Souls
isle of souls.summary: The Isle of Souls is an island located in the Shrouded Ocean, west of Feldip Hills. It is where the Soul Wars minigame takes place. The island was once the site of a battle during the God Wars; the Armadylean soldiers that were sent there were tasked with securing an unknown artefact, however it was claimed by Bandos, who evidently used it to destroy not only the Armadyleans but his own army as well. This resulted in some of those slain becoming ancient ghosts, unable to move on to the next world. The island was since abandoned, until Nomad opened it up and started hosting Soul Wars.
transportNotes: The isle can be accessed through a few different means:
Entering the Soul Wars Portal near the Edgeville ruins.
Entering the Soul Wars Portal inside the Ferox Enclave Dungeon.
Using the Soul Wars Minigame Teleport.
Using the fairy ring code Fairy ring BJP to reach the northern coast.
By mooring on the south-east coast with 55 Sailing.
Using the rowboat from the Tear of the Soul on the south-east coast.
travel: The Isle of Souls is an island located in the Shrouded Ocean, west of Feldip Hills.

isle of souls dungeon.name: Isle of Souls Dungeon
isle of souls dungeon.summary: The Isle of Souls Dungeon is a small dungeon located on the eastern side of the Isle of Souls. It houses several types of monsters, all of which can be assigned as a Slayer task. The dungeon also contains a chest which can be thieved for several resources such as gems and grimy herbs, as well as a rare chance for a dark key. A dwarf multicannon can be used in the dungeon, though it is not a multicombat area.
transportNotes: The dungeon can be reached by teleporting to fairy ring code Fairy ring BJP on the northern coast of the isle, then running south-east.

Otherwise, players can use a Minigame Teleport to Soul Wars and run north-east. A dose of stamina potion drunk at the bank in the Soul Wars lobby will expire on reaching the deepest part of the dungeon.
travel: The Isle of Souls Dungeon is a small dungeon located on the eastern side of the Isle of Souls.

jatizso mine.name: Jatizso mine
jatizso mine.summary: The Jatizso mine is found just outside the western gates of Jatizso. The mine is accessed from a staircase just outside the city proper. The Fremennik Isles quest has to be started in order to go in the mine. It is more dangerous than most mines, as it is inhabited by aggressive ice trolls - male, female and runts in the northern half of the mine. However, it may be worthwhile as players can obtain plenty of mithril and adamantite ores fairly close to a bank, which is located in the city. Gruva Patrull guards the entrance of the mine.
travel: The Jatizso mine is found just outside the western gates of Jatizso.
The mine is accessed from a staircase just outside the city proper.

jiggig.name: Jiggig
jiggig.summary: Jiggig is a former ogre ritual site, located south of Castle Wars. Its primary known uses were to house the corpses of ogre ancestors and to serve as a site for ceremonial dancing. Due to the suspicious activities of a renegade wizard leading up to the events shown in the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest, some of the ogre corpses have been raised as undead zogres and skogres. Ogre guards have installed barricades around Jiggig to stop these undead ogres from escaping. The dungeon inside can only be entered during and after the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest. Undead ogres may disease a player. This can be countered with Relicym's balm. They are also very resistant to normal weapons, but Brutal arrows work on them very well. There are many ogre coffins scattered about Jiggig. They can be opened either with an ogre coffin key, which is a drop from zogres and skogres, or by picking the locks through the Thieving skill.
transportNotes: Ring of dueling teleport to Castle Wars then run south to Jiggig.
Using Fairy ring code Fairy ring BKP and running east.
travel: Jiggig is a former ogre ritual site, located south of Castle Wars.

jiggig dungeon.name: Jiggig Dungeon
jiggig dungeon.summary: Jiggig Dungeon is a dungeon in Jiggig. The dungeon is a large area swarming with zogres and skogres. The player can access it by climbing over crushed barricade and then climbing down the stairs. They can only be climbed during and after the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest. The main points of interest during the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest are the skeleton lying on a broken lectern in the north-west corner, and the entrance to the level below to the west. The locked ogre stone doors can only be opened during the quest, using the ogre gate key given to the player by Grish. The player will find Slash Bash in the bottom level. There are many ogre coffins scattered inside the wall and on the ground. They can be opened either with an ogre coffin key, which is a drop from zogres and skogres, or by picking the locks through the Thieving skill. When burying zogre bones in the dungeon, there's a 1 in 3 chance and to spawn a skogre alongside the regular experience drop. The skogre will despawn after 5 minutes. A message in the chatbox appears .
transportNotes: Ring of dueling teleport to Castle Wars then run south to Jiggig.
Using Fairy ring code Fairy ring BKP and running east.
travel: The player can access it by climbing over crushed barricade and then climbing down the stairs.
They can only be climbed during and after the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest.

jolly boar inn.name: Jolly Boar Inn
jolly boar inn.summary: The Jolly Boar Inn is a two-story bar and inn located north-east of Varrock, on the southern border of the Wilderness. It contains a range and a spawn point for thread. The bartender only sells (ordinary) beer for 2 coins each. The bar contains Johnathon, whom players must speak to in the Family Crest quest. A man upstairs and a woman downstairs, though they both walk normally, act drunk when you talk to them, conversing with a player about how there are two of them and mumbling about "giant hairy cabbages". A Black Knight and a thief also wander around the inn, but the knight is not aggressive, unlike those at the Black Knights' Fortress. A quite-unfriendly cook resides in the kitchen of the inn, cooking something on the range.
travel: The Jolly Boar Inn is a two-story bar and inn located north-east of Varrock, on the southern border of the Wilderness.
The bar contains Johnathon, whom players must speak to in the Family Crest quest.

jormungand's prison.name: Jormungand's Prison
jormungand's prison.summary: The Jormungand's Prison is a dungeon beneath the Island of Stone. During The Fremennik Exiles, the player and Brundt the Chieftain attempt to stop the basilisk generals - Bakuna, Typhor, and Vritra - from reawakening The Jormungand, the serpent king. After the quest, it contains dagannoth, basilisk, and basilisk knights. The dwarf multicannon cannot be used to kill the basilisks in the prison, but it can be set up in the dagannoth areas. Additionally, the player cannot resurrect thralls in the single-way combat area of the prison, meaning thralls cannot be used against basilisks, but can be used against dagannoth. The dagannoth in Jormungand's Prison are in multi-combat, and only attack using melee. No food is required if using Protect from Melee.
transportNotes: Players must talk to Haskell () on the western-most dock of Rellekka in order to reach the Island of Stone (). When on the island, players may enter the prison through the entrance at the centre of the island.
travel: The Jormungand's Prison is a dungeon beneath the Island of Stone.

kalphite cave.name: Kalphite Cave
kalphite cave.summary: The Kalphite Cave is a dungeon located east of the Shantay Pass, housing kalphites that can only be killed while on a Slayer task. The centre of the cave contains kalphite larvae. Unlike the Kalphite Lair, a rope is not required to access the cave. Players may enter without a Slayer task, but upon attacking any monster inside the dungeon, Buggie will stop them from doing so, claiming that they are not assigned to kill them. A dwarf multicannon can be used here, and it is a multi-combat area. The player does not suffer from desert heat while within the cave.
transportNotes: Using a desert amulet 4 teleports the player directly there.
Using an achievement diary cape to teleport to the Shantay Pass.
Minigame teleport to Sorceress's Garden
Using an amulet of glory to teleport to Al Kharid, then running south.
Using fairy ring Fairy ring BIQ to teleport to the Kalphite Lair, then run north-east.
Teleporting to the player's house in Pollnivneach (or using a Pollnivneach teleport) and taking the magic carpet to Shantay Pass.
Teleport to the Emir's Arena, then run south.
Using a necklace of passage to teleport to Eagle's Eyrie, running south to the bridge, and then running north-west.
travel: The Kalphite Cave is a dungeon located east of the Shantay Pass, housing kalphites that can only be killed while on a Slayer task.
Unlike the Kalphite Lair, a rope is not required to access the cave.

kalphite lair.name: Kalphite Lair
kalphite lair.summary: The Kalphite Lair is located north-east of the Bedabin Camp, in the Kharidian Desert. Players will need a rope to enter the lair and another to enter the area containing the Kalphite Queen. As the name suggests, only Kalphites live in this area. Players will need to bring a rope every time they visit the lair, and another rope should they wish to reach the Queen's lair; players who have completed the Hard Desert Diary need not do so after attaching the ropes one last time post-diary completion. There is also a crevice shortcut requiring 86 Agility and the Elite Desert Diary to use; it is a two-way shortcut and is helpful for players wishing to kill the Kalphite Queen as it will drop them off in the room leading to her chamber. Entering the Kalphite Lair, as well as collecting 5 potato cacti while inside, are required for the Easy Desert Diary. Note: This area is not affected by desert heat, thus waterskins are not necessary while inside the lair's entrance.
transportNotes: Fairy ring - A quick way to access the lair is using the nearby fairy ring with the code Fairy ring BIQ. Then, run north-west towards the lair.
Shantay Pass - An alternative is entering the desert via Shantay Pass, which is located south of Al Kharid and requires a Shantay pass, and heading westward to the lair.

Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon - Alternatively, those with access to Dorgesh-Kaan will be able to find a blocked tunnel in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon that leads through to the lair, emerging at the tunnel near some kalphite workers. A light source is necessary to avoid damage from swarming insects.

Lumbridge Swamp - On the southern coast of the Lumbridge swamp, south-west of the the start point for Misthalin Mystery, a shortcut requiring level 66 Agility takes the player just a few tiles from the entrance. As the player will not need a dramen staff, Shantay pass, or light source to reach the entrance this way, it maximises the number of useful inventory slots for those who haven't completed the Elite Lumbridge Diary.
travel: The Kalphite Lair is located north-east of the Bedabin Camp, in the Kharidian Desert.
Note: This area is not affected by desert heat, thus waterskins are not necessary while inside the lair's entrance.

karamja.name: Karamja
karamja.summary: Karamja (pronounced ) is a large island in Gielinor. It is located to the south of the major kingdoms of Asgarnia and Kandarin. The island contains mostly jungle and tropical geography. You can reach Karamja using the fairy ring code Fairy ring CKR, or by charter ship. Different tribes of Karamja speak different Karamjan languages.
transportNotes: A popular way to travel for free players is by ship from Port Sarim, which costs 30gp for the trip. Another ship route is available from the Ardougne Docks to Brimhaven. Players who wish to travel by boat will have their inventories searched by customs officers, as the law prohibits individuals from carrying rum off the island. Those who wish to circumvent this and smuggle rum to the mainland may find it helpful to check the guide for the Pirate's Treasure quest, where the player must smuggle Karamja rum.
(Points of origin listed on the left-hand side, destinations listed at the top.)
* Indicates access only through the charter system.
Regular service costs 30 coins to utilise; charter service is significantly more expensive, depending on the route.
Amulet of glory teleport to Musa Point
Minigame teleport to Tzhaar Cave
Gnome glider to a crash site near the Ship Yard (be warned that this method is one-way only, and only during The Grand Tree).
Another Gnome glider can take the player to an area east of the crash site mentioned above, south of the Ship Yard.
travel: It is located to the south of the major kingdoms of Asgarnia and Kandarin.
Different tribes of Karamja speak different Karamjan languages.

karamja volcano.name: Karamja Volcano
karamja volcano.summary: The Karamja Volcano is located on the island of Karamja between Brimhaven to Musa Point. An entrance at the top leads to the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon, providing passage to Mor Ul Rek and Crandor.
transportNotes: To reach the Karamja Volcano, one can use one of the following methods.
Teleport with an amulet of glory to the docks north-east in Musa Point, and run west.
From Port Sarim, pay the 30-coin fare to Captain Tobias, Seaman Lorris, or Seaman Thresnor to sail to Musa Point, then run west.
Sail to Musa Point using your ship, or any charter ship, then run west.
Sail to Brimhaven using any charter ship, then run south-east.
From Shilo Village, pay the 200 coin fare for the Shilo Village cart system to travel to Brimhaven, then run south-east.
Take a fairy ring to Fairy ring BLP to arrive in Mor UI Rek, run north-east to the Cave exit, then climb the nearby rope to reach the surface.
travel: The Karamja Volcano is located on the island of Karamja between Brimhaven to Musa Point.
An entrance at the top leads to the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon, providing passage to Mor Ul Rek and Crandor.

karuulm slayer dungeon.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
karuulm slayer dungeon.summary: The Karuulm Slayer Dungeon is a dungeon located beneath Mount Karuulm, which is located just west of Lovakengj. It contains a variety of monsters, most notably hydras which cannot be found anywhere else. Upon entering the dungeon, players will encounter a chamber with the Tasakaal, the masters of the Kahlith just above; they will not converse with players until The Ascent of Arceuus quest. This chamber also contains a mysterious pipe shortcut requiring 88 Agility which leads players outside the Alchemical Hydra's chambers. As the dungeon is found inside a volcano, players who wish to explore further beyond the entrance chamber must wear the boots of stone, boots of brimstone or granite boots to protect themselves from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor. If players attempt to explore further without one of these boots, then they will be warned of the consequences; if players proceed regardless, they will be rapidly burnt, taking 4 damage every tick, which can quickly kill the player. Players who have obtained the rewards from the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary will no longer need to wear these boots and can bring other footwear or walk barefoot without taking damage. Throughout the dungeon, players can find opened stone chests which can be searched for some old notes. These are written by a Dragonkin named Karuulm, and documents the various projects he's worked on in creating the draconic inhabitants of the dungeon. Players can compile all the old notes into the Mount Karuulm
transportNotes: Players can get there via the fairy ring Fairy ring CIR. The mountain is a short walk north of this fairy ring.
The skills necklace (The Farming Guild) will take you just south-west of Mount Karuulm.
The Battlefront Teleport will take you just south-east of Mount Karuulm.

Players may use Rada's blessing 3 or higher, which is unlocked after completing the Kourend & Kebos Hard Diary, to teleport straight to the dungeon using "Mount Karuulm" option. Rada's blessing 3 offers three daily teleports, while Rada's blessing 4 provides unlimited teleports.
travel: The Karuulm Slayer Dungeon is a dungeon located beneath Mount Karuulm, which is located just west of Lovakengj.
It contains a variety of monsters, most notably hydras which cannot be found anywhere else.

kebos lowlands.name: Kebos Lowlands
kebos lowlands.summary: The Kebos Lowlands are a region located on the continent of Zeah, just west of Great Kourend. It is one of the three regions that make up the continent, the other two being the Kingdom of Great Kourend and Varlamore. The region consists of a rocky mountain known as Mount Quidamortem to the south, and a sulphurous volcano known as Mount Karuulm to the north. Between these two mountains lies a large piece of land with very fertile soil and the Kebos Swamp. The fertile land and the swamp are separated by the River Molch, which runs between the two. Players can travel to the Kebos Lowlands by walking to the Battlefront north-west of Shayzien or by traversing the rocky terrain south-west of Lovakengj. Players can also reach the region by walking past the Shayziens' Wall, but this is not recommended unless they are travelling to Mount Quidamortem, as aggressive lizardmen are found directly west of the Wall; the aforementioned methods are safer for players seeking to reach the northern part of the region.
transportNotes: The Kebos Lowlands can be accessed by travelling through Shayziens' Wall in south-west Kourend or walking past the south-west corner of Lovakengj. The area can also be accessed by the following transportation methods:
Casting Battlefront Teleport (Battlefront)
Fairy ring (code Fairy ring CIR, Mount Karuulm)
Farming spirit tree (Farming Guild)
Lovakengj Minecart Network to Mount Quidamortem or the Farming Guild (nearest fairy ring Fairy ring CIR)
Skills necklace (Farming Guild)
Rada's blessing 3 or Rada's blessing 4 (Mount Karuulm)
Xeric's talisman (Mount Quidamortem)
travel: The Kebos Lowlands are a region located on the continent of Zeah, just west of Great Kourend.
The region consists of a rocky mountain known as Mount Quidamortem to the south, and a sulphurous volcano known as Mount Karuulm to the north.

kebos swamp.name: Kebos Swamp
kebos swamp.summary: The Kebos Swamp is a swamp located in the Kebos Lowlands north of Mount Quidamortem. Here, players can find the lizardman village of Molch, as well as Xeric's Shrine. To the west of the swamp is the Kebos Lowlands mine, as well as a small hunter area containing crimson swifts. Here, players can find Ket'sal K'uk, a lizardman shaman, worshipping a fire in the centre of a stone circle. The Dwarf multicannon cannot be used here. If attempted, you receive the message, "There's something in the swampy atmosphere that interferes with your cannon."
travel: The Kebos Swamp is a swamp located in the Kebos Lowlands north of Mount Quidamortem.
To the west of the swamp is the Kebos Lowlands mine, as well as a small hunter area containing crimson swifts.

keep le faye.name: Keep Le Faye
keep le faye.summary: Keep Le Faye is a tower south of Camelot Castle, and directly east of Sorcerer's Tower. It plays a large role in the Merlin's Crystal and King's Ransom quests. The keep is the home of Morgan Le Faye.
transportNotes: Teleport to Camelot and run south
Use fairy ring code Fairy ring BLR and run north-east
Use the Kandarin headgear 3/4 teleport to Sherlock and run east
Use the Ardougne cloak 2/3/4 teleport to Ardougne farm and run east
Hide in the crate outside of the Candle Shop in Catherby
travel: Keep Le Faye is a tower south of Camelot Castle, and directly east of Sorcerer's Tower.

keldagrim.name: Keldagrim
keldagrim.summary: Keldagrim is the city of the dwarves. Its name is derived from the River Kelda flowing through the city, and it is a massive underground settlement accessible from the tunnel entrance east of Rellekka. It is first visited during The Giant Dwarf quest. This is also the home of the Blast Furnace and the Rat Pits. After the completion of Another Slice of H.A.M, players can use the Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system to travel between the city of Dorgesh-Kaan and Keldagrim. The city is divided into two parts by the river: the rich Keldagrim-West and the poorer Keldagrim-East. The Keldagrim Palace sits in the centre of the city, accessible from both halves. The city was once a monarchy during the so-called Age of Kings, but is currently ruled by a Consortium of the eight most powerful trading companies.
transportNotes: Travelling to Keldagrim requires starting The Giant Dwarf quest. The quest can be started by talking to the dwarven boatman just outside the city, in the cave north-east of Rellekka.
A common method of getting to Keldagrim is by using the trapdoor located in the north-west of the Grand Exchange to take a minecart to the south-eastern section of the city.
Additionally, Keldagrim can be travelled to via minecart from the underground White Wolf Mountain passageway or the Dwarven Mine under Ice Mountain for a fee of 100 or 150 coins respectively.
Players can use fairy ring code Fairy ring DKS to teleport right next to the cave entrance to Keldagrim.
Players can also use an enchanted lyre or Fremennik sea boots, and then walk north-east around the outside of Rellekka to reach the entrance to Keldagrim.
After completing Another Slice of H.A.M., players can use the Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system.
Players can also use the Minigame Teleport for either the Blast Furnace or the Rat Pits (requiring Ratcatchers to be completed).

After completion of the quest Between a Rock..., players can use a ring of wealth to teleport to Dondakan's rock which gets players close to the ferry system that can be used to enter Keldagrim. It should be noted that 2 coins will be needed in order to cross the river to travel via the dwarven boatman.
travel: Its name is derived from the River Kelda flowing through the city, and it is a massive underground settlement accessible from the tunnel entrance east of Rellekka.
After the completion of Another Slice of H.A.M, players can use the Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system to travel between the city of Dorgesh-Kaan and Keldagrim.

kharazi jungle.name: Kharazi Jungle
kharazi jungle.summary: The Kharazi Jungle is an area south of Shilo Village on Karamja. This is where most of the Legends' Quest takes place, and it is necessary to start the quest in order to enter the jungle (you only have to talk to Radimus Erkle and receive Radimus notes). A machete and a Woodcutting axe are required to hack through the dense jungle blocking the path along with the notes. Radimus notes is required to navigate it if players have not completed Legends' Quest. The jungle often serves as the location for Treasure Trail co-ordinates. The jungle is home to the Kharazi tribe and several species of wolves, birds, and other animals, most of which are aggressive. To the north-west is the mossy rock that acts as the entrance to the Shaman Caves and Viyeldi caves, which has a role in Legends' Quest. Along the southern beach are several vanilla plants, which players will find a use for during the Sir Amik Varze subquest of Recipe for Disaster. Roughly in the centre of the jungle is a pond with special water and near it is a location where special Yommi trees may be planted. Along the jungle there are several black totem poles which players will have to get rid of during Legends' Quest. This location is also visited again for the death wing, oomlie wrap, and palm leaf tasks from the Karamja Diary. A palm leaf can be retrieved by shaking the leafy palm trees to the east and west of the small pool in the centre of the jungle. When shaken, a leaf will appear on the ground. To the south-east is
transportNotes: There are several easy ways to enter the Kharazi Jungle from Shilo Village:

One of the easiest ways to enter the jungle coming from Shilo Village is to stand by the jungle tree south of Shilo Village's east fence. Cut the most north-eastern jungle tree from the north-west tile (as pictured), followed by the jungle plant further south.
Players with 79 Agility and completion of Legends' Quest can use a vine shortcut on the east side of the jungle to pass through.
To the west of Shilo Village is a Jungle tree that can be cut down to directly cross the jungle.
travel: South of Shilo Village
Cut into Kharazi Jungle with an axe and machete
Mossy rock in the north-west: Shaman Caves; winch leads deeper
caveats: These are Karamja caves, not Lizardman shaman caves. Deeper routes need the relevant quest steps, ropes and tools.

kharidian desert.name: Kharidian Desert
kharidian desert.summary: The Kharidian Desert is an expansive region located south of the nations of Misthalin and Morytania. The desert becomes a dangerous region south of the Shantay Pass, requiring a player to drink from waterskins or other sources of water to avoid dehydration. The player will automatically drink every 90 seconds if they have a waterskin with charges in their inventory; the time between drinks can be extended by wearing heat-resistant gear. Failing to drink will cause the player to periodically lose hitpoints. Within the boundaries of towns, players are immune to the desert heat and do not need to drink. Players may quickly travel to certain locations by using magic carpet rides, though some destinations are unavailable until certain quests have been completed. This region also has its own achievement diary that was released on 5 March 2015, along with many other diaries.
travel: The Kharidian Desert is an expansive region located south of the nations of Misthalin and Morytania.
The desert becomes a dangerous region south of the Shantay Pass, requiring a player to drink from waterskins or other sources of water to avoid dehydration.

killerwatt plane.name: Killerwatt plane
killerwatt plane.summary: The Killerwatt plane is an area where Killerwatts are found. It is accessed by Professor Oddenstein's portal machine, found atop Draynor Manor after completion of the quest Ernest the Chicken. The plane hosts some Killerwatts, and some small storm clouds, like the ones found in Zanaris, are also seen here. Players can exit via the portal home going back to Professor Oddenstein's room or by simply teleporting out. During the Enlightened Journey quest, it was revealed by the balloon travelling screen that killerwatts inhabit clouds. However, players cannot engage them in battle there. Players cannot use the dwarf multicannon in the Killerwatt plane.
travel: Draynor Manor
Top floor: Professor Oddenstein
Enter the portal
caveats: Insulated boots or an applicable protective item are needed to fight killerwatts.

king black dragon lair.name: King Black Dragon Lair
king black dragon lair.summary: The King Black Dragon Lair, abbreviated as the KBD lair, is a multi-combat area, allowing groups of players to fight him simultaneously. The lair can be accessed via the western entrance to the Lava Maze Dungeon in level 42 Wilderness near the Lava Maze, however the lair itself is not the Wilderness. The lair is additionally visited by players completing an elite or master clue scroll step; the elite one requires players to kill the dragon, while the master clue has an emote clue that must be performed in the cave. : Watch out for player-killers on the way to the lair. The dungeon may be accessed via a ladder in a fenced area on the west end of the Lava Maze containing four lesser demons. The ladder leads to an area with poison spiders, and a lever which will teleport the player to the King Black Dragon's lair. The lair itself isn't in the Wilderness, but players are in the Wilderness until they pull the lever. As with all Wilderness levers, if a player is teleblocked, they can't pull the lever. As the lair itself is not considered the Wilderness, players can use any means of teleportation to leave. The quickest way to reach the KBD lair is by rubbing a burning amulet and teleporting to the Lava Maze.
travel: The lair can be accessed via the western entrance to the Lava Maze Dungeon in level 42 Wilderness near the Lava Maze, however the lair itself is not the Wilderness.
The dungeon may be accessed via a ladder in a fenced area on the west end of the Lava Maze containing four lesser demons.

kingstown.name: Kingstown
kingstown.summary: Kingstown is a town located in the centre of Great Kourend, made up of Kourend Castle, its courtyard, and multiple houses to the east of the courtyard. Here, players can find the houses of the four members of the Kourend Council, although it is not known which council members lives in which house, save Sophia Hughes before her arrest during the events of The Queen of Thieves. Outside the councillors’ houses, Martin Holt and four other protesters can be seen protesting against the Kourend Council, accusing them of corruption and expressing their desire for a king to rule Great Kourend once more. The town also has a park east of the councillors’ residences. Here, Reshi, Kendall and Thomdril, travelling students from the College of Bards in Varlamore, can be seen camping and playing music. In the nearby pond, players can fish salmon, trout, pikes and sardine. A Lovakengj Minecart Network station operated by Hordal is located south of the park.
travel: Kingstown is a town located in the centre of Great Kourend, made up of Kourend Castle, its courtyard, and multiple houses to the east of the courtyard.
The town also has a park east of the councillors’ residences.

kourend castle.name: Kourend Castle
kourend castle.summary: The Kourend Castle is a large castle found in the centre of Great Kourend, its courtyard directly flowing into the district of Kingstown.
transportNotes: The fastest way to the main courtyard is through Xeric's talisman with the "Xeric's Heart" function, which teleports the player outside the statue of King Rada I, the Kourend Castle Teleport spell, which requires completion of Client of Kourend, or using a ring of returning having set your respawn point to Kourend Castle, which can only be done after completion of A Kingdom Divided.
Alternate forms of transport include:
Achievement diary cape to the Kourend & Kebos option, which puts the player next to Elise.
A portal in the portal chamber or portal nexus of a player-owned house attuned to Kourend Castle.
Using the Hosidius page in the Kharedst's memoirs; or using the Hosidius page in the Book of the Dead, after completion of A Kingdom Divided
Fairy ring: Fairy ring CIS, then Lovakengj Minecart Network to Kingstown
Games necklace to Wintertodt, then Lovakengj Minecart Network to Kingstown
Rada's blessing to Kourend Woodland, then Lovakengj Minecart Network to Kingstown
travel: The Kourend Castle is a large castle found in the centre of Great Kourend, its courtyard directly flowing into the district of Kingstown.

kourend woodland.name: Kourend Woodland
kourend woodland.summary: The Kourend Woodland is an area found in the southern coast of Great Kourend. It contains chinchompas to the north-west, ruby harvests in the centre, and copper longtails to the south-east. In the area where ruby harvests are found, three NPCs, Reginald, Roy jr. and a duck, are camping. In addition, in the north-western area, there is a mysterious staircase that cannot be climbed on. There is also a small barbarian settlement in the eastern area (directly south of the Woodcutting Guild), along with three magic trees and four yew trees nearby. In the southernmost side, a small settlement named Land's End is found.
transportNotes: The Rada's blessing teleport is the quickest way to get here.
Take the Lovakengj Minecart Network to Kourend Woodland.
Use the Xeric's Lookout option on the Xeric's talisman, and run south-west.
Use the Woodcutting Guild option on the Skills necklace, and run south-west.
Take the boat from Veos to Land's End.
travel: The Kourend Woodland is an area found in the southern coast of Great Kourend.
It contains chinchompas to the north-west, ruby harvests in the centre, and copper longtails to the south-east.

kraken cove.name: Kraken Cove
kraken cove.summary: The Kraken Cove is a dungeon full of underground lakes located in Piscatoris, south-west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, housing waterfiends, cave krakens, and the Kraken boss. All of the creatures can only be killed while on a Slayer task. Players may enter without a Slayer task, but upon attacking any monster inside the dungeon, Lieve McCracken will stop them from doing so, stating that they are not assigned to kill them. It is not possible to use a dwarf multicannon within this dungeon. If players attempt to place one, they will instead receive a chatbox message:
transportNotes: There are several ways to access the cove:
The fairy ring code Fairy ring AKQ will bring the players just east of the Cove.
Using a Piscatoris teleport scroll, or either the Western banner 3 or 4 to teleport the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, and running south-west.
travel: The Kraken Cove is a dungeon full of underground lakes located in Piscatoris, south-west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, housing waterfiends, cave krakens, and the Kraken boss.

kruk's dungeon.name: Kruk's Dungeon
kruk's dungeon.summary: Kruk's Dungeon is a large labyrinth whose entrance is hidden under jungle grass west of Marim on Ape Atoll. The dungeon is visited during Monkey Madness II to kill Kruk and sabotage Glough's laboratory. After completing Monkey Madness II, the laboratory is destroyed and becomes a hunter training area for maniacal monkeys. The dwarf multicannon can be used in the dungeon.
travel: Kruk's Dungeon is a large labyrinth whose entrance is hidden under jungle grass west of Marim on Ape Atoll.

kurask lair.name: Kurask Lair
kurask lair.summary: Kurask Lair is a dungeon beneath Laguna Aurorae, accessed by a cave entrance. It is a small cave that contains eight kurask. A dwarf multicannon can be used in the dungeon, although cannonballs don't damage kurask. The entire dungeon is single-way combat.
travel: Kurask Lair is a dungeon beneath Laguna Aurorae, accessed by a cave entrance.

lady zay.name: Lady Zay
lady zay.summary: The Lady Zay is a galleon in possession of pirates from Pirates' Cove and is owned by Captain Bentley. To reach her, players must speak to Lokar Searunner on Rellekka's western-most dock, who will row them to the docked Lady Zay. From there, players can reach Lunar Isle. Barrels of swamp tar, cooking apples, and rotten apples can be found around the ship. The barrels have a 1 in 3 chance of emptying when a player loots them and refill after 24 seconds when they empty.
