travel: To reach her, players must speak to Lokar Searunner on Rellekka's western-most dock, who will row them to the docked Lady Zay.
Barrels of swamp tar, cooking apples, and rotten apples can be found around the ship.

laguna aurorae.name: Laguna Aurorae
laguna aurorae.summary: Laguna Aurorae is an island located in the Sunset Ocean, requiring level 58 Sailing to moor at. The island is notable for containing the Kurask Lair. Laguna Aurorae is inhabited by multiple moss giants, leeches, giant mosquitoes, pirates, and giant toads, and is currently the only location where mangrove trees are found. It contains one hard-tier Treasure Trails clue step location.
transportNotes: Mooring point (requires 58 Sailing)
The mooring point is surrounded by aggressive pygmy krakens, so it's safest to approach the mooring point fast and dock quickly.
The nearest port with a shipwright to retrieve a boat and sail over is located on Aldarin.
Spirit tree (requires having moored at the island, but does not require talking to the tree first)
travel: Laguna Aurorae is an island located in the Sunset Ocean, requiring level 58 Sailing to moor at.
Laguna Aurorae is inhabited by multiple moss giants, leeches, giant mosquitoes, pirates, and giant toads, and is currently the only location where mangrove trees are found.

land's end.name: Land's End
land's end.summary: Land's End is a small village in Great Kourend that is located in the south-western corner of the kingdom, within its Woodland. Taking a boat here is a task in the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary.
transportNotes: Players can reach Land's End via Port Sarim or Port Piscarilius by speaking to Veos (or Cabin Boy Herbert after A Kingdom Divided), and can leave the village via the small port where Captain Magoro is. Using Rada's blessing's teleport to Kourend Woodland is also a fast way to get there. It can also be reached via charter ship.
With a greater teleport focus installed on a player-owned boat docked there, Teleport to Boat can also be used.
travel: Land's End is a small village in Great Kourend that is located in the south-western corner of the kingdom, within its Woodland.
Taking a boat here is a task in the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary.

lava dragon isle.name: Lava Dragon Isle
lava dragon isle.summary: The Lava Dragon Isle is a members-only section of the Wilderness which stretches from level 36 to level 42. It is a Multicombat area, and the only place where lava dragons spawn.
transportNotes: The main entrance is located at the northern point of the isle, and players can reach it either by using a Revenant cave teleport and heading north-east, or the Annakarl Teleport to the Demonic Ruins and heading south-west.

Alternatively, there is an agility shortcut at the southern point of the isle, which requires 74 Agility to use. Players with level 57 Woodcutting can take a canoe to the Wilderness Pond to the south-west, and run east to reach the shortcut.
travel: The Lava Dragon Isle is a members-only section of the Wilderness which stretches from level 36 to level 42.

lava maze.name: Lava Maze
lava maze.summary: The Lava Maze is a maze located deep in the Wilderness, around level 40-45. In the entrance and partway through the maze, there are spiderwebs that must be cut with a slash weapon or a knife. Should players somehow lose their slash weapon or knife while inside the maze, there are a couple of knife item spawns. An Agility shortcut (stepping stone) on the north side of the maze allows you to go to the centre of the maze with 82 Agility.
transportNotes: Using a burning amulet's Lava Maze teleport is the fastest method, and will teleport you directly to the maze's entrance on the west side. The Ghorrock Teleport and level 44 Wilderness Obelisk also provide quick access to the west side of the maze.

The level 35 Wilderness Obelisk, the Wilderness canoe stop, and the Revenant cave teleport scroll all take the player near the south-east side of the lava maze, and can be good ways to access the Agility shortcut on the north side.
travel: The Lava Maze is a maze located deep in the Wilderness, around level 40-45.
In the entrance and partway through the maze, there are spiderwebs that must be cut with a slash weapon or a knife.

lava maze dungeon.name: Lava Maze Dungeon
lava maze dungeon.summary: The Lava Maze Dungeon is a dungeon beneath the Lava Maze in high level Wilderness. The dungeon is entirely single-way combat and has two ladder entrances. The dungeon's western entrance is west of the Lava Maze, level 42 Wilderness in a metal fenced area containing lesser demons. This entrance leads to a small area containing only poison spiders and the lever to enter the King Black Dragon's lair. This part of the dungeon covers level 42 to 43 Wilderness. The dungeon's eastern entrance is in the centre of the Lava Maze, level 42 to 43 Wilderness in a metal fenced area. This entrance leads to an area containing more monsters and a single Runite rock. This part of the dungeon covers level 41 to 47 Wilderness. Players who are on a black dragon or greater demon Wilderness Slayer task given by Krystilia may opt to kill them here as their other locations in the Wilderness are multicombat areas. However, it is only recommended to do so with 82 Agility given the massive distance and lack of a bank in the area.
travel: The dungeon is entirely single-way combat and has two ladder entrances.
The dungeon's western entrance is west of the Lava Maze, level 42 Wilderness in a metal fenced area containing lesser demons.

legends' guild.name: Legends' Guild
legends' guild.summary: The Legends' Guild is the second most exclusive of the quest-based guilds in Old School RuneScape (with the Myths' Guild being the first). It is located to the north-east of East Ardougne, east of Hemenster, and the south of Seers' Village. To enter the grounds of the Legends' Guild, players must have started the Legends' Quest. However, to enter the actual building, players must have completed the entire quest. Radimus Erkle is the grand vizier of the guild, and he is also the start point of the Legends' Quest. A number of NPCs are implied to be members of the guild, by the fact they themselves wear a Cape of Legends.
transportNotes: There are several ways to get to the Legends' Guild:
Quest point cape teleport - by the entrance
Fairy ring code Fairy ring BLR - just east of the entrance.
Ardougne cloak (farm teleport) - run east.
Myths' Guild - 2, eastern red Portal of Legends - front path inside the guild.
Wizards' Guild Yanille - 2, western portal to the Sorcerer's Tower, which is slightly to the north-west of the guild.
Ardougne teleport - go east, then north.
Combat bracelet to Ranging Guild - go south-east.
travel: It is located to the north-east of East Ardougne, east of Hemenster, and the south of Seers' Village.
caveats: The grounds can be entered during the quest; the listed Slayer creatures are in the post-quest basement.

lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
lighthouse.summary: The Lighthouse is an area north of the Barbarian Outpost, and features prominently in the Horror from the Deep quest. The Lighthouse can only be entered during and after the quest; however, the island itself can be visited prior to starting the quest. Jossik can be found upstairs after completing the aforementioned quest. He runs a general store and will provide players with god books, as well as replace any that are lost. Its dungeon is a popular place for players to kill dagannoth for Slayer.
transportNotes: The fastest way getting there is fairy ring code Fairy ring ALP. Players can get there from the Barbarian Outpost by jumping across the northern basalt rocks that protrude from the sea. It is possible to slip on the rocks, which results in the player falling into the water, being swept back to shore, and taking up to 10 damage. It is noted that having an Agility level above 35 increases the likelihood of successfully jumping across the rocks. Players seem to have a lot of trouble getting over the rock as the character "fails" to jump over it several times.

Another route of access is via a bridge, which is fixed during the quest. The bridge is located in the south-western part of the Fremennik Province. If the bridge has not been fixed, the player can jump across it and gain 1 Agility experience, but failing to cross the bridge will deal anywhere between 1 and 5 damage and grant 0.7 Agility experience.
Besides the fairy ring, there are three teleports that arrive near the Lighthouse:
A games necklace or Minigame Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost.
Teleport to House, if the player's house is at Rellekka.
An enchanted lyre teleport to the entrance to Rellekka.
travel: The Lighthouse is an area north of the Barbarian Outpost, and features prominently in the Horror from the Deep quest.
Jossik can be found upstairs after completing the aforementioned quest.

limbo.name: Limbo
limbo.summary: Limbo is an island south-west of the Isle of Souls. It does not have a standard mooring point and can only be reached by hopping to a different world while on someone else's boat. Junior Jim enjoys vacations on the island, to "get away from all the rabble." It is home to two level 5 frogs, a duck and three crabs. To exit the island, Junior Jim can transport players to The Pandemonium, or players can hop back to the world they came from to return to the boat.
travel: Limbo is an island south-west of the Isle of Souls.
It does not have a standard mooring point and can only be reached by hopping to a different world while on someone else's boat.
caveats: No standard mooring route; requires the special world-hop/other-player boat behaviour. Excluded from ordinary recommendations.

lithkren vault.name: Lithkren Vault
lithkren vault.summary: The Lithkren Vault is an underground research facility located in the ruins of a dragonkin castle on Lithkren. During the Dragon Slayer II quest, it is opened with the dragon key, in which the player, Dallas Jones, and Bob inadvertently release the dragonkin Zorgoth and his creation, Galvek. Seven old notes are found here, of which four can only be obtained after completion of the quest. In the north-east corner of the Vault, next to the pool, a strange machine can be found that can enchant a digsite pendant to allow players to teleport outside the Vault. Another piece of machinery can be found in the centre of the Vault with the ability to turn hydra leather into ferocious gloves using a hammer. Adamant and rune dragons can also be found roaming the west and east wings of the facility, respectively, behind the red barriers. These barriers can only be entered once Dragon Slayer II has been completed. The mural between the two metallic dragon chambers can be interacted with to check the player's killcount for those two dragons.
transportNotes: Prior to unlocking the digsite pendant teleport after Dragon Slayer II:
Use the digsite pendant to teleport to Fossil Island
Mushtree transport to Mushroom Meadow
Use the rowboat found south-west of the mushtree
Climb up the stairs in the middle of island
Keep going north until you are in the vault!
After Dragon Slayer II has been completed:
Use a digsite pendant on the strange machine in Lithkren Vault (north of the rune dragons) to unlock the teleport.
travel: The Lithkren Vault is an underground research facility located in the ruins of a dragonkin castle on Lithkren.
Seven old notes are found here, of which four can only be obtained after completion of the quest.

lizardman canyon.name: Lizardman Canyon
lizardman canyon.summary: The Lizardman Canyon is a valley in the west portion of Great Kourend, between Lovakengj and Shayzien. The valley is where lizardmen and lizardman brutes reside, and is the responsibility of the Shayzien soldiers to keep them contained. A wounded soldier overlooking both canyons can inform players of how many people are inside either canyon. The easiest way to get there is by using the fairy ring with the code Fairy ring DJR.
travel: The Lizardman Canyon is a valley in the west portion of Great Kourend, between Lovakengj and Shayzien.

lizardman caves.name: Lizardman Caves
lizardman caves.summary: The Lizardman Caves are a series of caves located at the north-west corner of the Lizardman Settlement in the Kebos Lowlands. It is a single-combat area, but all eight of the shamans can only be killed while on a Slayer task. Only the northern-most entrance can be used, as indicated on the world map. The player character will refuse to enter any other entrances, stating "I don't think it would be wise for me to enter this lair. It sounds like a lot of lizardmen are down there." Players may enter without a Slayer assignment, but upon attacking any monster inside the dungeon, Captain Cleive will stop them from doing so, claiming that they are not assigned to kill them. According to Captain Cleive, there were lizardman shamans causing trouble on the surface, so he led a taskforce to drive them into the caves that they currently reside in, albeit with many casualties. A dwarf multicannon cannot be set up in the caves; attempting to do so will display the following message in the player's chatbox: "The ground is too marshy here."
transportNotes: The fairy ring code Fairy ring BLS will bring players south of the entrance.
By using the Xeric's talisman to teleport to Lookout and running west.

After completing Tale of the Righteous, players can use Kharedst's Memoirs/Book of the Dead to teleport to the Graveyard of Heroes by selecting History and Hearsay, not far from the gates, and run west from there.
The fairy ring code Fairy ring DJR will bring the players just near the Chasm of Fire. Run south to the Shayziens' Wall, and run west from there.

The fairy ring code Fairy ring CIS will bring the players north of the Arceuus Library. Players who have fully unlocked the Lovakengj Minecart Network can use it to reach the Mount Quidamortem station, and travel to the Shayziens' Wall via the Mountain Guide, and running west from there.
Players who have unlocked the Xeric's Honour teleport on the Xeric's talisman can teleport directly to Mount Quidamortem.

Additionally players who have unlocked the Xeric's Honour teleport on the Xeric's talisman can use travel with the Mountain guide just located east of the teleport location which will transport the player in the swamp just east of the caves.
travel: The Lizardman Caves are a series of caves located at the north-west corner of the Lizardman Settlement in the Kebos Lowlands.
Only the northern-most entrance can be used, as indicated on the world map.

lizardman settlement.name: Lizardman Settlement
lizardman settlement.summary: The Lizardman Settlement is an area in the Kebos Lowlands inhabited by Lizardmen, between Mount Quidamortem and Shayziens' Wall. In the north is Xeric's Shrine. Players going to the Chambers of Xeric for the first time will need to pass through this area. It is recommended to bring antipoison while moving through this area since the lizardmen can poison you. Dwarf multicannons can't be placed in the area or inside Lizardman Caves where lizardman shamans can be fought during slayer tasks. A message will appear with the text "There's something in the swampy atmosphere around here that inteferes with your cannon."
transportNotes: The Lizardman Settlement can be reached by various methods:
Using the fairy ring (code Fairy ring BLS) and running north-east towards the bridge and continue into the swamp
The skills necklace or Farming cape provide teleports to the Farming Guild then running south through the River Molch towards Xeric's Shrine, then continue south
travel: In the north is Xeric's Shrine.

lizardman temple.name: Lizardman Temple
lizardman temple.summary: The Lizardman Temple is a temple dedicated to Xeric found beneath Molch. The entrances leading to the temple are a one-way trip, but players can leave via the strange hole in the south-west corner of the temple, where they will end up on the top of the step pyramid in Molch. A lizardman shaman named Kaht B'alam, the only lizardman players can talk to, can be found at the south-east end of the Temple, giving players insights into their culture. The stone chest near him can be searched to find a stone tablet documenting the origins of the Temple. A Dwarf multicannon cannot be placed within the temple.
travel: The Lizardman Temple is a temple dedicated to Xeric found beneath Molch.

The entrances leading to the temple are a one-way trip, but players can leave via the strange hole in the south-west corner of the temple, where they will end up on the top of the step pyramid in Molch.

lletya.name: Lletya
lletya.summary: Lletya (Welsh pronunciation: , Jagex pronunciation: LLE-to-ah) is a small village that can be accessed after starting Mourning's End Part I. Eluned brings players to Lletya the first time, and gives a teleport crystal for teleporting back afterwards.
transportNotes: The only way to teleport to Lletya directly is a charged teleport crystal. Players can obtain new crystals as a common drop from the elves in the village. Recharging costs to , depending on how many times it's been charged before.

Beyond the teleport crystal, players can reach Lletya on foot after teleporting nearby. Although they all require substantial walking, several methods of teleporting this way exist, listed here from shortest walk to longest:
will teleport you directly to Lletya.
, a variant of the teleport crystal with unlimited charges (after completing Song of the Elves).
, then navigating the forest (after completing Regicide).
to Prifddinas, then navigating the forest (after completing Song of the Elves).
to Port Tyras for , then navigating the forest (after completing Regicide).
Fairy ring BJS, then navigating the forest (with 76 Agility and completion of Regicide).
travel: Lletya (Welsh pronunciation: , Jagex pronunciation: LLE-to-ah) is a small village that can be accessed after starting Mourning's End Part I.

lovakengj.name: Lovakengj
lovakengj.summary: Lovakengj ( ) is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend, which resides in a volcanic area exclusively inhabited by dwarves. One of the three cities founded in the history of Great Kourend, Lovakengj was founded by Yonrith Lovakengj, the leader of a dwarven army allied with Saradomin that fought against the Zarosians at Lassar during the God Wars. Today, the city is led by Lady Vulcana Lovakengj of the Lovakengj House. As one of the five cities of Great Kourend, the city is responsible for providing military equipment for the Shayzien Army; their main export are ores found by blasting rocks with dynamite in the Blast Mine, in addition to Shayzien armour, which is made from lovakite, a unique metal found only within Lovakengj. Since the establishment of trade routes between Great Kourend and the mainland, Lovakengj has established contact with the Mining Consortium of Keldagrim, though they offer nothing notable to Lovakengj. In the past, the city once had maintained contact with the imcando dwarves in the southern kingdom of Varlamore, who reside in an underground city beneath the Ralos' Rise. However, they lost contact with them centuries ago, presumably during the War of the Five Houses.
transportNotes: Xeric's Talisman - Xeric's Inferno teleport (by the lovakite furnace south of the blast mine)
Fairy ring Fairy ring CIS and run West
Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead - Jewellery of Jubilation teleport (requires completion of The Forsaken Tower)
Games necklace - Wintertodt teleport and run south-west
Fairy ring - Fairy ring DJR and run north
travel: One of the three cities founded in the history of Great Kourend, Lovakengj was founded by Yonrith Lovakengj, the leader of a dwarven army allied with Saradomin that fought against the Zarosians at Lassar during the God Wars.

As one of the five cities of Great Kourend, the city is responsible for providing military equipment for the Shayzien Army; their main export are ores found by blasting rocks with dynamite in the Blast Mine, in addition to Shayzien armour, which is made from lovakite, a unique metal found only within Lovakengj.

lovakite mine.name: Lovakite Mine
lovakite mine.summary: The lovakite mine is located in the north-western section of Lovakengj in Great Kourend. Lovakite rocks are found here, which requires level 65 Mining and grants 60 Mining experience per lovakite ore mined. Coal rocks can be found here as well. A bank is available within the mine, making this mine one of the best places to mine coal, as it is very close to a bank. Players may consider bringing nature runes and a staff of fire (or any other staff that provides unlimited fire runes) to cast Superheat Item on the ores to get the bars, as there are plenty of coal within the mine as well. This may save players trouble of having to walk to the special furnace, which is far from the bank.
travel: The lovakite mine is located in the north-western section of Lovakengj in Great Kourend.
Lovakite rocks are found here, which requires level 65 Mining and grants 60 Mining experience per lovakite ore mined.

lumbridge.name: Lumbridge
lumbridge.summary: Lumbridge is a large town where players begin their Old School RuneScape journey. New players are sent here from Tutorial Island to further learn the game from various tutors across the town. Lumbridge gets its name from the bridge that crosses the River Lum. After a player's death, Lumbridge is the player's default respawn point, although players can change their respawn location to other locations. The main point of interest of Lumbridge is the Lumbridge Castle, where players can start several quests and access its bank at the top floor.
transportNotes: Several transport options bring players into or close to Lumbridge, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
— castle courtyard, once every 30 minutes. No Magic requirement or rune cost.
— castle courtyard (only if a respawn is set there). Players should bank items before doing this.
The and the spell work the same way.
— nearby Al Kharid or Draynor Village.
Fairy ring DIP — Abyssal Nexus via the Appendage or Fairy ring DIS — Wizard's Tower.
Taking any fairy ring to Zanaris then leaving also leads to the Lumbridge shed.
Broken raft - A grapple spot between Al Kharid and Lumbridge requiring 8 Agility, or 48 Agility without a grapple.
travel: Lumbridge is a large town where players begin their Old School RuneScape journey.
Lumbridge gets its name from the bridge that crosses the River Lum.

lumbridge castle.name: Lumbridge Castle
lumbridge castle.summary: Lumbridge Castle is a large castle located in Lumbridge and home of Duke Horacio. The courtyard enclosed by the outer walls features two decorative fountains and two statues, one of an ancient king and one of an ancient hero. A short flight of three steps joins this to the castle's front entrance. Another entrance is behind the castle. The Lumbridge Home Teleport and Lumbridge Teleport spells take players to the courtyard of the castle. It is a popular location as many new players are here, as they spawn here after completing Tutorial Island. Players also respawn here after death, although it it possible to change your respawn point and respawn elsewhere.
travel: Lumbridge Castle is a large castle located in Lumbridge and home of Duke Horacio.
A short flight of three steps joins this to the castle's front entrance.

lumbridge swamp.name: Lumbridge Swamp
lumbridge swamp.summary: The Lumbridge Swamp is located south of Lumbridge and is east of Draynor Village. It can be accessed via a small gateway at the back of the graveyard behind Lumbridge Church. Players can also access it via an entry south-east of Draynor Village, or they can swing across an Agility shortcut from Al Kharid. Zandar Horfyre will also teleport the player here, away from the Dark Wizards' Tower, if they refuse to leave when going through his dialogue. It is also possible for players to get to the Lumbridge swamp by using a ring of the elements to teleport to the Water Altar, or alternatively by travelling to the altar through the Abyss and exiting the portal. There are several fishing spots on the east end of the swamp that are ideal for novice anglers. There are two mining sites in the swamp. Hermit Father Urhney (from The Restless Ghost quest) can be found in the swamp as well as the entrance to the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. The starting point to the Lost City quest is in the swamp as well as the entrance to the lost city itself, Zanaris. The Misthalin Mystery quest can also be started by speaking to Abigale (or Hewey, who sits next to her) in the south-east corner. The Water Altar is also located in the swamp, where players can craft water runes. Over a dozen Swamp tar spawns are scattered across the western half of the swamp.
travel: The Lumbridge Swamp is located south of Lumbridge and is east of Draynor Village.
It can be accessed via a small gateway at the back of the graveyard behind Lumbridge Church.

lumbridge swamp caves.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
lumbridge swamp caves.summary: The Lumbridge Swamp Caves are a dungeon filled with a variety of monsters and Slayer monsters, located beneath Lumbridge Swamp. There are three entrances to the caves: *From the swamp near the candle seller, requiring a rope to enter. After one rope has been used, further ropes are not required. *Directly south from the Lumbridge castle cellar. You must start The Lost Tribe to gain access this way. A pickaxe is needed to enter for the first time. *From the minigame Tears of Guthix, which is in its own cave branching off from the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. The caves require a light source, unless the player has lit a fire of eternal light near the rope entrance. If the player is within 3 tiles of the rope entrance from the Lumbridge swamp without a light source, they will automatically climb up to escape. Minimum recommended items include a light source with tinderbox, rope, spiny helmet and antipoison. A Dwarf multicannon can be used in the caves.
travel: The Lumbridge Swamp Caves are a dungeon filled with a variety of monsters and Slayer monsters, located beneath Lumbridge Swamp.
There are three entrances to the caves: *From the swamp near the candle seller, requiring a rope to enter.

lumbridge cow field.name: Lumbridge cow field
lumbridge cow field.summary: The Lumbridge cow field is a field containing level 2 cows and cow calves. Located in the north-east of Lumbridge, the field is managed by Gillie Groats, and is part of the larger Groats' farm. Also present are dairy cows, which can be milked if you have a bucket in your inventory. This is a good place to train either Magic or Ranged at a low combat level due to the fact that you can safely kill them from the other side of the fence, and run in to loot between kills. There are 2 other cow fields in Lumbridge: a large pen north of the windmill, and a smaller pen that is part of Fred's farm. This field is a very popular training spot for low levels of both free players and members because of the 100% cowhide drop, as well as raw beef and bones to train Cooking and Prayer with, respectively. It is also an extremely good place to train Prayer and Cooking as bones and beef are often left in the rush to collect cow hides. This is also the closest cow field to a bank as well as a Tanner in Al Kharid, which also makes it crowded. After completing The Ides of Milk, Brutus can be fought at the north end of the field.
transportNotes: The cowbell amulet can transport you to the middle of the field following the completion of the The Ides of Milk quest.
travel: The Lumbridge cow field is a field containing level 2 cows and cow calves.
Located in the north-east of Lumbridge, the field is managed by Gillie Groats, and is part of the larger Groats' farm.

lumbridge cow field (north).name: Lumbridge cow field (north)
lumbridge cow field (north).summary: The northern Lumbridge cow field is a field containing cows, cow calves, a dairy cow, and attackable farmers located in the north of Lumbridge. This is a good place to train combat skills at low levels and can be preferred over the eastern cow field or Fred's farm due to more players training in those fields in free-to-play. This place is also a good place for early Prayer training due to the bones dropped by the cows.
transportNotes: The easiest mode of transportation for a new player is to teleport to Lumbridge using either the Lumbridge Home Teleport or Lumbridge Teleport spell, and walk north from there.
travel: The northern Lumbridge cow field is a field containing cows, cow calves, a dairy cow, and attackable farmers located in the north of Lumbridge.
This is a good place to train combat skills at low levels and can be preferred over the eastern cow field or Fred's farm due to more players training in those fields in free-to-play.

lumbridge pond.name: Lumbridge pond
lumbridge pond.summary: The Lumbridge pond is a small body of water found amongst the farms of Lumbridge and Draynor. The pond features two ducks and two ducklings, all of whom are attackable, as well as two more ducks outside of the pond that can only be examined.
travel: The Lumbridge pond is a small body of water found amongst the farms of Lumbridge and Draynor.

lunar isle.name: Lunar Isle
lunar isle.summary: Lunar Isle is a crescent-shaped island located in the Northern Ocean, occupied by the ancient Moon Clan. The island becomes accessible to members who have progressed far enough into the Lunar Diplomacy quest. A Seal of Passage is required to interact with all NPC's on the island except 'Birds-Eye' Jack. Players who do so without one equipped or in their inventory will be teleported to Rellekka. Completing the elite tier of the Fremennik Diary removes the need for a seal, adding a Return Orb to the bank which can be used to return to Rellekka if desired.
transportNotes: There are two methods for teleporting to Lunar Isle:
and — entrance to the residential area.
— centre of the residential area.

Beyond that, players may talk to to Lokar Searunner on the western-most dock of Rellekka to be taken to Pirates' Cove, then go up to the pirate ship and talk to Captain Bentley to go on to Lunar Isle. A number of teleports to Rellekka exist, including:
— centre of the Rellekka marketplace.
— Rellekka's southern entrance.
— POH portal just south of Rellekka.
— just south of the POH portal.
travel: Lunar Isle is a crescent-shaped island located in the Northern Ocean, occupied by the ancient Moon Clan.
The island becomes accessible to members who have progressed far enough into the Lunar Diplomacy quest.
caveats: Use the Lady Zay route via Pirates' Cove. NPC interaction may require a seal of passage unless exempt.

mage arena.name: Mage Arena
mage arena.summary: The Mage Arena is a members-only combat area located deep in the Wilderness. Inside the arena are battle mages affiliated with the gods, which must be fought to unlock the god spells. The arena is involved in the miniquest Mage Arena I. Before the player can cast god spells or access the Mage Arena, players must complete the miniquest. The Mage Arena bank and rune shop can still be used without completion of the miniquest.
transportNotes: Use the Ardougne Wilderness teleport lever with a knife or slash weapon, slash through the web to the north. Walk west to the arena
The Edgeville Wilderness teleport lever can also be used.
There are 2 levers at the Mage Arena.
The western lever inside the house behind 2 spiderwebs takes players to the Mage Arena bank
The eastern lever behind a spiderweb next to the arena wall takes players inside of the Mage Arena
travel: The Mage Arena is a members-only combat area located deep in the Wilderness.
Before the player can cast god spells or access the Mage Arena, players must complete the miniquest.

mage arena ii.name: Mage Arena II
mage arena ii.summary: Mage Arena II is the sequel to Mage Arena I miniquest. Players with level 75 Magic and the ability to cast Saradomin Strike, Flames of Zamorak, and Claws of Guthix outside the Mage Arena can start this miniquest by talking to Kolodion in the Mage Arena bank. Here, players must defeat three powerful god followers roaming the Wilderness- Porazdir, Justiciar Zachariah, and Derwen- and collect their remains in order to enhance one of their god capes upon quest completion. The player is thereafter able to retrieve various imbued capes by bringing just one additional artefact of the representative boss killed to Kolodion. A single remains type will allow the player to imbue each cape affiliate.
travel: Mage Arena II is the sequel to Mage Arena I miniquest.

magic axe hut.name: Magic axe hut
magic axe hut.summary: The magic axe hut is a small hut located in the north of the Wilderness at level 54 Wilderness. A lockpick and level 32 Thieving are required to unlock either of the doors to the hut. It is infested with aggressive magic axes and also contains three chests which may be searched for traps, then looted for 8 Thieving experience and 10 coins. A Dwarf multicannon may be put down within the hut, but the area is single-way combat. A plaque can be found on the eastern wall inside the hut.
transportNotes: Pull the lever in either Ardougne or Edgeville to teleport to the Deserted Keep. Run north and slash the web, then run east to the hut.
Use a Wilderness Obelisk to travel to level 50 Wilderness. Run west past the Rogues' Castle and the Chaos Elemental, then north-west to the hut.
travel: The magic axe hut is a small hut located in the north of the Wilderness at level 54 Wilderness.
A plaque can be found on the eastern wall inside the hut.

marim.name: Marim
marim.summary: Marim is a settlement on Ape Atoll, inhabited by a population of societal monkeys who are ruled over by King Awowogei. It is only accessible to players who have partially or fully completed the Monkey Madness I quest, and most of the quest takes place there. The village is most likely named after Marimbo, the monkey goddess. There are various shops and stalls around the village, including the only shop that sells Dragon scimitars. Players who have not taken the form of a monkey using a greegree will find themselves the target of aggressive creatures throughout Marim and the rest of the island. These include poison-inducing jungle snakes and spiders, Ninja Monkey Archers and Ninja Monkey Guards, and Gorilla Monkey Guards. Being spotted by the monkey locals or interacting with them may result in the player being knocked out and sent to the prison. However, upon completion of Monkey Madness II, a greegree becomes unnecessary for this purpose as all inhabitants of Marim become tolerant towards the player.
transportNotes: Initial access to Marim requires the player to first travel to Ape Atoll via Lumdo on Crash Island during Monkey Madness I. To get there, speak to Daero on the 1 of the Grand Tree. From there, have Waydar fly you to Crash Island.
There are several alternative transportation methods available after completion of Monkey Madness I:

A Fairy ring (Fairy ring CLR) will take players to the Ape Atoll Agility Course, just south of Marim. 48 Agility and a ninja monkey greegree are required to exit the course safely and travel to Marim.

The level 64 Ape Atoll Teleport is available in the normal spellbook after Freeing King Awowogei during Recipe for Disaster. The spell takes the player to the safe upstairs section of the Temple of Marimbo, on the eastern edge of Marim.

The level 90 Ape Atoll Teleport in the Arceuus spellbook, as well as the equivalent magic tablet, takes players to the inside of the entrance to Ape Atoll Dungeon, a little ways south from the entrance gates to Marim.

The Gnome glider network can take players to the western edge of Marim after completion of Monkey Madness II. The fastest way to access the glider network is by climbing to the top floor of the Grand Tree.
travel: Grand Tree: Daero, then Waydar
Crash Island: speak to Lumdo
Ape Atoll: follow the relevant temple or tunnel entrance
caveats: A greegree and quest travel steps may still be needed. Monkey Madness II removes surface hostility, not all dungeon dangers.

mcgrubor's wood.name: McGrubor's Wood
mcgrubor's wood.summary: McGrubor's Wood is a wooded, fenced-in area north of Hemenster and west of Seers' Village, used primarily for quests. There are two ways in and out: a loose section of the northern railing, and a fairy ring with code Fairy ring ALS. A forester can be found at the main entrance, preventing players from using it. The loose section of the railing is immediately to the north-east of the small building that borders the fence, and is shown on the map in red, similarly to how a door is portrayed.
travel: McGrubor's Wood is a wooded, fenced-in area north of Hemenster and west of Seers' Village, used primarily for quests.
There are two ways in and out: a loose section of the northern railing, and a fairy ring with code Fairy ring ALS.

meiyerditch.name: Meiyerditch
meiyerditch.summary: Meiyerditch is a slum ruled by Lord Drakan and his family from the city of vampyres, Darkmeyer, the capital of Morytania. Once the capital city of the Saradominist kingdom of Hallowvale prior to the God Wars, the city fell to vampyric control during the kingdom's fall in the Third Age.
transportNotes: The player must begin the Darkness of Hallowvale quest before they may travel to Meiyerditch. The following methods can be used to get there.
Boarding the boat south of Burgh de Rott, on the eastern dock.
Taking the rowboat to Slepe north of Port Phasmatys for 10,000 coins and running to Ver Sinhaza.
After completing A Taste of Hope, the Drakan's medallion, can be used to teleport to Ver Sinhaza in the south-eastern part of Meiyerditch.
travel: Meiyerditch is a slum ruled by Lord Drakan and his family from the city of vampyres, Darkmeyer, the capital of Morytania.

meiyerditch laboratories.name: Meiyerditch Laboratories
meiyerditch laboratories.summary: The Meiyerditch Laboratories are a set of winding tunnels beneath the Sanguinesti Region where the vampyres practised haemalchemy until they were suddenly shut down by Lord Drakan. Various gruesome experiments were conducted there on humans and bloodveld. The northern end of the tunnels connects to the tomb of Ivandis Seergaze. During the quest Darkness of Hallowvale, the player visits the laboratories in search of possible research that may aid The Myreque in their fight against the vampyres, and during Sins of the Father, the player and Safalaan visits further beyond for additional research. Access to the complete laboratory is granted after the player kills the mutated bloodveld that appears during the Sins of the Father quest, though players are recommended to complete the quest until acquiring Vyre noble clothing for easier laboratory access. In the southern part of the dungeon, near the mutated bloodvelds, there are 3 log respawns and tinderbox. In the eastern part, crawling hands can be found as well. The entire area is also multicombat and the Dwarven multicannon can be used here thus making it an excellent place to kill bloodvelds with a cannon. The entrance to the true Blood Altar is located within the northern part of the dungeon, a blood talisman or blood tiara is required for players to enter the ruins. Players may also access the altar through the blood rift in the Abyss. In this area, a nearby skeleton can be searched for a tatty note. {| class="wikitable" !Mon
transportNotes: The entrance to the Meiyerditch Laboratory is in the house with the slashed tapestry, which is south-east of the location you arrive at once exiting the Meiyerditch mine.
There are various ways to get there:

One of the fastest ways to reach the Meiyerditch Laboratories is to ask the closest Vyrewatch to be sent to the mines, and then exiting. Once you exit, follow the path to the house with the slashed tapestry and climb down the stairs to enter the Meiyerditch Laboratories (See image: "Route to the Meiyerditch Laboratories").

To exit the mine immediately, players who haven't completed The Blood Moon Rises up until the final Lowerniel Drakan fight will need to equip three pieces of Vyre noble clothing when speaking with a Vampyre Juvinate. Otherwise, one must mine 15 daeyalt ore to exit; bring the best pickaxe you can use, or ask the Meiyerditch miners for a spare bronze pickaxe.
Access to the bloodvelds is only possible after killing the mutated bloodveld that appears during the Sins of the Father quest, as otherwise the door will not open.
After Sins of the Father, players can also do the following:
Use a Hallowed crystal shard and exit the Hallowed Sepulchre. Run south and west to reach the cracked wall, follow the path to the house with slashed tapestry, then climb down the stairs.

Teleport to Edgeville or the Grand Exchange, cross the wilderness ditch and run north to the Mage of Zamorak. Enter the Abyss and go to the blood rift, being sure to select the true blood altar instead of the Kourend altar. While this is comparative to the 93 Agility shortcut in speed without having any requirements beyond quest completion, it carries the costly risk of losing your items to a player killer. It also has the downsides of draining your prayer to 0 and being skulled.
travel: The northern end of the tunnels connects to the tomb of Ivandis Seergaze.

Access to the complete laboratory is granted after the player kills the mutated bloodveld that appears during the Sins of the Father quest, though players are recommended to complete the quest until acquiring Vyre noble clothing for easier laboratory access.

melzar's maze.name: Melzar's Maze
melzar's maze.summary: Melzar's Maze is a large, three-story building with a basement located north-west of Rimmington. It is the home of Melzar the Mad and contains Melzar's map part required for the Dragon Slayer I quest. To enter the building, players must obtain the Maze key from the Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild during the quest. The building was built by Melzar atop the remains of the Crandorian refugee camp that was destroyed by Elvarg. Once inside the building, players must go through mazes on each floor and in the basement. However, to proceed to the next floor, players must kill the creature that is holding the key to one of the many doors on the floor. Only one door leads players to the next floor; the rest will send them back to the previous floor. Once a key is used with a door, it will disappear. Because of this, it is recommended that players carry two of each key, so that if they make a mistake, they can go back through the door, get another key, and go into the correct door.
travel: Melzar's Maze is a large, three-story building with a basement located north-west of Rimmington.
melzar's maze.confirmation: Requires the maze key from Dragon Slayer I and the correct coloured-door route.

mind altar.name: Mind Altar
mind altar.summary: The Mind Altar is a runic altar upon which mind runes are crafted from rune essence or pure essence, providing 5.5 Runecraft experience per essence imbued. Level 2 Runecraft is required to craft mind runes. Players may create a mind tiara here by using either a mind talisman or a tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 27.5 Runecraft experience. A catalytic tiara can also be created here by using a catalytic talisman and gold tiara, granting 60 Runecraft experience. Upon entering the Mind Altar, the music track Miracle Dance plays.
transportNotes: The entrance to the altar can be found between Ice Mountain and Goblin Village, the altar can also be accessed through the Abyss. The Mind Altar Teleport can be used to teleport to the altar.

To enter the mysterious ruins, players either have to use a mind talisman on the ruins, or click "Enter" on the ruins while wearing a mind tiara or the runecrafting cape. Alternatively, a catalytic talisman or tiara can be used.
travel: The Mind Altar is a runic altar upon which mind runes are crafted from rune essence or pure essence, providing 5.5 Runecraft experience per essence imbued.

mining guild.name: Mining Guild
mining guild.summary: The Mining Guild, located in and beneath Falador, is a guild for expert miners available to players with at least 60 Mining (can be boosted). The mine is accessible from either the Mining Guild's above-ground complex in the south-east of the city, or through the gate at the southern end of the Dwarven Mine. Both of these entrances are guarded by dwarves who will answer questions about the guild and stop players without the requirements from entering the guild. The guildmaster, Gadrin, also sells the Mining cape to those who have achieved level 99 Mining. This mine is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for power-mining.
transportNotes: Players may use a skills necklace to teleport to the underground entrance.
Casting Falador Teleport will transport a player to the Falador town square, just north-west of the guild entrance.
The Keldagrim mine cart system can be used to travel to the north-west corner of the Dwarven Mine. From there, players can follow the mines south until they reach the underground entrance.
The Explorer's ring 2, 3, and 4 will teleport you into the cabbage field south of the Falador Dwarven Mine entrance.
travel: The Mining Guild, located in and beneath Falador, is a guild for expert miners available to players with at least 60 Mining (can be boosted).
The mine is accessible from either the Mining Guild's above-ground complex in the south-east of the city, or through the gate at the southern end of the Dwarven Mine.

miscellania.name: Miscellania
miscellania.summary: Miscellania is an island kingdom in the Northern Ocean, north-west off the coast of the Fremennik Province. It was formed as a colony by Fremenniks who split off from the Fremennik people of the mainland due to cultural differences a long time ago, but has since become independent. It lies directly west of the island kingdom of Etceteria, accessible via a bridge link. The island kingdoms of Miscellania and Etceteria are the focus of two quests, Throne of Miscellania and Royal Trouble. Prior to the player intertwining themselves in the affairs of the two islands, currently ruled by King Vargas of Miscellania and Queen Sigrid of Etceteria respectively, the two kingdoms had been at war, despite neither side having an army. The islands are unique in that after the completion of Throne of Miscellania, the islands may be managed by the player, a recurring activity/reward called Managing Miscellania. This involves maintaining a favour level by performing favours for the island and giving gold to their coffers. In return, the citizens of Miscellania will passively gather certain types of resources for you. After completion of Royal Trouble, the citizens of Etceteria will also work for you, increasing productivity.
transportNotes: A boat off of the second most western dock in northern Rellekka sails to and from the dock on Miscellania. Using this boat requires the completion of the quest The Fremennik Trials.
There is a fairy ring (code Fairy ring CIP) to the north-west on Miscellania, which requires the completion of The Fremennik Trials in order to use.
After Throne of Miscellania, you can teleport to Miscellania using ring of wealth.
A spirit tree can be grown in the spirit tree patch on Etceteria, provided that the relevant quest and Farming level requirements have been met to grow and use it.
Docking at Etceteria, with 65 Sailing and the completion of Royal Trouble, and walking across the bridge to Miscellania
travel: Miscellania is an island kingdom in the Northern Ocean, north-west off the coast of the Fremennik Province.
It lies directly west of the island kingdom of Etceteria, accessible via a bridge link.

miscellania and etceteria dungeon.name: Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon
miscellania and etceteria dungeon.summary: The Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon is a cave system that runs underneath Miscellania and Etceteria. Both Miscellania and Etceteria have entrances to the dungeon. The Miscellania entrance is closest to the subterranean village, while the Etceteria entrance is closest to the sea snakes. The player cannot access the settlement until permitted to enter the dungeon during the quest Royal Trouble. The full cave system cannot be accessed until after the boss fight of the same quest, although the chamber the Giant Sea Snake is fought in becomes closed off after the fight. A Dwarf multicannon can be set up here to kill the sea snakes, but with reduced effectiveness due to the area being single-way combat.
travel: Both Miscellania and Etceteria have entrances to the dungeon.
The Miscellania entrance is closest to the subterranean village, while the Etceteria entrance is closest to the sea snakes.
caveats: Only the appropriate post-boss quest stage opens the full caves. The giant sea snake boss chamber closes after the fight.

mistrock.name: Mistrock
mistrock.summary: Mistrock is a dwarven settlement on the island of Aldarin, located in the region of Varlamore. Mistrock used to belong to the Moonrise Brewery and Winery, but it was given to the Cam Torum dwarves who moved there after humans had "one of your wars" as the land was not well suitable for growing grapes, and it presented a new business opportunity. As a result the settlement provides the winery with metals and ores at a reduced rate. Most of the residents of Mistrock strongly dislike humans and will express hostility to the player in dialogue, telling them to "go back where they came from". Overseer Khougo explains this is because they view humans as subjugating their kind and prospering at the expense of dwarves. Completing The Giant Dwarf and Perilous Moons will cause the Overseer to become slightly less hostile when the player explains the ways they have helped dwarves in the past. To the east of Mistrock, there is a small net fishing spot - fishing at it between 3:00 AM and 4:00 AM UTC will give the player one of the four nasty tokens.
transportNotes: There are no direct teleports to Mistrock, however it is easily accessed through differing teleports to Aldarin and running south:
Using the Quetzal Transport System to Aldarin.
Using the western ship from Sunset Coast. Requires paying Antonia 20 coins.
Casting Teleport to house if the player-owned house is in Aldarin; otherwise a Teleport to house tablet with a scroll of redirection (requiring 35 construction), or the Construction cape.
Using Fairy Ring Fairy ring CKQ.
North Aldarin teleport via the Pendant of Ates (Requires completion of Death on the Isle and subsequent activation of the North Aldarin statue).
travel: Mistrock is a dwarven settlement on the island of Aldarin, located in the region of Varlamore.
To the east of Mistrock, there is a small net fishing spot - fishing at it between 3:00 AM and 4:00 AM UTC will give the player one of the four nasty tokens.

molch.name: Molch
molch.summary: Molch is a small settlement found in the Kebos Swamp, a swamp in the Kebos Lowlands. It is inhabited by lizardmen. A lizardman shaman named Ek'ans Chan can be seen chanting. In addition, two enclosures containing unattackable swamp frogs can be found, suggesting the lizardmen use them as a source of food. A can be found here with an altar dedicated to Xeric. In addition, there are four entrances to the Lizardman Temple, containing six lizardman shamans in a single-way combat area. A quick way to travel to Molch is to use a Skills necklace to teleport to the Farming Guild and run south across the bridge and through the swamp. Another quick way is to use the fairy ring code Fairy ring DJR, running south-west and taking the Boaty directly to Molch.
travel: Molch is a small settlement found in the Kebos Swamp, a swamp in the Kebos Lowlands.
In addition, two enclosures containing unattackable swamp frogs can be found, suggesting the lizardmen use them as a source of food.

mons gratia.name: Mons Gratia
mons gratia.summary: Mons Gratia is a mountain located west of the Quetzacalli Gorge. It lies along the "Pilgrim Path," a sacred route in Losanium that involves walking from the Teomat to the Proudspire.
transportNotes: Transport routes to the mountain include:
Quetzal Transport System to Quetzacalli Gorge.
travel: Mons Gratia is a mountain located west of the Quetzacalli Gorge.

mor ul rek.name: Mor Ul Rek
mor ul rek.summary: Mor Ul Rek, also known as the TzHaar City, is a city located underneath the volcano on Karamja. It is inhabited by the TzHaar, a race of golem-like volcanic creatures. It is home to multiple combat-focused minigames, and uses the currency of Tokkul. Having a fire cape or fire max cape is required to enter the interior portion of the city. In the TzHaar language, the words mor, ul, and rek are translated as old/retired, circle/ring and young/youth respectively.
transportNotes: Cave entrance — from the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon
Minigame Teleport — to TzHaar Fight Pit
Achievement Diary Cape — to TzHaar-Mej
Ghommal's hilt — with at least Elite Combat Achievements completed
travel: Mor Ul Rek, also known as the TzHaar City, is a city located underneath the volcano on Karamja.

mort myre swamp.name: Mort Myre Swamp
mort myre swamp.summary: The Mort Myre Swamp, once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania. Players first unlock the gate to the swampland by starting Nature Spirit, but the swamp can also be accessed by Barrows or Mort'ton teleport scrolls. Much of the swamp is plagued by ghasts, which attack players and rot food, as well as a swamp decay effect, hitting the player periodically. Both can be avoided by building a Fire of Dehumidification after completion of Making Friends with My Arm.
travel: The Mort Myre Swamp, once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania.
Players first unlock the gate to the swampland by starting Nature Spirit, but the swamp can also be accessed by Barrows or Mort'ton teleport scrolls.

mort'ton.name: Mort'ton
mort'ton.summary: Mort'ton (, ) is a small, dilapidated town in the Mort Myre Swamp, inhabited by afflicted humans and ghostly shades. The town is known for the Shades of Mort'ton quest and the minigame of the same name. The Barrows burial mounds are found just to the east.
transportNotes: Several teleports bring players into or close to Mort'ton, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
— Shades of Mort'ton. Usable once every 20 minutes.
— Burgh de Rott, south of the town.
Fairy ring BIP — the island west of the Nature Grotto. Requires 50 Agility.
Fairy ring BKR — near the swamp boaty, a small boat that Cyreg will let players ride to the Hollows for .
travel: The Barrows burial mounds are found just to the east.

morytania spider cave.name: Morytania Spider Cave
morytania spider cave.summary: The Morytania Spider Cave is a cave found north-east of Darkmeyer. The cave is divided into three sections; the main cavern, a task-only cavern and Araxxor's cavern. The caves are full of araxytes that are capable of inflicting venom. The main part of the cave contains a mix of both level 96 and 146 araxytes, along with five tunnels leading to other sections of the cave. The tunnel closest to the hive leads to the beginning sequence for the Amulet of rancour (s). Three tunnels further down the cave lead to varying points in the task-only section, which itself has three chambers; one chamber to the north and south containing level 146 araxytes, and one in the middle containing level 96 araxytes. Another tunnel, not near the others, leads to Araxxor. The entire cave, apart from the north task-only cavern, is entirely multicombat. The cave is also visited during A Night at the Theatre quest by the player when they are tasked to obtain strange spider eggs. A skeleton, belonging to one of Daer Krand's unfortunate assistants, can be found and searched for a sticky note at the end of the cave during the quest.
transportNotes: The quickest methods of reaching the cave entrance are as follows:
Teleporting directly to the cave via use of a spider cave teleport
Teleporting to Hallowed Sepulchre using a hallowed crystal shard, then exiting and using the wall shortcut just south east. Requires 63 Agility and installing 2 long ropes.
Teleporting via ectophial or fairy ring code Fairy ring ALQ, then running south past the small bridge. Ectophial can be used for convenient banking at Port Phasmatys as well.
travel: The Morytania Spider Cave is a cave found north-east of Darkmeyer.

Three tunnels further down the cave lead to varying points in the task-only section, which itself has three chambers; one chamber to the north and south containing level 146 araxytes, and one in the middle containing level 96 araxytes.

mos le'harmless.name: Mos Le'Harmless
mos le'harmless.summary: Mos Le'Harmless (pronounced MOH-s lee-HARM-less) is the quaint, pirate-run free port that can be visited after completion of the Cabin Fever quest. The island has a few attractions, such as the Trouble Brewing minigame and the Mos Le'Harmless Cave, where cave horrors are found. Players must be carrying the Book o' Piracy in their inventory to understand what the inhabitants are saying and interact with them. Otherwise, the pirates and shopkeepers will respond with a fixed script of incomprehensible pirate slang. The book, however, is not necessary to use the bank on the island.
transportNotes: You must complete Cabin Fever to access the island.
Talk to Bill Teach on the eastern boat in Port Phasmatys. (Fastest way there is the ectophial.)
Use the Minigame Teleport to Trouble Brewing (requires completion of the quest and 40 Cooking).
Teleport to Harmony Island and talk to Brother Tranquility.
Mos le'harmless teleport scrolls (brings you to the north gate).
Charter ship (can be used once the quest is complete).
Red or blue rum to teleport to Trouble Brewing (costs 20 pieces of eight each).
travel: The island has a few attractions, such as the Trouble Brewing minigame and the Mos Le'Harmless Cave, where cave horrors are found.

mos le'harmless cave.name: Mos Le'Harmless Cave
mos le'harmless cave.summary: The Mos Le'Harmless Cave, also called the "Cave of Horrors", is found on Mos Le'Harmless, which players can reach only after completing the Cabin Fever quest. The cave is the only place where Cave horrors and Albino bats are found. The primary entrance is found on the beach on south side of the island (). Alternatively, players with Level 82 Agility can enter the cave using the entrance on the small island north of Trouble Brewing. A light source is required in the cave unless the player has lit a Fire of Eternal Light near the entrance. In the north-east, two staircases ascend to small islands with teak and mahogany trees and seaweed spawns. The Dwarf multicannon can be used in the cave.
transportNotes: The cave can be reached through a few methods:
Teleporting to Trouble Brewing using the Trouble Brewing Minigame Teleport or rum and running southwest (or north over the northern stepping stone with 82 Agility Agility).

Travelling to Mos Le'Harmless' main settlement, running north through the northern entrance, then south-east through the forest. Players with 60 Agility Agility can instead use the stepping stone shortcut on the settlement's east side to cross the estuary.
The settlement can be reached by using Mos Le'Harmless teleport scrolls, taking a charter ship, speaking to Bill Teach in Port Phasmatys, or speaking to Brother Tranquility on Harmony Island.
travel: The Mos Le'Harmless Cave, also called the "Cave of Horrors", is found on Mos Le'Harmless, which players can reach only after completing the Cabin Fever quest.
The cave is the only place where Cave horrors and Albino bats are found.

moss giant island.name: Moss Giant Island
moss giant island.summary: Moss Giant Island is a small island located west of Brimhaven, accessed by using a rope swing (Rope not needed) requiring 10 Agility. There are five moss giants on the island. Players can use safespots when fighting them. There are two slice of cake spawns, which have a respawn time of 45 seconds. Players with 40+ Defence do not need to bring much food because of this resource. Lower-level players should, however, be cautious of the Poison Scorpions near the island. The island is also a medium clue scroll step location.
transportNotes: Brimhaven teleport or Teleport to house (if your house is in Brimhaven) and run west.
Brimhaven spirit tree and run west.
Fairy ring Fairy ring BJR, then blowing the magic whistle obtained during the Holy Grail quest.
Ardougne teleport, run south-east to Captain Barnaby, travel to Brimhaven for 30 coins, run west.
travel: Moss Giant Island is a small island located west of Brimhaven, accessed by using a rope swing (Rope not needed) requiring 10 Agility.

mount karuulm.name: Mount Karuulm
mount karuulm.summary: Mount Karuulm is a volcano found in the northern edge of the Kebos Lowlands. It is inhabited by the Kahlith, servants of the Tasakaal, a trio of ancient TzHaar that had left the Karamja Volcano long ago. This volcano is unique in that it is sulphurous, giving the lava a bluish appearance due to the combination of sulphuric gases and lava, and is the only known sulphurous volcano in Gielinor.
transportNotes: Mount Karuulm can be reached by various methods:
Directly teleporting to the volcano's summit via use of Rada's blessing 3 or 4.
Rada's blessing 3 is limited to 3 teleports per day, resetting at 00:00 UTC, while Rada's blessing 4 provides unlimited teleports
Using the fairy ring (code Fairy ring CIR) and travelling up the volcano
Casting Battlefront Teleport or using its magic tablet variant, and running north-west
The skills necklace or Farming cape provide teleports to the nearby Farming Guild just south-west.
The mountain itself can be climbed with 2 agility shortcuts, taking you halfway, then to the top of the mountain. (Agility levels 29 and 62 respectively.)
travel: Mount Karuulm is a volcano found in the northern edge of the Kebos Lowlands.

mount quidamortem.name: Mount Quidamortem
mount quidamortem.summary: Mount Quidamortem ( ) is a mountain in the Kebos Lowlands. Underneath Mount Quidamortem are the Chambers of Xeric, which serves as the staging ground for raids, as well as the Quidamortem Cave, which is visited during the Tale of the Righteous quest.
transportNotes: Players who haven't unlocked fairy rings will have to travel to the mountain on foot. Players can walk south-west past Shayziens' Wall and run westward until they reach the mountain. A form of poison protection should be taken as there are aggressive Lizardmen of all types patrolling the east side of the mountain. Just before the mountain base, there should be some big frogs and goblins wandering the area. At the base of the mountain will be some mountain troll settlements and a large group of rock crabs.

When players reach the summit, find the Mountain Guide and speak with him to unlock a travel point between the mountain, the Wall, and south of Mount Quidamortem. This will save a considerable amount of time should players enter from Shayzien. Players who have unlocked fairy rings can also use Fairy ring BLS south of Quidamortem, and then utilise the Mountain Guide to travel to the mountain.
It can also be quickly accessed via the Lovakengj Minecart Network, and then running north.

Once players receive an ancient tablet as a reward from the Chambers of Xeric, they are able to use it on Xeric's talisman to unlock the ability to instantly teleport to the mountain with the "Xeric's Honour" option.
travel: Mount Quidamortem ( ) is a mountain in the Kebos Lowlands.

mourner tunnels.name: Mourner Tunnels
mourner tunnels.summary: The Mourner Tunnels are located outside the basement of the Mourner Headquarters in the north-eastern part of West Ardougne. During Mourning's End Part II, the Head Mourner gives the player the new key, which can be used to enter the tunnels from the basement. Note that if the player is not wearing full mourner gear, the mourners in the basement will be aggressive. After the completion of Mourning's End Part II, the slayer ring can be used to teleport directly into the tunnels, skipping the need to wear mourner gear or have the new key. After the completion of Song of the Elves, the mourners in the basement leave, and neither the key nor the mourner gear are required to use the basement door.
travel: The Mourner Tunnels are located outside the basement of the Mourner Headquarters in the north-eastern part of West Ardougne.

mudskipper point.name: Mudskipper Point
mudskipper point.summary: Mudskipper Point is a small peninsula located in the south of the Kingdom of Asgarnia. It can be reached by journeying south past the coastal town of Port Sarim. After passing by the Rimmington Church, players will come to a small hut belonging to Thurgo, an Imcando dwarf. His hut contains an anvil, for smithing weapons, a hammock, a table and a chair. He plays a part in various quests and sells the Skillcape of Smithing. Next to him is a small hill with a trapdoor leading into the dangerous Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. If you continue south you will come to a small peninsula with a signpost reading: On a members' world, Mudskipper Point is known for its dangerous underwater inhabitants as both mudskippers (hence the name) and mogres dwell in this seemingly quiet place. The latter can be summoned by throwing fishing explosive into ominous fishing spots, which will drive an enraged mogre to the shore, who will engage in battle. These creatures have affected a drunken man named Skippy, who stands south-east of Rimmington tossing rather empty bottles of "Captain Braindeath's Extra Strength Rum/Drain Cleaner" into the sea, yelling at the mudskippers. You can start the Skippy and the Mogres miniquest by speaking with him. The most prominent use for the location, however, is the fairy ring with code Fairy ring AIQ located there. Notable in that it is the only fairy ring in Asgarnia. There are two fishing spots for anchovies on west side of Mudskipper point. On the east side, there is a b
travel: Mudskipper Point is a small peninsula located in the south of the Kingdom of Asgarnia.
It can be reached by journeying south past the coastal town of Port Sarim.

mushroom forest.name: Mushroom Forest
mushroom forest.summary: Mushroom Forest is a location on Fossil Island. It is home to a very large variety of fungi, particularly mushrooms. This area is notorious for causing frame rate drops for players with low-performance devices, due to the large amount of mushrooms on-screen at any given time. Players can consider zooming in their camera to reduce the number of visible mushrooms.
transportNotes: From the Museum Camp, run north-west to reach the Mushroom Forest.

If players have unlocked the magic mushtree in the Forest, they can teleport to it via other magic mushtrees. Using a digsite pendant to teleport to the House on the Hill and using the magic mushtree there is a quick way to reach the Forest.
If players have used the rowboat in the north-east corner of the Forest, they can row the boat from the Museum Camp to get there.
travel: Mushroom Forest is a location on Fossil Island.

mynydd.name: Mynydd
mynydd.summary: Mynydd is a lone mountain located just north-west of Prifddinas. It is dotted with dead trees, and towers over the small village of Gwenith. It is also the only mountain in Tirannwn aside from the Arandar mountain pass. In order to reach the mountain, players must travel to its base in the south-west. There is no other way to ascend the mountain. The book Legends of the Mountain provides the player with three local folktales about Mynydd.
travel: Mynydd is a lone mountain located just north-west of Prifddinas.
In order to reach the mountain, players must travel to its base in the south-west.

myreque hideout.name: Myreque Hideout
myreque hideout.summary: The Myreque Hideouts are the safe-havens of the resistance force of the Myreque, with each of them located in Morytania. They feature primarily in the Myreque quest chain, in which multiple different hideouts are used by the Myreque.
travel: The Myreque Hideouts are the safe-havens of the resistance force of the Myreque, with each of them located in Morytania.

nardah.name: Nardah
nardah.summary: Nardah is a town in the far south of the Kharidian Desert. In the quest Spirits of the Elid, players work to save the town from drought. After the quest, the town is popular for Ironmen training Herblore, and players recharging their stats at its statue. The bank is unofficially regarded as the Herblore Guild.
transportNotes: Several transport options bring players into or close to Nardah, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
— Temple of Elidinis. Amulets 2 and 3 offer one teleport daily; amulet 4 offers unlimited teleports.
Fairy ring DLQ — north of Nardah, near the desert lizards.
— Jaleustrophos (Simon Templeton's camp).
The magic carpet system can be also used to travel to Nardah from south Pollnivneach.
travel: Nardah is a town in the far south of the Kharidian Desert.

necropolis.name: Necropolis
necropolis.summary: The Necropolis is an area on the south-eastern coast of the Kharidian Desert. It is the location of the Jaltevas Pyramid, otherwise known as the Tombs of Amascut, which is in actuality the ancient tomb of Osmumten, the last Chosen of Tumeken. Entering the Necropolis requires partial completion of Beneath Cursed Sands.
transportNotes: Fairy ring AKP — an island just off the coast, by the mine. Requires 62 Agility to cross.
— Jaltevas, the Tombs of Amascut lobby. To unlock this teleport, players must first commune with the obelisk just north of the mine while having a pharaoh's sceptre in the inventory.
— Nardah town centre, a long run north of the area.
— Temple of Elidinis in Nardah. Amulets 2 and 3 offer one teleport daily; amulet 4 offers unlimited teleports.
travel: The Necropolis is an area on the south-eastern coast of the Kharidian Desert.

neypotzli.name: Neypotzli
neypotzli.summary: Neypotzli is a prison beneath Cam Torum that seals three powerful nagua known as the Moons of Peril, and the shaman that summoned them. Created by the Old Ones, the prison was sealed with water and earth runic energies, with Eyatlalli, a nagua of earth and stream, being summoned to watch over the prison and reinforce the seals as needed. The prison remained hidden for thousands of years until an earthquake caused a cave-in that revealed them; though the Imcando dwarves of Cam Torum initially attempted to cover it up, news eventually spread of its discovery. Civitas illa Fortis, who wished to set up an archaeological dig in the newly-discovered ruins, attempted to make a deal with Cam Torum for access, involving expensive export deals and exclusive imports from the mainland kingdoms. After weeks of negotiations, the deal finally went through, allowing the Grand Museum to send Jessamine to lead the dig. Accessing Neypotzli requires having gained access during the Perilous Moons quest, which acts as an introduction to the prison and the bosses. The area is not multi combat, but a dwarven cannon can be set up for Slayer tasks within the caverns.
transportNotes: The entrance to Neypotzli is accessed from the northernmost end of Cam Torum, which can be reached in the following ways:
Teleporting with a calcified moth.
Taking the Quetzal Transport System to the entrance of Cam Torum, then running all the way north once inside. Requires having built the landing site there.
Taking the Quetzal Transport System to the Teomat, and then running around the west side of the mountain.
Players with level 47 Agility may run south-east to the agility shortcut, then crossing the bridge west to the city entrance.
travel: Civitas illa Fortis, who wished to set up an archaeological dig in the newly-discovered ruins, attempted to make a deal with Cam Torum for access, involving expensive export deals and exclusive imports from the mainland kingdoms.
Accessing Neypotzli requires having gained access during the Perilous Moons quest, which acts as an introduction to the prison and the bosses.

nightmare zone.name: Nightmare Zone
nightmare zone.summary: The Nightmare Zone is a combat-based minigame located north-west of Yanille bank. Players enter a "dream" to take on bosses they have previously defeated during completed quests. It is run by Dominic Onion, a mage from Lunar Isle. The dreams that make up this minigame take place in an instance of the King Black Dragon Lair.
transportNotes: Teleport using Minigame Teleport, either through any spellbook or the Grouping interface, by selecting Nightmare Zone. (Only usable when the requirements for Nightmare Zone are met)
Casting Watchtower Teleport or using a Watchtower teleport tablet and running east. Both require completion of Watchtower quest to use.
Casting Teleport to House or using a Teleport to house tablet if your player-owned house is in Yanille, or using a scroll of redirection on a Teleport to house tablet to make a Yanille teleport.
Using fairy ring code Fairy ring CLS and walking north-west or code Fairy ring CIQ and walking through Yanille.
Using a ring of dueling to teleport to Castle Wars, then walking to Yanille.
Using the Spirit tree to teleport to Tree Gnome Village and walking from there.
Using the Ardougne cloak 1 to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery and walking south.
Teleport using Minigame Teleport, either through any spellbook or the Grouping interface, by selecting Fishing Trawler and walking south-west.
travel: The Nightmare Zone is a combat-based minigame located north-west of Yanille bank.

north brimhaven mine.name: North Brimhaven mine
north brimhaven mine.summary: The North Brimhaven mine (also known as the horseshoe mine or Karamja north-western mine) is located on the peninsula north-west of Brimhaven. The mine has ten gold rocks from which players may mine gold ore as well as a single gold ore spawn. The mine is in a members-only area, and there are several Poison Scorpions in the area that will be aggressive to players who aren't combat level 41 or higher). Players may get to this area quickly from the Fisher Realm by blowing a magic whistle and then walking a few steps south. If the Shilo Village quest is finished, this is the best place on Karamja to mine gold. (You will need money for the cart fare to quickly access the Shilo Village bank.) Mine a full load, run to Brimhaven, use the cart system to Shilo Village, deposit the gold ore, and return to the mine. Alternatively, players can use an amulet of glory to travel to Edgeville, bank there, and use the Fairy ring to access the Fisher Realm and run south to the mine. Yet, another alternative could be to use the amulet of glory to Edgeville or the Ring of dueling to Castle Wars to bank, then use a House teleport if your house is in Karamja to run a bit north to the gold mine. Players may also bank by returning to the Fisher Realm by running back between the four posts to the north of the mine and blowing the whistle. Then use the fairy ring in the Fisher Realm to bank in Zanaris and return again via the same route. Alternatively, the South Brimhaven mine has 6 gold rocks, but it
travel: The North Brimhaven mine (also known as the horseshoe mine or Karamja north-western mine) is located on the peninsula north-west of Brimhaven.
Players may get to this area quickly from the Fisher Realm by blowing a magic whistle and then walking a few steps south.

observatory.name: Observatory
observatory.summary: The Observatory is a complex mostly used during the Observatory Quest. It consists of four parts. The area was overrun by goblins, who have damaged the telescope, and players must fix it during the quest. The original bridge to the Observatory has been destroyed, so you must go underground at the ruined buildings and through the Observatory Dungeon to get to it. Alternatively, players who have completed the Observatory Quest can use the grapple shortcut with 23 Agility, 24 Ranged, and 28 Strength. It should be noted that players who use this shortcut forfeit their mith grapple, but in doing so create a permanent shortcut.
transportNotes: Ring of dueling teleport to Castle Wars and go north
To get to the Observatory itself, the player has to either go through the Observatory Dungeon, or use the shortcut.
travel: The original bridge to the Observatory has been destroyed, so you must go underground at the ruined buildings and through the Observatory Dungeon to get to it.

observatory dungeon.name: Observatory Dungeon
observatory dungeon.summary: The Observatory Dungeon leads from the Goblin settlement found north-east of the Observatory, to the Observatory. The dungeon is a giant maze, infested with low-levelled goblins and a few high-levelled goblin guards.
transportNotes: Ring of dueling or minigame teleport to Castle Wars, then run north.
Ourania Teleport, then run south.
travel: The Observatory Dungeon leads from the Goblin settlement found north-east of the Observatory, to the Observatory.

ogre enclave.name: Ogre Enclave
ogre enclave.summary: The Ogre Enclave, located south-west of Yanille and accessed via the cave in the market of Gu'Tanoth, is one of several locations containing Blue dragons, and is visited during the Watchtower Quest. In the centre of the cave is the Rock of Dalgroth, which you can mine during the Watchtower Quest for the grey crystal. While blue dragons and greater demons are present in the cave, they are rarely killed for Slayer purposes, as the dungeon is extremely far from a bank and other locations are more easily accessible. A dwarf multicannon may be used here, but it is not a multi-combat area.
transportNotes: If returning to this cave after completing the Watchtower Quest, you will not need any cave nightshade, as you can just sneak past the Enclave guards without it. Also, you do not need a light source when entering the cave unlike the other Skavid caves nearby. To leave the cave, there is an exit in the centre of the north wall. It will take you to the north cave near the pathway to Gu'Tanoth.

Teleport to your house in Yanille (requires 50 Construction) and run west, then south to the entrance of Gu'Tanoth. Alternatively, if you have 39 Agility, 38 Strength and 21 Ranged, you can use a Mith grapple on the wall in south-west Yanille to take you right to the entrance of the city. With 69 Agility, this shortcut can be used without a grapple and without Strength or Ranged level requirement.
Teleport to Castle Wars using a ring of dueling and run south over the bridge and then east to the entrance.

If you have completed the Watchtower Quest, teleport to the Watchtower using the spell, run east and use the shortcut requiring level 16 Agility to get inside Yanille. Run south and use the grapple shortcut if you are able to.
Use the Minigame interface to teleport to the Nightmare Zone and then run west through Yanille or over the south-east corner of the city to get to the entrance.

There are two fairy rings fairly close to the entrance. The one north-west of Yanille Fairy ring CIQ and running south, or the one in Feldip Hills Fairy ring AKS and running north (beware of Ogres and wolves).
If you have completed One Small Favour, you can use a gnome glider in the Feldip Hills and run north to the entrance.
travel: The Ogre Enclave, located south-west of Yanille and accessed via the cave in the market of Gu'Tanoth, is one of several locations containing Blue dragons, and is visited during the Watchtower Quest.
