While blue dragons and greater demons are present in the cave, they are rarely killed for Slayer purposes, as the dungeon is extremely far from a bank and other locations are more easily accessible.

ortus farm.name: Ortus Farm
ortus farm.summary: The Ortus Farm is a farm to the west of Civitas illa Fortis. The farm has chickens, buffalos, and alpacas. Part of the Fortis Aqueduct also transports freshwater from Ralos' Rise to it.
travel: The Ortus Farm is a farm to the west of Civitas illa Fortis.

outer fortis.name: Outer Fortis
outer fortis.summary: Outer Fortis is a part of Civitas illa Fortis found outside the main walls. The local population, mostly being farmers, use the area to grow crops to support the city's population.
travel: Outer Fortis is a part of Civitas illa Fortis found outside the main walls.

outpost.name: Outpost
outpost.summary: The Outpost is an old, now-derelict tower to the north of West Ardougne where Jorral can be found, and is involved heavily in the Making History quest, which centres around the tower. The Outpost, though now disused, played a very important role in the history of Kandarin and the Ardignas line of royalty.
transportNotes: The Outpost lies just off the north-west corner of West Ardougne, and can be reached in a variety of ways.
Note: Many of the fast transport methods require the start or completion of various quests before they can be used.
Tree Gnome Stronghold locations:
Stronghold Slayer Cave teleport on the Slayer ring
Games necklace to Barbarian Outpost, take the level 37 Agility shortcut
Teleports to the Ardougne area. From East Ardougne, players must walk north-west to exit the city and then west to the Outpost.
Spirit tree to the Battlefield of Khazard.
Eagle transport system to Eagles' Peak, then climbing down the eastern side of the mountain.
travel: The Outpost is an old, now-derelict tower to the north of West Ardougne where Jorral can be found, and is involved heavily in the Making History quest, which centres around the tower.

pandemonium cave.name: Pandemonium Cave
pandemonium cave.summary: The Pandemonium Cave is located on the north end of The Pandemonium. It is a small cave populated by rats, giant rats, spiders, giant spiders, and deadly red spiders. There are ores close to the bank chest outside, namely eight lead rocks important for Sailing upgrades, and also three tin rocks, three copper rocks, and five iron rocks (including a power-mining location). There are also two spawns of bones, three spawns of red spiders' eggs, one rope spawn, and one bronze mace spawn in the cave, along with a permanent fire. Chartin' Charles McAtless can be found just past the entrance. He is the target of a spyglass Sea charting task. Near the mining area of the cave is a locked chest, which can be opened with the Stormy key from a barracuda trial and contains the Storm cruiser's outfit. Just outside the cave entrance is a sea charting task location, and a key for a buried schematic.
travel: The Pandemonium Cave is located on the north end of The Pandemonium.
Chartin' Charles McAtless can be found just past the entrance.

pirates' cove.name: Pirates' Cove
pirates' cove.summary: The Pirates' Cove is a small island located in the Northern Ocean north of the Fremennik Province. It is the current docking place of the Lady Zay, a massive pirate vessel known for its unlawful activity in the region. The player is first taken to the island by the Fremennik pirate Lokar Searunner during the Lunar Diplomacy quest, and may visit it again at any point afterwards by speaking to Lokar at the port in Rellekka. The island is totally uninhabited except for some moss giants. A number of pirates can also be found wandering the island, although they are presumably crewmen aboard the Lady Zay and not permanent residents. Although the Lady Zay's crew typically appear to remain onboard their ship whenever possible, evidence of their activity on the island is obvious; supply crates, basic fences, flags, and other materials can be found dotted around the area, and a number of skeletal corpses can be found hanging from poles on the island's peak.
transportNotes: The Pirates' Cove can be accessed only by boat. Players may reach the island either by speaking to Lokar Searunner in Rellekka, provided they have completed the The Fremennik Trials quest (must start Lunar Diplomacy in order for Lokar Searunner to speak to you), or by talking to Captain Bentley on Lunar Isle, provided they have reached a certain point in Lunar Diplomacy. There is no fee either way. With 76 Sailing, a rowboat may be built at the Buccaneers' Haven to access this island, though it requires partial completion of Lunar Diplomacy to use.

There are no teleportation methods through which a player can immediately reach the island; however, players may reach the Lady Zay's port of call on Lunar Isle more quickly by using the Lunar Home Teleport or the Moonclan Teleport found in the Lunar spellbook, which is a reward for the Lunar Diplomacy quest. Players can also access Rellekka more quickly through a variety of means, including the enchanted lyre or teleport to house spell (provided their player-owned house is in Rellekka).
travel: The Pirates' Cove is a small island located in the Northern Ocean north of the Fremennik Province.

The player is first taken to the island by the Fremennik pirate Lokar Searunner during the Lunar Diplomacy quest, and may visit it again at any point afterwards by speaking to Lokar at the port in Rellekka.

pirates' hideout.name: Pirates' Hideout
pirates' hideout.summary: The Pirates' Hideout is a single-way combat building located in deep Wilderness. A lockpick and 39 Thieving are required to pick the door lock and gain entry. The hideout features aggressive pirates, as well as four Thieving chests that have to be searched for traps before the player can loot them. There is also a half of a redberry pie spawn in the hideout.
transportNotes: Pull the lever in either Ardougne or Edgeville to teleport to the Deserted Keep. Run north and slash the web, then run west.
Ice Plateau Teleport or Ghorrock Teleport to the Frozen Waste Plateau, and then run east.
travel: The Pirates' Hideout is a single-way combat building located in deep Wilderness.

piscatoris fishing colony.name: Piscatoris Fishing Colony
piscatoris fishing colony.summary: The Piscatoris Fishing Colony is a settlement in the northern-most part of Piscatoris. Despite Piscatoris referring to the larger area, the settlement is often just called Piscatoris instead. Swan Song must be partially completed in order to enter the colony, though the area will be instanced until the quest is completed.
transportNotes: The Piscatoris Fishing colony can be reached through several teleportation methods, listed here in order of shortest run to longest:
Fairy ring AKQ — Hunter area, shortly south of the entrance.
— Outpost, well south of Kathy.
Kathy Corkat, outside of the west fence of the Tree Gnome Stronghold, will ferry players up the river for 50 coins, or for free after completion of Swan Song.
Players can also moor a boat on the north-western side of the colony, with 75 Sailing and full completion of Swan Song.
travel: The Piscatoris Fishing Colony is a settlement in the northern-most part of Piscatoris.
caveats: During the quest the colony is instanced. Completed Swan Song proves the ordinary repeatable colony.

stronghold of security.name: Stronghold of Security
stronghold of security.summary: The Stronghold of Security is a dungeon, found at the heart of the Barbarian Village mine, west of Varrock. The dungeon contains four maze-like floors, filled with monsters of increasing level with each descent. The dungeon exists as a way to help players understand how to better protect their account from would-be scammers. This is done by having each room, on every floor, separated by two sets of doors, with the second occasionally asking new visitors security questions. To pass through, they must be answered correctly. In return for a player's efforts, they may choose to receive a few rewards at the ends of each floor. Before being allowed to claim rewards, a player must have two-factor authentication enabled. This is enabled through having a Jagex Account, the older RuneScape Authenticator, or through having Steam Guard if playing on the Steam Client. Be aware, monsters in the Catacomb of Famine and below are aggressive. Players with poor defences should bring healing supplies, and proceed with caution and haste. A cannon can be placed in the stronghold.
travel: The Stronghold of Security is a dungeon, found at the heart of the Barbarian Village mine, west of Varrock.

poison waste dungeon.name: Poison Waste Dungeon
poison waste dungeon.summary: The Poison Waste Dungeon makes up the immense sewerage of the legendary and malevolent gnome city Arposandra. The experiments of Glouphrie the Untrusted, which involved the warping of tortoises and terrorbirds to intelligent creatures, have led to large amounts of toxic waste. This waste is disposed of through the sewers and pumped into Tirannwn. The degree of this was so bad that it defiled the area south of Isafdar, and is now known as the Poison Waste. At the end of the sewers is a door to the basement of Arposandra, although it is guarded by two guards. These have access to an emergency button that, when pressed, releases tar and toxic gas to kill off any intruders. A dwarf multicannon can be used in the dungeon.
transportNotes: Partial completion of The Path of Glouphrie is required to access the dungeon. The dungeon is in a canyon east of the Poison Waste. It is technically in Tirannwn, but you cannot reach it by passing through the main parts of Tirannwn, Arandar and Isafdar. The dungeon can be accessed by taking a spirit tree to the Poison Waste or by using a crossbow and mithril grapple to cross the river. The grapple location can be accessed by the fairy ring Fairy ring BKP (partial completion of the Fairytale II - Cure a Queen quest is required), or by walking from Castle Wars.
The entrance to the dungeon is west of the spirit tree, along the edge of the poison waste.
travel: The degree of this was so bad that it defiled the area south of Isafdar, and is now known as the Poison Waste.
These have access to an emergency button that, when pressed, releases tar and toxic gas to kill off any intruders.

pollnivneach.name: Pollnivneach
pollnivneach.summary: Pollnivneach ( ) is a town located in the middle of the Kharidian Desert, wherein the desert heat does not affect the player. It is notable for featuring heavily in The Feud quest, and for its citizens, most of whom go by the alias "Ali" until completion of The Feud. The Menaphite and Bandit gangs are the source of the conflict which engulfs Pollnivneach. The Bandits control the northern half of the town, while the Menaphites control the southern half. Both gangs are constantly engaging in a turf war, and hold much influence and power over the entire town, including the mayor.
transportNotes: Use the Fairy rings teleport (Fairy ring BIQ) to just south-west of the Shantay Pass. From there, travel south-east to reach Pollnivneach.

Aside from walking to Pollnivneach and facing the harsh effects of the desert, players may use Ali Morrisane's magic carpet system from the north or south of town. Each route starts at 200 coins per trip:
Shantay Pass to Pollnivneach or back
To Sophanem and Menaphos or from

If a player's house portal is in Pollnivneach, they may use the house teleport spell to reach the portal, thus bringing them to Pollnivneach. The POH Portals option on the Max cape can also teleport the player to the Pollnivneach house portal.
Similarly, a scroll of redirection on a teleport to house tablet allows the player to teleport to the House Portal, requiring level 20 Construction.
travel: Pollnivneach ( ) is a town located in the middle of the Kharidian Desert, wherein the desert heat does not affect the player.
The Bandits control the northern half of the town, while the Menaphites control the southern half.

port phasmatys.name: Port Phasmatys
port phasmatys.summary: Port Phasmatys ( ) is a small town located on the north-eastern coast of Morytania. Once a coastal hub, the town was decimated by vampyres and is now populated by ghosts, making a ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 necessary to talk to the majority of the inhabitants. Entry to the town through the energy barriers requires two ecto-tokens unless Ghosts Ahoy has been completed. Alternatively, a charter ship can be used to bypass the ecto-token requirement.
transportNotes: Several transport options bring players into or close to Port Phasmatys, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
— Ectofuntus, just north of town.
Fairy ring ALQ — Haunted Woods, west of the town.
— Ver Sinhaza, a short run south of Andras' boat.
— Fenkenstrain's Castle entrance, far west of the town.
— Salve Graveyard, very far west of the town.
travel: Port Phasmatys ( ) is a small town located on the north-eastern coast of Morytania.
Once a coastal hub, the town was decimated by vampyres and is now populated by ghosts, making a ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 necessary to talk to the majority of the inhabitants.

port piscarilius.name: Port Piscarilius
port piscarilius.summary: Port Piscarilius is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend. Led by Lady Shauna Piscarilius of the Piscarilius House, the city is a port primarily inhabited by fishermen who rely on the fishing industry for their source of income, in addition to overseas trade. All visitors from the mainland often come through here or Land's End. The port is known for its high crime rate, with newcomers to the kingdom warning other new arrivals of the thieves that run rampant in Port Piscarilius. This is due to the political corruption within the Piscarilius authorities, allowing thieves and smugglers such as Captain Khaled to steal artefacts from houses in the residential district through bribery, and shipping the stolen goods overseas. It can be accessed by travelling by boat by talking to Veos in Port Sarim.
transportNotes: There are several methods to quickly reach Port Piscarilius:
Veos or Cabin Boy Herbert - ship from Port Sarim or Land's End, then run west and north.
Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead - The Fisher's Flute teleport (requires completion of The Queen of Thieves).
Lovakengj Minecart Network - Travel to the Port Piscarilius station (20 coins per ride, or completion of The Forsaken Tower).
Kourend Castle Teleport or Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Heart - Run east past Kingstown, then north along the coast.

The fairy ring code Fairy ring AKR to Hosidius near the Tithe Farm minigame, then run north. A faster alternative is to run south instead and take the Lovakengj Minecart Network cart to Port Piscarillius for 20 coins, located just south of Tithe Farm.
Tithe Farm Minigame Teleport, then run north. Must have entered the minigame at least once before, which requires Lvl 34 Farming.
travel: It can be accessed by travelling by boat by talking to Veos in Port Sarim.

port roberts.name: Port Roberts
port roberts.summary: Port Roberts is a floating platform found in the Western Ocean, which is under the jurisdiction of Great Kourend. Level 50 Sailing is required to dock at and Charter to Port Roberts.
transportNotes: There are several methods to quickly reach Port Roberts:
Sailors' amulet - Requires interacting with the Sailors' marker in the eastern side of Port Roberts
Docking at the western side of the port by Sailing with a boat
Take a Charter ship to Port Roberts (requires an initial visit via other method to unlock).
travel: Port Roberts is a floating platform found in the Western Ocean, which is under the jurisdiction of Great Kourend.

port sarim.name: Port Sarim
port sarim.summary: Port Sarim is a small port in south-eastern Asgarnia. The port connects to a number of other ports, including Entrana, Karamja, Crandor, Great Kourend, Corsair Cove, and the Void Knights' Outpost, as well as even more destinations via charter ship.
transportNotes: Several transport options bring players into or close to Port Sarim, listed here with their arrival destination.
— Rat Pits or Void Knights' Outpost. Usable once every 20 minutes.
— Void Knights' Outpost, where the squire can take players to Port Sarim for free.
— the farm just north of the pub.
— Draynor Village, east of the port.
— Draynor Manor, north-east of the port.
— Air Altar entrance, north of the port.
— Rimmington house portal. Requires a POH in Rimmington.
travel: Port Sarim is a small port in south-eastern Asgarnia.

port sarim jail.name: Port Sarim jail
port sarim jail.summary: The Port Sarim jail is a top security prison located in Port Sarim, commonly referred to as the worst jail in Gielinor. Players can get sent to the jail by Shantay should they declare themselves an outlaw and refuse to pay his fine of five coins twice, although they can escape quite easily by picking the lock on the door or teleporting out. Picking the lock to get out awards 4 Thieving experience on members' worlds, while not providing any experience on free-to-play worlds.
travel: The Port Sarim jail is a top security prison located in Port Sarim, commonly referred to as the worst jail in Gielinor.

prifddinas.name: Prifddinas
prifddinas.summary: Prifddinas ( ) is the city of the elves and the capital city of Tirannwn. Located just north of Isafdar, the city is the oldest surviving settlement on Gielinor, being created in the First Age. In order to enter the city, the quest Song of the Elves must be completed. While outside Prifddinas, it will appear as if there's nothing there when looking from outside the city walls. This is revealed by Baxtorian to be one of the security measures put in place during the God Wars.
transportNotes: All methods of entering the city require completion of Song of the Elves:
Teleport crystal or eternal teleport crystal to get to the centre of Prifddinas, south of the Tower of Voices
Breaking a Prifddinas teleport tablet made by using a scroll of redirection on a teleport to house tablet
Casting Teleport to House or breaking an unredirected teleport to house tablet if your player-owned house is located in Prifddinas
Construction cape Teleport option, choosing Prifddinas
Respawn Teleport, ring of returning, ring of life, Defence cape, or death if your spawn point is located in Prifddinas
Spirit tree close to the northern bank
At 70 Sailing, docking at the mooring point west of the city (requires an adamant keel or better to traverse the crystal-flecked waters)
travel: Located just north of Isafdar, the city is the oldest surviving settlement on Gielinor, being created in the First Age.

ralos' rise.name: Ralos' Rise
ralos' rise.summary: Ralos' Rise is a mountain found west of Civitas illa Fortis in Varlamore. At the summit is the Teomat, home to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. The mountain is considered a holy site, as it is said that the mountain was where Ralos made his first and only appearance. The summit also houses a step pyramid with an exposed altar, a place where players can bless bones and jugs of wines for Prayer training at the libation bowl. At the southern face of the mountain lies the entrance to Cam Torum, the last bastion of the Imcando dwarves. The city, along with Neypotzli, a prison built by the Old Ones, are accessed as part of the Perilous Moons quest. Lastly, the mountain also has an outflow spring that leads to the Fortis Aqueduct, serving as the source of freshwater for Civitas illa Fortis.
transportNotes: Pendant of Ates to Ralos' Rise (With the statue of ates unlocked at this location.)
Quetzal Transport System to the Teomat. The Quetzal Transport System can be accessed in several ways:
Ring of dueling to Fortis Colosseum and run west (this requires Hero status in the Colosseum)
Hunter cape to Hunter Guild and run west
Civitas illa Fortis Teleport and run north-east
Civitas illa Fortis Teleport and run west
travel: Ralos' Rise is a mountain found west of Civitas illa Fortis in Varlamore.
At the southern face of the mountain lies the entrance to Cam Torum, the last bastion of the Imcando dwarves.

ralos' rise mine.name: Ralos' Rise mine
ralos' rise mine.summary: Ralos' Rise mine is a mine located to the south-east of Ralos' Rise, and west of the Avium Savannah. Three level 14 scorpions inhabit the mine as well as 3 sunbeam skinks.
travel: Ralos' Rise mine is a mine located to the south-east of Ralos' Rise, and west of the Avium Savannah.

ranging guild.name: Ranging Guild
ranging guild.summary: The Ranging Guild is an encampment located between Seers' Village and East Ardougne. Level 40 Ranged is required to enter, though this can be boosted. Inside, there are several shops, a minigame, and a training area.
transportNotes: A charged combat bracelet will teleport just outside the entrance.
Skills necklace teleport to the Fishing Guild and walk north-east.
Ardougne cloak 2, 3 or 4 teleport to the Ardougne farm patch and run north.
Charter ship to Catherby and run west.
Fairy Ring Fairy ring ALS into McGrubor's Wood and run south.
travel: The Ranging Guild is an encampment located between Seers' Village and East Ardougne.

rashiliyia's tomb.name: Rashiliyia's Tomb
rashiliyia's tomb.summary: Rashiliyia's Tomb is the final burial ground for the zombie queen, Rashiliyia. The tomb is visited during the Shilo Village quest, where it was taken over by Nazastarool. After the quest, the dungeon is filled with undead ones. If you are inside without wearing Beads of the Dead, Rashiliyia will appear, briefly attack, and summon two level 68 and one level 73 undead one.
transportNotes: To get to the tomb, go north beyond the temple of Ah Za Rhoon. There will be stone doors in the ground to enter, provided a bone key is used on them. It may be re-bought after the quest from Yanni Salika.
Take the fairy ring code Fairy ring DKP and run south
travel: Rashiliyia's Tomb is the final burial ground for the zombie queen, Rashiliyia.

rat pits.name: Rat Pits
rat pits.summary: The Rat Pits are a minigame that involves pet cats fighting against rats in several underground gambling rings. There are a total of four pits throughout Gielinor, located in Varrock, Ardougne, Keldagrim, and Port Sarim. Access to the Rat Pits requires partial completion of Ratcatchers, and the pits are unlocked one at a time throughout the quest. Ironmen cannot take part in this minigame.
travel: There are a total of four pits throughout Gielinor, located in Varrock, Ardougne, Keldagrim, and Port Sarim.
Access to the Rat Pits requires partial completion of Ratcatchers, and the pits are unlocked one at a time throughout the quest.
caveats: The four pits unlock at different quest steps. A started quest alone does not prove every pit.

red rock.name: Red Rock
red rock.summary: Red Rock is an island in the Unquiet Ocean, located south-east of the Void Knights' Outpost. It can be accessed following partial completion of the The Red Reef quest. It includes a bank chest, sailors' marker, salvaging station, notice board, and ledger table.
transportNotes: Partial completion of the quest The Red Reef is required to access Red Rock
Teleport with the sailors' amulet (requires inspecting Sailors' Marker before using)
Sailing to the gangplank on the east of the dock
travel: Red Rock is an island in the Unquiet Ocean, located south-east of the Void Knights' Outpost.
It can be accessed following partial completion of the The Red Reef quest.

rellekka.name: Rellekka
rellekka.summary: Rellekka is a village in the Fremennik Province. It is home to the Fremenniks, a hardy people who place great value on tradition. Nearly all of its features require completion of The Fremennik Trials to use. Multiple quests take place in the area and its surroundings.
transportNotes: Rellekka's remote location makes it a very tedious place to access. However, there are a number of ways to reach Rellekka, listed here in order of least to most running involved:
— Waterbirth Island, next to a boat leading to the Rellekka docks.
— POH portal just south of the village.
or — just outside the house portal.
— just south of the POH portal.
— Weiss, after which players can climb down the cliff and take the boat to a dock north-east of the village.
and the — Lunar Isle, after which talking to one of the NPCs without a Seal of Passage will cause players to be instantly kicked out to the Rellekka marketplace.
With the elite Fremennik Diary completed, the Return Orb in Lunar Isle's bank can be used instead.
travel: Rellekka is a village in the Fremennik Province.

revenant caves.name: Revenant Caves
revenant caves.summary: The Revenant Caves, also known as the Forinthry Dungeon, are a set of caverns found in the Wilderness. Accessible to members only, it is an extremely dangerous cave that ranges from level 17 to 40 Wilderness and is exclusively a singles-plus combat area. The caves serve as a refuge for revenants. There are three one-way entrances: * Level 17 Wilderness — east of the Dark Warriors' Fortress. * Level 26 Wilderness — north of the Bandit Camp. * Level 40 Wilderness — south-east of the Lava Maze. In addition to the entrances, there is also an exit by the level 17 and level 40 locations that allows players to leave the dungeon. These are intentionally placed away from the dungeon entrance to prevent players from escaping player killers by going in and out of them. In addition, there is a delay of 2 ticks (1.2 seconds) upon selecting any method of teleportation before it is activated, provided the player is in combat with an NPC while the attempt to teleport is made. This delay can be interrupted by another incoming attack from an NPC, resulting in the teleport delay timer having to be run down anew. The teleport delay is removed if the player has completed the hard Wilderness Diary. Unlike other locations in the Wilderness, dying to a revenant in the caves without taking damage from another player will be considered a player-versus-player death and follows its death mechanics accordingly. Any items not converted into coins or an untradeable/broken variant will be seen by every play
transportNotes: To get to the caves, players will have to traverse the Wilderness. Aside from simply walking there, there are some other options:
Revenant cave teleport, which teleports the player to the level 40 entrance.
Burning amulet, can take players to two entrances:
Bandit Camp option - head east for the level 17 entrance.
Lava Maze option - head east for the level 40 entrance.
Wilderness Obelisks can take players to two entrances:
Level 27 obelisk - head east to the level 26 entrance.
Level 35 obelisk - head north-east to the level 40 entrance.
travel: The Revenant Caves, also known as the Forinthry Dungeon, are a set of caverns found in the Wilderness.
Accessible to members only, it is an extremely dangerous cave that ranges from level 17 to 40 Wilderness and is exclusively a singles-plus combat area.
caveats: 100,000 coin entry fee and singles-plus PvP risk; protect only equipment you are prepared to lose.

rimmington.name: Rimmington
rimmington.summary: Rimmington is a small village in south-west Asgarnia. In addition to playing a role in several quests, the village is popular for its player-owned house portal, which players use to train Prayer by un-noting bones with Phials and then using them on a gilded altar.
transportNotes: Many transport options bring players into or close to Rimmington, listed here with their arrival destination.
— Rimmington house portal. Requires a POH in the village.
— Ardougne docks, which offer a trip to Rimmington for 30 coins.
can teleport players to the Crafting Guild north of the village.
can bring players to the Crafting Guild.
Charter a ship to Corsair Cove, then speak to Captain Tock (Cabin Boy Colin after completion of The Corsair Curse) to reach Rimmington.
to Rat Pits - Port Sarim (wily cats), east of Rimmington (requires Ratcatchers); Minigame Teleport recharges every 20 minutes.
— Port Sarim. Requires 83 Farming.
travel: Rimmington is a small village in south-west Asgarnia.

river elid.name: River Elid
river elid.summary: The River Elid begins just east of the Shantay Pass and flows across the Kharidian Desert. There are three bridges across this river. The northernmost bridge is close to the Shantay Pass and leads into the Uzer Hunter area, and then on into the Ruins of Uzer. The next bridge is south-west of Pollnivneach. The final bridge joins Sophanem to Menaphos, but the bridge is blocked on the Menaphos side. The section of the river south of Pollnivneach is home to the crocodiles, a possible Slayer assignment from Vannaka.
travel: The River Elid begins just east of the Shantay Pass and flows across the Kharidian Desert.
There are three bridges across this river.

river hos.name: River Hos
river hos.summary: The River Hos is a river in Gielinor and runs through Hosidius. The river's mouth begins west of the mess, and splits into two once it reaches the Forthos Ruin. Per Kharedst's memoirs The Fisher's Flute section, a song named Mist on the River Hos was written after it.
travel: The river's mouth begins west of the mess, and splits into two once it reaches the Forthos Ruin.

river lum.name: River Lum
river lum.summary: The River Lum is a river flowing through mostly Misthalin and the Wilderness, moving north-to-south. It is the second longest river in Gielinor. Its source is in the Wilderness. It runs as an underground stream until it briefly emerges at the Ferox Enclave, before it reemerges just north of the Wilderness border. It filters through the Lum Lagoon and Lumbridge Basin into the Ardent Ocean on the Misthalin-Kharidian border. The town of Lumbridge is named after the river.
transportNotes: Travelling on top of the river rather than across it is possible by using canoes. There are 4 normal stops, at Lumbridge, the Champions Guild, Barbarian Village, and Edgeville. Better canoes can travel farther, but require a higher Woodcutting level.

With 57 Woodcutting, a Waka canoe can be made. This allows a player to travel through an underground portion of the river into the Ferox Enclave or level 35 Wilderness, although a return trip from the latter is not possible.
travel: The River Lum is a river flowing through mostly Misthalin and the Wilderness, moving north-to-south.
It runs as an underground stream until it briefly emerges at the Ferox Enclave, before it reemerges just north of the Wilderness border.

rogues' castle.name: Rogues' Castle
rogues' castle.summary: The Rogues' Castle is a building located in the deep Wilderness, specifically in levels 52-56. It is one of the few places that rogues reside in (they can be fought and pickpocketed). An aggressive boss monster, the Chaos Elemental, can be found lurking around or inside the castle. It is also part of the Curse of the Empty Lord miniquest. This area is considered to be highly dangerous, as it is in high level Wilderness which runs the risk of PKers, and has the nearby Chaos Elemental, who can bind and unequip players, cutting off possible escape routes. Additionally, there are aggressive rogues located within the castle. There is a Wilderness Obelisk nearby which can be used to escape the immediate vicinity, though it is not a surefire way to reach safety.
travel: The Rogues' Castle is a building located in the deep Wilderness, specifically in levels 52-56.
An aggressive boss monster, the Chaos Elemental, can be found lurking around or inside the castle.

ruins (east).name: Ruins (east)
ruins (east).summary: The eastern ruins, commonly referred to simply as the ruins or sometimes the farm, are the remains of a village in the eastern Wilderness. They lie a single-way combat area in between level 26 to 29 Wilderness.
transportNotes: Unlike many remains found within the Wilderness, these ruins cannot be reached by using Ancient Magicks teleportation. There are several transport options that place players near the ruins, however, listed here in order of least to greatest distance away:
— Corporeal Beast, slightly south-east of the cave.
— Graveyard of Shadows, directly south of the ruins.
— the hill just north of the ruins.
— the pond slightly north of the ruins.
— Ferox Enclave, south of the ruins.
— Revenant Caves, fairly north-west of the ruins.
— the King Black Dragon lair, well north-west of the ruins.
travel: The eastern ruins, commonly referred to simply as the ruins or sometimes the farm, are the remains of a village in the eastern Wilderness.

ruins (west).name: Ruins (west)
ruins (west).summary: The ruins in level 21 Wilderness are all that remain of the Zarosian fortress and village once known as Dareeyak. The ruins are located west of the Bandit Camp and south of the Forgotten Cemetery.
transportNotes: — ruins centre. Requires completion of Desert Treasure I.
— Bandit Camp, south-east of the ruins
— level 27 Wilderness, north-east of the ruins.
— The Forgotten Cemetery, shortly north of the ruins.
or above — God Wars Dungeon entrance. Run south-east, climb the rocks, run east again, and climb the rocks into the Wilderness.
— Ferox Enclave, a long run east of the ruins.
travel: The ruins are located west of the Bandit Camp and south of the Forgotten Cemetery.

ruins of tapoyauik.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
ruins of tapoyauik.summary: The Ruins of Tapoyauik is a dungeon located under the Tower of Ascension in Varlamore. They are visited during the quest The Heart of Darkness, after completion of which the ruins become populated with a variety of monsters, all of which are susceptible to fire spells. Prior to quest completion, they are not accessible. Pulling the chain on the bottom floor allows the player to freely climb up and down the chain, without having to navigate the agility obstacles. Additionally, a lift platform is available on the ground floor of the Tower of Ascension, which brings the player to the bottom floor of the dungeon, where Amoxliatl is. The moon key can be used on the chest located on the bottom floor of the ruins for various rewards. A Dwarven multicannon cannot be placed inside the ruins.
transportNotes: Transport routes to the ruins include:
The Pendant of Ates can teleport directly to the Twilight Temple, near the lift.
Quetzal Transport System to Salvager Overlook (requires the Landing site to be built) and run South towards the Twilight Temple.
Quetzal Transport System to Quetzacalli Gorge (unlocked by default) and run North-East through the gate followed by a turn to the South around The Proudspire mountain.
The lift platform at the Tower of Ascension can then be used as a shortcut after completion of The Heart of Darkness quest, which will bring you to the centre of the slayer area part of the dungeon.
travel: The Ruins of Tapoyauik is a dungeon located under the Tower of Ascension in Varlamore.
Prior to quest completion, they are not accessible.

ruins of ullek.name: Ruins of Ullek
ruins of ullek.summary: The Ruins of Ullek are the remains of an ancient city located in the deep south of the Kharidian Desert. The area is visited during the Beneath Cursed Sands quest, where the player unlocks the dungeon below.
transportNotes: There are several ways of reaching the ruins through teleports, listed here in order of least running to most:
— Agility Pyramid (Jaleustrophos).
Fairy ring AKP — Necropolis island. Requires 62 Agility and completion of Beneath Cursed Sands.
— town centre, slightly east of the rug merchant.
— Temple of Elidinis, slightly east of the rug merchant.
— Pollnivneach house portal, north of the rug merchant, then rug to Sophanem.
travel: The Ruins of Ullek are the remains of an ancient city located in the deep south of the Kharidian Desert.

ruins of unkah.name: Ruins of Unkah
ruins of unkah.summary: The Ruins of Unkah are ancient ruins in the Kharidian Desert, now inhabited by the Spirit Anglers, who have set up camp to research and subdue Tempoross. A small mine is located atop a cliff north of the ruins.
transportNotes: The Ruins of Unkah can be reached from Al Kharid by boarding Ferryman Sathwood's ferry. If entering from the desert, the player must go through either of the Shantay passes located on the southern and eastern borders of the ruins. Players can take Ferryman Nathwood's ferry back to Al Kharid.
travel: A small mine is located atop a cliff north of the ruins.

ruins of uzer.name: Ruins of Uzer
ruins of uzer.summary: The Ruins of Uzer are all that remain of the former city of Uzer, an ancient city in the Kharidian Desert that was destroyed during the God Wars.
transportNotes: to the Eagle's Eyrie — just north-west of the ruins.
Fairy ring DLQ — just south of the ruins, near the desert lizards.
— Temple of Elidinis in Nardah.
— Jaleustrophos (Simon Templeton's camp), well south of the ruins.

Players can take the magic carpet ride from Shantay Pass to the ruins after completion of The Golem. Note that, unlike on the world map, the destination for the ruins of Uzer is simply labeled as "Uzer."
travel: The Ruins of Uzer are all that remain of the former city of Uzer, an ancient city in the Kharidian Desert that was destroyed during the God Wars.

salvager overlook.name: Salvager Overlook
salvager overlook.summary: Salvager Overlook is a small village north of Civitas illa Fortis. As its name suggests, it is inhabited by salvagers, led by Izel. It contains a landing site (which is initially unbuilt), a general store, an armour store, a furnace, a range, and a water source. There is a STASH unit for the master clue scroll step here. The Proudspire is also located to the south-west of the overlook. A road leads south-east out of the Salvager Overlook to the Twilight Temple.
transportNotes: Walk through the large gate in Quetzacalli Gorge and continue north then east.
After the landing site is built, the player can fly there via the Quetzal Transport System.
After activating the Statue of Ates, use the Pendant of Ates to teleport to Twilight Temple and run north-west.
travel: Salvager Overlook is a small village north of Civitas illa Fortis.
The Proudspire is also located to the south-west of the overlook.

scabaras dungeon.name: Scabaras Dungeon
scabaras dungeon.summary: The Scabaras Dungeon is located underground in the Ruins of Ullek area. The dungeon plays a major role in the Beneath Cursed Sands quest. Its entrance is on the plateau, just north of the anvil and furnace, in an area surrounded by broken pillars. The Ruins of Ullek are in the south-eastern Kharidian Desert and are subject to desert heat, so players are advised to bring a water source. The dungeon itself is not subject to desert heat. Aggressive Scabarites can be found here on the 2nd level which attack with melee, ranged, and magic. They are found close together and in high numbers, making this an effective place to kill them for Slayer assignments, though the Sophanem Dungeon may be a better alternative for lower level players (maze level) and players wishing to use a dwarf multicannon (cavern level).
travel: The Scabaras Dungeon is located underground in the Ruins of Ullek area.
Its entrance is on the plateau, just north of the anvil and furnace, in an area surrounded by broken pillars.

scorpia.name: Scorpia
scorpia.summary: Scorpia is a large female scorpion boss that resides in a cave beneath the Scorpion Pit located in Wilderness level 53-55. Scorpia is notable for dropping one of the three shards that form the malediction ward and odium ward, with the Crazy archaeologist and Chaos Fanatic dropping the other pieces. Killing all three at least once is a hard Wilderness Diary task.
travel: Deep Wilderness: Scorpion Pit
Descend the cave entrance
Scorpia chamber
caveats: Wilderness PvP risk; Scorpia does not inherit the other Wilderness bosses' diary/50,000 coin entry rule.

scorpion pit.name: Scorpion Pit
scorpion pit.summary: The Scorpion Pit is a valley in the northern portion of the Wilderness extending from level 53 to 55. The surface of the pit is infested with many level 14 Scorpions. Multiple cave entrances lead the player into an underground cavern which contains Scorpia and her offspring. On the valley itself, there are several headless arrow and bone spawns, along with many level 14 Scorpions. The Scorpion Pit (both inside and outside), along with the surrounding area is multi-combat, and is a hotspot for PKers who come to kill Scorpia hunters. Players should take caution around the pit as the Chaos Elemental can also wander into the Scorpion Pit, dealing high damage to lower-levelled players.
transportNotes: Pull the lever in either Ardougne or Edgeville to teleport to the Deserted Keep. Run north and slash the web, then run east.
Use a Wilderness Obelisk to travel to level 50 Wilderness. Run west past the Rogues' Castle and the Chaos Elemental.
travel: The Scorpion Pit is a valley in the northern portion of the Wilderness extending from level 53 to 55.
Multiple cave entrances lead the player into an underground cavern which contains Scorpia and her offspring.

settlement ruins.name: Settlement Ruins
settlement ruins.summary: The Settlement Ruins are a village found south-west of the Wintertodt Camp in the Northern Tundras. The northern entrance is guarded by aggressive level-132 ice wolves, while the settlement itself is inhabited by ice giants and ice spiders. The southern entrance can be accessed north of the Tower of Magic. From the appearance of the settlement and the frozen warriors found there, it is assumed the settlement was destroyed after the Wintertodt ravaged Great Kourend during the Long Winter 1,400 years ago. Note that this is a multicombat area, and can be threatening for lower level players. Be prepared to be attacked by the Level 53 Ice Giants and level 61 Ice Spiders.
transportNotes: Fairy ring Fairy ring CIS and head west up the mountain to the southern entrance.
Games necklace to the Wintertodt Camp and head south-west down the path to the northern entrance.
The south entrance route via fairy ring is recommended, to avoid spending a games necklace charge and also to avoid the ice wolves.
travel: The Settlement Ruins are a village found south-west of the Wintertodt Camp in the Northern Tundras.
The northern entrance is guarded by aggressive level-132 ice wolves, while the settlement itself is inhabited by ice giants and ice spiders.

shade catacombs.name: Shade Catacombs
shade catacombs.summary: The Shade Catacombs are a complex labyrinth found under Mort'ton as part of the Shades of Mort'ton minigame. The entrance is directly north of the general store and west of the temple, marked as a brown area on the map. To access it you need to have completed Shades of Mort'ton and have a bronze shade key or better. To get a bronze shade key, you must kill a Loar Shade in Mort'ton, sanctify some olive oil at the repaired temple to make sacred oil, then use the sacred oil on any log, making a pyre log. Use the pyre log on one of the four pyre slabs in one of the seven shade burning areas of Mort'ton, identified by grey diamonds on the minimap. Then use the loar remains on the pyre logs, then use a tinderbox on the pyre logs. You may need to burn more than one, sometimes burning a shade produces coins on the reward pillar instead of a key. Inside the shade catacombs are various shades and chests which may contain fine cloth (used to make splitbark armour), the amulet of the damned, and Zealot's robes. The Dwarf Multicannon can be used here.
travel: The Shade Catacombs are a complex labyrinth found under Mort'ton as part of the Shades of Mort'ton minigame.
The entrance is directly north of the general store and west of the temple, marked as a brown area on the map.
caveats: Bring a bronze shade key or better; higher doors require the appropriate key tier.

shadow dungeon.name: Shadow Dungeon
shadow dungeon.summary: The Shadow Dungeon is the dungeon used during Desert Treasure I, where players fight Damis to obtain the shadow diamond. To access the dungeon, players must use the ladder east of Baxtorian Falls, near Rasolo. To be able to see the ladder, players are required to wear the ring of visibility or the ring of shadows. If lost, the ring of visibility can be reclaimed from Rasolo west of the Fishing Guild, or if Desert Treasure II has been completed, the ring of shadows can be bought from the Mysterious Bandit at the Ancient Vault for 75,000 coins. Outside of the quest, the dungeon is only frequented for potential clue steps: *Elite: Cheer in the Shadow dungeon *Master: The far north eastern corner where 1 of 4 was defeated The map of the dungeon shows the location of Giant skeletons (G), Shadow Hounds (S), Damis (2, during Desert Treasure I), and the path to the end of the dungeon where Damis as well as the dig location for the master clue step can be found.
transportNotes: The Shadow Dungeon can be found down a ladder south-east of Baxtorian Falls; a ring of visibility or ring of shadows must be equipped to see the ladder. The ladder can be found within the fenced area north of the moss giants and south of Glarial's Tomb. These are located slightly west of the Fishing Guild.
travel: East of Baxtorian Falls, near Rasolo
Wear the required visibility ring
Descend the visible ladder
shadow dungeon.confirmation: Requires an equipped ring of visibility or ring of shadows for the ladder.

shaman caves.name: Shaman Caves
shaman caves.summary: The Shaman Caves are the upper floor of a cave system located in the Kharazi Jungle in southern Karamja. They play a large role in Legends' Quest, which must be started in order to access the caves. The entrance to the cave is in the north-western part of the Kharazi Jungle and is accessed by squeezing into the mossy rock, which requires 50 Agility. The first room of the caves has a fire wall containing Ungadulu, a shaman possessed by the black demon Nezikchened. Ungadulu later helps the player reach the deeper sections of the cave, including the deeper Viyeldi caves accessed via a winch at the end of the dungeon. There is a shortcut on the western wall near the entrance that bypasses a majority of the cave, requiring 96 Agility. After Legends' Quest, there are two reasons to return to the caves: * A hard task for the Karamja Diary (kill a death wing) * A master clue step
transportNotes: To navigate the caves after the quest (below 96 Agility), bring the following items:
Runes to cast an enchantment spell (3 cosmic runes and 30 elemental runes).
An axe and machete to access the Kharazi Jungle, unless using the level 79 Agility shortcut.
A spade, if doing a master clue scroll.
The unpowered orb, runes, and a spade are not required to access the Death Wings.
To traverse the caves, the following steps must be taken:
Enter the caves by searching the Rocks in the north-western part of the Kharazi Jungle.
If you have at least 96 Agility and have completed Legends' Quest, use the shortcut on the western wall near the entrance of the cave. Skip to step 9.
travel: South of Shilo Village
Cut into Kharazi Jungle with an axe and machete
Mossy rock in the north-west: Shaman Caves; winch leads deeper
caveats: These are Karamja caves, not Lizardman shaman caves. Deeper routes need the relevant quest steps, ropes and tools.

shantay pass.name: Shantay Pass
shantay pass.summary: The Shantay Pass is a small area that separates Al Kharid from the Kharidian Desert. Players will need to have 5 coins to buy a pass from Shantay, or have completed the elite Desert Diary, if they wish to enter the desert.
travel: The Shantay Pass is a small area that separates Al Kharid from the Kharidian Desert.

shayzien.name: Shayzien
shayzien.summary: Shayzien is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend. Led by Lord Shiro Shayzien of the Shayzien House, the city controls the Shayzien Army, the main military force providing law, order, and defence for the kingdom. Most Shayzien citizens are part of the Army, and serve as the police force responsible for dealing with crime in Great Kourend, as well as defending the kingdom against the lizardmen, creatures created by Xeric, a powerful mage who reigned over Great Kourend in the past. Shayzien is one of the more recent cities founded in the history of Great Kourend; it was founded by the legendary heroine Camorra Shayzien during the Dragonkin Conflicts 2,000 years ago.
transportNotes: Xeric's talisman - Use the Xeric's Lookout teleport
Fairy rings - Use the code Fairy ring DJR and then run south-east
Skills necklace - Use the Woodcutting Guild teleport and walk west until you reach the War Tent and then walk north
Kourend Castle Teleport and then run south-west
Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead - Use History and Hearsay to teleport to the Graveyard of Heroes (requires completion of Tale of the Righteous)
travel: Shayzien is one of the more recent cities founded in the history of Great Kourend; it was founded by the legendary heroine Camorra Shayzien during the Dragonkin Conflicts 2,000 years ago.

shayzien crypts.name: Shayzien Crypts
shayzien crypts.summary: The Shayzien Crypts are an ancient dungeon located in the south-western part of the Graveyard of Heroes, in Shayzien. Players must bring a light source with them or risk getting swarmed over with tiny insects. The crypts are visited during Dragon Slayer II. Players should use caution when traversing the crypts as they are a multicombat area filled with high-level monsters. A dwarf multicannon may be used in the crypts. The crypts were constructed long before the founding of Great Kourend 1,510 years ago, and is the burial grounds for the kings and queens of Great Kourend, until a few hundred years ago when unusually strong zombies and skeletons began to overrun the crypts; despite efforts by the Shayzien House to eradicate the undead, they kept returning, making the entire area dangerous to traverse, though the undead do not appear to have any interest in escaping to the surface. Throughout the crypts, the symbol of Xeric can be seen, despite the crypts predating his reign. In the lowest level of the crypts, the tomb of Camorra Shayzien, the founder of Shayzien, can be found. In addition, a tomb can be found north of hers, which appears to have been opened with blood spilled around it, and has collapsed into the floor below. It should be noted that the bloody tomb has the symbol of Xeric engraved on it. Killing a zombie in the Shayzien Crypts is a task in the Hard Kourend & Kebos Diary.
travel: The Shayzien Crypts are an ancient dungeon located in the south-western part of the Graveyard of Heroes, in Shayzien.

The crypts were constructed long before the founding of Great Kourend 1,510 years ago, and is the burial grounds for the kings and queens of Great Kourend, until a few hundred years ago when unusually strong zombies and skeletons began to overrun the crypts; despite efforts by the Shayzien House to eradicate the undead, they kept returning, making the entire area dangerous to traverse, though the undead do not appear to have any interest in escaping to the surface.

shayziens' wall.name: Shayziens' Wall
shayziens' wall.summary: Shayziens' Wall, also known as the Shayzien Outpost, is a wall located west of Shayzien. Immediately to the west of the wall, on the other side of the river, are two outposts that serve as a first line of defence against the lizardmen. Fires can be found at both of the outposts. West of this wall is the Lizardman Settlement, home to hostile lizardmen, including brutes and shamans, who can poison unprepared players.
travel: Shayziens' Wall, also known as the Shayzien Outpost, is a wall located west of Shayzien.
Immediately to the west of the wall, on the other side of the river, are two outposts that serve as a first line of defence against the lizardmen.

shellbane gryphon cave.name: Shellbane Gryphon Cave
shellbane gryphon cave.summary: The Shellbane Gryphon Cave is a dungeon found on The Great Conch and is home to the Shellbane gryphon boss. The cave entrance is protected by Elder Nama, who prevents players from entering unless they have an appropriate slayer task or an elite clue scroll directing them to kill the shellbane gryphon. Although the cave is a multicombat area, the boss fight takes place in a solo instance. The entrance to the cave is north of the fairy ring Fairy ring CJQ. Players may not place a dwarf multicannon or light a fire within the cave; attempting to do so produces the messages and respectively.
travel: The Shellbane Gryphon Cave is a dungeon found on The Great Conch and is home to the Shellbane gryphon boss.
The cave entrance is protected by Elder Nama, who prevents players from entering unless they have an appropriate slayer task or an elite clue scroll directing them to kill the shellbane gryphon.
caveats: Give Floopa the bandage during Troubled Tortugans. Charter ships/fairy ring CJQ avoid imposing the 45 Sailing mooring requirement on every route.

shilo village (location).name: Shilo Village (location)
shilo village (location).summary: Shilo Village (pronounced "Shy-lo") is a small village in southern Karamja, accessible after completing the Shilo Village quest.
transportNotes: Several transport options bring players into or close to Shilo Village, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
Hajedy and Vigroy's cart system brings players between Shilo Village and Brimhaven, costing between 10-200 coins each time.
— Duradel. Requires completion of the elite Karamja diary.
— gem mine. Requires completion of the hard Karamja diary.
Fairy ring CKR — outside of the village. With 79 Agility, players can scale the rocks near the north-eastern corner of the village wall.

Players can also talk to Seravel upstairs in the Shilo Village fishing shop to buy a one-way ticket on the Lady of the Waves for 25 coins. Players can then go to either Port Khazard or Port Sarim by presenting the ticket to the boat west of Shilo Village.
travel: Shilo Village (pronounced "Shy-lo") is a small village in southern Karamja, accessible after completing the Shilo Village quest.

shimmering atoll.name: Shimmering Atoll
shimmering atoll.summary: The Shimmering Atoll is an atoll found south of the Avium Savannah in Wyrm's Waters. Mooring here requires 49 Sailing.
travel: The Shimmering Atoll is an atoll found south of the Avium Savannah in Wyrm's Waters.

silk chasm.name: Silk Chasm
silk chasm.summary: The Silk Chasm is the lair of Venenatis. It is a multi-combat dungeon located in the Wilderness, just south-east of Callisto's Den. Entering the boss lair requires completion of the medium Wilderness diary OR a Venenatis boss Slayer task, and a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. This fee is shared across Callisto's Den, Hunter's End, the Skeletal Tomb, Vet'ion's Rest, the Silk Chasm, the Web Chasm and the Escape Caves. The fee does not need to be paid again, unless the player dies to another player without having left the Wilderness since their most recent visit to a boss lair or the Escape Caves. If this happens, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer, and needs to be paid again to re-enter the boss lairs. Players can decrease the fee by killing the six bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins. Like the Callisto's Den and Vet'ion's Rest, players exiting the Silk Chasm will always arrive at one of three points within the Escape Caves at random. Note that any player who exits within 10 seconds of the previous player will arrive at the same point, meaning player killers can pursue their targets through the boss lair. Upon any player entering the lair, all players inside will be unable to teleport for 3 ticks. This delay no longer occurs after completion of the hard Wilderness diary. In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have a
travel: It is a multi-combat dungeon located in the Wilderness, just south-east of Callisto's Den.
In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills registered in their name.
silk chasm.confirmation: Requires medium Wilderness diary OR a specific Venenatis boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.
caveats: A generic bear, skeleton or spider assignment does not bypass the diary gate. PvP risk applies.

silvarea.name: Silvarea
silvarea.summary: Silvarea is a small area in the north-eastern corner of Misthalin. Primarily consisting of a path between two mountain ranges, it ends at the Paterdomus Temple, behind which is the River Salve.
transportNotes: Several teleports bring players close to Silvarea, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
— Digsite, south-west of the area.
and — Lumberyard, west of Silvarea.
, Fairy ring CKS, and — Morytania, near the east end of Silvarea. With level 65 Agility, the ornate railing shortcut by the Paterdomus Temple allows quick passage between Morytania and Silvarea.
travel: Silvarea is a small area in the north-eastern corner of Misthalin.

sinclair mansion.name: Sinclair Mansion
sinclair mansion.summary: Sinclair Mansion is a large mansion owned by the Sinclair family that plays a significant role in the Murder Mystery quest. It is located north of Camelot, along the path that leads from Seers' Village to Rellekka. The fairy ring Fairy ring CJR is located just west of the mansion. An Agility shortcut north of the mansion leads to Fremennik Province (48 Agility required).
transportNotes: The fastest way to Sinclair Mansion is via fairy ring, using code Fairy ring CJR. Other routes include:
Music cape teleport to Falo the Bard, then run east.
Teleport to Camelot or Seers' Village via the Camelot Teleport spell or tablet, then running north along the road.
Kandarin headgear teleport to Sherlock, then run north.
Travel to Catherby via the Catherby Teleport spell or tablet or by charter ship, then run north-west to the road between Camelot and the Seers' Village bank.
travel: It is located north of Camelot, along the path that leads from Seers' Village to Rellekka.
The fairy ring Fairy ring CJR is located just west of the mansion.

sisterhood sanctuary.name: Sisterhood Sanctuary
sisterhood sanctuary.summary: The Sisterhood Sanctuary, also known as the Slepe Dungeon, is a formerly-sealed subterranean complex beneath Slepe created by the Sisterhood, who were former Justiciars that abandoned Saradomin and pledged allegiance to Zamorak during the Third Age. The entrance can be found via a house just south-west of the town's church.
transportNotes: The quickest methods of reaching Slepe, where the Sisterhood Sanctuary is found, are:
Using the "Slepe" option on Drakan's medallion, which brings players directly to the Sisterhood Sanctuary. This requires having used a Slepey tablet on the medallion.
Using the "Ver Sinhaza" option on Drakan's medallion, then running north. Once players pass the small dock, run east to arrive at Slepe.

Using the Ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus, then heading north to the small dock and paying Andras 10,000 coins to row to Slepe (or for free after paying him a one-off fee of 1,000,000 coins). The player will arrive at a dock just south-west of Slepe.
Using the Morytania Legs teleport to Burgh de Rott, then take the southern boat to Slepe (after Sins of the Father).
travel: The entrance can be found via a house just south-west of the town's church.

skavid caves.name: Skavid Caves
skavid caves.summary: The Skavid caves are a set of six caves around the ogre city of Gu'Tanoth. The caves are inhabited by the Skavid, a race of creatures enslaved by the Ogres. The caves are an important feature of the Watchtower quest. Also, two caves each have a slow spawn of cave nightshade (also known as nightshade or belladonna), the collection of which is a part of the medium Ardougne Diary. Players need a light source and skavid map to enter any of the caves. If players attempt to enter a skavid cave without having a skavid map in their inventory, they become confused and end up outside another skavid cave.
transportNotes: In some cases, entering a skavid cave without a skavid map can be exploited as a transport system since it follows a fixed route. For example, a player running from Castle Wars to Gu'Tanoth could attempt to enter the north-west cave (ending up at the north-central one), attempt to enter the north-central one (ending up at the north-east one), and then run up the hill to the city gates. The player does not need to have a light source to use this feature.
Using the Skavid caves as a transport system is faster than walking from cave to cave and does not use run energy.
Note: This feature cannot be used if the player has a skavid map in their inventory.
travel: The Skavid caves are a set of six caves around the ogre city of Gu'Tanoth.
skavid caves.confirmation: Bring the skavid map and a light source; the map is obtained during Watchtower.
caveats: Without the map, entry moves you to another exit instead of the chosen cave.

skeletal tomb.name: Skeletal Tomb
skeletal tomb.summary: The Skeletal Tomb is the lair of Calvar'ion, a skeletal Zamorakian warrior. It is a singles-plus combat dungeon located in the Graveyard of Shadows north of Ferox Enclave. To enter the lair, players must have completed the hard Wilderness diary, OR they must have a Vet'ion boss Slayer task (a skeleton Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement). As the entrance to the Skeletal Tomb and the tomb itself are found in level 21 Wilderness, items that can teleport players above level 20 Wilderness are recommended in the event of encountering a player killer. Entering the boss lairs requires players to pay a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. This fee is shared across Callisto's Den, Hunter's End, the Skeletal Tomb, Vet'ion's Rest, the Silk Chasm, the Web Chasm and the Escape Caves. The fee does not need to be paid again, unless the player dies to another player without having left the Wilderness since their most recent visit to a boss lair or the Escape Caves. If this happens, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer, and needs to be paid again to re-enter the boss lairs. Players can decrease the fee by killing the six bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins. Upon entering the lair, if players have recently attacked Calvar'ion, they will be unable to teleport for 3 ticks unless they have completed the hard Wilderness diary. To peek insi
travel: It is a singles-plus combat dungeon located in the Graveyard of Shadows north of Ferox Enclave.

As the entrance to the Skeletal Tomb and the tomb itself are found in level 21 Wilderness, items that can teleport players above level 20 Wilderness are recommended in the event of encountering a player killer.
skeletal tomb.confirmation: Requires hard Wilderness diary OR a specific Vet'ion boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.
caveats: A generic bear, skeleton or spider assignment does not bypass the diary gate. PvP risk applies.

skotizo.name: Skotizo
skotizo.summary: Skotizo is a demonic boss located beneath the Catacombs of Kourend. He is primarily known for his guaranteed hard clue scroll drops, along with a very high chance of elite clue scrolls. He is also a reliable source of ancient shards. Accessing his lair requires the use of a dark totem on the altar found in the centre of the Catacombs; one dark totem permits only one attempt, which makes him a sporadic boss. The totem is immediately consumed on entry, and the player is teleported into Skotizo's arena. He will never respawn in this arena, and as he is located in an instance, ground items will be lost on exit, so players wishing to attempt to fight him several times should leave appropriate inventory space for any loot they wish to take with them. Skotizo can be substituted for both black demon and greater demon kills during Slayer tasks. Skotizo's Lair is part of the Catacombs of Kourend, and does count as such for the purpose of Konar Slayer tasks. He cannot be damaged with a ring of recoil.
travel: Skotizo is a demonic boss located beneath the Catacombs of Kourend.
Accessing his lair requires the use of a dark totem on the altar found in the centre of the Catacombs; one dark totem permits only one attempt, which makes him a sporadic boss.

slayer tower.name: Slayer Tower
slayer tower.summary: The Slayer Tower, also known as Viggora's Folly, is a tall granite tower located north-west of Canifis that was built by Viggora, a follower of Zaros, during the Second Age. There are three levels, each with increasingly dangerous Slayer monsters. All monsters within the building require a certain Slayer level to kill, the lowest being crawling hands at level 5, and the highest being abyssal demons at level 85 Slayer. Players may also earn bonus Slayer experience depending on their progress on the Morytania Diary. The amount of bonus experience gained starts at 2.5% with the easy tasks completed, increasing by 2.5% for each set complete, up to 10% with the elite tasks completed. Attempting to wait out a monster's 10 minute aggression timer can be done on a different floor. For example, the aberrant spectre aggression can be waited out at the top of the staircase leading to the 2. Dwarf multicannons cannot be used here. If attempted, players will receive the message, "A strange magical force won't let you set up a cannon here."
transportNotes: The Slayer ring can be used to teleport to the main entrance of the tower.
Fairy ring code Fairy ring CKS lands you in the west of Canifis, just south of the tower.
The Salve Graveyard Teleport (requires Arceuus spellbook) will take you to the graveyard just south of the tower.
The Kharyrll teleport (requires completion of Desert Treasure I) (spell, tablet, POH portal) will take the player to Canifis, where it is a short run north-west.
Go west after casting Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport or using the tablet.
The player can use the Ectophial to teleport to Port Phasmatys, and walk from there.
You can walk from Varrock or the digsite through Paterdomus, though this is by far the longest route.
travel: The Slayer Tower, also known as Viggora's Folly, is a tall granite tower located north-west of Canifis that was built by Viggora, a follower of Zaros, during the Second Age.
All monsters within the building require a certain Slayer level to kill, the lowest being crawling hands at level 5, and the highest being abyssal demons at level 85 Slayer.

slepe.name: Slepe
slepe.summary: Slepe (pronounced "sleep") is a small coastal town which occupies an area east of Meiyerditch and Darkmeyer. The town is home to the sleeper plague, which causes infected people to fall into a deep eternal sleep, giving the town its name. Due to the town's fealty to the vampyres, Slepe is the only human settlement in Morytania whose inhabitants voluntarily allow their blood to be tithed, and thus the people are healthier than others despite the grim look of life in the region.
transportNotes: The quickest methods of reaching Slepe are as follows:
Teleporting to Slepe via Drakan's medallion after using a Slepey tablet on it.
Spider cave teleport and run south-east.
Hallowed crystal shard to Hallowed Sepulchre exit, then use the shortcut on the eastern wall of Darkmeyer.
Teleporting to Ver Sinhaza via Drakan's medallion, then running north. Once players pass the small dock, run east to arrive at Slepe.
Using the ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus, then heading north to the small dock and paying Andras 10,000 coins to row to Slepe. The player will arrive at a dock just south-west of Slepe.
Teleporting to Darkmeyer via Drakan's medallion, then use the shortcut on the eastern wall of Darkmeyer.

Teleport to Burgh de Rott with the Morytania legs 3 or 4 or to the Shades of Mort'ton Minigame Teleport after completing the Shades of Mort'ton quest, which has a 20 minute cooldown, then go south to Burgh de Rott. Go to the southern shore and use the boat to go to Meiyerditch. Traverse the wall obstacles, run east along the shore, and then enter Ver Sinhaza. Go north through the opening in the wall to arrive at Slepe.
travel: Slepe (pronounced "sleep") is a small coastal town which occupies an area east of Meiyerditch and Darkmeyer.

smoke devil dungeon.name: Smoke Devil Dungeon
smoke devil dungeon.summary: The Smoke Devil Dungeon is a dungeon located in the Chompy Marsh south of Castle Wars, housing smoke devils and the thermonuclear smoke devil that can both only be killed while on a Slayer task. Players may enter without a slayer assignment, but upon attacking any monster inside the dungeon, Breive will stop them from doing so, claiming that they are not assigned to kill them. Attempting to enter the dungeon without a facemask (or Slayer helm) will result in Breive warning the player that they should get some protection first before entering. The gas mask also works. Without one, the player will take periodic damage from the smoke (shown as "cough"; "wheeze" if the smoke damages you to 1 Hitpoint). The smoke cannot kill the player, but a facemask or slayer helm is still needed to fight the smoke devils. The smoke from smoke devils will also reduce all combat stats and agility to 1 if inhaled without a mask/slayer helm. The smoke overlay effect within the cave can be toggled on and off by right-clicking the cave's entrance and selecting the Smoke option.
transportNotes: There are several ways to access the dungeon:
The fairy ring code Fairy ring BKP will bring the players just south-west of the dungeon.
Using a ring of dueling to teleport to Castle Wars, then running south-west.
travel: The Smoke Devil Dungeon is a dungeon located in the Chompy Marsh south of Castle Wars, housing smoke devils and the thermonuclear smoke devil that can both only be killed while on a Slayer task.
The smoke overlay effect within the cave can be toggled on and off by right-clicking the cave's entrance and selecting the Smoke option.

smoke dungeon.name: Smoke Dungeon
smoke dungeon.summary: The Smoke Dungeon is a winding tunnel underneath the Kharidian Desert. To reach it, players must climb down the smokey well. It is visited during the Desert Treasure I quest to obtain the smoke diamond from Fareed. Progressing the quest up until constructing the mystical mirrors is required to be able to enter the dungeon. While in the dungeon, the player must wear a facemask, Slayer helmet, or Slayer helmet (i) to protect themselves from the smoke. A gas mask from the Plague City quest will also serve as adequate protection from the dungeon's smoke, however the dust devils inside the dungeon will still rapidly drain the player's stats despite the gas mask's protection. Remaining in the dungeon without protection will cause players to receive 20 damage every 12 seconds (20 ticks), though this cannot reduce the player's Hitpoints below 1. The Smoke Dungeon is one of three locations that contain dust devils, which have an exceedingly rare chance to drop the dragon chainbody or dust battlestaff. Dust devils can be killed with Ranged, Magic, or attacked using a Melee weapon such as a halberd. Weapons such as the aforementioned may prove useful when killing dust devils, as they allow for safespots to be used. The area also contains fire giants; other monsters that may be found in the dungeon include pyrefiends and fire elementals. In the western portion of the dungeon is a multi-combat, task-only area for players to slay dust devils. Players who attempt to kill these dust devils o
transportNotes: Teleport to House (if house is in Pollnivneach)
Scroll of redirection on a Teleport to house (tablet) for a Pollnivneach teleport
Using a Nardah teleport and then taking a magic carpet to Pollnivneach
Using a desert amulet 2 or higher and then taking a magic carpet to Pollnivneach
From Al Kharid, go through the Shantay Pass and take a magic carpet to Pollnivneach
Teleport to the Jaldraocht Pyramid with the Pharaoh's sceptre, then running north-east.
Fairy Ring Fairy ring DLQ will take you North of Nardah
travel: To reach it, players must climb down the smokey well.
The area also contains fire giants; other monsters that may be found in the dungeon include pyrefiends and fire elementals.

sophanem.name: Sophanem
sophanem.summary: Sophanem, also known as the City of the Dead, is a plague-ridden city located in the southern end of the Kharidian Desert. In order to gain access, players need to partially progress through Icthlarin's Little Helper. The city is connected to the capital Menaphos, although it cannot currently be entered. As its nickname suggests, Sophanem's main business is to take care of the Menaphite deceased, erecting large tombs and pyramids and mainly worshipping Icthlarin, shepherd of the souls of the departed. Unfortunately for the Sophanites, these treasure-filled tombs are a magnet for graverobbers such as Simon Templeton. It is the seat of the High Priest of Icthlarin, whose duties include the protection of the great pyramids and ensuring that the souls of the dead are protected from the Amascut, Icthlarin's deranged sister. Cats and their protector, the Sphinx, play an important role in this latter task.
transportNotes: There are several ways of reaching Sophanem through teleports, listed here in order of least running to most:
— Pyramid Plunder minigame (Jalsavrah).
Fairy ring AKP — Necropolis island. Requires 62 Agility and partial completion of Beneath Cursed Sands.

Fairy ring DLQ — well north of Nardah. The magic carpet system can also be used to travel to Sophanem from southern Pollnivneach after starting Icthlarin's Little Helper. Players can teleport near a magic carpet, and reach Sophanem:
— town centre, slightly east of the rug merchant.
— Temple of Elidinis, slightly east of the rug merchant.
— Pollnivneach house portal, north of the rug merchant.
A shortcut on the wall just east of the bank leads to the camp just north of Sophanem, west of the Agility Pyramid.
travel: Sophanem, also known as the City of the Dead, is a plague-ridden city located in the southern end of the Kharidian Desert.
In order to gain access, players need to partially progress through Icthlarin's Little Helper.

sophanem dungeon.name: Sophanem Dungeon
sophanem dungeon.summary: The Sophanem Dungeon is a series of tunnels under Sophanem which are filled with a variety of scabarites. It is a dangerous dungeon, especially on the cavern level, with many monsters over level 100, which all use different attack styles, making it hard to protect-pray from them. Also, the monsters can roam all over the place and they all have high max-hits, which can kill a weak player in a matter of seconds. A light source is required for the full dungeon.
travel: The Sophanem Dungeon is a series of tunnels under Sophanem which are filled with a variety of scabarites.

sourhog cave.name: Sourhog Cave
sourhog cave.summary: The Sourhog Cave is the home to the Sourhog. Located just east of Draynor Manor, the cave serves as a battleground for the A Porcine of Interest quest. A Dwarf multicannon can be used here. {| | |}
travel: Located just east of Draynor Manor, the cave serves as a battleground for the A Porcine of Interest quest.

south falador farm.name: South Falador Farm
south falador farm.summary: The South Falador Farm is a large farm between Falador and Port Sarim. Found in the north-eastern edge of the farm, there is a herb patch, a flower patch, and two allotment patches that can be used to train Farming. A tool leprechaun and compost bin are located nearby, and Elstan will watch over your crops for you if you pay him. Players that have completed the medium Falador Diary will receive 10% more Farming experience from these patches. In the farm building, Sarah runs a Farming shop that stocks various farming items, such as sacks and baskets. The building also has a loom, which can be used to created certain items using Crafting.
transportNotes: Use the Explorer's ring 2 and up from the Lumbridge & Draynor Diary to teleport to the farm's cabbage patch.
Amulet of glory to Draynor Village then run west.
Use Falador Teleport and run south to the farm.
Charter a ship to Port Sarim and run north.
If players have their house in Rimmington, they can cast Teleport to House and run to the farm.
If players have a spirit tree grown in Port Sarim, they can teleport there and run north.
If players have unlocked the Rat Pits, they can use the Minigame Teleport spell to Port Sarim and run north.
travel: The South Falador Farm is a large farm between Falador and Port Sarim.
Found in the north-eastern edge of the farm, there is a herb patch, a flower patch, and two allotment patches that can be used to train Farming.

south-west wilderness mine.name: South-west Wilderness mine
south-west wilderness mine.summary: The south-west Wilderness mine is located in level 9 Wilderness, just north-west of Edgeville, north of the Black Knights' Fortress, and south of the Dark Warriors' Fortress. This Mining site is a very rich coal mine since it contains over 30 coal rocks, which is sizeable in comparison to the Mining Guild, but players have to rely on running to safety or teleporting if attacked by player killers. This mine is recommended when the Mining Guild or other coal sites are crowded, or for players with a high Combat level. *The level 22 skeletons are aggressive to players of all levels and become tolerant after 10 minutes. Only the three skeletons carrying circular shields drop anything beside bones. *If players want to avoid additional monster encounters, they should travel north/south along the edge of the Black Knights' Fortress. *The closest bank is in Edgeville. *Because of the large amount of coal present here, this place is excellent for players wishing to use Superheat Item to smelt ores into bars.
travel: The south-west Wilderness mine is located in level 9 Wilderness, just north-west of Edgeville, north of the Black Knights' Fortress, and south of the Dark Warriors' Fortress.
*If players want to avoid additional monster encounters, they should travel north/south along the edge of the Black Knights' Fortress.

stalker den.name: Stalker Den
stalker den.summary: The Stalker Den is a cave located beneath the Custodia Pass. Limited access to the den is gained during Shadows of Custodia quest, but full access to the area and monsters requires its full completion. It is inhabited by Custodian stalkers, of which there are three main types: juvenile, mature, and elder Custodian stalkers, requiring 54, 67 and 76 Slayer in order to be harmed, respectively. Baby custodian stalkers also wander the caves but cannot be attacked. A book called On Migration Patterns and a noose wand can be found near a corpse in the western section of the cave. Ancient Zygomites and rod fishing spots can be found around the spring in the centre of the dungeon. With level 64 Agility, a stepping stone can be used to cross the water and quickly reach the elder Custodian stalkers in the north. The south-western sections of the dungeon are entirely multicombat, and cannons can be placed, while two caves in the south-east and two in the north are single-way combat.
transportNotes: Southern entrance requiring 59 Agility ()
Quetzal to Auburnvale, run west then north.
After activating the Statue of Ates, use the Pendant of Ates to go to Nemus Retreat then run north.
Fairy ring Fairy ring AIS to Auburn Valley, then run north-west.
Fairy ring Fairy ring BLS to Kebos Lowlands, then run south to the pass, then take the rowboat across the lake, then enter the cave south east.
