Use Xeric's Talisman to Xeric's Honour, descending to South of Quidamortem with the Mountain Guide, then running south.
travel: Kebos Lowlands, south of Mount Quidamortem
Follow Custodia Pass to the northern den entrance
caveats: The southern entrance needs 59 Agility; the northern entrance avoids that requirement.
Rooms differ between single and multi-combat; cannon use depends on the room.

stonecutter outpost.name: Stonecutter Outpost
stonecutter outpost.summary: The Stonecutter Outpost is a mining site located at the eastern coast of the Avium Savannah, just south-east of the Locus Oasis in the continent of Varlamore. Metla, a dwarven stonemason, sells high-level Construction materials in her store, similar to the Keldagrim Stonemason. Avinia can be seen wandering around the mining site. This mine is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for power-mining. South of the outpost is a cave entrance, where players can attempt to enter. However, the cave is currently inaccessible due to a large amount of rocks blocking the way. There is a rowboat east of the outpost, which can be unlocked by building the utility at the destination, Vatrachos Island, with 10 swamp paste and 8 camphor planks. This requires 46 Sailing, 50 Construction, and completion of the quest Children of the Sun.
travel: The Stonecutter Outpost is a mining site located at the eastern coast of the Avium Savannah, just south-east of the Locus Oasis in the continent of Varlamore.
South of the outpost is a cave entrance, where players can attempt to enter.

stronghold slayer cave.name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
stronghold slayer cave.summary: The Stronghold Slayer Cave, also known as the Stronghold Slayer Dungeon, is a dungeon located beneath the Tree Gnome Stronghold. It contains a small variety of monsters that are commonly assigned to players. The cave entrance is located next to Nieve (or Steve, after the events of Monkey Madness II). Anyone can enter the dungeon, but players can only attack the Slayer monster they were assigned, and only while the task has not been completed. The Slayer ring can teleport players to the entrance of the cave. A dwarf multicannon can be used in the dungeon. There is a shortcut in the dungeon requiring 72 Agility (can be boosted) to use. This allows the player to reach aberrant spectres and ankou more quickly. It may be used to exit the dungeon faster, but doing so without the required Agility level deals up to 12 damage.
transportNotes: The entrance to the Stronghold Slayer Cave is located in the Gnome Stronghold near Nieve, who is located just south-west of the spirit tree. ()
There are various ways to get there:
Use a Slayer ring to teleport directly to the entrance by Nieve.
Use the gnome glider to Ta Quir Priw, which will take you to the Grand Tree. Exit the Grand Tree and run south-west to the entrance.
Use the spirit tree to the Gnome Stronghold and run south-west.
Use the necklace of passage to Teleport to 'Outpost' and then run north-east.
Use the royal seed pod to Teleport to the Grand Tree, then run south-west.
Use the Achievement diary cape to Teleport to Elder Gnome child, then run south-west.
travel: The Stronghold Slayer Cave, also known as the Stronghold Slayer Dungeon, is a dungeon located beneath the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
The cave entrance is located next to Nieve (or Steve, after the events of Monkey Madness II).

sunbleak cave.name: Sunbleak Cave
sunbleak cave.summary: Sunbleak Cave is a dungeon found in the middle of Sunbleak Island. The cave contains some rocks which can be mined and a few giant bats and spiders. A skeleton is in an inaccessible room behind a barred door.
travel: Sunbleak Cave is a dungeon found in the middle of Sunbleak Island.
A skeleton is in an inaccessible room behind a barred door.
caveats: The island approach needs an adamant helm. The skeleton behind the barred door cannot be attacked.

sunbleak island.name: Sunbleak Island
sunbleak island.summary: Sunbleak Island is an island in the Shrouded Ocean. Mooring at the island requires 72 Sailing as well as an adamant helm to traverse the surrounding tangled kelp. The island is home to the Sunbleak Cave, 14 ironwood trees, 6 tortoises, and three buildable utilities: a bank chest, cooking pot, and water pump. A lockbox is located west of the cave entrance. It can be opened using the small key (Laguna Aurorae) to obtain the dragon helm schematic.
transportNotes: The island can only be reached by sailing there in a boat.
Use a Necklace of passage, a Slayer ring, or a Slayer ring (eternal) to teleport to Wyrmscraig, summon your boat, and sail north-west.
Use the sailors' amulet to teleport to Deepfin Point, summon your boat, and sail south-east.
travel: A lockbox is located west of the cave entrance.
caveats: An adamant helm is required for the tangled kelp on the approach.

tai bwo wannai.name: Tai Bwo Wannai
tai bwo wannai.summary: Tai Bwo Wannai, meaning 'small clearing in the jungle', is a village located south of Brimhaven in the jungle of Karamja. It is home to a number of villagers. Unfortunately for its residents, the surrounding jungle grows back rapidly after being cut down, often housing deadly broodoo victims with high health, strong damage, and stat-reducing spells.
transportNotes: Several methods exist for reaching the village:
Fairy ring CKR — south of the village.
— Cairn Island. Leaves from Port Khazard for a fee of 20-50 coins.
or better — Shilo Village. With 79 Agility, players can scale the rocks near the north-eastern corner of the village wall.
— nature altar, south-east of the village. Players will be skulled if they are not wearing an abyssal bracelet when entering the Abyss.
— east of the village. Players can only use it if coming from the Feldip Hills, and if they provide two raw or cooked chompies. Due to its strange placement and requirements, it is rarely used.
Finally, players can dock at Cairn Isle at level 42 Sailing and run north.
travel: Tai Bwo Wannai, meaning 'small clearing in the jungle', is a village located south of Brimhaven in the jungle of Karamja.

tal teklan.name: Tal Teklan
tal teklan.summary: Tal Teklan is a location in Varlamore, within the Tlati Rainforest. It was the first major settlement of the Talkasti people. Scrambled! takes place in Tal Teklan.
transportNotes: To get to this location, players can use:
The Quetzal Transport System. The landing site does not have to be built.
Achilka's boat service from Kastori. (Travel to Kastori with the Pendant of Ates and then run a short distance south-east to Achilka.)
travel: Tal Teklan is a location in Varlamore, within the Tlati Rainforest.

tarn's lair.name: Tarn's Lair
tarn's lair.summary: Tarn's Lair is located in south-western Morytania. Its entrance is located in the Abandoned Mine. It is a complex dungeon with lots of the undead, and features a miniquest to kill Tarn Razorlor called Lair of Tarn Razorlor. Completion of the miniquest unlocks the ability to enchant a Salve amulet and turn it into a Salve amulet (e). After the miniquest, the lair is mostly visited for an elite clue scroll that directs the player to dig at the toad batta spawn inside, or for ironmen looking to kill zombies for early rune nails or ranging potions. Players cannot set up a dwarf multicannon within the lair. If players attempt to do so, a chatbox message will state This temple is ancient and would probably collapse if you started firing a cannon.
transportNotes: The lair is found inside the Abandoned Mine and requires a Salve amulet to enter.
The fastest way to get to Tarn is to teleport to Tarn's Lair via a Slayer ring. This will bring you directly outside of the room with Tarn.
The fastest way to get to the entrance through the Abandoned Mine is using the Morytania legs 3 to teleport to Burgh de Rott and hop over the Agility shortcut west of the town.
Using the Minigame Teleport to Shades of Mort'ton or the Mort'ton teleport scroll will place you directly in Mort'ton, which is north-east of the Abandoned Mine.
By fairy ring Fairy ring BIP (50 Agility needed) and then walking south.
To enter Tarn's Lair, climb over the mine cart just south of the Zealot (featured in the Haunted Mine quest), go through the entrance of the Abandoned Mine, and then head north of the entrance.
travel: Tarn's Lair is located in south-western Morytania.
Its entrance is located in the Abandoned Mine.
caveats: Bring a salve amulet for the Abandoned Mine entrance. A Slayer ring is an alternative approach.

taverley dungeon.name: Taverley Dungeon
taverley dungeon.summary: The Taverley Dungeon is one of the largest dungeons in Old School RuneScape. There are many monsters, ranging from low to high combat levels, getting stronger as players venture deeper into the dungeon. These include poisonous monsters, so bringing antipoison potions is advised if travelling through the parts of the dungeon that contain them. Taverley Dungeon is entirely single combat (although cannons can still attack multiple targets if the player is not in direct combat).
transportNotes: The entrance to the dungeon is found south of Taverley and west of Falador. Ways of getting there include:
Teleport to House if your house is in Taverley, or Taverley teleport tablet.
Falador Teleport spell or tablet.
Balloon transport system to Taverley.
The south portal in the Wizards' Guild (requires 66 Magic) of Yanille brings the player to the Dark Wizards' Tower located just south.
Skills necklace teleport to Crafting Guild, then run north.
Burthorpe Games Room Minigame Teleport or games necklace to Burthorpe, then run south.
Portal to the Heroes' Guild in the Myths' Guild, then run south.
travel: These include poisonous monsters, so bringing antipoison potions is advised if travelling through the parts of the dungeon that contain them.

tear of the soul.name: Tear of the Soul
tear of the soul.summary: Tear of the Soul is an island south-east of the Isle of Souls. Level 61 Sailing is required to moor at the island (not boostable), along with a boat furnished with an inoculation station (can be a friend's boat, though 61 Sailing will still be required); however, the island can be accessed without protection from fetid waters by carefully navigating a boat on the edge of the hazardous water near the mooring point. A small key can be dug up on the island, two tiles west of the rowboat/rowboat space. This key can be used to unlock a lockbox on Buccaneers' Haven containing an eternal brazier schematic. Sleve McDichael offers services to rename boats here at the cost of 1 cider, and Biles can exchange banknotes for 5 coins per banknote. Yew trees, sand crabs, and an iron axe spawn can also be found on the island. The island also has two burnt trees, although they are unreachable. It contains one hard tier treasure trail step.
transportNotes: Disembark at the mooring point by sailing to the island (61 Sailing).
Teleport to the Isle of Souls via the Soul Wars Portal or Minigame Teleport, then run south-east and take the rowboat (must be constructed first, see below).
travel: Edgeville Soul Wars portal
Isle of Souls: south-east shore
Take the unlocked rowboat to Tear of the Soul
caveats: Sailing 61 and an inoculation station for mooring; alternatively use the rowboat from the Isle of Souls. Do not apply the Sailing requirement to the rowboat route.
tear of the soul.confirmation: The rowboat must first be built, or use the 61 Sailing mooring route with an inoculation station.

temple of ikov (dungeon).name: Temple of Ikov (dungeon)
temple of ikov (dungeon).summary: The Temple of Ikov is a dungeon underneath Hemenster. The main entrance to the dungeon is located south of the Ranging Guild. The second entrance inside the house in McGrubor's Wood requires a shiny key. There are no requirements to access the dungeon, however players that have not completed the Temple of Ikov quest will need to wear a pendant of Lucien to pass through the gates north-west of the southern entrance. The dungeon is also the only place that contains the boots of lightness (except through Perdu). Players must bring a knife or a slash weapon, as well as a light source, and go down the stairs near the entrance of the dungeon. Players must slash the web to collect the boots on the other side of the small room, which will lower weight by 4.535 kg when equipped. The Temple of Ikov is the site of the only remaining temple of Armadyl in Gielinor, on the other side of the dungeon, and is inhabited by the Guardians of Armadyl. This is also where the Staff of Armadyl was located. The guardians serve to protect the Staff of Armadyl, a very powerful staff used by Zamorak to betray Zaros and ascend to godhood at the end of the Second Age.
travel: The main entrance to the dungeon is located south of the Ranging Guild.
The second entrance inside the house in McGrubor's Wood requires a shiny key.

temple of marimbo.name: Temple of Marimbo
temple of marimbo.summary: The Temple of Marimbo is a temple in Marim, Ape Atoll; it is dedicated to the monkey goddess, Marimbo. Marimbo takes the shape of a giant gorilla, yet she is a shapeshifter. The temple is only accessible during and after Monkey Madness I. Players can use the temple for melee training without needing food or prayer potions, being able to top up their prayer at the nearby gorilla statue. Players may use Dharok the Wretched's set bonus along with the use of Protect from Melee to fight the Monkey Guards within, as they will only fight using melee. Using this method, players can keep their hitpoints at 1 to maximize damage dealt. Taking a few anti-poisons with you is recommended as the nearby level 1 spiders can poison you. The altar being so close-by also allows the player to take advantage of extra damage boosting prayers, such as Incredible Reflexes, Ultimate Strength, Chivalry, or Piety. Since the guards occasionally heal, a single guard can award a large amount of exp whilst being relatively low effort. The bearded guards near the trapdoor will block players from moving past them, similar to barricades in Castle Wars, so it's best to avoid positioning yourself between two of them, as greegrees cannot be equipped during combat. A greegree is not required after completing Monkey Madness II, but the guards will no longer be aggressive. The Temple of Marimbo Dungeon is found under the temple, and is visited during Monkey Madness I and the Awowogei section of Recipe for Disaster q
travel: Grand Tree: Daero, then Waydar
Crash Island: speak to Lumdo
Ape Atoll: follow the relevant temple or tunnel entrance
caveats: A greegree and quest travel steps may still be needed. Monkey Madness II removes surface hostility, not all dungeon dangers.

temple of marimbo dungeon.name: Temple of Marimbo Dungeon
temple of marimbo dungeon.summary: The Temple of Marimbo Dungeon is found under the Temple of Marimbo, on Ape Atoll. It can be entered through the trapdoor found at the east end on the 0 of the temple. The dungeon is composed of three distinct parts. The first area is visited during Monkey Madness I, in which the player makes m'speak amulets with one of the two wall of flames. This area contains some Monkey Zombies and spiders. Large monkey zombies are found on the upper area, spiders are found in the lower area, and small monkey zombies are found all over the cave. A small crevice in the middle of the first area leads to a small cave with a long, hot rock on which players may cook stuffed snakes for the Awowogei portion of Recipe for Disaster. However, a line of hot rocks blocks the players' way, and stepping on it results in rapidly taking 1 damage each tick along with the message Players must hold a zombie monkey greegree to pass this. West of the first area is a small tunnel filled with traps and a few more monkey zombies, which leads to a wooden door that cannot be opened or even examined. Beyond the door is a large cave crawling with monkey zombies, as well as an inaccessible monkey skull that can only be obtained after completing the hard Western Provinces Diary. A dwarf multicannon can be placed in this area, an ideal spot to place it is 4 tiles west and 1 tile south of the small crevice in the wall labelled Exit (used during Monkey Madness I). The player can stand in the small alcove 2 tiles south of
travel: Grand Tree: Daero, then Waydar
Crash Island: speak to Lumdo
Ape Atoll: follow the relevant temple or tunnel entrance
caveats: A greegree and quest travel steps may still be needed. Monkey Madness II removes surface hostility, not all dungeon dangers.

tenzing.name: Tenzing
tenzing.summary: Tenzing is a living in the house just west of Burthorpe. The player needs to go through his house to take the secret path past Death Plateau on the way to Trollheim. He is involved in the Death Plateau and Troll Romance quests. He sells climbing boots for 12 coins each. To get to him, follow the path north of the Warriors' Guild then go west once there's a fork in the path. Continue up to reach the house. Open the gate, knock on the door and talk to him (you must have completed Death Plateau to equip these boots). If you try to open the door before learning of the secret path, he will shoo the player away saying "No milk today! Thank you!"
travel: Tenzing is a living in the house just west of Burthorpe.
He sells climbing boots for 12 coins each.

the dibber.name: The Dibber
the dibber.summary: The Dibber is a peninsula, north-east of the Hosidius Vinery. It is populated by Hobgoblins. Seaweed and snape grass can be found along the coastline.
travel: The Dibber is a peninsula, north-east of the Hosidius Vinery.
Seaweed and snape grass can be found along the coastline.

the forgotten cemetery.name: The Forgotten Cemetery
the forgotten cemetery.summary: The Forgotten Cemetery is a minor area in the Wilderness at around level 30. It contains ankou, ghosts, skeletons, zombies, and a man. The cemetery is visited by those wishing to complete the Wilderness Diary, as a medium task requires the player to kill an ankou in the Wilderness and is the one of the two locations where they can be found. The Agility shortcut (level 60) just north-west of the cemetery is a one-way shortcut from the God Wars Dungeon into the Wilderness. Ian's Wilderness Cape Shop, which sells the “X” pattern team capes, can be found inside the cemetery itself. The cemetery is often visited as it contains a location for a coordinate hard clue.
transportNotes: Use Cemetery Teleport (spell or portal in POH) or the Cemetery teleport tablet, which will teleport you directly to the cemetery.
Use Dareeyak Teleport or Dareeyak teleport tablet, which will teleport you to ruins, south of the cemetery.
Use burning amulet to teleport to Lava Maze, then run south-west. This WILL take you to level 41 Wilderness.
If you have access to choose a Wilderness Obelisk, you can select the level 27, teleport, and run west.
travel: The cemetery is visited by those wishing to complete the Wilderness Diary, as a medium task requires the player to kill an ankou in the Wilderness and is the one of the two locations where they can be found.
The Agility shortcut (level 60) just north-west of the cemetery is a one-way shortcut from the God Wars Dungeon into the Wilderness.

the great conch.name: The Great Conch
the great conch.summary: The Great Conch is a large island located in the Unquiet Ocean south of Menaphos. It is the home of the Tortugan species. A settlement named The Summer Shore is located on the southern shore and has a docking point requiring 45 Sailing and partial completion of Troubled Tortugans to use. Among the island's features are a calquat patch to the west of the Summer Shore, a coral patch off the eastern dock, Woodcutting trees including jatoba and camphor trees, Mining spots, an area for crab trapping, hermit crabs for combat training as well as the Gryphon slayer monsters and their boss variant, the Shellbane Gryphon. The Tortugan quest series is a series of quests taking place on and around the Great Conch. Starting Troubled Tortugans, the first quest in the series, is required to access the Great Conch.
transportNotes: After starting the quest Troubled Tortugans and giving the bandage to Floopa, the Great Conch can be visited by:
Using the fairy ring Fairy ring CJQ
Sailing to the docking point on the south side of the island
travel: The Great Conch is a large island located in the Unquiet Ocean south of Menaphos.
A settlement named The Summer Shore is located on the southern shore and has a docking point requiring 45 Sailing and partial completion of Troubled Tortugans to use.
caveats: Give Floopa the bandage during Troubled Tortugans. Charter ships/fairy ring CJQ avoid imposing the 45 Sailing mooring requirement on every route.

the hollows.name: The Hollows
the hollows.summary: The Hollows is an area in the middle of Mort Myre Swamp that gets its name because of the caverns and tunnels that lie underneath that section of the swamp. Cyreg Paddlehorn takes you here from Mort'ton. The Hollows are fairly close to some hollow trees, which can be chopped using the Woodcutting skill for bark. The bark is used in the making of splitbark armour, an armour for mages.
transportNotes: The Hollows are a somewhat remote area of the Mort Myre Swamp. Players who have completed the Priest in Peril quest can walk to them directly. Players who have started or completed In Aid of the Myreque can reach them via a cave from Canifis or by using Cyreg Paddlehorn's boat in Mort'ton, for a fee of 10 coins. (The boat journey from the Hollows back to Mort'ton is free.) Fairy ring Fairy ring DLS also provides quick access to the Hollows, as described below.
travel: The Hollows is an area in the middle of Mort Myre Swamp that gets its name because of the caverns and tunnels that lie underneath that section of the swamp.

the node.name: The Node
the node.summary: The Node is a group of three small islands just south of Tutorial Island that are only accessible to Group Ironman players. The islands are connected to each other via bridges, resembling an upside-down Ironman helm. Together, the islands form the southern-most part of the kingdom of Misthalin.
travel: The Node is a group of three small islands just south of Tutorial Island that are only accessible to Group Ironman players.
The islands are connected to each other via bridges, resembling an upside-down Ironman helm.
caveats: Group Ironman formation area; not a normal repeatable Slayer route for arbitrary characters.

the onyx crest.name: The Onyx Crest
the onyx crest.summary: The Onyx Crest is an island located south-west of The Great Conch, in the Unquiet Ocean. Docking at the island requires level 47 Sailing. It is a volcanic island, with the forming volcano still fully visible on the west side of the island. Two fishing spots for lantern harpooning are found on the eastern shore. Multiple butterfly ray spawns are present near the mooring point. Small key (The Onyx Crest) can be dug up on the island, requiring a spade. It is used to obtain the gale catcher schematic from a chest on Anglers' Retreat. On the east side of the volcano, the nest of a fearless bird can be charted. A medallion fragment can be obtained by killing or pickpocketing the pirates on the island.
travel: The Onyx Crest is an island located south-west of The Great Conch, in the Unquiet Ocean.
It is a volcanic island, with the forming volcano still fully visible on the west side of the island.

the pandemonium.name: The Pandemonium
the pandemonium.summary: The Pandemonium is a collection of ships connected to an island off the eastern coast of Karamja. It contains a dungeon, an eponymous pub, a bank crab, and a dock. It is first accessed during the Pandemonium quest and serves as a starting place to begin training Sailing.
transportNotes: All methods of travelling to the Pandemonium require progressing the Pandemonium quest to the point where you visit the island.
Teleport with the sailors' amulet (requires 1 law rune and 10 water runes per 10 charges)
Teleport with a Sailing cape, either directly, or to a docked boat with a Greater Teleport Focus
Sail with your ship and dock at the island
Teleport to Boat (if it's at the island, requiring a Greater Teleport Focus and either 67 Magic or a tablet)
Charter Captain Tobias' ship from Port Sarim (requires 30 coins, or Ring of Charos(a))
Charter Customs officer's ship from Musa Point (requires 30 coins - lowered to 15 coins, if wearing Karamja gloves, or free if wearing Ring of Charos(a))
Taking a charter ship from any charter location except Port Sarim or Musa Point
travel: The Pandemonium is a collection of ships connected to an island off the eastern coast of Karamja.
It is first accessed during the Pandemonium quest and serves as a starting place to begin training Sailing.

the proudspire.name: The Proudspire
the proudspire.summary: The Proudspire is the largest mountain within Varlamore, being part of the Hailstorm Mountains, the range flanking the capital of Civitas illa Fortis. It is famous enough that Emperor Imafore Tullus gave the Kourend royal family a tour of "the peak of the Proudspire", among other places. The Proudspire is mainly visited by players through Treasure Trails, directing them to dig near the obelisk. There are two Agility shortcuts on the path to the peak, with the lower shortcut requiring 45 Agility and the upper shortcut requiring 71 Agility. Other than that, there are currently no other useful features at its peak. The Twilight Temple teleport on the Pendant of Ates is the closest teleport. Slightly further, the peak is equidistant from the Quetzacalli Gorge quetzal and Salvager Overlook quetzal. Players may wish to bring a stamina potion as it is nearly 400 tiles from the peak to any teleport if not using the shortcuts.
travel: The Proudspire is the largest mountain within Varlamore, being part of the Hailstorm Mountains, the range flanking the capital of Civitas illa Fortis.

the warrens.name: The Warrens
the warrens.summary: The Warrens is a sewer located beneath Port Piscarilius, accessed by climbing down the manhole located in the centre of the port. It is visited during The Queen of Thieves quest. The Warrens is home to pirates, thieves, and homeless men and women. The Saviours of Kourend gang, led by the Queen of Thieves, makes their headquarters here, which is guarded by Devan Rutter.
transportNotes: The manhole can be quickly accessed with the The Fisher's Flute teleport of Kharedst's memoirs or the Book of the Dead.
travel: The Warrens is a sewer located beneath Port Piscarilius, accessed by climbing down the manhole located in the centre of the port.

tonali cavern.name: Tonali Cavern
tonali cavern.summary: The Tonali Cavern is a dungeon located beneath the Crypt of Tonali in the Tlati Rainforest region of Varlamore. Accessing it requires completion of the The Final Dawn quest. It features a number of Slayer monsters and leads to the Ruins of Mokhaiotl. The central section contains a lift which can be activated to allow a two-way transit from the central section to the Tlati Rainforest. West of this lift is a chest which can be looted to obtain two tonali teleporters, which allow instant teleportation between the two nodes, provided that they are placed within a 30 tile range from each other. The western Moon chamber contains grimy lizards, while the eastern Sun chamber contains earthen nagua, both of which are in a multicombat area and only appear after completion of the quest. Players cannot set up a dwarf multicannon within the cavern. Attempting to do so yields the chatbox message: "An ancient magical force won't let you set up a cannon here."
transportNotes: Mokhaiotl waystones can be used to teleport directly inside the Ruins of Mokhaiotl, then run south to the cavern.
The Pendant of Ates can be used to teleport to Kastori just east of the cavern's entrances.
The Quetzal Transport System can be used to land at Tal Teklan or Kastori, both near the cavern's entrances.
travel: Tlati Rainforest
Crypt of Tonali entrance
Descend to the requested chamber
caveats: This is not Neypotzli. The Moon and Sun chambers and the lift have their own positions.

tree gnome stronghold.name: Tree Gnome Stronghold
tree gnome stronghold.summary: The Tree Gnome Stronghold, sometimes shortened to Gnome Stronghold, also called Ta Quir Priw in Gnomish, is one of the largest cities in Gielinor and is populated solely by gnomes. Its most notable features are the Grand Tree, the Gnome Stronghold agility course, the Gnome Ball field, and the Stronghold Slayer Cave. As the largest gnome settlement, it is considered the capital of the Gnomish Empire. Most of the stronghold was constructed by Oaknock, a famous gnomish engineer and architect, near the end of the Fourth Age.
transportNotes: Gnome glider after completing The Grand Tree quest - top level of the Grand Tree

Transport to near Varrock, the peak of White Wolf Mountain, Al Kharid, Grand Tree, Karamja, Feldip Hills (after finishing the One Small Favour quest), and Ape Atoll (after finishing the Monkey Madness II quest).
A Spirit tree (used after completing The Grand Tree quest)
Transport to Tree Gnome Village, Grand Exchange, Battlefield of Khazard, Myths' Guild, Prifddinas and various player-grown spirit trees.
Balloon transport system after completing the Enlightened Journey quest
Transport to Entrana, Taverley, Crafting Guild, Varrock, and Castle Wars

Grand seed pods from the Gnome Restaurant minigame - these may be used to instantly transport a player to the Grand Tree by either launching or squashing them. They are consumed when used and are very expensive.
Royal seed pod - a particular kind of seed pod with unlimited charges, that takes its user directly to the throne room.
travel: The Tree Gnome Stronghold, sometimes shortened to Gnome Stronghold, also called Ta Quir Priw in Gnomish, is one of the largest cities in Gielinor and is populated solely by gnomes.

tree gnome village (location).name: Tree Gnome Village (location)
tree gnome village (location).summary: The Tree Gnome Village is a village led by King Bolren. Part of the Gnomish Kingdoms, it lies at the centre of a giant hedge maze. To enter the village, navigate the gnome maze and then squeeze through the loose railing. Once you've reached the centre and started the Tree Gnome Village quest, Elkoy will offer you quick travel between the maze entrance and the village.
transportNotes: Spirit Tree teleport directly to the centre of the maze.
Fairy ring to (Fairy ring CIQ) and run west and then north.
Ardougne cloak teleport to Ardougne Monastery and run west.
Inside the city is a house portal, which can be reached with a House Teleport spell or tablet if your player-owned house is located in Yanille.
A Yanille tablet (made from using a scroll of redirection on a house tablet) can be used to teleport to the Yanille house portal, even if your house is located elsewhere.
Minigame teleport to Fishing Trawler and run west.
Ardougne Teleport (tablet), run south.
Ring of dueling, from Castle Wars--this is a longer walk but has no skill or quest requirements.
travel: Once you've reached the centre and started the Tree Gnome Village quest, Elkoy will offer you quick travel between the maze entrance and the village.

tree gnome village dungeon.name: Tree Gnome Village dungeon
tree gnome village dungeon.summary: The Tree Gnome Village Dungeon is found beneath the Tree Gnome Village. Its surface entrance is in the maze just south of the main village area. The dungeon features in Waterfall Quest, where players visit it to obtain glarial's pebble from Golrie. To reach Golrie, a key must first be obtained from the eastern room, which is inhabited by zombies and giant bats. The key is found in the large crate in the south-east corner that is coloured differently from the rest of the crates. The key can then be used in the western room full of hobgoblins to unlock the door Golrie is imprisoned behind. After starting Roving Elves, Golrie and the hobgoblins swap positions, and the key to the now-imprisoned hobgoblins can instead be obtained by simply speaking to Golrie. During The Path of Glouphrie, the player gains access to a storeroom in the east of the dungeon, containing a singing bowl as well as Yewnock's anti-illusion machine.
travel: The Tree Gnome Village Dungeon is found beneath the Tree Gnome Village.
Its surface entrance is in the maze just south of the main village area.

troll arena.name: Troll Arena
troll arena.summary: The Troll arena is a combat arena used by trolls in the Troll Country. The arena is on one route to Trollheim and the Troll Stronghold. Players can enter the area during and after the Troll Stronghold quest. The player fights trolls in the arena is in two quests: Troll Stronghold, against Dad, and Troll Romance, against Arrg. Several troll spectators are present at the arena to watch the fights. These trolls are not aggressive but players can fight them if they wish. An instanced version of the troll arena is also the location of a battle against three drink trolls: The rocks, Chuck up, and Daddy's special water, upon drinking the bottle of fishier bladderier stout.
travel: The Troll arena is a combat arena used by trolls in the Troll Country.

troll stronghold (location).name: Troll Stronghold (location)
troll stronghold (location).summary: The Troll Stronghold is a stronghold inhabited by mountain trolls in the Troll Country, carved into the side of the mountain that the Mountain Camp is situated on top of. Notable trolls found inside include Burntmeat, My Arm, Ug and Kob from various quests involving trolls. The Stronghold has three levels, with the top level having some small windows carved out into the rock that overlook the aforementioned camp. The Troll Stronghold Storeroom, which contains the trolls' hoard of the rare herb, Goutweed, can also be found within the stronghold. The storeroom revolves around an activity in which players can steal Goutweed. Many of the trolls in the stronghold are aggressive. Quest-related trolls as well as troll cooks are not aggressive. The troll guards in the storeroom will not fight players but will hit (once) and expel any they catch in the storeroom. On the roof of the stronghold, there is a herb farming patch, which cannot become diseased, accessible to players who have completed the quest My Arm's Big Adventure.
transportNotes: The main entrance to the stronghold is situated west of Trollheim, found atop a small slope found east of the small camp of trolls. This entrance takes you directly to the top floor of the stronghold. Players can get to Trollheim by using the standard spellbook spell Trollheim Teleport if they have completed the Eadgar's Ruse quest or by walking there from Burthorpe (Climbing boots are required).

There is also a southern entrance unlocked during the Troll Stronghold quest, found situated in a mountain passage between Burthorpe and the Fremennik Province (climbing boots are also required). This entrance grants access to the strongholds lowest level, where the trolls keep their prisoners. Players very commonly use the fairy ring system to get nearby - using the combination Fairy ring AJR (Kandarin), which takes them just south-west of this entrance. You must remember climbing boots to scale the rocks to get to this entrance.

After the quest Making Friends with My Arm players can create Stony basalt, which can be used to teleport to the entrance of the stronghold. After the Hard Fremennik Diary and with 73 Agility this teleport is changed to the roof of the stronghold near the herb patch.
travel: Notable trolls found inside include Burntmeat, My Arm, Ug and Kob from various quests involving trolls.
The Troll Stronghold Storeroom, which contains the trolls' hoard of the rare herb, Goutweed, can also be found within the stronghold.

trollweiss dungeon.name: Trollweiss Dungeon
trollweiss dungeon.summary: The Trollweiss Dungeon is a dangerous tunnel filled with ice trolls. These always appear in groups of four and can hit very high. The entrance to the dungeon is located by the Ice Gate, a few steps north-west of the troll child and his parents. In the north-west of the dungeon is a small crevasse in a wall. When climbed through, you emerge at the brow of Trollweiss Mountain. You can sled down (beware of ice wolves) to get a trollweiss flower or go east to Brambickle the gnome explorer. The dungeon is mostly abandoned.
travel: The entrance to the dungeon is located by the Ice Gate, a few steps north-west of the troll child and his parents.
In the north-west of the dungeon is a small crevasse in a wall.

trollweiss mountain.name: Trollweiss Mountain
trollweiss mountain.summary: Trollweiss Mountain is a snowy mountain located in Troll Country and is one of the largest mountains in Gielinor. The Troll Romance quest must be completed, and players must have a sled to travel over it. It is covered year-round in a thick layer of ice and snow, and powerful winds constantly sweep across it. Because of this harsh environment, little can survive apart from ice wolves, evergreen trees, and the endangered Trollweiss flower. To reach the mountain peak, players must enter a cave north of the Troll Stronghold and just west of the Ice Path. The cave is filled with ice trolls and leads to the summit. On the summit, the gnomish explorer Brambickle can be found, along with a tunnel that leads to a fort owned by the Mahjarrat Zemouregal. The mountain slopes down steeply from north to south, making northward travel impossible on land. Players must use a sled to slide down from the summit. Along the slope are an uncut sapphire, multiple chaos rune spawns, and another sled in case players lose theirs. At the base of the mountain is a tunnel that leads to both Keldagrim and the Fremennik Province. Sliding down the slope rewards the player with 25 Agility experience. There are two animations for sliding down the slope, one where player will go over a jump, and one where player will crash into rocks. Crashing into rocks causes no damage to the player.
transportNotes: The entrance to Trollweiss Mountain is not marked on the world map. Don't forget to bring your waxed sled if intending to traverse down the mountain!
To reach the top of Trollweiss Mountain:
Teleport to Trollheim using Ghommal's hilt/Trollheim Teleport/Stony basalt.
Go up the path north-west of Trollheim (use Protect from Missiles if the Thrower trolls target you).
Enter the dungeon entrance to the west at the top of the path.
Leave through the exit to the north-west. Beware of Ice trolls (Protect from Melee is effective here).
travel: Trollweiss Mountain is a snowy mountain located in Troll Country and is one of the largest mountains in Gielinor.
The Troll Romance quest must be completed, and players must have a sled to travel over it.
caveats: Bring a waxed sled for descending. The passage through Trollweiss Dungeon is a different location.

twilight temple.name: Twilight Temple
twilight temple.summary: The Twilight Temple is a temple compound in Varlamore. It was initially a temple dedicated to Ranul built under the reign of Emperor Imafore, which was considered blasphemous and thus was abandoned for many years until the Twilight Emissaries began using it as their base of operations. The temple is the main setting in The Heart of Darkness. The player and Prince Itzla explore the temple buildings and underground whilst infiltrating the Twilight Emissaries to investigate them. The player must be wearing all pieces of the Twilight Emissary Robes to enter the temple during and after the quest. The robes can be reobtained from a chest on the ground floor of the Tower of Ascension. Whilst inside the temple, players who attempt to remove any part of the robes will receive the message,
transportNotes: Use the Pendant of Ates to teleport to the Statue of Ates at the Temple
Take the Quetzal Transport System to Salvager Overlook (must be built before it can be used) and run east
travel: The Twilight Temple is a temple compound in Varlamore.

tyras camp.name: Tyras Camp
tyras camp.summary: The Tyras camp is a camp formed by King Tyras and his soldiers, located in a secluded part of the elven forest of Isafdar. Isafdar and the camp can only be accessed after starting the Regicide quest.
transportNotes: The Tyras camp can be reached in several ways, all of which require partial (or full) completion of Regicide. Listed here in order from closest to furthest:
— Port Tyras, slightly south of the camp (costs ).
Fairy ring BJS — island west of the camp (requires 76 Agility to leave the island).
— Iorwerth Camp, north of the Tyras Camp.
— Prifddinas, well north of the camp.
— Zul-Andra, south of the camp.
— Lletya, well to the east of the poison waste.
travel: The Tyras camp is a camp formed by King Tyras and his soldiers, located in a secluded part of the elven forest of Isafdar.
Isafdar and the camp can only be accessed after starting the Regicide quest.
caveats: Forest obstacles and traps remain. The Arandar gate is a separate completed-quest route.

tzhaar fight cave.name: TzHaar Fight Cave
tzhaar fight cave.summary: The TzHaar Fight Cave, commonly referred to as the Fight Caves, is a combat minigame in the outer area of Mor Ul Rek, located within the Karamja volcano. Fully completing it is considered an early major challenge players will take on in Old School RuneScape. It involves single-handedly fighting off 63 waves of volcanic creatures, including a boss fight against the strongest of the creatures: TzTok-Jad. Players will be rewarded with Tokkul for playing this minigame, and if they manage to defeat TzTok-Jad, they will be rewarded with the fire cape. The Fight Cave was created by the TzHaar-Xil, who use it for practice.
transportNotes: Using the "TzHaar Fight Pit" Minigame Teleport.
Using the Fairy ring BLP fairy ring and running north.
travel: The TzHaar Fight Cave, commonly referred to as the Fight Caves, is a combat minigame in the outer area of Mor Ul Rek, located within the Karamja volcano.
caveats: TzTok-Jad is reached through the full wave sequence, not by walking directly to a normal spawn.

underground pass (dungeon).name: Underground Pass (dungeon)
underground pass (dungeon).summary: The Underground Pass is one of the pathways to reach Tirannwn, the elven lands of western Gielinor. Traversing the enormous and hostile dungeon is the focus of the eponymous Underground Pass quest.
travel: The Underground Pass is one of the pathways to reach Tirannwn, the elven lands of western Gielinor.

underwater.name: Underwater
underwater.summary: Underwater is a location just off the northern coast of Fossil Island. In order to enter the underwater area, a player must first travel to a small island via rowboat by choosing the option row out to sea, located at the northern tip of the island (transportation icon ). On this smaller island, a player can then select Dive on the rowboat to enter the underwater section. They will also find a bank on this island, which can be used to quickly grab required items. After a player has travelled here once, a new option is unlocked when using the Museum Camp rowboat, allowing quick travel to this island. While the fishbowl helmet and diving apparatus are not required to dive, it is heavily suggested that players bring them in order to extend their visit. Flippers can also be worn in order to "run" underwater and swim faster, though the player is limited by weighing no more than 27kg to do so. Weapons can be wielded underwater; however, they prevent players from being able to swim. Shield-slot items such as defenders cannot be wielded whatsoever. Attempting to access the deeper areas with a weapon equipped or while weighing 28kg and above will cause the player to drown. The Medallion of the Deep can be worn in this area, regardless of whether the fishbowl helmet and diving apparatus are also equipped. The underwater area cannot be accessed in PvP worlds or the permanent Deadman world.
travel: Underwater is a location just off the northern coast of Fossil Island.

In order to enter the underwater area, a player must first travel to a small island via rowboat by choosing the option row out to sea, located at the northern tip of the island (transportation icon ).

ungael.name: Ungael
ungael.summary: Ungael is an island located in the northernmost region of the Northern Ocean. An abandoned dragonkin fortress and laboratory can be found here. It can be reached by boarding Torfinn's boat directly north of the Rellekka marketplace. Sometime during the Dragonkin Conflicts, it was used as the base of operations for Zorgoth's experiments, which took place in the laboratory underneath the island. Here, he brought spores and fungi from Lithkren to Ungael to use for his experiments. It is here in which Zorgoth created Vorkath, and left it there in order to guard the route to the laboratory from invading humans. Vorkath remains on the island after over 2,000 years, and is fought during Dragon Slayer II in order to retrieve a dragon key piece hidden by Robert the Strong in the laboratory. After the quest, Vorkath can be fought again as a stronger boss. Near the stone table in the north-western corner of the island lies a single glass of dragon bitter.
travel: Ungael is an island located in the northernmost region of the Northern Ocean.
An abandoned dragonkin fortress and laboratory can be found here.

uzer oasis.name: Uzer Oasis
uzer oasis.summary: The Uzer Oasis is a small settlement found directly south of the ruins of the Ruins of Uzer. The oasis contains three homes and the Uzer Mastaba, a ruined mastaba on a hill to the south. Little history is known about the area, although it likely shares some history with the nearby ruins. Various rockslides, tropical trees, and oasis trees surround the oasis at the centre of the settlement. Various crates dot the area, but do not contain any items.
transportNotes: to the Eagle's Eyrie — north-west of the oasis.
Fairy ring DLQ — just west of the oasis, near the desert lizards.
— Temple of Elidinis in Nardah.
— Jaleustrophos (Simon Templeton's camp), decent south of the oasis.
— Pollnivneach house portal, far west of the oasis.
travel: The Uzer Oasis is a small settlement found directly south of the ruins of the Ruins of Uzer.
The oasis contains three homes and the Uzer Mastaba, a ruined mastaba on a hill to the south.

varrock.name: Varrock
varrock.summary: Varrock (Jagex pronunciation: ) is the capital of the kingdom of Misthalin. It is one of the largest cities in Old School RuneScape, and the largest city available to free players. In addition to being popular due to its proximity to the Wilderness, the city hosts the massive Grand Exchange, through which players can trade any item they wish, and features in many of the quests throughout the game. Varrock can be entered from all sides, and each entrance has non-aggressive level 21 guards surrounding it. The city is safe for all players, although care should be taken when coming from Lumbridge through the south entrance, as there are aggressive level 7 and 20 dark wizards.
transportNotes: Varrock's size and importance results in a number of options for reaching different parts of the city:
, , and Fairy ring DKR — Grand Exchange.
— Varrock town centre, or Grand Exchange after completing the medium Varrock diary.
— Cooks' Guild, just south of the Grand Exchange.
and — Champions' Guild, south-east of the southern city entrance.
— Champions' Guild, Barbarian Village, and Edgeville.
— Toby, just south of the town centre.
— Bryophyta's lair in the Varrock sewers.
travel: Varrock can be entered from all sides, and each entrance has non-aggressive level 21 guards surrounding it.
The city is safe for all players, although care should be taken when coming from Lumbridge through the south entrance, as there are aggressive level 7 and 20 dark wizards.

varrock palace.name: Varrock Palace
varrock palace.summary: Varrock Palace is the official residence of the ruler of Misthalin as well as the nation's primary diplomatic and military centre. Located in central Varrock, it is the largest building in the city. Since the Fourth Age, Varrock Palace has been a hub of economic, political, and social development within Misthalin. The palace currently houses King Roald III and his wife, Queen Ellamaria. As their full-time residence, it is equipped with kitchens, barracks, dining areas, a church, a large garden, troop housing areas, and other facilities. The Varrock Library is also housed here. Amongst players, the palace is popular for its guards, who are commonly killed for Combat training and pickpocketed for Thieving training and profit. It also houses a Farming patch and several species of tree for Woodcutting. Its connection to Varrock Square makes it a popular route of travel. The palace also plays a large role in a number of quests and other in-game activities.
travel: Located in central Varrock, it is the largest building in the city.
Its connection to Varrock Square makes it a popular route of travel.

varrock sewers.name: Varrock Sewers
varrock sewers.summary: The Varrock Sewers are a network of tunnels under the city of Varrock. It is a fairly large multi-combat underground area filled with low to mid-level monsters and is one of the largest dungeons in free-to-play. A knife, slashing weapon, or sharp-object (e.g. scimitar) is required to access certain parts of the sewer to cut a spider web (note: a throwing knife will not work). The dwarf multicannon can be used here, making it a decent place to farm mossy keys outside of the Wilderness.
transportNotes: The Varrock Sewers can be accessed via a manhole just east of Varrock Palace. Members can also access the sewers through Edgeville Dungeon by using a pipe shortcut near Vannaka - this requires 51 Agility, and drops players off near some of the moss giants.
A giantsoul amulet can be used to teleport directly into the sewers, in front of Bryophyta's lair.
travel: scimitar) is required to access certain parts of the sewer to cut a spider web (note: a throwing knife will not work).

vatrachos island.name: Vatrachos Island
vatrachos island.summary: Vatrachos Island is an island east of Varlamore. It requires 46 Sailing to moor on, as well as completion of the quest Children of the Sun. It contains fishing spots to catch raw lobster, raw tuna, and raw swordfish, mining spots and a rusty chest. It also contains multiple buildable utilities. Thigo can be found here, mining peacefully. Once the rowboat is built, the player may travel to and from the island using a rowboat on the coast east of the Stonecutter Outpost. Using various edible fruits on the raccoon to the north side of the island will reward the player with one of the medallion fragments used to create the medallion of the deep.
travel: Vatrachos Island is an island east of Varlamore.
Thigo can be found here, mining peacefully.
caveats: The 46 Sailing mooring route has a built-rowboat alternative from Stonecutter Outpost.
vatrachos island.confirmation: Confirm the built rowboat from Stonecutter Outpost, or the 46 Sailing mooring route.

ver sinhaza.name: Ver Sinhaza
ver sinhaza.summary: Ver Sinhaza is a castle found in the southern sector of Meiyerditch, where the vampyre noble Verzik Vitur currently resides. Beneath the castle is the Theatre of Blood, where people take on ferocious monsters and challenges set up by Verzik to provide entertainment for the vampyres. According to Garth, the castle was once home to the Saradominist queen, Queen Efaritay.
transportNotes: Players who have completed A Taste of Hope may teleport directly to Ver Sinhaza by rubbing Drakan's medallion. Alternatively, players may pay 10,000 coins to Andras north of the Ectofuntus in Port Phasmatys to travel to Slepe, then run south from there. Players can also use an Ectophial to travel to the Ectofuntus and run south from there.
Otherwise, the player will need to traverse from Burgh de Rott and ride the boat there to Meiyerditch.
travel: Ver Sinhaza is a castle found in the southern sector of Meiyerditch, where the vampyre noble Verzik Vitur currently resides.

vet'ion's rest.name: Vet'ion's Rest
vet'ion's rest.summary: Vet'ion's Rest is the lair of Vet'ion, a skeletal Zamorakian warrior. It is a multi-combat dungeon located in the Wilderness, just south of Lava Dragon Isle. Entering the boss lair requires completion of the medium Wilderness diary OR a Vet'ion boss Slayer task, and pay a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. This fee is shared across Callisto's Den, Hunter's End, the Skeletal Tomb, Vet'ion's Rest, the Silk Chasm, the Web Chasm and the Escape Caves. The fee does not need to be paid again, unless the player dies to another player without having left the Wilderness since their most recent visit to a boss lair or the Escape Caves. If this happens, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer, and needs to be paid again to re-enter the boss lairs. Players can decrease the fee by killing the six bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins. Like the Silk Chasm and Callisto's Den, players exiting Vet'ion's Rest will always arrive at one of three points within the Escape Caves at random. Note that any player who exits within 10 seconds of the previous player will arrive at the same point, meaning player killers can pursue their targets through the boss lair. Upon entering the lair, players will be unable to teleport for 3 ticks. This delay no longer occurs after completion of the hard Wilderness diary. In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have
travel: It is a multi-combat dungeon located in the Wilderness, just south of Lava Dragon Isle.
In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills registered in their name.
vet'ion's rest.confirmation: Requires medium Wilderness diary OR a specific Vet'ion boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.
caveats: A generic bear, skeleton or spider assignment does not bypass the diary gate. PvP risk applies.

virer hunting ground.name: Virer Hunting Ground
virer hunting ground.summary: Virer Hunting Ground is an area in Vampyrium located south-west of Sangvesti. Twelve venators can be found to the west, while a swarm of letvek can be found to the east. Of these twelve venators, one of them is on a hill overlooking the hunting grounds and can only be attacked with ranged.
travel: Virer Hunting Ground is an area in Vampyrium located south-west of Sangvesti.
Twelve venators can be found to the west, while a swarm of letvek can be found to the east.

viyeldi caves.name: Viyeldi caves
viyeldi caves.summary: The Viyeldi caves, named after their resident spirit Viyeldi, are the lower floor of a cave system located in the Kharazi Jungle in southern Karamja. They play a major role in Legends' Quest, of which partial completion is required for access to the caves. The Viyeldi caves may be visited after the quest for the purpose of a master cryptic step. Additionally, barrels in the room just above the caves (containing the winch used to enter) can be smashed for a chance at random treasure, such as noted cooked sharks.
transportNotes: The caves are accessed using a winch at the end of the Shaman Caves, which in turn are accessed via a mossy rock in the north-western part of the Kharazi Jungle.

With 91 Agility, a shortcut down the cliff-face in the final room of the Shaman Caves is available. One long rope must first be used on the rocks next to the blue hat after completion of Legends' Quest.
With 96 Agility, a crevice may be squeezed through directly from the Shaman Caves entrance.
To navigate the caves after the quest (below 96 Agility), bring the following items:
Lockpick (note: a Strange old lockpick will not work)
Means to cast any Charge Orb spell (3 cosmic runes and 30 elemental runes)
Any axe and any machete to access the Kharazi Jungle (unless using the eastern level 79 Agility shortcut, which is farther away)
Spade, if doing a master clue scroll
travel: South of Shilo Village
Cut into Kharazi Jungle with an axe and machete
Mossy rock in the north-west: Shaman Caves; winch leads deeper
caveats: These are Karamja caves, not Lizardman shaman caves. Deeper routes need the relevant quest steps, ropes and tools.

warriors' guild.name: Warriors' Guild
warriors' guild.summary: The Warriors' Guild is a large building located in the west of Burthorpe, founded by Harrallak Menarous. Only players with a combined Attack and Strength level of at least 130 (or level 99 in either skill), are allowed entry by the guild's guard Ghommal (or Laidee Gnonock after the events of While Guthix Sleeps). Temporary boosts cannot be used. Inside the guild, players may play various minigames related to melee combat. These activities reward warrior guild tokens, which grant access to the top floor and basement of the guild where players can kill cyclopes for defenders. Cannons cannot be used to complete activities within the guild. Players wearing an Attack cape can enter these areas without tokens. When the rewards for the easy or medium tier of the combat achievements have been claimed from Ghommal or Laidee, the amount of tokens earned throughout the guild will be respectively doubled or tripled.
transportNotes: The Warriors' Guild can be easily accessed in a number of ways;
Combat bracelet or Strength cape to teleport directly to the Warriors' Guild.
Games necklace to teleport to Burthorpe, then head west.
Minigame Teleport to the Burthorpe Games Room, then head west.
House teleport (if a player's house is in Taverley) or a Taverley teleport tablet, then head north.
Balloon transport system to Taverley (requires partial completion of Enlightened Journey), then head north-west.
travel: The Warriors' Guild is a large building located in the west of Burthorpe, founded by Harrallak Menarous.

Only players with a combined Attack and Strength level of at least 130 (or level 99 in either skill), are allowed entry by the guild's guard Ghommal (or Laidee Gnonock after the events of While Guthix Sleeps).
caveats: 99 Attack or 99 Strength also permits entry. Temporary boosts do not count. Cyclopes still need tokens or the cape exemption and the correct defender tier.

waterbirth island.name: Waterbirth Island
waterbirth island.summary: Waterbirth Island is a snowy, crescent-shaped island found in the Northern Ocean, off the coast of Rellekka. The island is primarily known for the Waterbirth Island Dungeon, a multi-level dungeon that is home to a variety of dangerous monsters, including the powerful Dagannoth Kings. Bardur is located in this dungeon, constantly fighting a group of dagannoth fledgelings. The surface of the island contains several Rock Crabs and hobgoblins, as well as an abundance of snape grass. Jarvald and Askeladden can also be found here. While on the surface of the island, snowflakes will appear to fall on the player's screen as a visual effect.
transportNotes: Players can get to the island via one of the following methods:
Speak to Jarvald at the Rellekka docks to travel to the island via boat (the player does not have to start or complete The Fremennik Trials; costs 1,000 coins each time if the quest is not complete)
Use a Waterbirth teleport tablet
Use an enchanted lyre (with completion of the hard tier of the Fremennik Diary)
Cast Waterbirth Teleport (requires access to the Lunar spellbook and level 72 Magic)
Cast or be in range of another player casting Tele Group Waterbirth (casting requires access to the Lunar spellbook and level 73 Magic)
Teleport via a portal chamber or portal nexus in a player-owned house (requires the house owner to set up the portal first).
Through a mooring point with 74 Sailing.
travel: Waterbirth Island is a snowy, crescent-shaped island found in the Northern Ocean, off the coast of Rellekka.
Bardur is located in this dungeon, constantly fighting a group of dagannoth fledgelings.

waterbirth island dungeon.name: Waterbirth Island Dungeon
waterbirth island dungeon.summary: Waterbirth Dungeon is a large dungeon found on Waterbirth Island and consists of several sublevels that contain powerful, aggressive monsters. Players must be prepared to encounter all three combat styles. Few safespots are available, so those adventurers who wish to explore the dungeon must take caution.
travel: Waterbirth Dungeon is a large dungeon found on Waterbirth Island and consists of several sublevels that contain powerful, aggressive monsters.

waterfall dungeon.name: Waterfall Dungeon
waterfall dungeon.summary: The Waterfall Dungeon is a set of connected caverns underneath the Baxtorian Falls. The dungeon can be accessed during and after the completion of the Waterfall Quest, and is an important destination in the quest. {| | |}
transportNotes: Note: Players must use a rope to reach the dungeon's entrance unless they have completed the medium Kandarin Diary. Players who have not completed Waterfall Quest must also have Glarial's amulet in their inventory (or be wearing it) to gain entry to the dungeon - it is not needed after the quest.
A quick way of getting to Baxtorian Falls is using a games necklace and travelling to Barbarian Outpost, then running south.
When you have both of these items, go to the house above the Baxtorian Falls. West of it, behind a gate, there is a log raft. Click the raft to ride it and you will crash into a little island.

Do not use the available left-click option to swim to the rock to the south; instead, use your rope on that rock. Once you have safely reached the rock, you are at the top of the Baxtorian Falls. Again, do not fall for the left-click option on the dead tree, but use your rope on that tree to climb down.

You now will be on a small ledge with a barrel and an entrance. If you have completed Waterfall Quest or have Glarial's amulet with you, you may safely enter the dungeon. Otherwise, the barrel allows you to leave the ledge without losing Hitpoints.

If you try to enter without the amulet, or if you forgot to use the rope instead of either of the left-click options, you will fall down the waterfall and wash up to the south, losing 8 Hitpoints. You will then have to run back north onto the top of the waterfall and start over.
travel: The dungeon can be accessed during and after the completion of the Waterfall Quest, and is an important destination in the quest.

web chasm.name: Web Chasm
web chasm.summary: The Web Chasm is the lair of Spindel. It is a singles-plus combat dungeon located in the eastern ruins north of the Graveyard of Shadows. To enter the lair, players must have completed the hard Wilderness diary, OR they must have a Venenatis boss Slayer task (a spider Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement). The entrance and lair itself is in level 29 Wilderness, meaning items that can teleport players above level 20 Wilderness are recommended in the event of player killers arriving. Entering the boss lairs requires players to pay a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. This fee is shared across Callisto's Den, Hunter's End, the Skeletal Tomb, Vet'ion's Rest, the Silk Chasm, the Web Chasm and the Escape Caves. The fee does not need to be paid again, unless the player dies to another player without having left the Wilderness since their most recent visit to a boss lair or the Escape Caves. If this happens, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer, and needs to be paid again to re-enter the boss lairs. Players can decrease the fee by killing the six bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins. Upon entering the lair, if players have recently attacked Spindel, they will be unable to teleport for 3 ticks unless they have completed the hard Wilderness diary. In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills register
travel: It is a singles-plus combat dungeon located in the eastern ruins north of the Graveyard of Shadows.
The entrance and lair itself is in level 29 Wilderness, meaning items that can teleport players above level 20 Wilderness are recommended in the event of player killers arriving.
web chasm.confirmation: Requires hard Wilderness diary OR a specific Venenatis boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.
caveats: A generic bear, skeleton or spider assignment does not bypass the diary gate. PvP risk applies.

weiss.name: Weiss
weiss.summary: Weiss is an ice troll settlement located in the North, requiring partial completion of Making Friends with My Arm to access. Below the settlement are the salt mine and the Ghorrock Dungeon.
transportNotes: All methods of accessing Weiss require at least partial completion of the quest Making Friends with My Arm.

Weiss has one teleport, icy basalt, which teleports players near the herb patches in the western section of town. A permanent version of the teleport can be built in a player-owned home. Players who obtain the frozen tablet from Duke Sucellus may also use the ring of shadows to teleport to the dungeon beneath the settlement.

Players can also use Larry's boat north-east of Rellekka to sail to Weiss. Larry can be reached a number of ways, including fairy ring code Fairy ring DKS, the Fremennik sea boots, or the enchanted lyre. Finally, players with 80 Sailing can dock at the mooring point after completing the quest.
travel: Weiss is an ice troll settlement located in the North, requiring partial completion of Making Friends with My Arm to access.

west ardougne.name: West Ardougne
west ardougne.summary: West Ardougne is the western part of the capital city of Ardougne, which has been quarantined due to a mysterious plague. It is first accessible to players during the Plague City quest.
transportNotes: Several teleports bring players in or near West Ardougne, listed here with their teleport destinations:
— city centre. This is the only direct teleport into West Ardougne.
— East Ardougne. From here, players then have several methods of entry:
Through the pipe under Edmond's house (during and after Plague City. Unavailable after starting Biohazard).
Via shortcut over the wall via Omart (during Plague City, before returning the distillator to Elena)
Through the main gate from East Ardougne (after Plague City has been completed)
— the Outpost, north-west of the city.
Coming from Tirannwn via the Underground Pass.
travel: West Ardougne is the western part of the capital city of Ardougne, which has been quarantined due to a mysterious plague.
It is first accessible to players during the Plague City quest.

white wolf mountain.name: White Wolf Mountain
white wolf mountain.summary: The White Wolf Mountain is a natural region in the members-only area. It acts as a mountainous border between Taverley and Catherby, and as a borderline between the kingdoms of Asgarnia and Kandarin. The mountain is notorious for being a dangerous area for low levelled players wishing to travel to Kandarin. The Ice Queen's Lair can be found beneath the mountain, where players can fight the Ice Queen during Heroes' Quest.
transportNotes: Once a player has completed the Fishing Contest quest, a tunnel that travels underneath the mountain becomes accessible. This tunnel features a cart station that leads to Keldagrim. The tunnel proves especially useful to low-level players because it avoids the dangerous monsters that live on White Wolf Mountain.
A gnome glider manned by Captain Bleemadge is located at the centre peak of the mountain, but it is only accessible to players after they have completed The Grand Tree quest.

There is a mithril grapple Agility shortcut located at the entrance of the mountain (when coming from Catherby) that requires 35 Strength, 35 Ranged, 32 Agility. This shortcut, however, can only be used when travelling from Catherby to Taverley.
travel: The mountain is notorious for being a dangerous area for low levelled players wishing to travel to Kandarin.
The Ice Queen's Lair can be found beneath the mountain, where players can fight the Ice Queen during Heroes' Quest.

wilderness.name: Wilderness
wilderness.summary: The Wilderness, also known as the Wild or Wildy, is a large and dangerous wasteland that makes up most of north-eastern Gielinor. The entirety of the Wilderness is a PvP area, except for Ferox Enclave, Mage Arena bank, Corporeal Beast's Lair, and King Black Dragon Lair. When the player is killed by another player, all unprotected items will be lost to the killer. Hardcore ironmen will lose their status if they die to a player, just like they would in the event of any other unsafe death. Two players or multiple players (within multi-combat zones) may fight if their combat levels are within a certain range of each other, increasing the deeper into the Wilderness they go. This, along with very high level monsters and bosses, makes the Wilderness one of the most dangerous places in the game. The area has its own set of achievement diaries, the Wilderness Diaries with tasks relating to the Wilderness and its surrounding area.
transportNotes: Note: Some methods in this section may allow the player to immediately teleport into deep sections of the Wilderness. However, nothing except members' Deserted Keep, KBD and Mage Arena levers allow directly leaving the Wilderness above level 30, and pk-ers may tele-block the player below level 30. Always come prepared, as easy escape may not be readily available in an emergency.
- has teleports to various locations around the Wilderness
- teleports players to Corporeal Beast Cave, where exiting the cave places players in the Wilderness
- teleports players to the Ferox Enclave
- offers five daily teleports to the black chinchompa Hunter area
- teleports players to any of the three Revenant Caves entrances (level 17, 26, or 40)
- offers one daily teleport to the Fountain of Rune
- offers unlimited teleports to the Fountain of Rune
travel: The Wilderness, also known as the Wild or Wildy, is a large and dangerous wasteland that makes up most of north-eastern Gielinor.
The entirety of the Wilderness is a PvP area, except for Ferox Enclave, Mage Arena bank, Corporeal Beast's Lair, and King Black Dragon Lair.

wilderness agility course.name: Wilderness Agility Course
wilderness agility course.summary: The Wilderness Agility Course is a training area located deep in the Wilderness, requiring level 52 Agility to enter, and 49 Agility to complete the first obstacle inside. , taking place in a singles-plus combat area that allows player killers to attack at any time, even if you are already in combat with a monster. The course can be completed either risk-free, or with paid access to the agility dispenser. Tagging the dispenser after completing a lap rewards one Wilderness agility ticket, redeemable for Agility experience, and if the reward fee is paid it also dispenses loot after each lap. The fee is 150,000 coins, which is lost every time a player dies or leaves the course, but is not removed if they log out and remain within the course. This money must be deposited from a player's inventory, unlike other Wilderness fees which can be withdrawn from a bank. On Bounty Hunter worlds, this fee must be paid in order to enter the course. It can be paid at the entrance gate, or at the dispenser on another world before hopping worlds. A counter tracks how many consecutive laps have been completed; a higher number of laps increases the average value of dispenser rewards, in discrete intervals. Even though the coins are not lost when logging out inside the course, doing so will remove 10 laps from the reward lap counter. Lastly, the player must have an open looting bag in their inventory to obtain loot. Looting bags cannot be destroyed within the course. The agility dispenser restores
transportNotes: There are several different methods for traveling to the Wilderness Agility Course. The best options, in order of fastest to slowest, are:

Note that the level 52 Agility requirement is only needed to enter the gates; the level requirement of the obstacles is level 49. Therefore it is possible to use a temporary skill boost to access the course starting at level 47, giving far superior rates to other courses available to the same level.
travel: The Wilderness Agility Course is a training area located deep in the Wilderness, requiring level 52 Agility to enter, and 49 Agility to complete the first obstacle inside.
The course can be completed either risk-free, or with paid access to the agility dispenser.

wilderness agility course dungeon.name: Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon
wilderness agility course dungeon.summary: The Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon is a small dungeon beneath the Wilderness Agility Course in high level Wilderness. It covers level 53 to 56 Wilderness. The dungeon entrance is a ladder in the north-east corner of the Agility course, which is past the rope swing and before the stepping stones. The dungeon contains eight skeletons and four bone spawns. Players who fail the rope swing or log balance obstacles will enter the middle or end of the dungeon by falling on spikes, depending on the obstacle failed. Players who have a skeleton Wilderness Slayer task given by Krystilia may opt to kill them here as it is rarely visited by PKers. Players who are under attack by PKers may use the ladder repeatedly to avoid being attacked for long enough to exit combat and be able to log out and escape.
travel: The dungeon entrance is a ladder in the north-east corner of the Agility course, which is past the rope swing and before the stepping stones.

wilderness god wars dungeon.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
wilderness god wars dungeon.summary: The Wilderness God Wars Dungeon is a multi-combat area located within a cave east of The Forgotten Cemetery at level 28 Wilderness. It contains monsters from the main God Wars Dungeon. The cave was opened to the monsters when an underground tremor caused a deep fissure to open up, which caused the creatures to climb through the fissure and populate the cave. Like the main God Wars Dungeon, all monsters in the dungeon are aggressive to any player unless they have equipped at least one item that is devoted to their god. The entire area counts as the Wilderness. Players will be able to attack you here.
transportNotes: As the dungeon is located within the Wilderness, players must go through the Wilderness to get to the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon. Methods of getting to the dungeon include:

Using the Wilderness Obelisk. The closest obelisk is the level 27 obelisk, located slightly south-east of the entrance. The Wilderness Obelisk system can be quickly accessed from one's player-owned house (80 Construction required), or by teleporting to the Corporeal Beast's cave and running south-east to the level 19 obelisk. Completion of the hard tier of the Wilderness diary allows the player to select the destination obelisk.
Casting the Cemetery Teleport spell on the Arceuus spellbook or the corresponding tablet to The Forgotten Cemetery and running east.
Casting the Dareeyak Teleport spell on the Ancient spellbook or breaking a Dareeyak teleport tablet to the ruins at level 23 Wilderness. Both require completion of Desert Treasure I to use.
Using a burning amulet teleport to the Bandit Camp and running west then north.
Using the agility shortcut from Trollheim puts you much closer than running directly from Edgeville, but requires 64 Agility.
Running directly from the Ferox Enclave.
Running directly to the dungeon from Edgeville.
travel: Level 28 Wilderness, east of the Forgotten Cemetery
Enter the cave
Pass the 60 Strength boulder or 60 Agility wall
caveats: This is not the main God Wars Dungeon. No faction boss-room kill count is required; carry god protection and plan for PvP risk.

wilderness pond.name: Wilderness Pond
wilderness pond.summary: The Wilderness Pond is located in the centre of the Wilderness. It is one of the locations on the River Lum canoe system, which players can travel to by making a waka canoe. There is no canoe station at the pond, so travelling here via canoe is a one way trip. Moss giants can be found around the pond, being the only ones that can be found in the Wilderness. Skeletons and 6 chaos rune spawns can also be found around the pond. Near the pond, there is entrance as well to as a one-way from the Revenant Caves, and to the west, a Wilderness Obelisk can be found.
transportNotes: Wilderness obelisk to level 35 Wilderness and run east.
Revenant cave teleport and run south.
travel: The Wilderness Pond is located in the centre of the Wilderness.
It is one of the locations on the River Lum canoe system, which players can travel to by making a waka canoe.

wilderness slayer cave.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
wilderness slayer cave.summary: The Wilderness Slayer Cave is a cave located beneath the Wilderness. The chambers contain a diverse selection of monsters, located between level 17 to 32 Wilderness. All of the monsters in this cave are commonly assigned by Krystilia as well as other Slayer masters, although the full task list is extensive and most are not found in the cave. Often, monsters in the cave are stronger than their other Wilderness counterparts, and their drop tables are significantly improved. Loot from monsters includes a variety of items from Justine's shop, such as Trouver parchments and Blighted items. While on a Wilderness Slayer task they also have a 15% increased drop rate of Larran's key. The area is desirable to players wishing to quickly complete slayer tasks, as it's possible to use the Dwarf multicannon inside the dungeon. The cave is the only multi-combat spot where the cannon can be used for some monsters. Additionally, as the monsters drop better loot in the cave than in the overworld, it is a popular slayer location despite the added risk; many players use the cave to complete tasks for Krystilia but also for Slayer masters in general. It's usually profitable enough in the cave to justify the cost of deaths (providing the player doesn't risk too much and die too often). The ability to use Wilderness weapons and Slayer helmet(i) means the player has the potential for substantially boosted damage and therefore players can enjoy high experience rates in the cave. Ancients such as the
transportNotes: Level 18 Wilderness — west of Larran's small chest
Level 29 Wilderness — south-west of the Silk Chasm

Games necklace offers a teleport to the Corporeal Beast — players can then run east to the level 18 entrance. This is usually the most convenient location for the southern entrance, as the Corporeal Beast cave is not classed as the Wilderness despite leading directly to it giving the player added security.

Teleporting to Ferox Enclave and running east to the level 18 entrance. This is preferred by many players, as here they are able to bank and it is not a PvP area. It's also possible to restore health, prayer, and run energy here with the Pool of Refreshment. Be aware of others players, you may be more likely to be scouted if running from the Ferox Enclave.

Teleporting to the Wilderness obelisk in level 19 wilderness by using an obelisk built in a player's Superior garden and running east to the level 18 entrance. This is more dangerous as it takes the player directly into the wilderness rather than a safe location.
Using either the Carrallanger teleport or Carrallanger teleport tablet, leading to the Graveyard of Shadows and again running east to the level 18 entrance.
