Breaking a Wilderness crabs teleport tablet and running west to the level 29 entrance — This is not recommended not only due to the high cost of this teleport, but also because it teleports the player to level 33 Wilderness. This means it inherently carries more risk as the player cannot instantly teleport out if a PKer is in the area.

Hunter cape has a teleport to Black chinchompa (Hunter), from here players can run east to arrive at the north entrance. This teleport takes the player to level 32 Wilderness in an active area, so again is not recommended.
travel: The Wilderness Slayer Cave is a cave located beneath the Wilderness.
The chambers contain a diverse selection of monsters, located between level 17 to 32 Wilderness.

wintumber island.name: Wintumber Island
wintumber island.summary: Wintumber Island is an island south of the Isle of Souls. It requires 63 Sailing, unboosted, to moor on. It contains a crab monument that can be charted. Doing so while on the island will also unlock the crab dance emote and gives a medallion fragment. If the player has already charted the monument, the emote and medallion fragment can still be obtained by approaching the monument and attempting to chart it again. If you teleport away from the island, you will need to retrieve your boat via a Shipwright, use one of the boat teleportation spells, or be brought to the island by another player, as there is no other way to get to the island than with a player-owned ship. There is also a pile of inconspicuous rocks for building an Elite STASH unit, several lantern fishing spots, as well as 11 Sand Crabs.
transportNotes: The closest island with a teleport is Deepfin Point, located to the north-west of Wintumber Island. Players can teleport to Deepfin Point with the Sailors' amulet, summon their boat or have Shipwright Sornik recover it, and then sail south-east.
travel: Wintumber Island is an island south of the Isle of Souls.

If you teleport away from the island, you will need to retrieve your boat via a Shipwright, use one of the boat teleportation spells, or be brought to the island by another player, as there is no other way to get to the island than with a player-owned ship.

witchaven dungeon.name: Witchaven Dungeon
witchaven dungeon.summary: The Witchaven Dungeon is a dungeon located below the Pillars of Zanash near Witchaven. It can be accessed via the old ruin entrance. The dungeon is used in a number of quests and is the home to a number of monsters, so it may be advisable to bring food if you are a lower level player. The entire dungeon is single way combat and the dwarf multi-cannon is usable here.
transportNotes: Ardougne Teleport or the tablet then head east.
Fairy ring code Fairy ring BLR and head south.
travel: The Witchaven Dungeon is a dungeon located below the Pillars of Zanash near Witchaven.
It can be accessed via the old ruin entrance.

wizards' guild.name: Wizards' Guild
wizards' guild.summary: The Wizards' Guild, located in Yanille, contains a number of useful resources for those interested in Magic. You must have level 66 Magic to enter. Boosts, such as a wizard's mind bomb at level 63, can be used to enter. Entering the Wizards' Guild is a task in the Hard Ardougne Diary.
transportNotes: Besides walking, there are several fast-transport means to the area near Yanille:
Watchtower Teleport places you in the Watchtower just outside the city walls, or just north of the hunter shop if you've completed the Hard Ardougne Diary.
Teleport to House (if your player-owned house is in Yanille).
A redirected house tablet to Yanille.
Fairy ring code Fairy ring CIQ places you a bit north of the city's western gate.
A ring of dueling can teleport you to Castle Wars, which is just west of Yanille.
Minigame Teleport to the Nightmare Zone.
Ardougne cloak which teleports you to the Ardougne Monastery just north of Yanille
travel: The Wizards' Guild, located in Yanille, contains a number of useful resources for those interested in Magic.

wizards' tower.name: Wizards' Tower
wizards' tower.summary: The Wizards' Tower is located south of Draynor Village, over a bridge. The tower plays a part in many quests.
transportNotes: The fairy ring code Fairy ring DIS teleports you immediately south of the tower.
The necklace of passage teleports you to the bridge just north of the tower.
The Amulet of the Eye teleports the player to the Temple of the Eye, near a portal that takes them to the basement of the guild.
A ring of the elements can provide a teleport near to the Water Altar entrance, east of the tower.
An Achievement diary cape can teleport the player to Twiggy O'Korn north of the tower
An amulet of glory teleport to Draynor Village to the north of the tower.
Players with 66 Magic can enter the east portal on the 2 of the Wizards' Guild.
travel: The Wizards' Tower is located south of Draynor Village, over a bridge.

woodcutting guild.name: Woodcutting Guild
woodcutting guild.summary: The Woodcutting Guild is a members-only guild located in the south-western corner of Hosidius. In order to enter the guild, players must have at least level 60 in Woodcutting (which can be boosted). While inside the guild, players will receive an invisible +7 level boost to their Woodcutting. This boost will stack with any existing boosts the player already has, such as the visible +3 boost from using the dragon axe's special attack, though visible boosts are capped to level 99. However, the invisible boost will not allow a player to perform actions above their base level. In addition, forestry events will not occur while inside the Woodcutting Guild. There is no group Woodcutting bonus whilst cutting trees inside the guild. Entering the Woodcutting Guild is a task in the hard Kourend & Kebos Diary.
transportNotes: Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the front gate.
Use Rada's blessing to teleport to Kourend Woodland and run north-east to enter through the back.
Lovakengj Minecart Network to Hosidius West and run south, or to Kourend Woodland and run west then north.
Minigame Teleport to Tithe Farm and use the Lovakengj Minecart Network, or run West.
Right click Veos, who is located on the northern dock of Port Sarim, to travel to Land's End and head north-east.
Teleport to House while the player's POH is in Hosidius. Redirecting a Teleport to house tablet to a Hosidius teleport tablet via the use of a scroll of redirection works as well.
Take the Fairy Ring to Hosidius Vinery (Fairy ring AKR) and then run west.
Use Xeric's talisman to teleport to Xeric's Lookout and run south.
travel: The Woodcutting Guild is a members-only guild located in the south-western corner of Hosidius.
In order to enter the guild, players must have at least level 60 in Woodcutting (which can be boosted).

wyrmscraig.name: Wyrmscraig
wyrmscraig.summary: Wyrmscraig is an island in The Lonely Sea located in the Unquiet Ocean that requires 62 Sailing to access. Designed as part of the Sailing skill expansion, it was the winning entry of the "Sailing Player-Designed Island" competition held in early 2026. The island is characterised by its unique basalt column geography and its ties to the Icyene race. The island is inhabited by humans, though a small group of trolls lives underground. Wyrms of various types dot both the surface and caves. The island's inhabitants prefer to keep to themselves, seeing outsiders with disdain unless they gain the trust of the village mayor. On the island, players can start the quest Fallen From Grace, which upon completion allows access to a repeatable mid-level boss, the Mad Angel. Additional features of the island include Mortimer, a Slayer Master who exclusively assigns tasks with superior Slayer monsters; golem crafting, a Crafting method that makes use of hunter furs; and goat hunting, a Hunter method.
transportNotes: Sail with your ship and dock at the island, requiring 62 Sailing
Casting Teleport to Boat (if it's docked at the island, requiring 67 Magic and a greater teleport focus)
Necklace of passage (after Fallen From Grace)
Slayer ring (after Fallen From Grace)
Ardeaglais teleport (after Fallen From Grace, dropped by the Mad Angel)
travel: Wyrmscraig is an island in The Lonely Sea located in the Unquiet Ocean that requires 62 Sailing to access.
On the island, players can start the quest Fallen From Grace, which upon completion allows access to a repeatable mid-level boss, the Mad Angel.
caveats: 62 Sailing for first mooring; necklace of passage/Slayer ring destinations unlock through Fallen From Grace.
wyrmscraig.confirmation: Confirm the first 62 Sailing visit or the unlocked Fallen From Grace teleport route.

wyrmscraig cavern.name: Wyrmscraig Cavern
wyrmscraig cavern.summary: The Wyrmscraig Cavern is a dungeon located underneath Wyrmscraig, accessible after partial completion of Fallen From Grace. A mooring point can be used to dock a boat in the cavern; the cave leading to it is too small for a sloop to be navigated here, though a sloop can still be docked via the Summon Boat spell in order to utilise Teleport to Boat. The Slayer Master Mortimer resides here. Five wyrms reside in the cavern, and a large mining area that contains silver, nickel, and a runite rock. A cannon can be set up in the cavern. It also contains the basement of the cathedral on Wyrmscraig, Ardeaglais.
transportNotes: A Slayer ring can teleport to the cavern, after completion of Fallen From Grace. This will teleport the player in the junction connecting to the outer cave, cathedral basement, and wyrms.
Teleport to Boat can be used with a boat docked within the cavern, with a built greater teleport focus boat facility.
Running to the dungeon entrance from a teleport to the surface of Wyrmscraig:
travel: The Wyrmscraig Cavern is a dungeon located underneath Wyrmscraig, accessible after partial completion of Fallen From Grace.

A mooring point can be used to dock a boat in the cavern; the cave leading to it is too small for a sloop to be navigated here, though a sloop can still be docked via the Summon Boat spell in order to utilise Teleport to Boat.

wyvern cave.name: Wyvern Cave
wyvern cave.summary: The Wyvern Cave is a pair of ancient caverns found on Fossil Island. It contains wyverns that were long thought to be extinct. The northern cavern is monitored by Weve (Steve's son) who only allows players on a Slayer task to kill the wyverns inside; the wyverns in the southern cavern can be killed at any time. A dwarf multicannon cannot be set up; attempting to do so will result in "Fungi start eating into the legs of your cannon; you quickly decide not to set it up here."
transportNotes: To get to the cave players have several options:

The northern, task-only cave is is reached via the trapdoor found in the Mushroom Forest . To get to the cave, use the digsite pendant to teleport to Fossil Island. Then use the Magic Mushtree to teleport to Mushroom Meadow. Finally run south to the trapdoor.
The regular cave is found south of the Museum Camp . To get to it, teleport to the Digsite. Travel to Fossil Island using the barge, run east past the bank, and then south-east into the cave.
travel: The Wyvern Cave is a pair of ancient caverns found on Fossil Island.
The northern cavern is monitored by Weve (Steve's son) who only allows players on a Slayer task to kill the wyverns inside; the wyverns in the southern cavern can be killed at any time.

xeric's shrine.name: Xeric's Shrine
xeric's shrine.summary: Xeric's Shrine is a temple housed north-east of Mount Quidamortem, north of the Lizardman Settlement in the Kebos Lowlands. Players can recharge their prayer points at the altar in this location. The Swamp Priest lives right outside the shrine. It is also the location for the third hole you climb into during the The Garden of Death quest. It's recommended to bring antipoison potions while moving through this area since the lizardmen can poison you.
travel: Xeric's Shrine is a temple housed north-east of Mount Quidamortem, north of the Lizardman Settlement in the Kebos Lowlands.
It is also the location for the third hole you climb into during the The Garden of Death quest.

yanille.name: Yanille
yanille.summary: Yanille (pronounced "ya-NEEL") is a members-only city south of Ardougne, known for hosting Wizards' Guild. Due to the threat of ogres from nearby Gu'Tanoth, the city is surrounded by tall walls, and is heavily patrolled by guards.
transportNotes: A number of methods exist for teleporting to or near Yanille:
— Yanille house portal. Requires a POH there.
— Nightmare Zone, just outside the eastern entrance.
— Watchtower. After completing Ardougne Hard Diary, the teleport can be switched to the centre of Yanille.
Fairy ring CLS — behind Hazelmere's home on the Yanille Chain.
Fairy ring CIQ — north of the ogre island, just outside the western entrance.
— Port Khazard, a good run north-east of the city.
to Castle Wars — the Castle Wars lobby, well west of the city.
travel: Yanille (pronounced "ya-NEEL") is a members-only city south of Ardougne, known for hosting Wizards' Guild.

yanille agility dungeon.name: Yanille Agility Dungeon
yanille agility dungeon.summary: The Yanille Agility Dungeon (also known as Yanille Dungeon) is the dungeon under the town of Yanille. Part of the dungeon can be entered by players with any Agility level, while other parts have minimum Agility requirements. The experience rewards for using this dungeon are not as good as most other Agility courses, so players rarely come here to train Agility. Instead, players use it to train combat skills using the monsters there and gather their drops. Players training Herblore also use the dungeon, since many monsters here sometimes drop high-level herbs. Torstol, a fairly rare herb, can be obtained here.
transportNotes: Players must go to the Yanille area to reach the dungeon. Other than walking, there are a few ways to get there:
The Watchtower Teleport to the Watchtower, which is quite close to the dungeon's northern entrance. This teleport ability is a reward of the Watchtower quest.
Minigame Teleport to Nightmare Zone.
The Teleport to House to Yanille, if the player has a house and has located it in Yanille.
The ring of dueling or Minigame Teleport to Castle Wars, which is west of Yanille.
Fairy ring code Fairy ring CIQ, which arrives north-west of Yanille. Partial completion of the quest Fairytale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings.
The dungeon has two entrances ():

The northern entrance is in a small house north of the Yanille city walls. It is very close to the shortcut under the wall by the farming patch. A spider web blocks the entrance to the house. Players must either bring a knife or have a slashing weapon to cut through the web before they can enter the house. To come further than the giant bats when you enter the dungeon, you need an Agility level of at least 40.
travel: The Yanille Agility Dungeon (also known as Yanille Dungeon) is the dungeon under the town of Yanille.

ynysdail.name: Ynysdail
ynysdail.summary: Ynysdail is an island located north of Gwenith. It requires 73 Sailing to moor onto. As Ynysdail is surrounded by crystal-flecked waters, the player will need a boat equipped with an adamant keel or better to safely sail to the island. It has a cave entrance leading to Ynysdail Cavern, which contains Aquanites and mithril, adamantite and runite rocks. Digging right next to the mooring point will give a small key, which unlocks the lockbox on Lledrith Island containing the Dragon salvaging hook schematic. There is also a Reinforced chest on the island. A rowboat space can be built on the island. Upon being built, the player can travel to and from the island from Gwenith. Using the rowboat additionally requires completion of Song of the Elves.
transportNotes: Players can embark from various nearby ports when sailing to Ynysdail. Using a skiff will make it easier to navigate tight spaces and the numerous obstacles in Porth Gwenith and along the coastline. Players can also reach the area directly around Ynysdail by sailing through the green portal to the east of Lledrith Island. Building the rowboat shortcut on Ynysdail will allow players to easily reach it from Gwenith without needing to sail.
Note: The player will need a boat equipped with an adamant keel if sailing.
Teleport to Prifddinas, exit north towards Gwenith, and take the rowboat if built (after completion of Song of the Elves)
Piscatoris teleport to the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, use Summon Boat to teleport your boat to you (note that there is no Shipwright to retrieve your boat at this location), then sail south
Sailor's amulet teleport to Port Roberts, summon your boat (or pay Shipwright), then sail north east
Go to Port Piscarilius, summon your boat (or pay Shipwright), then sail south east
Teleport to Civitas, summon your boat (or pay Shipwright), then sail north east

File:Ynysdail route.png|Ynysdail route if approaching from the west (Can be done with sloop on the way in with a bit a jig but more advised with smaller boats for the way out. Can take the yellow portal just north to head to the shore)
travel: Ynysdail is an island located north of Gwenith.
As Ynysdail is surrounded by crystal-flecked waters, the player will need a boat equipped with an adamant keel or better to safely sail to the island.
ynysdail.confirmation: Confirm 73 Sailing mooring with an adamant keel, or the built Gwenith rowboat after Song of the Elves.
caveats: The Gwenith rowboat avoids a Sailing requirement, but needs Song of the Elves and prior construction. The cavern prohibits cannons.

ynysdail cavern.name: Ynysdail Cavern
ynysdail cavern.summary: Ynysdail Cavern is a dungeon beneath Ynysdail. The dungeon contains several mining spots containing a total of seven mithril, eight adamantite and two runite rocks. It also contains a small assortment of Slayer monsters; rockslugs, jellies and is the only location to house aquanites. The entire dungeon is a single-combat zone and Dwarf multicannons cannot be set in the dungeon; attempting to do so will result in the message "The ground is too damp to set up a cannon here."
travel: Ynysdail Cavern is a dungeon beneath Ynysdail.
ynysdail cavern.confirmation: Confirm 73 Sailing mooring with an adamant keel, or the built Gwenith rowboat after Song of the Elves.
caveats: The Gwenith rowboat avoids a Sailing requirement, but needs Song of the Elves and prior construction. The cavern prohibits cannons.

zanaris.name: Zanaris
zanaris.summary: Zanaris, also known as the Lost City, is the home of the fairies and is the moon of Gielinor. Accessed during the Lost City quest, the settlement is notable for bearing several amenities, such as a marketplace to buy a dragon longsword, and the highly useful fairy ring transportation system. The entrance to Zanaris is located in the shed in Lumbridge Swamp.
transportNotes: The fairy ring code for the main portal in Zanaris is Fairy ring BKS. Zanaris can also be accessed by wielding a dramen staff or lunar staff and entering the small hut in the middle of Lumbridge Swamp, north-west of the Mining tutor, Monlum, in the East Lumbridge Swamp mine. Players can also gain access via The Abyss to the Cosmic Altar.
There is a one-way fairy ring to Al Kharid bank from the market area.
travel: Accessed during the Lost City quest, the settlement is notable for bearing several amenities, such as a marketplace to buy a dragon longsword, and the highly useful fairy ring transportation system.
The entrance to Zanaris is located in the shed in Lumbridge Swamp.

dense essence mine.name: dense essence mine
dense essence mine.summary: The dense essence mine is located north-east of Arceuus. Overseen by Clerris, the mine contains two dense runestones, where players can mine dense essence blocks, which are then used on the Dark Altar to create dark essence blocks. In order to use this mine, players require level 38 Mining and 38 Crafting. A pickaxe and chisel in the player's inventory is required to mine the dense runestone, granting 12 Mining and 8 Crafting experience per block mined. It is not possible to get a rock golem pet from mining here. After completion of the medium tasks in the Kourend & Kebos Diary, players have a chance to mine two dense essence blocks at once. No additional experience is awarded for the extra block. While only 38 Mining is required to mine the essence, a higher Mining level is slightly helpful, as the essence stone depletes less frequently with a higher Mining level. At level 38 Mining there is a 85% chance to not deplete the dense runestone when successfully mining a dense essence block, increasing to 90% at level 99. In order to use the shortcuts leading to and from the mine, players need to have 73 Agility for the western rock scramble, 69 for the northern scramble and 52 for the eastern scramble. A boulder a little further to the north-east meanwhile requires 49 Agility to jump over.
travel: The dense essence mine is located north-east of Arceuus.
In order to use the shortcuts leading to and from the mine, players need to have 73 Agility for the western rock scramble, 69 for the northern scramble and 52 for the eastern scramble.
